sanskrit: अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् । होतारं रत्नधातमम् ॥
translation: I Laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice, The hotar, lavishest of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निः पूर्वेभिर्ऋषिभिरीड्यो नूतनैरुत । स देवाँ एह वक्षति ॥
translation: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers. He shall bring hitherward the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निना रयिमश्नवत्पोषमेव दिवेदिवे । यशसं वीरवत्तमम् ॥
translation: Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing day by day, Most rich in heroes, glorious.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने यं यज्ञमध्वरं विश्वतः परिभूरसि । स इद्देवेषु गच्छति ॥
translation: Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about Verily goeth to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्होता कविक्रतुः सत्यश्चित्रश्रवस्तमः । देवो देवेभिरा गमत् ॥
translation: May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great, The God, come hither with the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदङ्ग दाशुषे त्वमग्ने भद्रं करिष्यसि । तवेत्तत्सत्यमङ्गिरः ॥
translation: Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper, That, Angiras, is indeed thy truth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे दोषावस्तर्धिया वयम् । नमो भरन्त एमसि ॥
translation: To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer Bringing thee reverence, we come
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राजन्तमध्वराणां गोपामृतस्य दीदिविम् । वर्धमानं स्वे दमे ॥
translation: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One, Increasing in thine own abode.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पितेव सूनवेऽग्ने सूपायनो भव । सचस्वा नः स्वस्तये ॥
translation: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son: Agni, be with us for our weal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायवा याहि दर्शतेमे सोमा अरंकृताः । तेषां पाहि श्रुधी हवम् ॥
translation: BEAUTIFUL Vâyu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared: Drink of them, hearken to our call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाय उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते त्वामच्छा जरितारः । सुतसोमा अहर्विदः ॥
translation: Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify Thee, Vâyu, with their hymns of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायो तव प्रपृञ्चती धेना जिगाति दाशुषे । उरूची सोमपीतये ॥
translation: Vâyu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper, Far-spreading for the Soma draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरा गतम् । इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि ॥
translation: These, Indra-Vâyu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties' sake: The drops are yearning for you both.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायविन्द्रश्च चेतथः सुतानां वाजिनीवसू । तावा यातमुप द्रवत् ॥
translation: Well do ye mark libations, ye Vâyu and Indra, rich in spoil So come ye swiftly hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायविन्द्रश्च सुन्वत आ यातमुप निष्कृतम् । मक्ष्वित्था धिया नरा ॥
translation: Vâyu and Indra, come to what the Soma. presser hath prepared: Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रं हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम् । धियं घृताचीं साधन्ता ॥
translation: Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuṇa, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतेन मित्रावरुणावृतावृधावृतस्पृशा । क्रतुं बृहन्तमाशाथे ॥
translation: Mitra and Varuṇa, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law, Have ye obtained your might power
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कवी नो मित्रावरुणा तुविजाता उरुक्षया । दक्षं दधाते अपसम् ॥
translation: Our Sages, Mitra-Varuṇa, wide dominion, strong by birth, Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना यज्वरीरिषो द्रवत्पाणी शुभस्पती । पुरुभुजा चनस्यतम् ॥
translation: YE Aṣvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands, Accept the sacrificial food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना पुरुदंससा नरा शवीरया धिया । धिष्ण्या वनतं गिरः ॥
translation: Ye Aṣvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise, Accept our songs with mighty thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वृक्तबर्हिषः । आ यातं रुद्रवर्तनी ॥
translation: Nisatyas, wonder-workers, yours arc these libations with clipt grass: Come ye whose paths are red with flame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि चित्रभानो सुता इमे त्वायवः । अण्वीभिस्तना पूतासः ॥
translation: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by fine fingers purified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि धियेषितो विप्रजूतः सुतावतः । उप ब्रह्माणि वाघतः ॥
translation: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers, Of the libation-pouring priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रा याहि तूतुजान उप ब्रह्माणि हरिवः । सुते दधिष्व नश्चनः ॥
translation: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers. In our libation take delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो विश्वे देवास आगत । दाश्वांसो दाशुषः सुतम् ॥
translation: Ye Viṣvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वे देवासो अप्तुरः सुतमागन्त तूर्णयः । उस्रा इव स्वसराणि ॥
translation: Ye Viṣvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught, As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वे देवासो अस्रिध एहिमायासो अद्रुहः । मेधं जुषन्त वह्नयः ॥
translation: The Viṣvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile, Bearers, accept the sacred draught
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावका नः सरस्वती वाजेभिर्वाजिनीवती । यज्ञं वष्टु धियावसुः ॥
translation: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright Sarsavad desire, With eager love, our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चोदयित्री सूनृतानां चेतन्ती सुमतीनाम् । यज्ञं दधे सरस्वती ॥
translation: Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer o all gracious thought, Sarasvatî accept our rite
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महो अर्णः सरस्वती प्र चेतयति केतुना । धियो विश्वा वि राजति ॥
translation: Sarasvatî, the mighty flood,– she with be light illuminates, She brightens every pious thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुरूपकृत्नुमूतये सुदुघामिव गोदुहे । जुहूमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
translation: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds, To our assistance day by day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नः सवना गहि सोमस्य सोमपाः पिब । गोदा इद्रेवतो मदः ॥
translation: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अथा ते अन्तमानां विद्याम सुमतीनाम् । मा नो अति ख्य आ गहि ॥
translation: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परेहि विग्रमस्तृतमिन्द्रं पृच्छा विपश्चितम् । यस्ते सखिभ्य आ वरम् ॥
translation: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत ब्रुवन्तु नो निदो निरन्यतश्चिदारत । दधाना इन्द्र इद्दुवः ॥
translation: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, Ye who serve Indra and none else;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नः सुभगाँ अरिर्वोचेयुर्दस्म कृष्टयः । स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मणि ॥
translation: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एमाशुमाशवे भर यज्ञश्रियं नृमादनम् । पतयन्मन्दयत्सखम् ॥
translation: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice, That to the Friend gives wings and joy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा शतक्रतो घनो वृत्राणामभवः । प्रावो वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
translation: Thou, Ṣatakratu, drankest this and wast the Vr̥itras' slayer; thou Helpest the warrior in the fray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा वाजेषु वाजिनं वाजयामः शतक्रतो । धनानामिन्द्र सातये ॥
translation: We strengthen, Ṣatakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो रायो३वनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा । तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ॥
translation: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend ot'him who pours the juice, yea, to this Indra sing your song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वेता निषीदतेन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । सखायः स्तोमवाहसः ॥
translation: O COME ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरूतमं पुरूणामीशानं वार्याणाम् । इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
translation: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, wi th Soma juice outpoured.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स घा नो योग अ भुवत्स राये स पुरंध्याम् । गमद्वाजेभिरा स नः ॥
translation: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: May he come nigh us with his strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य संस्थे न वृण्वते हरी समत्सु शत्रवः । तस्मा इन्द्राय गायत ॥
translation: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra sing your song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुतपाव्ने सुता इमे शुचयो यन्ति वीतये । सोमासो दध्याशिरः ॥
translation: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सुतस्य पीतये सद्यो वृद्धो अजायथाः । इन्द्र ज्यैष्ठ्याय सुक्रतो ॥
translation: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, Strong Indra, for preeminence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्वाशवः सोमास इन्द्र गिर्वणः । शं ते सन्तु प्रचेतसे ॥
translation: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां स्तोमा अवीवृधन्त्वामुक्था शतक्रतो । त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
translation: Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Ṣatakratu, and our lauds So strengthen thee the songs we sing.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्षितोतिः सनेदिमं वाजमिन्द्रः सहस्रिणम् । यस्मिन्विश्वानि पौंस्या ॥
translation: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold, Wherein all manly powers abide.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो मर्ता अभिद्रुहन्तनूनामिन्द्र गिर्वणः । ईशानो यवया वधम् ॥
translation: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति ब्रध्नमरुषं चरन्तं परितस्थुषः । रोचन्ते रोचना दिवि ॥
translation: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed The lights are shining in the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जन्त्यस्य काम्या हरी विपक्षसा रथे । शोणा धृष्णू नृवाहसा ॥
translation: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन्नकेतवे पेशो मर्या अपेशसे । समुषद्भिरजायथाः ॥
translation: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदह स्वधामनु पुनर्गर्भत्वमेरिरे । दधाना नाम यज्ञियम् ॥
translation: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of' babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial names.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वीळु चिदारुजत्नुभिर्गुहा चिदिन्द्र वह्निभिः । अविन्द उस्रिया अनु ॥
translation: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm ' Foundest the kine even in the cave.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवयन्तो यथा मतिमच्छा विदद्वसुं गिरः । महामनूषत श्रुतम् ॥
translation: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रेण सं हि दृक्षसे संजग्मानो अबिभ्युषा । मन्दू समानवर्चसा ॥
translation: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous, equal in your sheen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनवद्यैरभिद्युभिर्मखः सहस्वदर्चति । गणैरिन्द्रस्य काम्यैः ॥
translation: With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतः परिज्मन्ना गहि दिवो वा रोचनादधि । समस्मिन्नृञ्जते गिरः ॥
translation: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven: Our songs of praise all yearn for this.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि । इन्द्रं महो वा रजसः ॥
translation: Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्गाथिनो बृहदिन्द्रमर्केभिरर्किणः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषत ॥
translation: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र इद्धर्योः सचा संमिश्ल आ वचोयुजा । इन्द्रो वज्री हिरण्ययः ॥
translation: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो दीर्घाय चक्षस आ सूर्यं रोहयद्दिवि । वि गोभिरद्रिमैरयत् ॥
translation: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र वाजेषु नोऽव सहस्रप्रधनेषु च । उग्र उग्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
translation: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वयं महाधन इन्द्रमर्भे हवामहे । युजं वृत्रेषु वज्रिणम् ॥
translation: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो वृषन्नमुं चरुं सत्रादावन्नपावृधि । अस्मभ्यमप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
translation: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुञ्जेतुञ्जे य उत्तरे स्तोमा इन्द्रस्य वज्रिणः । न विन्धे अस्य सुष्टुतिम् ॥
translation: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा यूथेव वंसगः कृष्टीरियर्त्योजसा । ईशानो अप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
translation: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The Ruler irresistible:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य एकश्चर्षणीनां वसूनामिरज्यति । इन्द्रः पञ्च क्षितीनाम् ॥
translation: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race Of those who dwell upon the earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वो विश्वतस्परि हवामहे जनेभ्यः । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
translation: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others', may he be.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र सानसिं रयिं सजित्वानं सदासहम् । वर्षिष्ठमूतये भर ॥
translation: INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि येन मुष्टिहत्यया नि वृत्रा रुणधामहै । त्वोतासो न्यर्वता ॥
translation: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand, By thee assisted with the car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र त्वोतास आ वयं वज्रं घना ददीमहि । जयेम सं युधि स्पृधः ॥
translation: Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं शूरेभिरस्तृभिरिन्द्र त्वया युजा वयम् । सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
translation: With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may We conquer our embattled foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महाँ इन्द्रः परश्च नु महित्वमस्तु वज्रिणे । द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥
translation: Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer: Wide as the heaven extends his power
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समोहे वा य आशत नरस्तोकस्य सनितौ । विप्रासो वा धियायवः ॥
translation: Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः कुक्षिः सोमपातमः समुद्रइव पिन्वते । उर्वीरापो न काकुदः ॥
translation: His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा ह्यस्य सूनृता विरप्शी गोमती मही । पक्वा शाखा न दाशुषे ॥
translation: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा हि ते विभूतय ऊतय इन्द्र मावते । सद्यश्चित्सन्ति दाशुषे ॥
translation: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा ह्यस्य काम्या स्तोम उक्थं च शंस्या । इन्द्राय सोमपीतये ॥
translation: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung, That he may drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रेहि मत्स्यन्धसो विश्वेभिः सोमपर्वभिः । महाँ अभिष्टिरोजसा ॥
translation: COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एमेनं सृजता सुते मन्दिमिन्द्राय मन्दिने । चक्रिं विश्वानि चक्रये ॥
translation: To Indra pour ye forth thejuice, the active gladdening juice to him Ile gladdening, oinnific God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र मन्दिभिः स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणे । सचैषु सवनेष्वा ॥
translation: O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds, Present at these drink-offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृग्रमिन्द्र ते गिरः प्रति त्वामुदहासत । अजोषा वृषभं पतिम् ॥
translation: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And raised themselves unsatisfied.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं चोदय चित्रमर्वाग्राध इन्द्र वरेण्यम् । असदित्ते विभु प्रभु ॥
translation: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of' our wish, For power supreme is only thine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मान्त्सु तत्र चोदयेन्द्र राये रभस्वतः । तुविद्युम्न यशस्वतः ॥
translation: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth, And glorious, O most splendid One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं गोमदिन्द्र वाजवदस्मे पृथु श्रवो बृहत् । विश्वायुर्धेह्यक्षितम् ॥
translation: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength, Lasting our life-time, failing not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहद्द्युम्नं सहस्रसातमम् । इन्द्र ता रथिनीरिषः ॥
translation: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसोरिन्द्रं वसुपतिं गीर्भिर्गृणन्त ऋग्मियम् । होम गन्तारमूतये ॥
translation: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुतेसुते न्योकसे बृहद्बृहत एदरिः । इन्द्राय शूषमर्चति ॥
translation: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गायन्ति त्वा गायत्रिणोऽर्चन्त्यर्कमर्किणः । ब्रह्माणस्त्वा शतक्रत उद्वंशमिव येमिरे ॥
translation: THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee. The priests have raised thee up on high, O Ṣatakratu, like a pole.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सानोः सानुमारुहद्भूर्यस्पष्ट कर्त्वम् । तदिन्द्रो अर्थं चेतति यूथेन वृष्णिरेजति ॥
translation: As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task, Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि केशिना हरी वृषणा कक्ष्यप्रा । अथा न इन्द्र सोमपा गिरामुपश्रुतिं चर ॥
translation: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एहि स्तोमाँ अभिस्वराभि गृणीह्या रुव । ब्रह्म च नो वसो सचेन्द्र यज्ञं च वर्धय ॥
translation: Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud. Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्थमिन्द्राय शंस्यं वर्धनं पुरुनिष्षिधे । शक्रो यथा सुतेषु णो रारणत्सख्येषु च ॥
translation: To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives, That Ṣakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमित्सखित्व ईमहे तं राये तं सुवीर्ये । स शक्र उत नः शकदिन्द्रो वसु दयमानः ॥
translation: Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might. For Indra, he is Ṣakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुविवृतं सुनिरजमिन्द्र त्वादातमिद्यशः । गवामप व्रजं वृधि कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ॥
translation: Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee. Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि त्वा रोदसी उभे ऋघायमाणमिन्वतः । जेषः स्वर्वतीरपः सं गा अस्मभ्यं धूनुहि ॥
translation: The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood. Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आश्रुत्कर्ण श्रुधी हवं नूचिद्दधिष्व मे गिरः । इन्द्र स्तोममिमं मम कृष्वा युजश्चिदन्तरम् ॥
translation: Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा वृषन्तमं वाजेषु हवनश्रुतम् । वृषन्तमस्य हूमह ऊतिं सहस्रसातमाम् ॥
translation: We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry. Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र कौशिक मन्दसानः सुतं पिब । नव्यमायुः प्र सू तिर कृधी सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥
translation: O Indra, Son of Kuṣika, drink our libation with delight. Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि त्वा गिर्वणो गिर इमा भवन्तु विश्वतः । वृद्धायुमनु वृद्धयो जुष्टा भवन्तु जुष्टयः ॥
translation: Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee: Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं विश्वा अवीवृधन्त्समुद्रव्यचसं गिरः । रथीतमं रथीनां वाजानां सत्पतिं पतिम् ॥
translation: ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सख्ये त इन्द्र वाजिनो मा भेम शवसस्पते । त्वामभि प्रणोनुमो जेतारमपराजितम् ॥
translation: Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear. We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पूर्वीरिन्द्रस्य रातयो न वि दस्यन्त्यूतयः । यदी वाजस्य गोमतः स्तोतृभ्यो मंहते मघम् ॥
translation: The gifts of Indra from of' old, his saving succours, never fail, When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरां भिन्दुर्युवा कविरमितौजा अजायत । इन्द्रो विश्वस्य कर्मणो धर्ता वज्री पुरुष्टुतः ॥
translation: Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं वलस्य गोमतोऽपावरद्रिवो बिलम् । त्वां देवा अबिभ्युषस्तुज्यमानास आविषुः ॥
translation: Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवाहं शूर रातिभिः प्रत्यायं सिन्धुमावदन् । उपातिष्ठन्त गिर्वणो विदुष्टे तस्य कारवः ॥
translation: I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee. Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मायाभिरिन्द्र मायिनं त्वं शुष्णमवातिरः । विदुष्टे तस्य मेधिरास्तेषां श्रवांस्युत्तिर ॥
translation: The wily Ṣushṇa, Indra! thou o'er-threwest with thy wondrous powers. The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमीशानमोजसाभि स्तोमा अनूषत । सहस्रं यस्य रातय उत वा सन्ति भूयसीः ॥
translation: Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might, Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं वृणीमहे होतारं विश्ववेदसम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥
translation: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमग्निं हवीमभिः सदा हवन्त विश्पतिम् । हव्यवाहं पुरुप्रियम् ॥
translation: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने देवाँ इहावह जज्ञानो वृक्तबर्हिषे । असि होता न ईड्यः ॥
translation: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताँ उशतो वि बोधय यदग्ने यासि दूत्यम् । देवैरासत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
translation: Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage: Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृताहवन दीदिवः प्रति ष्म रिषतो दह । अग्ने त्वं रक्षस्विनः ॥
translation: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, bum up Our enemies whom fiends protect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निनाग्निः समिध्यते कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा । हव्यवाड् जुह्वास्यः ॥
translation: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears The gift: the ladle is his mouth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कविमग्निमुपस्तुहि सत्यधर्माणमध्वरे । देवममीवचातनम् ॥
translation: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true, The God who driveth grief away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्त्वामग्ने हविष्पतिर्दूतं देव सपर्यति । तस्य स्म प्राविता भव ॥
translation: God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts, Worshippeth thee the messenger.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्माँ आविवासति । तस्मै पावक मृळय ॥
translation: Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods, O Purifier, favour him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पावक दीदिवोऽग्ने देवाँ इहा वह । उप यज्ञं हविश्च नः ॥
translation: Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः स्तवान आ भर गायत्रेण नवीयसा । रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् ॥
translation: So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us, And food, with heroes for our sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा विश्वाभिर्देवहूतिभिः । इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व नः ॥
translation: O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods, Show pleasure in this laud of ours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुसमिद्धो न आवह देवाँ अग्ने हविष्मते । होतः पावक यक्षि च ॥
translation: AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts. Worship them, Purifier, Priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मधुमन्तं तनूनपाद्यज्ञं देवेषु नः कवे । अद्या कृणुहि वीतये ॥
translation: Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today. Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नराशंसमिह प्रियमस्मिन्यज्ञ उपह्वये । मधुजिह्वं हविष्कृतम् ॥
translation: Dear Narâṣansa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने सुखतमे रथे देवाँ ईळित आ वह । असि होता मनुर्हितः ॥
translation: Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods: Manu appointed thee as Priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तृणीत बर्हिरानुषग्घृतपृष्ठं मनीषिणः । यत्रामृतस्य चक्षणम् ॥
translation: Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due, Where the Immortal is beheld.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्रयन्तामृतावृधो द्वारो देवीरसश्चतः । अद्या नूनं च यष्टवे ॥
translation: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite, For sacrifice this day and now.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नक्तोषासा सुपेशसाऽस्मिन्यज्ञ उप ह्वये । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
translation: I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass At this our solemn sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता सुजिह्वा उपह्वये होतारा दैव्या कवी । यज्ञं नो यक्षतामिमम् ॥
translation: The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue, To celebrate this our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः । बर्हिः सीदन्त्वस्रिधः ॥
translation: Iḷâ, Sarasvatî, Mahi, three Goddesses who bring delight, Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इह त्वष्टारमग्रियं विश्वरूपमुप ह्वये । अस्माकमस्तु केवलः ॥
translation: Tvashṭar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will: May he be ours and curs alone.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव सृजा वनस्पते देव देवेभ्यो हविः । प्र दातुरस्तु चेतनम् ॥
translation: God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods, And let the giver be renowned.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाहा यज्ञं कृणोतनेन्द्राय यज्वनो गृहे । तत्र देवाँ उप ह्वये ॥
translation: With Svâhâ pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house: Thither I call the Deities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऐभिरग्ने दुवो गिरो विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये । देवेभिर्याहि यक्षि च ॥
translation: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs. With all these Gods; and worship them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा कण्वा अहूषत गृणन्ति विप्र ते धियः । देवेभिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: The Kaṇvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise Agni, come hither with the Gods;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू बृहस्पतिं मित्राग्निं पूषणं भगम् । आदित्यान्मारुतं गणम् ॥
translation: Indra, Vâyu, Br̥ihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pûshan, Bhaga, Âdityas, and the Marut host.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वो भ्रियन्त इन्दवो मत्सरा मादयिष्णवः । द्रप्सा मध्वश्चमूषदः ॥
translation: For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate, The meath-drops resting in the cup.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईळते त्वामवस्यवः कण्वासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः ॥
translation: The sons of Kaṇva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass, With offerings and all things prepared.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृतपृष्ठा मनोयुजो ये त्वा वहन्ति वह्नयः । आ देवान्त्सोमपीतये ॥
translation: Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil, Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तान्यजत्राँ ऋतावृधोऽग्ने पत्नीवतस्कृधि । मध्वः सुजिह्व पायय ॥
translation: Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames: Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये यजत्रा य ईड्यास्ते ते पिबन्तु जिह्वया । मधोरग्ने वषट्कृति ॥
translation: Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue Tle meath in solemn sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आकीं सूर्यस्य रोचनाद्विश्वान्देवाँ उषर्बुधः । विप्रो होतेह वक्षति ॥
translation: Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring All Gods awaking with the dawn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेभिः सोम्यं मध्वग्न इन्द्रेण वायुना । पिबा मित्रस्य धामभिः ॥
translation: With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vâyu, and Mitra's splendours, drink, Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं होता मनुर्हितोऽग्ने यज्ञेषु सीदसि । सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ॥
translation: Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite: Hallow thou this our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युक्ष्वा ह्यरुषी रथे हरितो देव रोहितः । ताभिर्देवाँ इहा वह ॥
translation: Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones: With those bring hitherward the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र सोमं पिब ऋतुना त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः । मत्सरासस्तदोकसः ॥
translation: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Rtu; let the cheering drops Sink deep within, which settle there.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मरुतः पिबत ऋतुना पोत्राद्यज्ञं पुनीतन । यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवः ॥
translation: Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Rtu; sanctify The rite, for ye give precious gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि यज्ञं गृणीहि नो ग्नावो नेष्टः पिब ऋतुना । त्वं हि रत्नधा असि ॥
translation: O Neshṭar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with R̥itudrink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने देवाँ इहा वह सादया योनिषु त्रिषु । परि भूष पिब ऋतुना ॥
translation: Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down: Surround them, and with R̥itudrink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्राह्मणादिन्द्र राधसः पिबा सोममृतूँरनु । तवेद्धि सख्यमस्तृतम् ॥
translation: Drink Soma after the Rtus, from the Brahmana's bounty: undissolved, O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवं दक्षं धृतव्रत मित्रावरुण दूळभम् । ऋतुना यज्ञमाशाथे ॥
translation: Mitra, Varuṇa, ye whose ways are firm – a Power that none deceives-, With R̥ituye have reached the rite.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्रविणोदा द्रविणसो ग्रावहस्तासो अध्वरे । यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
translation: The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite, In sacrifices praise the God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्रविणोदा ददातु नो वसूनि यानि शृण्विरे । देवेषु ता वनामहे ॥
translation: May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned. These things we gain, among the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्रविणोदाः पिपीषति जुहोत प्र च तिष्ठत । नेष्ट्रादृतुभिरिष्यत ॥
translation: He with the R̥ita fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Neshṭar's bowl. Haste, give your offering, and depart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्त्वा तुरीयमृतुभिर्द्रविणोदो यजामहे । अध स्मा नो ददिर्भव ॥
translation: As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Rtus, be A Giver bountiful to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना पिबतं मधु दीद्यग्नी शुचिव्रता । ऋतुना यज्ञवाहसा ॥
translation: Drink ye the meath, O Aṣvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure. who with Rtus accept the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गार्हपत्येन सन्त्य ऋतुना यज्ञनीरसि । देवान्देवयते यज ॥
translation: With Rtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice: Worship the Gods for the pious man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा वहन्तु हरयो वृषणं सोमपीतये । इन्द्र त्वा सूरचक्षसः ॥
translation: LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught- Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा धाना घृतस्नुवो हरी इहोपवक्षतः । इन्द्रं सुखतमे रथे ॥
translation: Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring Indra upon his easiest car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं प्रातर्हवामह इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice, Indra to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नः सुतमा गहि हरिभिरिन्द्र केशिभिः । सुते हि त्वा हवामहे ॥
translation: Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to- the draught we pour We call thee wher, the juice is shed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सेमं नः स्तोममा गह्युपेदं सवनं सुतम् । गौरो न तृषितः पिब ॥
translation: Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee Drink of it like a stag athirst.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमे सोमास इन्दवः सुतासो अधि बर्हिषि । ताँ इन्द्र सहसे पिब ॥
translation: Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं ते स्तोमो अग्रियो हृदिस्पृगस्तु शंतमः । अथा सोमं सुतं पिब ॥
translation: Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent: Then drink the Soma juice expressed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वमित्सवनं सुतमिन्द्रो मदाय गच्छति । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
translation: To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vr̥itra-slayer, comes, To drink the Soma for delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सेमं नः काममा पृण गोभिरश्वैः शतक्रतो । स्तवाम त्वा स्वाध्यः ॥
translation: Fulfil, O Ṣatakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine: With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुणयोरहं सम्राजोरव आ वृणे । ता नो मृळात ईदृशे ॥
translation: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuṇa; may they Both favour one of us like me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गन्तारा हि स्थोऽवसे हवं विप्रस्य मावतः । धर्तारा चर्षणीनाम् ॥
translation: Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call Of every singer such as I.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनुकामं तर्पयेथामिन्द्रावरुण राय आ । ता वां नेदिष्ठमीमहे ॥
translation: Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuṇa, with wealth: Fain would we have you nearest us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवाकु हि शचीनां युवाकु सुमतीनाम् । भूयाम वाजदाव्नाम् ॥
translation: May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence Of you who give strength bounteously.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रः सहस्रदाव्नां वरुणः शंस्यानाम् । क्रतुर्भवत्युक्थ्यः ॥
translation: Indra and Varuṇa, among givers of thousands, meet for praise, Are Powers who merit highest laud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तयोरिदवसा वयं सनेम नि च धीमहि । स्यादुत प्ररेचनम् ॥
translation: Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up Enough and still to spare, be ours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुण वामहं हुवे चित्राय राधसे । अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृतम् ॥
translation: O Indra-Varuṇa, on you for wealth in many a form I call: Still keep ye us victorious.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रावरुण नू नु वां सिषासन्तीषु धीष्वा । अस्मभ्यं शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
translation: O Indra-Varuṇa, – through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves, Give us at once your sheltering help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वामश्नोतु सुष्टुतिरिन्द्रावरुण यां हुवे । यामृधाथे सधस्तुतिम् ॥
translation: O Indra-Varuṇa, to you may fair praise which I offer come, joint eulogy which ye dignify.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमानं स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः ॥
translation: O BRAHMANAPSATI, make him who presses Soma glorious, Even Kakshîvân Auṣija.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो रेवान्यो अमीवहा वसुवित्पुष्टिवर्धनः । स नः सिषक्तु यस्तुरः ॥
translation: The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store, The prompt,– may he be with us still.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नः शंसो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ्मर्त्यस्य । रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्पते ॥
translation: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us Preserve us, Brahmaṇaspati.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स घा वीरो न रिष्यति यमिन्द्रो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः । सोमो हिनोति मर्त्यम् ॥
translation: Ne'er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmaṇaspati, And Soma graciously inspire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं तं ब्रह्मणस्पते सोम इन्द्रश्च मर्त्यम् । दक्षिणा पात्वंहसः ॥
translation: Do, thou, O Brahmaṇaspati, and Indra, Soma, Dakshina, Preserve that mortal from distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सदसस्पतिमद्भुतं प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । सनिं मेधामयासिषम् ॥
translation: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मादृते न सिध्यति यज्ञो विपश्चितश्चन । स धीनां योगमिन्वति ॥
translation: He without whom no sacrifice, e'en of the wise man, prospers; he Stirs up the series of thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदृध्नोति हविष्कृतिं प्राञ्चं कृणोत्यध्वरम् । होत्रा देवेषु गच्छति ॥
translation: He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice: Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नराशंसं सुधृष्टममपश्यं सप्रथस्तमम् । दिवो न सद्ममखसम् ॥
translation: I have seen Narâṣansa, him most resolute, most widely famed, As 'twere the Household Priest of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति त्यं चारुमध्वरं गोपीथाय प्र हूयसे । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि देवो न मर्त्यो महस्तव क्रतुं परः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one – O Agni, with the Maruts come
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये महो रजसो विदुर्विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य उग्रा अर्कमानृचुरनाधृष्टास ओजसा । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये शुभ्रा घोरवर्पसः सुक्षत्रासो रिशादसः । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes': O Agni, with those Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि देवास आसते । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य ईङ्खयन्ति पर्वतान् तिरः समुद्रमर्णवम् । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea: O Agni, with those Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ये तन्वन्ति रश्मिभिस्तिरः समुद्रमोजसा । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might O Agni, with those Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतये सृजामि सोम्यं मधु । मरुद्भिरग्न आ गहि ॥
translation: For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath: O Agni, with the Maruts come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं देवाय जन्मने स्तोमो विप्रेभिरासया । अकारि रत्नधातमः ॥
translation: FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly Was made by singers with their lips.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इन्द्राय वचोयुजा ततक्षुर्मनसा हरी । शमीभिर्यज्ञमाशत ॥
translation: They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word, Attained by works to sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तक्षन्नासत्याभ्यां परिज्मानं सुखं रथम् । तक्षन्धेनुं सबर्दुघाम् ॥
translation: They for the two Nâsatyas wrought a light car moving every way: They formed a nectar-yielding cow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवाना पितरा पुनः सत्यमन्त्रा ऋजूयवः । ऋभवो विष्ट्यक्रत ॥
translation: The R̥ibhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made Their Sire and Mother young again.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं वो मदासो अग्मतेन्द्रेण च मरुत्वता । आदित्येभिश्च राजभिः ॥
translation: Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt, With the Âdityas, with the Kings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्यं चमसं नवं त्वष्टुर्देवस्य निष्कृतम् । अकर्त चतुरः पुनः ॥
translation: The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvashṭar's hand- Four ladles have ye made thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नो रत्नानि धत्तन त्रिरा साप्तानि सुन्वते । एकमेकं सुशस्तिभिः ॥
translation: Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधारयन्त वह्नयोऽभजन्त सुकृत्यया । भागं देवेषु यज्ञियम् ॥
translation: As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves, A share in sacrifice with Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इहेन्द्राग्नी उप ह्वये तयोरित्स्तोममुश्मसि । ता सोमं सोमपातमा ॥
translation: INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता यज्ञेषु प्र शंसतेन्द्राग्नी शुम्भता नरः । ता गायत्रेषु गायत ॥
translation: Praise ye, O men, and glorify Indra-Agni in the holy rites: Sing praise to them in sacred songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता मित्रस्य प्रशस्तय इन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे । सोमपा सोमपीतये ॥
translation: Indra and Agni we invite, the Soma-drinkers, for the fame Of Mitra, to the Soma-draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उग्रा सन्ता हवामह उपेदं सवनं सुतम् । इन्द्राग्नी एह गच्छताम् ॥
translation: Strong Gods, we bid them come to this libation that stands ready here: Indra and Agni, come to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता महान्ता सदस्पती इन्द्राग्नी रक्ष उब्जतम् । अप्रजाः सन्त्वत्रिणः ॥
translation: Indra and Agni, mighty Lords of our assembly, crush the fiends: Childless be the devouring ones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेन सत्येन जागृतमधि प्रचेतुने पदे । इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यच्छतम् ॥
translation: Watch ye, through this your truthfulness, there in the place of spacious view Indra and Agni, send us bliss.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रातर्युजा विबोधयाश्विनावेह गच्छताम् । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: WAKEN the Aṣvin Pair who yoke their car at early morn: may they Approach to drink this Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या सुरथा रथीतमोभा देवा दिविस्पृशा । अश्विना ता हवामहे ॥
translation: We call the Aṣvins Twain, the Gods borne in a noble car, the best Of charioteers, who reach the heavens.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या वां कशा मधुमत्यश्विना सूनृतावती । तया यज्ञं मिमिक्षतम् ॥
translation: Dropping with honey is your whip, Aṣvins, and full of pleasantness Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि वामस्ति दूरके यत्रा रथेन गच्छथः । अश्विना सोमिनो गृहम् ॥
translation: As ye go thither in your car, not far, O Aṣvins, is the home Of him who offers Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्यपाणिमूतये सवितारमुप ह्वये । स चेत्ता देवता पदम् ॥
translation: For my protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar. He knoweth, as a God, the place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपां नपातमवसे सवितारमुप स्तुहि । तस्य व्रतान्युश्मसि ॥
translation: That he may send us succour, praise the Waters' Offspring Savitar: Fain are we for his holy ways.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभक्तारं हवामहे वसोश्चित्रस्य राधसः । सवितारं नृचक्षसम् ॥
translation: We call on him, distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सखाय आ निषीदत सविता स्तोम्यो नु नः । दाता राधांसि शुम्भति ॥
translation: Come hither, friends, and seat yourselves Savitar, to be praised by us, Giving good gifts, is beautiful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने पत्नीरिहावह देवानामुशतीरुप । त्वष्टारं सोमपीतये ॥
translation: O Agni, hither bring to us the willing Spouses of the Gods, And Tvashṭar, to the Soma draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ग्ना अग्न इहावसे होत्रां यविष्ठ भारतीम् । वरूत्रीं धिषणां वह ॥
translation: Most youthful Agni, hither bring their Spouses, Hotrâ, Bhâratî, Varûtrî, Dhishaṇâ, for aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि नो देवीरवसा महः शर्मणा नृपत्नीः । अच्छिन्नपत्राः सचन्ताम् ॥
translation: Spouses of Heroes, Goddesses, with whole wings may they come to us With great protection and with aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इहेन्द्राणीमुप ह्वये वरुणानीं स्वस्तये । अग्नायीं सोमपीतये ॥
translation: Indrâṇî, Varuṇânî, and Agnayi hither I invite, For weal, to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मही द्यौः पृथिवी च न इमं यज्ञं मिमिक्षताम् । पिपृतां नो भरीमभिः ॥
translation: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, bedew for us our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तयोरिद्घृतवत्पयो विप्रा रिहन्ति धीतिभिः । गन्धर्वस्य ध्रुवे पदे ॥
translation: Their water rich with fatness, there in the Gandharva's steadfast place, The singers taste through sacred songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्योना पृथिवि भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी । यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथः ॥
translation: Thornless be thou, O Earth, spread wide before us for a dwelling-place: Vouchsafe us shelter broad and sure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतो देवा अवन्तु नो यतो विष्णुर्विचक्रमे । पृथिव्याः सप्त धामभिः ॥
translation: The Gods be gracious unto us even from the place whence Vishṇu strode Through the seven regions of the earth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं विष्णुर्वि चक्रमे त्रेधा निदधे पदम् । समूळ्हमस्य पांसुरे ॥
translation: Through all this world strode Vishṇu; thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः । अतो धर्माणि धारयन् ॥
translation: Vishṇu, the Guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps; thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विष्णोः कर्माणि पश्यत यतो व्रतानि पस्पशे । इन्द्रस्य युज्यः सखा ॥
translation: Look ye on Vishṇu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्विष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यन्ति सूरयः । दिवीव चक्षुराततम् ॥
translation: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishṇu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते । विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम् ॥
translation: This, Vishṇu's station most sublime, the singers, ever vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तीव्राः सोमास आ गह्याशीर्वन्तः सुता इमे । वायो तान्प्रस्थितान्पिब ॥
translation: STRONG are the Somas; come thou nigh; these juices have been mixt with milk: Drink, Vâyu, the presented draughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभा देवा दिविस्पृशेन्द्रवायू हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Both Deities who touch the heaven, Indra and Vâyu we invoke To drink of this our soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रवायू मनोजुवा विप्रा हवन्त ऊतये । सहस्राक्षा धियस्पती ॥
translation: The singers' for their aid, invoke Indra and Vâyu, swift as mind, The thousand-eyed, the Lords of thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रं वयं हवामहे वरुणं सोमपीतये । जज्ञाना पूतदक्षसा ॥
translation: Mitra and Varuṇa, renowned as Gods of consecrated might, We call to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतेन यावृतावृधावृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पती । ता मित्रावरुणा हुवे ॥
translation: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law, Mitra I call, and Varuṇa.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वरुणः प्राविता भुवन्मित्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । करतां नः सुराधसः ॥
translation: Let Varuṇa be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids Both make us rich exceedingly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मरुत्वन्तं हवामह इन्द्रमा सोमपीतये । सजूर्गणेन तृम्पतु ॥
translation: Indra, by Maruts girt, we call to drink the Soma juice: may he Sate him in union with his troop.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रज्येष्ठा मरुद्गणा देवासः पूषरातयः । विश्वे मम श्रुता हवम् ॥
translation: Gods, Marut hosts whom Indra leads, distributers of Pûshan's gifts, Hearken ye all unto my cry.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हत वृत्रं सुदानव इन्द्रेण सहसा युजा । मा नो दुःशंस ईशत ॥
translation: With conquering Indra for ally, strike Vr̥itra down, ye bounteous Gods Let not the wicked master us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वान्देवान्हवामहे मरुतः सोमपीतये । उग्रा हि पृश्निमातरः ॥
translation: We call the Universal Gods, and Maruts to the Soma draught, For passing strong are Pr̥iṣni's Sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जयतामिव तन्यतुर्मरुतामेति धृष्णुया । यच्छुभं याथना नरः ॥
translation: Fierce comes the Maruts' thundering voice, like that of conquerors, when ye go Forward to victory, O Men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हस्काराद्विद्युतस्पर्यतो जाता अवन्तु नः । मरुतो मृळयन्तु नः ॥
translation: Born of the laughing lightning. may the Maruts guard us everywhere May they be gracious unto Us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पूषञ्चित्रबर्हिषमाघृणे धरुणं दिवः । आजा नष्टं यथा पशुम् ॥
translation: Like some lost animal, drive to us, bright Pûshan, him who bears up heaven, Resting on many-coloured grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पूषा राजानमाघृणिरपगूळ्हं गुहा हितम् । अविन्दच्चित्रबर्हिषम् ॥
translation: Pûshan the Bright has found the King, concealed and bidden in a cave, Who rests on grass of many hues.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतो स मह्यमिन्दुभिः षड्युक्ताँ अनुसेषिधत् । गोभिर्यवं न चर्कृषत् ॥
translation: And may he. duly bring to me the six bound closely, through these drops, As one who ploughs with steers brings corn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अम्बयो यन्त्यध्वभिर्जामयो अध्वरीयताम् । पृञ्चतीर्मधुना पयः ॥
translation: Along their paths the Mothers go, Sisters of priestly ministrants, Mingling their sweetness with the milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमूर्या उप सूर्ये याभिर्वा सूर्यः सह । ता नो हिन्वन्त्वध्वरम् ॥
translation: May Waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed forth this sacrifice of ours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपो देवीरुप ह्वये यत्र गावः पिबन्ति नः । सिन्धुभ्यः कर्त्वं हविः ॥
translation: I call the Waters, Goddesses, wherein our cattle quench their thirst; Oblations to the Streams be given.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्स्व१न्तरमृतमप्सु भेषजमपामुत प्रशस्तये । देवा भवत वाजिनः ॥
translation: Amrit is in the Waters in the Waters there is healing balm Be swift, ye Gods, to give them praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्सु मे सोमो अब्रवीदन्तर्विश्वानि भेषजा । अग्निं च विश्वशम्भुवमापश्च विश्वभेषजीः ॥
translation: Within the Waters-Soma thus hath told me-dwell all balms that heal, And Agni, he who blesseth all. The Waters hold all medicines.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपः पृणीत भेषजं वरूथं तन्वे३ मम । ज्योक् च सूर्यं दृशे ॥
translation: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm, So that I long may see the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदमापः प्र वहत यत्किं च दुरितं मयि । यद्वाहमभिदुद्रोह यद्वा शेप उतानृतम् ॥
translation: Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought. If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपो अद्यान्वचारिषं रसेन समगस्महि । पयस्वानग्न आ गहि तं मा सं सृज वर्चसा ॥
translation: The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come: O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं माग्ने वर्चसा सृज सं प्रजया समायुषा । विद्युर्मे अस्य देवा इन्द्रो विद्यात्सह ऋषिभिः ॥
translation: Fill me with splendour, Agni; give offspring and length of days; the Gods Shall know me even as I am, and Indra with the R̥ishis, know.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्य नूनं कतमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम । को नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात्पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च ॥
translation: WHO now is he, what God among Immortals, of whose auspicious name we may bethink us? Who shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्नेर्वयं प्रथमस्यामृतानां मनामहे चारु देवस्य नाम । स नो मह्या अदितये पुनर्दात्पितरं च दृशेयं मातरं च ॥
translation: Agni the God the first among the Immortals, – of his auspicious name let us bethink us. He shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा देव सवितरीशानं वार्याणाम् । सदावन्भागमीमहे ॥
translation: To thee, O Savitar, the Lord of precious things, who helpest us Continually, for our share we come-
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यश्चिद्धि त इत्था भगः शशमानः पुरा निदः । अद्वेषो हस्तयोर्दधे ॥
translation: Wealth, highly lauded ere reproach hath fallen on it, which is laid, Free from all hatred, in thy hands
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भगभक्तस्य ते वयमुदशेम तवावसा । मूर्धानं राय आरभे ॥
translation: Through thy protection may we come to even the height of affluence Which Bhaga hath dealt out to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि ते क्षत्रं न सहो न मन्युं वयश्चनामी पतयन्त आपुः । नेमा आपो अनिमिषं चरन्तीर्न ये वातस्य प्रमिनन्त्यभ्वम् ॥
translation: Ne'er have those birds that fly through air attained to thy high dominion or thy might or spirit; Nor these the waters that flow on for ever, nor hills, abaters of the wind's wild fury.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अबुध्ने राजा वरुणो वनस्योर्ध्वं स्तूपं ददते पूतदक्षः । नीचीनाः स्थुरुपरि बुध्न एषामस्मे अन्तर्निहिताः केतवः स्युः ॥
translation: Varuṇa, King, of hallowed might, sustaineth erect the Tree's stem in the baseless region. Its rays, whose root is high above, stream downward. Deep may they sink within us, and be hidden.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उरुं हि राजा वरुणश्चकार सूर्याय पन्थामन्वेतवा उ । अपदे पादा प्रतिधातवेऽकरुतापवक्ता हृदयाविधश्चित् ॥
translation: King Varuṇa hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate'er afflicts the spirit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतं ते राजन्भिषजः सहस्रमुर्वी गभीरा सुमतिष्टे अस्तु । बाधस्व दूरे निर्ऋतिं पराचैः कृतं चिदेनः प्र मुमुग्ध्यस्मत् ॥
translation: A hundred balms are thine, O King, a thousand; deep and wide-reaching also be thy favours. Far from us, far away drive thou Destruction. Put from us e'en the sin we have committed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमी य ऋक्षा निहितास उच्चा नक्तं ददृश्रे कुह चिद्दिवेयुः । अदब्धानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि विचाकशच्चन्द्रमा नक्तमेति ॥
translation: Whither by day depart the constellations that shine at night, set high in heaven above us? Varuṇa's holy laws remain unweakened, and through the night the Moon moves on in splendor
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्त्वा यामि ब्रह्मणा वन्दमानस्तदा शास्ते यजमानो हविर्भिः । अहेळमानो वरुणेह बोध्युरुशंस मा न आयुः प्र मोषीः ॥
translation: I ask this of thee with my prayer adoring; thy worshipper craves this with his oblation. Varuṇa, stay thou here and be not angry; steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदिन्नक्तं तद्दिवा मह्यमाहुस्तदयं केतो हृद आ वि चष्टे । शुनःशेपो यमह्वद्गृभीतः सो अस्मान्राजा वरुणो मुमोक्तु ॥
translation: Nightly and daily this one thing they tell me, this too the thought of mine own heart repeateth. May he to whom prayed fettered Ṣunaḥṣepa, may he the Sovran Varuṇa release us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुनःशेपो ह्यह्वद्गृभीतस्त्रिष्वादित्यं द्रुपदेषु बद्धः । अवैनं राजा वरुणः ससृज्याद्विद्वाँ अदब्धो वि मुमोक्तु पाशान् ॥
translation: Bound to three pillars captured Ṣunaḥṣepa thus to the Âditya made his supplication. Him may the Sovran Varuṇa deliver, wise, ne'er deccived, loosen the bonds that bind him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव ते हेळो वरुण नमोभिरव यज्ञेभिरीमहे हविर्भिः । क्षयन्नस्मभ्यमसुर प्रचेता राजन्नेनांसि शिश्रथः कृतानि ॥
translation: With bending down, oblations, sacrifices, O Varuṇa, we deprecate thine anger: Wise Asura, thou King of wide dominion, loosen the bonds of sins by us committed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं श्रथाय । अथा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम ॥
translation: Loosen the bonds, O Varuṇa, that hold me, loosen the bonds above, between, and under. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Âditya.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि ते विशो यथा प्र देव वरुण व्रतम् । मिनीमसि द्यविद्यवि ॥
translation: WHATEVER law of thine, O God, O Varuṇa, as we are men, Day after day we violate.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो वधाय हत्नवे जिहीळानस्य रीरधः । मा हृणानस्य मन्यवे ॥
translation: give us not as a prey to death, to be destroyed by thee in wrath, To thy fierce anger when displeased.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि मृळीकाय ते मनो रथीरश्वं न संदितम् । गीर्भिर्वरुण सीमहि ॥
translation: To gain thy mercy, Varuṇa, with hymns we bind thy heart, as binds The charioteer his tethered horse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परा हि मे विमन्यवः पतन्ति वस्यइष्टये । वयो न वसतीरुप ॥
translation: They flee from me dispirited, bent only on obtaining wealths As to their nests the birds of air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदा क्षत्रश्रियं नरमा वरुणं करामहे । मृळीकायोरुचक्षसम् ॥
translation: When shall we bring, to be appeased, the Hero, Lord of warrior might, Him, the far-seeing Varuṇa?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदित्समानमाशाते वेनन्ता न प्र युच्छतः । धृतव्रताय दाशुषे ॥
translation: This, this with joy they both accept in common: never do they fail The ever-faithful worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेदा यो वीनां पदमन्तरिक्षेण पतताम् । वेद नावः समुद्रियः ॥
translation: He knows the path of birds that fly through heaven, and, Sovran of the sea, He knows the ships that are thereon.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेद मासो धृतव्रतो द्वादश प्रजावतः । वेदा य उपजायते ॥
translation: True to his holy law, he knows the twelve moons with their progeny: He knows the moon of later birth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेद वातस्य वर्तनिमुरोर्ऋष्वस्य बृहतः । वेदा ये अध्यासते ॥
translation: He knows the pathway of the wind, the spreading, high, and mighty wind He knows the Gods who dwell above.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि षसाद धृतव्रतो वरुणः पस्त्या३स्वा । साम्राज्याय सुक्रतुः ॥
translation: Varuṇa, true to holy law, sits down among his people; he, Most wise, sits there to govern all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतो विश्वान्यद्भुता चिकित्वाँ अभि पश्यति । कृतानि या च कर्त्वा ॥
translation: From thence percerving he beholds all wondrous things, both what hath been, And what hereafter will be done.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो विश्वाहा सुक्रतुरादित्यः सुपथा करत् । प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
translation: May that Âditya, very -wise, make fair paths for us all our days: May lie prolong our lives for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बिभ्रद्द्रापिं हिरण्ययं वरुणो वस्त निर्णिजम् । परि स्पशो निषेदिरे ॥
translation: Varuṇa, wearing golden mail, hath clad him in a shining robe. His spies are seated found about.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न यं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवो न द्रुह्वाणो जनानाम् । न देवमभिमातयः ॥
translation: The God whom enemies threaten not, nor those who tyrannize o'er men, Nor those whose minds are bent on wrong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत यो मानुषेष्वा यशश्चक्रे असाम्या । अस्माकमुदरेष्वा ॥
translation: He who gives glory to mankind, not glory that is incomplete, To our own bodies giving it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परा मे यन्ति धीतयो गावो न गव्यूतीरनु । इच्छन्तीरुरुचक्षसम् ॥
translation: Yearning for the wide-seeing One, my thoughts move onward unto him, As kine unto their pastures move.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं नु वोचावहै पुनर्यतो मे मध्वाभृतम् । होतेव क्षदसे प्रियम् ॥
translation: Once more together let us speak, because my meath is brought: priest-like Thou eatest what is dear to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दर्शं नु विश्वदर्शतं दर्शं रथमधि क्षमि । एता जुषत मे गिरः ॥
translation: Now saw I him whom all may see, I saw his car above the earth: He hath accepted these my songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं मे वरुण श्रुधी हवमद्या च मृळय । त्वामवस्युरा चके ॥
translation: Varuṇa, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day Longing for help I cried to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं विश्वस्य मेधिर दिवश्च ग्मश्च राजसि । स यामनि प्रति श्रुधि ॥
translation: Thou, O wise God, art Lord of all, thou art the King of earth and heaven Hear, as thou goest on thy way.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदुत्तमं मुमुग्धि नो वि पाशं मध्यमं चृत । अवाधमानि जीवसे ॥
translation: Release us from the upper bond, untie the bond between, and loose The bonds below, that I may live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसिष्वा हि मियेध्य वस्त्राण्यूर्जां पते । सेमं नो अध्वरं यज ॥
translation: O WORTHY of oblation, Lord of prospering powers, assume thy robes, And offer this our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि नो होता वरेण्यः सदा यविष्ठ मन्मभिः । अग्ने दिवित्मता वचः ॥
translation: Sit ever to be chosen, as our Priest., most youthful, through our hymns, O Agni, through our heavenly word.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ हि ष्मा सूनवे पितापिर्यजत्यापये । सखा सख्ये वरेण्यः ॥
translation: For here a Father for his son, Kinsman for kinsman worshippeth, And Friend, choice-worthy, for his friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो बर्ही रिशादसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । सीदन्तु मनुषो यथा ॥
translation: Fiere let the foe-destroyers sit, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Like men, upon our sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पूर्व्य होतरस्य नो मन्दस्व सख्यस्य च । इमा उ षु श्रुधी गिरः ॥
translation: O ancient Herald, be thou glad in this our rite and fellowship: Hearken thou well to these our songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि शश्वता तना देवंदेवं यजामहे । त्वे इद्धूयते हविः ॥
translation: Whate'er in this perpetual course we sacrifice to God and God, That gift is offered up in thee
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रियो नो अस्तु विश्पतिर्होता मन्द्रो वरेण्यः । प्रियाः स्वग्नयो वयम् ॥
translation: May he be our dear household Lord, Priest, pleasant and, choice-worthy may We, with bright fires, be dear to him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वग्नयो हि वार्यं देवासो दधिरे च नः । स्वग्नयो मनामहे ॥
translation: The Gods, adored with brilliant fires. have granted precious wealth to us So, with bright fires, we pray to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अथा न उभयेषाममृत मर्त्यानाम् । मिथः सन्तु प्रशस्तयः ॥
translation: And, O Immortal One, so may the eulogies of mortal men Belong to us and thee alike.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेभिरग्ने अग्निभिरिमं यज्ञमिदं वचः । चनो धाः सहसो यहो ॥
translation: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice, And this our speech, O Son of Strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वं न त्वा वारवन्तं वन्दध्या अग्निं नमोभिः । सम्राजन्तमध्वराणाम् ॥
translation: WITH worship will I glorify thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of sacred rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स घा नः सूनुः शवसा पृथुप्रगामा सुशेवः । मीढ्वाँ अस्माकं बभूयात् ॥
translation: May the far-striding Son of Strength, bringer of great felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो दूराच्चासाच्च नि मर्त्यादघायोः । पाहि सदमिद्विश्वायुः ॥
translation: Lord of all life, from near; from far, do thou, O Agni evermore Protect us from the sinful man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इममू षु त्वमस्माकं सनिं गायत्रं नव्यांसम् । अग्ने देवेषु प्र वोचः ॥
translation: O Agni, graciously announce this our oblation to the Gods, And this our newest song of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो भज परमेष्वा वाजेषु मध्यमेषु । शिक्षा वस्वो अन्तमस्य ॥
translation: Give us a share of strength most high, a share of strength that is below, A share of strength that is between.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभक्तासि चित्रभानो सिन्धोरूर्मा उपाक आ । सद्यो दाशुषे क्षरसि ॥
translation: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent One; nigh, as with waves of Sindhu, thou Swift streamest to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यमवा वाजेषु यं जुनाः । स यन्ता शश्वतीरिषः ॥
translation: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकिरस्य सहन्त्य पर्येता कयस्य चित् । वाजो अस्ति श्रवाय्यः ॥
translation: Him, whosoever he may be, no man may vanquish, mighty One: Nay, very glorious power is his.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वाजं विश्वचर्षणिरर्वद्भिरस्तु तरुता । विप्रेभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
translation: May he who dwells with all mankind bear us with war-steeds through the fight, And with the singers win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जराबोध तद्विविड्ढि विशेविशे यज्ञियाय । स्तोमं रुद्राय दृशीकम् ॥
translation: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, this eulogy to Rudra, him Adorable in every house.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो महाँ अनिमानो धूमकेतुः पुरुश्चन्द्रः । धिये वाजाय हिन्वतु ॥
translation: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered excellently bright, Urge us to strength and holy thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स रेवाँइव विश्पतिर्दैव्यः केतुः शृणोतु नः । उक्थैरग्निर्बृहद्भानुः ॥
translation: Like some rich Lord of men may he, Agni the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमो महद्भ्यो नमो अर्भकेभ्यो नमो युवभ्यो नम आशिनेभ्यः । यजाम देवान्यदि शक्नवाम मा ज्यायसः शंसमा वृक्षि देवाः ॥
translation: Glory to Gods, the mighty and the lesser glory to Gods the younger and the elder! Let us, if we have power, pay the God worship: no better prayer than this, ye Gods, acknowledge.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र ग्रावा पृथुबुध्न ऊर्ध्वो भवति सोतवे । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
translation: THERE where the broad-based stone raised on high to press the juices out, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र द्वाविव जघनाधिषवण्या कृता । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
translation: Where, like broad hips, to hold the juice the platters of the press are laid, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र नार्यपच्यवमुपच्यवं च शिक्षते । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
translation: There where the woman marks and leans the pestle's constant rise and fall, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्र मन्थां विबध्नते रश्मीन्यमितवाइव । उलूखलसुतानामवेद्विन्द्र जल्गुलः ॥
translation: Where, as with reins to guide a horse, they bind the churning-staff with cords, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि त्वं गृहेगृह उलूखलक युज्यसे । इह द्युमत्तमं वद जयतामिव दुन्दुभिः ॥
translation: If of a truth in every house, O Mortar thou art set for work, Here give thou forth thy clearest sound, loud as the drum of conquerors.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत स्म ते वनस्पते वातो विवात्यग्रमित् । अथो इन्द्राय पातवे सुनु सोममुलूखल ॥
translation: O Sovran of the Forest, as the wind blows soft in front of thee, Mortar, for Indra press thou forth the Soma juice that he may drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयजी वाजसातमा ता ह्यु१च्चा विजर्भृतः । हरीइवान्धांसि बप्सता ॥
translation: Best strength-givers, ye stretch wide jaws, O Sacrificial Implements, Like two bay horses champing herbs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता नो अद्य वनस्पती ऋष्वावृष्वेभिः सोतृभिः । इन्द्राय मधुमत्सुतम् ॥
translation: Ye Sovrans of the Forest, both swift, with swift pressers press to-day Sweet Soma juice for Indra's drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उच्छिष्टं चम्वोर्भर सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । नि धेहि गोरधि त्वचि ॥
translation: Take up in beakers what remains: the Soma on the filter pour, and on the ox-hide set the dregs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि सत्य सोमपा अनाशस्ताइव स्मसि । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
translation: O SOMA DRINKER, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be, Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिप्रिन्वाजानां पते शचीवस्तव दंसना । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
translation: O Lord of Strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि ष्वापया मिथूदृशा सस्तामबुध्यमाने । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
translation: Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look Do thou, O Indra, give us, help of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ससन्तु त्या अरातयो बोधन्तु शूर रातयः । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
translation: Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler genius wake: Do thou, O Indra,. give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिन्द्र गर्दभं मृण नुवन्तं पापयामुया । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
translation: Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पताति कुण्डृणाच्या दूरं वातो वनादधि । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
translation: Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course! Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सर्वं परिक्रोशं जहि जम्भया कृकदाश्वम् । आ तू न इन्द्र शंसय गोष्वश्वेषु शुभ्रिषु सहस्रेषु तुवीमघ ॥
translation: Slay each reviler, and destroy him who in secret injures us: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine In thousands, O most wealthy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ व इन्द्रं क्रिविं यथा वाजयन्तः शतक्रतुम् । मंहिष्ठं सिञ्च इन्दुभिः ॥
translation: WE seeking strength with Soma-drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of Hundred Powers,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतं वा यः शुचीनां सहस्रं वा समाशिराम् । एदु निम्नं न रीयते ॥
translation: Who lets a hundred of the pure, a thousand of the milk-blent draughts Flow, even as down a depth, to him;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं यन्मदाय शुष्मिण एना ह्यस्योदरे । समुद्रो न व्यचो दधे ॥
translation: When for the strong, the rapturous joy he in this manner hath made room Within his belly, like the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमु ते समतसि कपोतइव गर्भधिम् । वचस्तच्चिन्न ओहसे ॥
translation: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest too for this our prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तोत्रं राधानां पते गिर्वाहो वीर यस्य ते । विभूतिरस्तु सूनृता ॥
translation: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and joyfulness Be his who sings the laud to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा न ऊतयेऽस्मिन्वाजे शतक्रतो । समन्येषु ब्रवावहै ॥
translation: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight In others too let us agree.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योगेयोगे तवस्तरं वाजेवाजे हवामहे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
translation: In every need, in every fray we call as friends to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ घा गमद्यदि श्रवत्सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिः । वाजेभिरुप नो हवम् ॥
translation: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसो हुवे तुविप्रतिं नरम् । यं ते पूर्वं पिता हुवे ॥
translation: I call him mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं विश्ववारा शास्महे पुरुहूत । सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः ॥
translation: We pray to thee, O much-invoked, rich in all prccious gifts, O Friend, Kind God to those who sing thy praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्माकं शिप्रिणीनां सोमपाः सोमपाव्नाम् । सखे वज्रिन्त्सखीनाम् ॥
translation: O Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Friend of our lovely-featured dames And of our Soma-drinking friends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तथा तदस्तु सोमपाः सखे वज्रिन्तथा कृणु । यथा त उश्मसीष्टये ॥
translation: Thus, Soma-drinker, may it be; thus, Friend, who wieldest thunder, act To aid each wish as we desire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रेवतीर्नः सधमाद इन्द्रे सन्तु तुविवाजाः । क्षुमन्तो याभिर्मदेम ॥
translation: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ घ त्वावान्त्मनाप्तः स्तोतृभ्यो धृष्णवियानः । ऋणोरक्षं न चक्र्योः ॥
translation: Like thee, thyself, the singers' Friend, thou movest, as it were, besought, Bold One, the axle of the car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यद्दुवः शतक्रतवा कामं जरितॄणाम् । ऋणोरक्षं न शचीभिः ॥
translation: That, Ṣatakratu, thou to grace and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शश्वदिन्द्रः पोप्रुथद्भिर्जिगाय नानदद्भिः शाश्वसद्भिर्धनानि । स नो हिरण्यरथं दंसनावान्त्स नः सनिता सनये स नोऽदात् ॥
translation: With champing, neighing loudly-snorting horses Indra hath ever won himself great treasures A car of gold hath he whose deeds are wondrous received from us, and let us too receive it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आश्विनावश्वावत्येषा यातं शवीरया । गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
translation: Come, Aṣvins, with enduring strength wealthy in horses and in kine, And gold, O ye of wondrous deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समानयोजनो हि वां रथो दस्रावमर्त्यः । समुद्रे अश्विनेयते ॥
translation: Your chariot yoked for both alike, immortal, ye of mighty acts, Travels, O Aivins, in the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न्य१घ्न्यस्य मूर्धनि चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः । परि द्यामन्यदीयते ॥
translation: High on the forehead of the Bull one chariot wheel ye ever keep, The other round the sky revolves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्त उषः कधप्रिये भुजे मर्तो अमर्त्ये । कं नक्षसे विभावरि ॥
translation: What mortal, O immortal Dawn, enjoyeth thee? Where lovest thou? To whom, O radiant, dost thou go?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं हि ते अमन्मह्यान्तादा पराकात् । अश्वे न चित्रे अरुषि ॥
translation: For we have had thee in our thoughts whether anear or far away, Red-hued and like a dappled mare.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं त्येभिरा गहि वाजेभिर्दुहितर्दिवः । अस्मे रयिं नि धारय ॥
translation: Hither, O Daughter of the Sky, come thou with these thy strengthenings, And send thou riches down to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरा ऋषिर्देवो देवानामभवः शिवः सखा । तव व्रते कवयो विद्मनापसोऽजायन्त मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः ॥
translation: Thou, Agni, wast the earliest Angiras, a Seer; thou wast, a God thyself, the Gods' auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, -with their glittering spears, were born.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरस्तमः कविर्देवानां परि भूषसि व्रतम् । विभुर्विश्वस्मै भुवनाय मेधिरो द्विमाता शयुः कतिधा चिदायवे ॥
translation: O Agni, thou, the best and earliest Angiras, fulfillest as a Sage the holy law of Gods. Sprung from two mothers, wise, through all existence spread, resting in many a place for sake of living man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने प्रथमो मातरिश्वन आविर्भव सुक्रतूया विवस्वते । अरेजेतां रोदसी होतृवूर्येऽसघ्नोर्भारमयजो महो वसो ॥
translation: To Mâtariṣvan first thou, Agni, wast disclosed, and to Vivasvan through thy noble inward power. Heaven and Earth, Vasu! shook at the choosing of the Priest: the burthen thou didst bear, didst worship mighty Gods.
