translation: And songs to thee who lovest song, and all those hymns addressed to thee- These evermore confirm thy might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवेदेष तुविकूर्मिर्वाजाँ एको वज्रहस्तः । सनादमृक्तो दयते ॥
translation: Thus he, sole doer of great deeds whose hand holds thunder, gives us strength, He who hath never been subdued.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हन्ता वृत्रं दक्षिणेनेन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः । महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
translation: Vr̥itra he slays with his right hand, even Indra, great with mighty power, And much-invoked in many a place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वाश्चर्षणय उत च्यौत्ना ज्रयांसि च । अनु घेन्मन्दी मघोनः ॥
translation: He upon whom all men depend, all regions, all achievements, he Takes pleasure in our wealthy chiefs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष एतानि चकारेन्द्रो विश्वा योऽति शृण्वे । वाजदावा मघोनाम् ॥
translation: All this hath he accomplished, yea, Indra, most gloriously renowned, Who gives our wealthy princes strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रभर्ता रथं गव्यन्तमपाकाच्चिद्यमवति । इनो वसु स हि वोळ्हा ॥
translation: Who drives his chariot seeking spoil, from afar, to him he loves: For swift is he to bring men wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सनिता विप्रो अर्वद्भिर्हन्ता वृत्रं नृभिः शूरः । सत्योऽविता विधन्तम् ॥
translation: The Sage who, winning spoil with steeds, slays Vr̥itra, Hero with the men, His servant's faithful succourer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजध्वैनं प्रियमेधा इन्द्रं सत्राचा मनसा । यो भूत्सोमैः सत्यमद्वा ॥
translation: O Priyamedhas, worship with collected mind this Indra whom The Soma hath full well inspired.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गाथश्रवसं सत्पतिं श्रवस्कामं पुरुत्मानम् । कण्वासो गात वाजिनम् ॥
translation: Ye Kaṇvas, sing the Mighty One, Lord of the Brave, who loves renown, All-present, glorified by song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य ऋते चिद्गास्पदेभ्यो दात्सखा नृभ्यः शचीवान् । ये अस्मिन्काममश्रियन् ॥
translation: Strong Friend, who, with no trace of feet, restores the cattle to the men, Who rest their wish and hope on him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इत्था धीवन्तमद्रिवः काण्वं मेध्यातिथिम् । मेषो भूतो३ऽभि यन्नयः ॥
translation: Shaped as a Ram, Stone-hurler I once thou camest hither to the son Of Kaṇva, wise Medhyâtithi.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिक्षा विभिन्दो अस्मै चत्वार्ययुता ददत् । अष्टा परः सहस्रा ॥
translation: Vibhindu, thou hast helped this man, giving him thousands four times ten, And afterward eight thousand more.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत सु त्ये पयोवृधा माकी रणस्य नप्त्या । जनित्वनाय मामहे ॥
translation: And these twain pouring streams of milk, creative, daughters of delight, For wedlock sake I glorify.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः । आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधे३ऽस्माँ अवन्तु ते धियः ॥
translation: DRINK, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught. Be, for our weal, our Friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा नः स्तरभिमातये । अस्माञ्चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय ॥
translation: In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: expose us not to foe's attack. With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and bring us to felicity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम । पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥
translation: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे । सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ॥
translation: He, with his might enhanced by R̥ishis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे । इन्द्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ॥
translation: Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as worshippers in battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् । इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
translation: With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath Indra lighted up the Sun. In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः । समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम् ॥
translation: Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The R̥ibhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि । अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा ॥
translation: Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice. And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्त्वा यामि सुवीर्यं तद्ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये । येना यतिभ्यो भृगवे धने हिते येन प्रस्कण्वमाविथ ॥
translation: I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer, Wherewith thou holpest Bhr̥igu and the Yatis and Praskaṇva when the prize was staked.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येना समुद्रमसृजो महीरपस्तदिन्द्र वृष्णि ते शवः । सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं क्षोणीरनुचक्रदे ॥
translation: Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is thy manly strength. For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शग्धी न इन्द्र यत्त्वा रयिं यामि सुवीर्यम् । शग्धि वाजाय प्रथमं सिषासते शग्धि स्तोमाय पूर्व्य ॥
translation: Help us, O Indra, when we pray to thee for wealth and hero might. First help thou on to strength the man who strives to win, and aid our laud, O Ancient One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शग्धी नो अस्य यद्ध पौरमाविथ धिय इन्द्र सिषासतः । शग्धि यथा रुशमं श्यावकं कृपमिन्द्र प्रावः स्वर्णरम् ॥
translation: Help for us, Indra, as thou holpest Paura once, this man's devotions bent on gain. Help, as thou gavest Ruṣama and Ṣyâvaka and Svarṇara and Kr̥ipa aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कन्नव्यो अतसीनां तुरो गृणीत मर्त्यः । नही न्वस्य महिमानमिन्द्रियं स्वर्गृणन्त आनशुः ॥
translation: What newest of imploring prayers shall, then, the zealous mortal sing? For have not they who laud his might, and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदु स्तुवन्त ऋतयन्त देवत ऋषिः को विप्र ओहते । कदा हवं मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वतः कदु स्तुवत आ गमः ॥
translation: When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as R̥ishi and as sage? When ever wilt thou, Indra Maghavan, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिरः स्तोमास ईरते । सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
translation: These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth, and give unfailing aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमानशुः । इन्द्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन् ॥
translation: The Bhr̥igus are like Suns, like Kaṇvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent upon. The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः । अर्वाचीनो मघवन्त्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥
translation: Best slayer of the Vr̥itras, yoke thy Bay Steeds, Indra, from afar. Come with the High Ones hither, Maghavan, to us, Mighty, to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमे हि ते कारवो वावशुर्धिया विप्रासो मेधसातये । स त्वं नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणो वेनो न शृणुधी हवम् ॥
translation: For these, the bards and singers, have cried out to thee with prayer, to gain the sacrifice. As such, O Maghavan, Indra, who lovest song, even as a lover bear my call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निरिन्द्र बृहतीभ्यो वृत्रं धनुभ्यो अस्फुरः । निरर्बुदस्य मृगयस्य मायिनो निः पर्वतस्य गा आजः ॥
translation: Thou from the lofty plains above, O Indra, hurledst Vr̥itra down. Thou dravest forth the kine of guileful Mr̥igaya and Arbuda from the mountain's hold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निरग्नयो रुरुचुर्निरु सूर्यो निः सोम इन्द्रियो रसः । निरन्तरिक्षादधमो महामहिं कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम् ॥
translation: Bright were the flaming fires, the Sun gave forth his shine, and Soma, Indra's juice, shone clear. Indra, thou blewest the great Dragon from the air -. men must regard that valorous deed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं मे दुरिन्द्रो मरुतः पाकस्थामा कौरयाणः । विश्वेषां त्मना शोभिष्ठमुपेव दिवि धावमानम् ॥
translation: The fairest courser of them all, who runneth on as 'twere to heaven. Which Indra and the Maruts gave, and Pâkasthâman Kaurayâṇ.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रोहितं मे पाकस्थामा सुधुरं कक्ष्यप्राम् । अदाद्रायो विबोधनम् ॥
translation: To me hath Pâkasthâman given, a ruddy horse,good at the pole, Filling is girth and rousing wealth;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मा अन्ये दश प्रति धुरं वहन्ति वह्नयः । अस्तं वयो न तुग्र्यम् ॥
translation: Compared with whom no other ten strong coursers, harnessed to the pole, Bear Tugrya to his dwelling place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आत्मा पितुस्तनूर्वास ओजोदा अभ्यञ्जनम् । तुरीयमिद्रोहितस्य पाकस्थामानं भोजं दातारमब्रवम् ॥
translation: Raiment is body, food is life, and healing ointment giveth strength. As the free-handed giver of the ruddy steed, I have named Pâkasthâman fourth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः । सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥
translation: THOUGH, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvaṣa, brave Champion I urged by men to Come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा । कण्वासस्त्वा ब्रह्मभिः स्तोमवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि ॥
translation: Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Ruṣama, Ṣyâvaka, and Kr̥ipa thou rejoicest thee, Still do the Kaṇvas, bringing praises, with their prayers, O Indra, draw thee hither: come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् । आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥
translation: Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kaṇvas drink thy fill.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते । आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः ॥
translation: May the drops gladden thee, rich Indra, and obtain bounty for him who pours the juice. Soma pressed in the mortar didst thou take and drink, and hence hast won surpassing might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र चक्रे सहसा सहो बभञ्ज मन्युमोजसा । विश्वे त इन्द्र पृतनायवो यहो नि वृक्षा इव येमिरे ॥
translation: With mightier strength he conquered strength, with energy he crushed their wrath. O Indra, Strong in youth, all those who sought the fray bent and bowed down to thee like trees.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहस्रेणेव सचते यवीयुधा यस्त आनळुपस्तुतिम् । पुत्रं प्रावर्गं कृणुते सुवीर्ये दाश्नोति नमउक्तिभिः ॥
translation: He who wins promise of thine aid goes girt as with a thousand mighty men of war. He makes his son preeminent in hero might – he serves with reverential prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव । महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥
translation: With thee, the Mighty, for our Friend, we will riot fear or feel fatigue. May we see Turvaṣa and Yadu: thy great deed, O Hero, must be glorified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृषा न दानो अस्य रोषति । मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब ॥
translation: On his left hip the Hero hath reclined himself: the proffered feast offends him not. The milk is blended with the honey of the bee: quickly come hither, baste, and drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाँ इदिन्द्र ते सखा । श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रो याति सभामुप ॥
translation: Indra, thy friend is fair of form and rich in horses, cars, and kine. He evermore hath food accompanied by wealth, and radiant joins the company.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋश्यो न तृष्यन्नवपानमा गहि पिबा सोमं वशाँ अनु । निमेघमानो मघवन्दिवेदिव ओजिष्ठं दधिषे सहः ॥
translation: Come like a thirsty antelope to the drinking-place: drink Soma to thy heart's desire. Raining it down, O Maghavan, day after day, thou gainest thy surpassing might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध्वर्यो द्रावया त्वं सोममिन्द्रः पिपासति । उप नूनं युयुजे वृषणा हरी आ च जगाम वृत्रहा ॥
translation: Priest, let the Soma juice flow forth, for Indra longs to drink thereof. He even now hath yoked his vigorous Bay Steeds: the Vr̥itra-slayer hath come near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वयं चित्स मन्यते दाशुरिर्जनो यत्रा सोमस्य तृम्पसि । इदं ते अन्नं युज्यं समुक्षितं तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब ॥
translation: The man with whom thou fillcst thee with Soma deems himself a pious worshipper. This thine appropriate food is here poured out for thee: come, hasten forward. drink of it,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रथेष्ठायाध्वर्यवः सोममिन्द्राय सोतन । अधि ब्रध्नस्याद्रयो वि चक्षते सुन्वन्तो दाश्वध्वरम् ॥
translation: Press out the Soma juice, ye priests, for Indra borne upon his car. The pressing-stones speak loud of Indra, while they shed the juice which, offered, honours him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप ब्रध्नं वावाता वृषणा हरी इन्द्रमपसु वक्षतः । अर्वाञ्चं त्वा सप्तयोऽध्वरश्रियो वहन्तु सवनेदुप ॥
translation: To the brown juice may his dear vigorous Bay Steeds bring Indra, to our holy task. Hither let thy Car-steeds who seek the sacrifice bring thee to our drink-offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र पूषणं वृणीमहे युज्याय पुरूवसुम् । स शक्र शिक्ष पुरुहूत नो धिया तुजे राये विमोचन ॥
translation: Pûshan, the Lord of ample wealth, for firm alliance we elect. May he with wisdom, Ṣakra! Looser! Much-invoked! aid us to riches and to seed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं नः शिशीहि भुरिजोरिव क्षुरं रास्व रायो विमोचन । त्वे तन्नः सुवेदमुस्रियं वसु यं त्वं हिनोषि मर्त्यम् ॥
translation: Sharpen us like a razor in the barber's hands: send riches thou who settest free. Easy to find with thee are treasures of the Dawn for mortal man whom thou dost speed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेमि त्वा पूषन्नृञ्जसे वेमि स्तोतव आघृणे । न तस्य वेम्यरणं हि तद्वसो स्तुषे पज्राय साम्ने ॥
translation: Pûshan, I long to win thy love, I long to praise thee, Radiant God. Excellent Lord, 'tis strange tome, no wish have I to sing the psalm that Pajra sings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परा गावो यवसं कच्चिदाघृणे नित्यं रेक्णो अमर्त्य । अस्माकं पूषन्नविता शिवो भव मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
translation: My kine, O Radiant God, seek pasture where they will, my during wealth, Immortal One. Be our protector, Pûshan! be, most liberal Lord, propitious to our gathering strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्थूरं राधः शताश्वं कुरुङ्गस्य दिविष्टिषु । राज्ञस्त्वेषस्य सुभगस्य रातिषु तुर्वशेष्वमन्महि ॥
translation: Rich was the gift Kurunga gave, a hundred steeds at morning rites. Among the gifts of Turvaṣas we thought of him, the opulent, the splendid King.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धीभिः सातानि काण्वस्य वाजिनः प्रियमेधैरभिद्युभिः । षष्टिं सहस्रानु निर्मजामजे निर्यूथानि गवामृषिः ॥
translation: What by his morning songs Kaṇva, the powerful, hath, with the Priyamedhas, gained-
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृक्षाश्चिन्मे अभिपित्वे अरारणुः । गां भजन्त मेहनाश्वं भजन्त मेहना ॥
translation: The very trees were joyful at my coming: kine they obtained in plenty, steeds in plenty.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दूरादिहेव यत्सत्यरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् । वि भानुं विश्वधातनत् ॥
translation: WHEN, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नृवद्दस्रा मनोयुजा रथेन पृथुपाजसा । सचेथे अश्विनोषसम् ॥
translation: Like Heroes on your will-yoked car farshining, Wonder-Workers! ye Attend, O Aṣvins, on the Dawn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू प्रति स्तोमा अदृक्षत । वाचं दूतो यथोहिषे ॥
translation: By you, O Lords of ample wealth our songs of praise have been observed: As envoy have I brought the prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुप्रिया ण ऊतये पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू । स्तुषे कण्वासो अश्विना ॥
translation: Kaṇvas must praise the Aṣvins dear to many, making many glad, Most rich, that they may succour us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मंहिष्ठा वाजसातमेषयन्ता शुभस्पती । गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
translation: Most liberal, best at winning strength, inciters, Lords of splendour who Visit the worshipper's abode.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता सुदेवाय दाशुषे सुमेधामवितारिणीम् । घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् ॥
translation: So for devout Sudeva dew with fatness his unfailing mead, And make it rich for sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः स्तोममुप द्रवत्तूयं श्येनेभिराशुभिः । यातमश्वेभिरश्विना ॥
translation: Hitherward running speedily with horses, as with rapid hawks, Come, Aṣvins, to our song of praise
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येभिस्तिस्रः परावतो दिवो विश्वानि रोचना । त्रीँरक्तून्परिदीयथः ॥
translation: Wherewith the three wide distances, and all the lights that are in heaven. Ye traverse, and three times of night.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो गोमतीरिष उत सातीरहर्विदा । वि पथः सातये सितम् ॥
translation: O Finders of the Day, that we may win us food of kine and wealth, Open the paths for us to tread.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो गोमन्तमश्विना सुवीरं सुरथं रयिम् । वोळ्हमश्वावतीरिषः ॥
translation: O Aṣvins, bring us wealth in kine, in noble heroes, and in cars: Bring us the strength that horses give.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वावृधाना शुभस्पती दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी । पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
translation: Ye Lords of splendour, glorified, ye Wonder-Workers borne on paths Of gold, drink sweets with Somajuice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवसू मघवद्भ्यश्च सप्रथः । छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यम् ॥
translation: To us, ye Lords of ample wealth, and to our wealth chiefs extend Wide shelter, ne'er to be assailed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि षु ब्रह्म जनानां याविष्टं तूयमा गतम् । मो ष्व१न्याँ उपारतम् ॥
translation: Come quickly downward to the prayer of people whom ye favour most: Approach not unto other folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य पिबतमश्विना युवं मदस्य चारुणः । मध्वो रातस्य धिष्ण्या ॥
translation: Ye Aṣvins whom our minds perceive, drink of this lovely gladdening draught, The mcath which we present to you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मे आ वहतं रयिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम् । पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम् ॥
translation: Bring riches hither unto us in hundreds and in thousands, source Of plenteous food, sustaining all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुत्रा चिद्धि वां नरा विह्वयन्ते मनीषिणः । वाघद्भिरश्विना गतम् ॥
translation: Verily sages call on you, ye Heroes, in full many a place. Moved by the priests, O Aṣvins, conic.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषो हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः । युवां हवन्ते अश्विना ॥
translation: Men who have trimmed the sacred grass, bringing oblations and prepared, O Aṣvins, are invoking you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्माकमद्य वामयं स्तोमो वाहिष्ठो अन्तमः । युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ॥
translation: May this our hymn of praise to-day, most powerful to bring you, be, O Aṣvins, nearest to your hearts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो ह वां मधुनो दृतिराहितो रथचर्षणे । ततः पिबतमश्विना ॥
translation: The skin filled full of savoury meath, laid in the pathway of your car- O Aṣvins, drink ye both therefrom.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू पश्वे तोकाय शं गवे । वहतं पीवरीरिषः ॥
translation: For this, ye Lords of ample wealth, bring blessing for our herd, our kine, Our progeny, and plenteous food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो दिव्या इष उत सिन्धूँरहर्विदा । अप द्वारेव वर्षथः ॥
translation: Ye too unclose to us like doors the strengthening waters of the sky, And rivers, ye who find the day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदा वां तौग्र्यो विधत्समुद्रे जहितो नरा । यद्वां रथो विभिष्पतात् ॥
translation: When did the son of' Tugra serve you, Men? Abandoned in the sea, That with winged steeds your car might fly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवं कण्वाय नासत्या ऋपिरिप्ताय हर्म्ये । शश्वदूतीर्दशस्यथः ॥
translation: Ye, O Nâsatyas, ministered to Kaṇva with repeated aid, When cast into the heated pit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताभिरा यातमूतिभिर्नव्यसीभिः सुशस्तिभिः । यद्वां वृषण्वसू हुवे ॥
translation: Come near with those most recent aids of yours which merit eulogy, When I invoke you, Wealthy Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा चित्कण्वमावतं प्रियमेधमुपस्तुतम् । अत्रिं शिञ्जारमश्विना ॥
translation: As ye protected Kaṇva erst, Priyamedha and Upastuta, Atri, Sinjara, Aṣvins Twain
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथोत कृत्व्ये धनेंऽशुं गोष्वगस्त्यम् । यथा वाजेषु सोभरिम् ॥
translation: And Anṣu in decisive fight, Agastya in the fray for kine. And, in his battles, Sobhari.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतावद्वां वृषण्वसू अतो वा भूयो अश्विना । गृणन्तः सुम्नमीमहे ॥
translation: For so much bliss, or even more, O Aṣvins, Wealthy Gods, than this, We pray white singing hymns to you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरं हिरण्याभीशुमश्विना । आ हि स्थाथो दिविस्पृशम् ॥
translation: Ascend your car with golden seat, O Aṣvins, and with reins of gold, That reaches even to the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्ययी वां रभिरीषा अक्षो हिरण्ययः । उभा चक्रा हिरण्यया ॥
translation: Golden is its supporting shaft, the axle also is of gold, And both the wheels are made of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेन नो वाजिनीवसू परावतश्चिदा गतम् । उपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ॥
translation: Thereon, ye Lords of ample wealth, come to us even from afar, Come ye to this mine eulogy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वहेथे पराकात्पूर्वीरश्नन्तावश्विना । इषो दासीरमर्त्या ॥
translation: From far away ye come to us, Aṣvins, enjoying plenteous food Of Dâsas, O Immortal Ones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो द्युम्नैरा श्रवोभिरा राया यातमश्विना । पुरुश्चन्द्रा नासत्या ॥
translation: With splendour, riches, and renown, O Aṣvins, hither come to us, Nâsatyas, shining brilliantly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एह वां प्रुषितप्सवो वयो वहन्तु पर्णिनः । अच्छा स्वध्वरं जनम् ॥
translation: May dappled horses, steeds who fly with pinions, bring you hitherward To people skilled in sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रथं वामनुगायसं य इषा वर्तते सह । न चक्रमभि बाधते ॥
translation: The whcel delayeth not that car of yours accompanied by song, That cometh with a store of food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्ययेन रथेन द्रवत्पाणिभिरश्वैः । धीजवना नासत्या ॥
translation: Borne on that chariot wrought of gold, with coursers very fleet of foot, Come, O Nâsatyas, swift as thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवं मृगं जागृवांसं स्वदथो वा वृषण्वसू । ता नः पृङ्क्तमिषा रयिम् ॥
translation: O Wealthy Gods, ye taste and find the brisk and watchful wild beast good. Associate wealth with food for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता मे अश्विना सनीनां विद्यातं नवानाम् । यथा चिच्चैद्यः कशुः शतमुष्ट्रानां ददत्सहस्रा दश गोनाम् ॥
translation: As such, O Aṣvins, find for me my share of new-presented gifts, As Kaṣu, Chedi's son, gave me a hundred head of buffaloes, and ten thousand kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो मे हिरण्यसंदृशो दश राज्ञो अमंहत । अधस्पदा इच्चैद्यस्य कृष्टयश्चर्मम्ना अभितो जनाः ॥
translation: He who hath given me for mine own ten Kings like gold to look upon. At Caidya's feet are all the people round about, all those who think upon the shield.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: माकिरेना पथा गाद्येनेमे यन्ति चेदयः । अन्यो नेत्सूरिरोहते भूरिदावत्तरो जनः ॥
translation: No man, not any, goes upon the path on which the Chedis walk. No other prince, no folk is held more liberal of gifts than they.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव । स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे ॥
translation: INDRA, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः । विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा ॥
translation: When the priests, strengthening the Son of Holy Law, present their gifts, Singers with Order's hymn of praiser.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम् । जामि ब्रुवत आयुधम् ॥
translation: Since Kaṇvas with their lauds have made Indra complete the sacrifice. Words are their own appropriate arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः । समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ॥
translation: Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men, bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् । इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी ॥
translation: This power of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा । शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना ॥
translation: The fiercely-moving Vr̥itra's head he severed with his thunderbolt, His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा अभि प्र णोनुमो विपामग्रेषु धीतयः । अग्नेः शोचिर्न दिद्युतः ॥
translation: Here are-we sing them loudly forth-our thoughts among-the best of songs. Even lightnings like the blaze of fire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गुहा सतीरुप त्मना प्र यच्छोचन्त धीतयः । कण्वा ऋतस्य धारया ॥
translation: When bidden thoughts, spontaneously advancing, glow, and with the stream Of sacrifice the Kaṇvas shine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र तमिन्द्र नशीमहि रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । प्र ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये ॥
translation: Indra, may we obtain that wealth in horses and in herds of cows, And prayer that may be noticed first.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रभ । अहं सूर्य इवाजनि ॥
translation: I from my Father have received deep knowledge of the Holy Law I was born like unto the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहं प्रत्नेन मन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् । येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे ॥
translation: After the lore of ancient time I make, like Kaṇva, beauteous songs, And Indra's selfgains strength thereby.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुॠषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
translation: Whatever R̥ishis have not praised thee, Indra, or have lauded thee, By me exalted wax thou strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदस्य मन्युरध्वनीद्वि वृत्रं पर्वशो रुजन् । अपः समुद्रमैरयत् ॥
translation: When his wrath thundered, when he rent Vr̥itra to pieces, limb by limb, He sent the waters to the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि शुष्ण इन्द्र धर्णसिं वज्रं जघन्थ दस्यवि । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे ॥
translation: Against the Dasyu gusna thou, Indra, didst hurl thy during bolt: Thou, Dread one, hast a hero's fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न द्याव इन्द्रमोजसा नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् । न विव्यचन्त भूमयः ॥
translation: Neither the heavens nor firmaments nor regions of the earth contain Indra, the Thunderer with his might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्त इन्द्र महीरपः स्तभूयमान आशयत् । नि तं पद्यासु शिश्नथः ॥
translation: O Indra him who lay at length staying thy copious waters thou, In his own footsteps, smotest down
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इमे रोदसी मही समीची समजग्रभीत् । तमोभिरिन्द्र तं गुहः ॥
translation: Thou hiddest deep in darkness itim, O Indra, who had set his grasp On spacious heaven and earth conjoined.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इन्द्र यतयस्त्वा भृगवो ये च तुष्टुवुः । ममेदुग्र श्रुधी हवम् ॥
translation: Indra, whatever Yatis and Bhr̥igus have offered praise to thee, Listen, thou Mighty, to my call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरम् । एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः ॥
translation: Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught; Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या इन्द्र प्रस्वस्त्वासा गर्भमचक्रिरन् । परि धर्मेव सूर्यम् ॥
translation: Which, teeming, have received thee as a life-germ, Indra, with their mouth, Like Sûrya who sustaineth all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिच्छवसस्पते कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः । त्वां सुतास इन्दवः ॥
translation: O Lord of Might, with hymns of praise the Kaṇvas have increased thy power, The drops poured forth have strengthened thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवेदिन्द्र प्रणीतिषूत प्रशस्तिरद्रिवः । यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः ॥
translation: Under thy guidance, Indra, mid thy praises, Lord of Thunder, shall The sacrifice be soon performed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ न इन्द्र महीमिषं पुरं न दर्षि गोमतीम् । उत प्रजां सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Indra, disclose much food for us, like a stronghold with store of kine: Give progeny and heroic strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्यदाश्वश्व्यं यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा । अग्रे विक्षु प्रदीदयत् ॥
translation: And, Indra, grant us all that wealth of fleet steeds which shone bright of old Among the tribes of Nahushas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि व्रजं न तत्निषे सूर उपाकचक्षसम् । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
translation: Hither thou seemest to attract heaven's fold which shines before our eyes, When, Indra, thou art kind to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदङ्ग तविषीयस इन्द्र प्रराजसि क्षितीः । महाँ अपार ओजसा ॥
translation: Yea, when thou puttest forth thy power, Indra, thou governest the folk. Mighty, unlimited in strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा हविष्मतीर्विश उप ब्रुवत ऊतये । उरुज्रयसमिन्दुभिः ॥
translation: The tribes who bring oblations call to thee, to thee to give them help, With drops to thee who spreadest far.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपह्वरे गिरीणां संगथे च नदीनाम् । धिया विप्रो अजायत ॥
translation: There where the mountains downward slope, there by the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest with song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतः समुद्रमुद्वतश्चिकित्वाँ अव पश्यति । यतो विपान एजति ॥
translation: Thence, marking, from his lofty place downward he looks upon the sea, And thence with rapid stir he moves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिष्पश्यन्ति वासरम् । परो यदिध्यते दिवा ॥
translation: Then, verify, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कण्वास इन्द्र ते मतिं विश्वे वर्धन्ति पौंस्यम् । उतो शविष्ठ वृष्ण्यम् ॥
translation: Indra, the Kaṇvas all exalt thy wisdom and thy manly power, And, Mightiest! thine heroic strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमां म इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं जुषस्व प्र सु मामव । उत प्र वर्धया मतिम् ॥
translation: Accept this eulogy of mine, Indra, and guard me carefully: Strengthen my thought and prosper it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत ब्रह्मण्या वयं तुभ्यं प्रवृद्ध वज्रिवः । विप्रा अतक्ष्म जीवसे ॥
translation: For thee, O Mighty, Thunder-armed, we singers through devotionhave Fashioned the hymn that we may live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि कण्वा अनूषतापो न प्रवता यतीः । इन्द्रं वनन्वती मतिः ॥
translation: To Indra have the Kaṇvas sung, like waters speeding down a slope: The song is fain to go to him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । अनुत्तमन्युमजरम् ॥
translation: As rivers swell the ocean, so our hymns of praise make Indra strong, Eternal, of resistIess wrath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो याहि परावतो हरिभ्यां हर्यताभ्याम् । इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ॥
translation: Come with thy lovely Bay Steeds, come to us from regions far away O Indra, drink this Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः । हवन्ते वाजसातये ॥
translation: Best slayer of Vr̥itras, men whose sacred grass is ready trimmed Invoke thee for the gain of spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे चक्रं न वर्त्येतशम् । अनु सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
translation: The heavens and earth come after thee as the wheel follows Etaṣa: To thee flow Sorna-drops effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्दस्वा सु स्वर्णर उतेन्द्र शर्यणावति । मत्स्वा विवस्वतो मती ॥
translation: Rejoice, O Indra, in the light, rejoice in Ṣaryaṇâvân, be Glad in the sacrificer's hymn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वावृधान उप द्यवि वृषा वज्र्यरोरवीत् । वृत्रहा सोमपातमः ॥
translation: Grown strong in heaven, the Thunder-armed hath bellowed, Vr̥itra-slayer, Bull, Chief drinker of the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋषिर्हि पूर्वजा अस्येक ईशान ओजसा । इन्द्र चोष्कूयसे वसु ॥
translation: Thou art a R̥ishi born of old, sole Ruler over all by might: Thou, Indra, guardest well our wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्माकं त्वा सुताँ उप वीतपृष्ठा अभि प्रयः । शतं वहन्तु हरयः ॥
translation: May thy Bay Steeds with beauteous backs, a hundred, bring thee to the feast, Bring thee to these our Soma-draughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमां सु पूर्व्यां धियं मधोर्घृतस्य पिप्युषीम् । कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः ॥
translation: The Kaṇvas with their hymns of praise have magnified this ancient thought That swells with streams of meath and oil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमिद्विमहीनां मेधे वृणीत मर्त्यः । इन्द्रं सनिष्युरूतये ॥
translation: Mid mightiest Gods let mortal man choose Indra at the sacrifice, Indra, whoe'er would win, for help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी । सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ॥
translation: Thy steeds, by Priyamedhas praised, shall bring thee, God whom all invoke, Hither to drink the Somajuice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतमहं तिरिन्दिरे सहस्रं पर्शावा ददे । राधांसि याद्वानाम् ॥
translation: A hundred thousand have I gained from Parṣu, from Tirindira, And presents of the Yadavas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीणि शतान्यर्वतां सहस्रा दश गोनाम् । ददुष्पज्राय साम्ने ॥
translation: Ten thousand head of kine, and steeds three times a hundred they bestowed On Pajra for the Sâma-song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदानट् ककुहो दिवमुष्ट्राञ्चतुर्युजो ददत् । श्रवसा याद्वं जनम् ॥
translation: Kakuha hath reached up to heaven, bestowing buffaloes yoked in fours, And matched in fame the Yadavas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र यद्वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मरुतो विप्रो अक्षरत् । वि पर्वतेषु राजथ ॥
translation: O MARUTS, when the sage hath poured the Trishṭup forth as food for you, Ye shine amid the mountain-clouds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदङ्ग तविषीयवो यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् । नि पर्वता अहासत ॥
translation: When, Bright Ones, fain to show your might ye have determined on your course, The mountain-clouds have bent them down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदीरयन्त वायुभिर्वाश्रासः पृश्निमातरः । धुक्षन्त पिप्युषीमिषम् ॥
translation: Loud roaring with the winds the Sons of Pr̥iṣni have upraised themselves: They have poured out the streaming food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वपन्ति मरुतो मिहं प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वतान् । यद्यामं यान्ति वायुभिः ॥
translation: The Maruts spread the mist abroad and make mountains rock and reel, When with the winds they go their way
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि यद्यामाय वो गिरिर्नि सिन्धवो विधर्मणे । महे शुष्माय येमिरे ॥
translation: What time the rivers and the hills before your coming bowed them down, So to sustain your mighty force.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युष्माँ उ नक्तमूतये युष्मान्दिवा हवामहे । युष्मान्प्रयत्यध्वरे ॥
translation: We call on you for aid by night, on you for succour in the day, On you while sacrifice proceeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु त्ये अरुणप्सवश्चित्रा यामेभिरीरते । वाश्रा अधि ष्णुना दिवः ॥
translation: These, verily, wondrous, red of hue, speed on their courses with a roar Over the ridges of the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सृजन्ति रश्मिमोजसा पन्थां सूर्याय यातवे । ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ॥
translation: With might they drop the loosened rein so that the Sun may run his course, And spread themselves with beams of light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमां मे मरुतो गिरमिमं स्तोममृभुक्षणः । इमं मे वनता हवम् ॥
translation: Accept, ye Maruts, this my song, accept ye this mine hymn of praise, Accept, R̥ibhukshans, this my call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीणि सरांसि पृश्नयो दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु । उत्सं कवन्धमुद्रिणम् ॥
translation: The dappled Cows have poured three lakes, meath for the Thunder-wielding God, From the great cask, the watery cloud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मरुतो यद्ध वो दिवः सुम्नायन्तो हवामहे । आ तू न उप गन्तन ॥
translation: O Maruts, quickly come to us when, longing for felicity, We call you hither from the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवो रुद्रा ऋभुक्षणो दमे । उत प्रचेतसो मदे ॥
translation: For, Rudras and R̥ibhukshans, ye, Most Bountiful, are in the house, Wise when the gladdening draught is drunk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो रयिं मदच्युतं पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम् । इयर्ता मरुतो दिवः ॥
translation: O Maruts, send us down from heaven riches distilling rapturous joy, With plenteous food, sustaining all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधीव यद्गिरीणां यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् । सुवानैर्मन्दध्व इन्दुभिः ॥
translation: When, Bright Ones, hither from the hills ye have resolved to take your way, Ye revel in the drops effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतावतश्चिदेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः । अदाभ्यस्य मन्मभिः ॥
translation: Man should solicit with his lauds happiness which belongs to them, So great a band invincible.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये द्रप्सा इव रोदसी धमन्त्यनु वृष्टिभिः । उत्सं दुहन्तो अक्षितम् ॥
translation: They who like fiery sparks with showers of rain blow through the heaven and earth, Milking the spring that never fails.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु स्वानेभिरीरत उद्रथैरुदु वायुभिः । उत्स्तोमैः पृश्निमातरः ॥
translation: With chariots and tumultuous roar, with tempests and with hymns of praise The Sons of Pr̥iṣni hurry forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येनाव तुर्वशं यदुं येन कण्वं धनस्पृतम् । राये सु तस्य धीमहि ॥
translation: For wealth, we think of that whereby ye aided Yadu, Turvaṣa, And Kaṇva who obtained the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा उ वः सुदानवो घृतं न पिप्युषीरिषः । वर्धान्काण्वस्य मन्मभिः ॥
translation: May these our viands Bounteous Ones I that flow in streams like holy oil, With Kaṇva's hymns, increase your might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्व नूनं सुदानवो मदथा वृक्तबर्हिषः । ब्रह्मा को वः सपर्यति ॥
translation: Where, Bounteous Lords for whom the grass is trimmed, are ye rejoicing now? What Brahman is adoring you?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि ष्म यद्ध वः पुरा स्तोमेभिर्वृक्तबर्हिषः । शर्धाँ ऋतस्य जिन्वथ ॥
translation: Is it not there where ye of old, supplied with sacred grass, for lauds Inspired the strong in sacrifice?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समु त्ये महतीरपः सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् । सं वज्रं पर्वशो दधुः ॥
translation: They brought together both the worlds, the mighty waters, and the Sun, And, joint by joint, the thunderbolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि वृत्रं पर्वशो ययुर्वि पर्वताँ अराजिनः । चक्राणा वृष्णि पौंस्यम् ॥
translation: They sundered Vr̥itra limb from limb and split the gloomy mountain-clouds, Performing a heroic deed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु त्रितस्य युध्यतः शुष्ममावन्नुत क्रतुम् । अन्विन्द्रं वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
translation: They reinforced the power and strength of Trita as he fought, and helped Indra in battle with the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्युद्धस्ता अभिद्यवः शिप्राः शीर्षन्हिरण्ययीः । शुभ्रा व्यञ्जत श्रिये ॥
translation: They deck themselves for glory, bright, celestial, lightning in their hands, And helms of gold upon their heads.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उशना यत्परावत उक्ष्णो रन्ध्रमयातन । द्यौर्न चक्रदद्भिया ॥
translation: When eagerly ye from far away came to the cavern of the Bull, He bellowed in his fear like Heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो मखस्य दावनेऽश्वैर्हिरण्यपाणिभिः । देवास उप गन्तन ॥
translation: Borne by your golden-footed steeds, O Gods, come hither to receive The sacrifice we offer you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदेषां पृषती रथे प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः । यान्ति शुभ्रा रिणन्नपः ॥
translation: When the red leader draws along their spotted deer yoked to the car. The Bright Ones come, and shed the rain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुषोमे शर्यणावत्यार्जीके पस्त्यावति । ययुर्निचक्रया नरः ॥
translation: Sushomâ, Ṣaryaṇâvân, and Ârjîka full of homes, have they. These Heroes, sought with downward car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदा गच्छाथ मरुत इत्था विप्रं हवमानम् । मार्डीकेभिर्नाधमानम् ॥
translation: When, Maruts, ye come to him, the singer who invokes you thus, With favours to your suppliant?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियो यदिन्द्रमजहातन । को वः सखित्व ओहते ॥
translation: What now? where have ye still a friend since ye left Indra all alone? Who counteth on your friendship now?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहो षु णो वज्रहस्तैः कण्वासो अग्निं मरुद्भिः । स्तुषे हिरण्यवाशीभिः ॥
translation: The Kaṇvas sing forth Agni's praise together with our Maruts' who Wield thunder and wear swords of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओ षु वृष्णः प्रयज्यूना नव्यसे सुविताय । ववृत्यां चित्रवाजान् ॥
translation: Hither for new felicity may I attract the Impetuous Ones, The Heroes with their wondrous strength
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरयश्चिन्नि जिहते पर्शानासो मन्यमानाः । पर्वताश्चिन्नि येमिरे ॥
translation: Before them sink the very hills deerning themseives abysses: yea, Even the mountains bend them down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आक्ष्णयावानो वहन्त्यन्तरिक्षेण पततः । धातारः स्तुवते वयः ॥
translation: Steeds flying on their tortuous path through mid-air carry them, and give The man who lauds them strength and life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्हि जानि पूर्व्यश्छन्दो न सूरो अर्चिषा । ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ॥
translation: Agni was born the first of all, like Sûrya lovely with his light: With lustre these have spread abroad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिरश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
translation: WITH all the succours that are yours, O Aṣvins, hither come to us: Wonderful, borne on paths of gold, drink ye the meath with Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विना रथेन सूर्यत्वचा । भुजी हिरण्यपेशसा कवी गम्भीरचेतसा ॥
translation: Come now, ye Aṣvins, on your car decked with a sun-bright canopy, Bountiful, with your golden forms, Sages with depth of intellect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यातं नहुषस्पर्यान्तरिक्षात्सुवृक्तिभिः । पिबाथो अश्विना मधु कण्वानां सवने सुतम् ॥
translation: Come hither from the Nahushas, come, drawn by pure hymns, from mid-air. O Aṣvins, drink the savoury juice shed in the Kaṇvas' sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो यातं दिवस्पर्यान्तरिक्षादधप्रिया । पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामिह सुषाव सोम्यं मधु ॥
translation: Come to us hither from the heavens, come from mid-air, well-loved by us: Here Kaṇva's son hath pressed for you the pleasant meath of Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो यातमुपश्रुत्यश्विना सोमपीतये । स्वाहा स्तोमस्य वर्धना प्र कवी धीतिभिर्नरा ॥
translation: Come, Aṣvins, to give car to us, to drink the Soma, Aṣvins, come. Hail, Strengtheners of the praise-song speed onward, ye Heroes, with your thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि वां पुर ऋषयो जुहूरेऽवसे नरा । आ यातमश्विना गतमुपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ॥
translation: As, Heroes, in the olden time the R̥ishis called you to their aid, So now, O Aṣvins, come to us, come near to this mine eulogy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवश्चिद्रोचनादध्या नो गन्तं स्वर्विदा । धीभिर्वत्सप्रचेतसा स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता ॥
translation: Even from the luminous sphere of heaven come to us, ye who find the light, Carers for Vatsa, through our prayers and lauds, O yewho hearour call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: किमन्ये पर्यासतेऽस्मत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना । पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
translation: Do others more than we adore the Aṣvins with their hymns of praise? The R̥ishi Vatsa, Kaṇva's son, hath magnified you with his songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वां विप्र इहावसेऽह्वत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना । अरिप्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं मयोभुवा ॥
translation: The holy singer with his hymns hath called you, Aṣvins, hither-ward; Best Vr̥itra-slayers, free from stain, as such bring us felicity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यद्वां योषणा रथमतिष्ठद्वाजिनीवसू । विश्वान्यश्विना युवं प्र धीतान्यगच्छतम् ॥
translation: What time, ye Lords of ample wealth, the Lady mounted on your car, Then, O ye Aṣvins, ye attained all wishes that your hearts desired.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना । वत्सो वां मधुमद्वचोऽशंसीत्काव्यः कविः ॥
translation: Come thence, O Aṣvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments: Vatsa the sage, the sage's son, hath sung a song of sweets to you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू मनोतरा रयीणाम् । स्तोमं मे अश्विनाविममभि वह्नी अनूषाताम् ॥
translation: Cheerers of many, rich in goods, discoverers of opulence, The Aṣvins, Riders through the sky, have welcomed this my song of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो विश्वान्यश्विना धत्तं राधांस्यह्रया । कृतं न ऋत्वियावतो मा नो रीरधतं निदे ॥
translation: O Aṣvins, grant us all rich gifts wherewith no man mav interfere. Make us observe the stated times: give us not over to reproach.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अध्यम्बरे । अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना ॥
translation: Whether, Nâsatyas, ye be nigh, or whether ye be far away, Come thence, O Aṣvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो वां नासत्यावृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् । तस्मै सहस्रनिर्णिजमिषं धत्तं घृतश्चुतम् ॥
translation: Vatsa the R̥ishi with his songs, Nâsatyas, hath exalted you: Grant him rich food distilling oil, graced with a thousand ornaments.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रास्मा ऊर्जं घृतश्चुतमश्विना यच्छतं युवम् । यो वां सुम्नाय तुष्टवद्वसूयाद्दानुनस्पती ॥
translation: Bestow on him, O Aṣvins, food that strengthens, and that drops with oil, On him who praises you for bliss, and, Lords of bounty, prays for wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो गन्तं रिशादसेमं स्तोमं पुरुभुजा । कृतं नः सुश्रियो नरेमा दातमभिष्टये ॥
translation: Come to us, ye who slay the foe, Lords of rich treasure, to this hymn. O Heroes, give us high renown and these good things of earth for help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत । राजन्तावध्वराणामश्विना यामहूतिषु ॥
translation: The Priyamedhas have invoked you with all succours that are yours, You, Aṣvins, Lords of solemn rites, with calls entreating you to come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो गन्तं मयोभुवाश्विना शम्भुवा युवम् । यो वां विपन्यू धीतिभिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
translation: Come to us, Aṣvins, ye Who bring felicity, auspicious Ones, To Vatsa who with prayer and hymn, lovers of song, hath honoured you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याभिः कण्वं मेधातिथिं याभिर्वशं दशव्रजम् । याभिर्गोशर्यमावतं ताभिर्नोऽवतं नरा ॥
translation: Aid us, O Heroes, for those hymns for which ye helped Goṣarya erst, Gave Vaṣa, Daṣavraja aid, and Kaṇva and Medhâtithi:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याभिर्नरा त्रसदस्युमावतं कृत्व्ये धने । ताभिः ष्व१स्माँ अश्विना प्रावतं वाजसातये ॥
translation: And favoured Trasadasyu, ye Heroes, in spoil-deciding fray: For these, O Aṣvins, graciously assist us in acquiring strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वां स्तोमाः सुवृक्तयो गिरो वर्धन्त्वश्विना । पुरुत्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं पुरुस्पृहा ॥
translation: O Aṣvins, may pure hymns of ours, and songs and praises, honour you: Best slayers everywhere of foes, as such we fondly yearn for you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीणि पदान्यश्विनोराविः सान्ति गुहा परः । कवी ऋतस्य पत्मभिरर्वाग्जीवेभ्यस्परि ॥
translation: Three places of the Aṣvins, erst concealed, are made apparent now. Both Sages, with the flight of Law come hither unto those who live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गन्तमवसे । प्रास्मै यच्छतमवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः ॥
translation: To help and favour Vatsa now, O Aṣvins, come ye hitherward. Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignities away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदन्तरिक्षे यद्दिवि यत्पञ्च मानुषाँ अनु । नृम्णं तद्धत्तमश्विना ॥
translation: All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air, Bestow, ye Aṣvins, upon us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमामृशुः । एवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
translation: Remember Kaṇva first of all among the singers, Aṣvins, who Have thought upon your wondrous deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना स्तोमेन परि षिच्यते । अयं सोमो मधुमान्वाजिनीवसू येन वृत्रं चिकेतथः ॥
translation: Aṣvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused, This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of ample wealth, through which ye think upon the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदप्सु यद्वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कृतम् । तेन माविष्टमश्विना ॥
translation: Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-Workers, and in growing plants, Therewith, O Aṣvins, succour me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यन्नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद्वा देव भिषज्यथः । अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विन्धते हविष्मन्तं हि गच्छथः ॥
translation: What force, Nâsatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal, This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नूनमश्विनोॠषिः स्तोमं चिकेत वामया । आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिञ्चादथर्वणि ॥
translation: Now hath the R̥ishi splendidly thought out the Aṣvins' hymn of praise. Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना । आ वां स्तोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत ॥
translation: Ye Aṣvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way. May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि । यद्वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
translation: When, O Nâsatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns, Or, Aṣvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanya specially.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वां कक्षीवाँ उत यद्व्यश्व ऋषिर्यद्वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव । पृथी यद्वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथाम् ॥
translation: As erst Kakshîvân and the R̥ishi Vyaṣva, as erst Dîrghatamas invoked your presence, Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Pr̥ithî, so be ye mindful of us here, O Aṣvins.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा । वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातम् ॥
translation: Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies, Come to the house to give us seed and offspring,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद्वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा । यदादित्येभिॠभुभिः सजोषसा यद्वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः ॥
translation: Whether with Indra ye be faring, Aṣvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vâyu, In concord with the R̥ibhus or Âdityas, or standing still in Vishṇu's striding-places.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये । यत्पृत्सु तुर्वणे सहस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः ॥
translation: When I, O Aṣvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength, Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Aṣvins' noblest grace.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता । इमे सोमासो अधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ ॥
translation: Now come, ye Aṣvins, hitherward: here are oblations set for you; These Soma-draughts to aid Yadu and Turvaṣa, these offered you mid Kaṇva's Sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यन्नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम् । तेन नूनं विमदाय प्रचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यच्छतम् ॥
translation: Whatever healing balm is yours, Nisatyas, near or far away, Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभुत्स्यु प्र देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः । व्यावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः ॥
translation: Together with the Goddess, with the Aṣvins' Speech have I awoke. Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn, and holy gift from mortal men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र बोधयोषो अश्विना प्र देवि सूनृते महि । प्र यज्ञहोतरानुषक्प्र मदाय श्रवो बृहत् ॥
translation: Awake the Aṣvins, Goddess Dawn! Up Mighty Lady of sweet strains! Rise, straightway, priest of sacrifice! High glory to the gladdening draught!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे । आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नृपाय्यम् ॥
translation: Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light shinest together with the Sun, And to this man-protecting home the chariot ofthe Aṣvins comes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः । यद्वा वाणीरनूषत प्र देवयन्तो अश्विना ॥
translation: When yellow stalks give forth the juice, as cows from udders pour their milk, And voices sound the song of praise, the Aṣvins' worshippers show first.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र द्युम्नाय प्र शवसे प्र नृषाह्याय शर्मणे । प्र दक्षाय प्रचेतसा ॥
translation: Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men, And power and skill, most sapient Ones!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यन्नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः । यद्वा सुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या ॥
translation: When Aṣvins, worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house. With wisdom or the bliss ye bring.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्स्थो दीर्घप्रसद्मनि यद्वादो रोचने दिवः । यद्वा समुद्रे अध्याकृते गृहेऽत आ यातमश्विना ॥
translation: WHETHER ye travel far away or dwell in yonder light of heaven, Or in a mansion that is built above the sea, come thence, ye Aṣvins, hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वा यज्ञं मनवे सम्मिमिक्षथुरेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् । बृहस्पतिं विश्वान्देवाँ अहं हुव इन्द्राविष्णू अश्विनावाशुहेषसा ॥
translation: Or if for Manu.ye prepared the sacrifice, remember also Kaṇva's son. I call Br̥ihaspati, Indra, Vishṇu, all the gods, the Aṣvins borne by rapid steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्या न्व१श्विना हुवे सुदंससा गृभे कृता । ययोरस्ति प्र णः सख्यं देवेष्वध्याप्यम् ॥
translation: Those Aṣvins I invoke who work marvels, brought hither to receive, With whom our friendship is most famed, and kinship passing that of Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ययोरधि प्र यज्ञा असूरे सन्ति सूरयः । ता यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य प्रचेतसा स्वधाभिर्या पिबतः सोम्यं मधु ॥
translation: On whom the solemn rites depend, whose worshippers rise without the Sun: These who foreknow the holy work of sacrifice, and by their Godhead drink the sweets of Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्याश्विनावपाग्यत्प्राक्स्थो वाजिनीवसू । यद्द्रुह्यव्यनवि तुर्वशे यदौ हुवे वामथ मा गतम् ॥
translation: Whether ye, Lords of ample wealth, now linger in the cast or west, With Druhyu, or with Anu, Yadu, Turvaga, I call you hither; come to me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदन्तरिक्षे पतथः पुरुभुजा यद्वेमे रोदसी अनु । यद्वा स्वधाभिरधितिष्ठथो रथमत आ यातमश्विना ॥
translation: Lords of great riches, whether through the firmament ye fly or speed through heaven and earth, Or with your Godlike natures stand upon your cars, come thence, O Aṣvins, hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा । त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः ॥
translation: THOU Agni, God mid mortal men, art guard of sacred rites, thou art To be adored at sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमसि प्रशस्यो विदथेषु सहन्त्य । अग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् ॥
translation: O Mighty Agni, thou must be glorified at our festivals, Bearing our offerings to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वमस्मदप द्विषो युयोधि जातवेदः । अदेवीरग्ने अरातीः ॥
translation: O Jâtavedas Agni, fight and drive our foes afar from us, Themand their godless enmities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्ति चित्सन्तमह यज्ञं मर्तस्य रिपोः । नोप वेषि जातवेदः ॥
translation: Thou, Jâtavedas, seekest not the worship of a hostile man, However nigh it be to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मर्ता अमर्त्यस्य ते भूरि नाम मनामहे । विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
translation: We sages, mortals as we are, adore the mighty name oof thee, Immortal Jâtavedas' name.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विप्रं विप्रासोऽवसे देवं मर्तास ऊतये । अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
translation: Sages, we call the Sage to help, mortals, we call the God to aid: We call on Agni with our songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् । अग्ने त्वांकामया गिरा ॥
translation: May Vatsa draw- thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
translation: Thou art the same in many a place: mid all the people thou art Lord. In fray and fightt we call on thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे । वाजेषु चित्रराधसम् ॥
translation: When we are seeking strength we call Agni to help us in the strife, The giver of rich gifts in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि । स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रयस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व ॥
translation: Ancient, adorablie at sacrifices, Priest from of old, meet for our praise, thou sittest. Fill full and satisfy thy body, Agni, and win us happiness by offering worship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति । येना हंसि न्य१त्रिणं तमीमहे ॥
translation: JOY, Mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma-draughts, wherewith Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we long.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयन्तं स्वर्णरम् । येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे ॥
translation: Wherewith thou bolpest Adhrigu, the great Daṣagva, and the God Who stirs the sunlight, and the sea, for that we long.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येन सिन्धुं महीरपो रथाँ इव प्रचोदयः । पन्थामृतस्य यातवे तमीमहे ॥
translation: Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods To go the way ordained by Law, for that we long.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं स्तोममभिष्टये घृतं न पूतमद्रिवः । येना नु सद्य ओजसा ववक्षिथ ॥
translation: Accept this laud for aid, made pure like oil, thou Caster of the Stone, Whereby even in a moment thou hast waxen great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं जुषस्व गिर्वणः समुद्र इव पिन्वते । इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्ववक्षिथ ॥
translation: Be pleased, Song-lover, with this song it flows abundant like the sea. Indra, with all thy succours thou hast waxen great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो नो देवः परावतः सखित्वनाय मामहे । दिवो न वृष्टिं प्रथयन्ववक्षिथ ॥
translation: The God who from afar hath sent gifts to maintain our friendship's bond, Thou. spreading them like rain from heaven, hast waxen great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ववक्षुरस्य केतवो उत वज्रो गभस्त्योः । यत्सूर्यो न रोदसी अवर्धयत् ॥
translation: The beams that mark him have grown strong, the thunder rests between his arms, When, like the Sun, he hath increased both Heaven and Earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदि प्रवृद्ध सत्पते सहस्रं महिषाँ अघः । आदित्त इन्द्रियं महि प्र वावृधे ॥
translation: When, Mighty Lord of Heroes, thou didst cat a thousand buffaloes, Then grew and waxed exceeding great thine Indra-power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्न्यर्शसानमोषति । अग्निर्वनेव सासहिः प्र वावृधे ॥
translation: Indra consumeth with the rays of Sûrya the malicious man: Like Agni conquering the woods, he hath grown strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इयं त ऋत्वियावती धीतिरेति नवीयसी । सपर्यन्ती पुरुप्रिया मिमीत इत् ॥
translation: This newest thought of ours that suits the time approaches unto thee: Serving, beloved in many a place it metes and marks.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गर्भो यज्ञस्य देवयुः क्रतुं पुनीत आनुषक् । स्तोमैरिन्द्रस्य वावृधे मिमीत इत् ॥
translation: The pious germ of sacrifice directly purifies the soul. By Indra's lauds it waxes great, it metes and marks.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सनिर्मित्रस्य पप्रथ इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये । प्राची वाशीव सुन्वते मिमीत इत् ॥
translation: Indra who wins the friend hath spread himself to drink the Soma-draught: Like worshipper's dilating praise; it metes and marks.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं विप्रा उक्थवाहसोऽभिप्रमन्दुरायवः । घृतं न पिप्य आसन्यृतस्य यत् ॥
translation: He whom the sages, living men, have gladdened, offering up their hymns, Hath swelled like oil of sacrifice in Agni's mouth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत स्वराजे अदितिः स्तोममिन्द्राय जीजनत् । पुरुप्रशस्तमूतय ऋतस्य यत् ॥
translation: Aditi also hath brought forth a hymn for Indra, Sovran Lord: The work of sacrifice for help is glorified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वह्नय ऊतयेऽनूषत प्रशस्तये । न देव विव्रता हरी ऋतस्य यत् ॥
translation: The ministering priests have sung their songs for aid and eulogy: God, thy Bays turn not from the rite which Law ordains.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये । यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः ॥
translation: If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Vishṇu's or Trita Âptya's side, Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मन्दसे । अस्माकमित्सुते रणा समिन्दुभिः ॥
translation: Or, Ṣakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air, Rejoice thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वासि सुन्वतो वृधो यजमानस्य सत्पते । उक्थे वा यस्य रण्यसि समिन्दुभिः ॥
translation: Or, Lord of Heroes if thou aid the worshipper who shed; the, juice, Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवंदेवं वोऽवस इन्द्रमिन्द्रं गृणीषणि । अधा यज्ञाय तुर्वणे व्यानशुः ॥
translation: To magnify the God, the God, Indra, yea, Indra for your help, And promptly end the sacrifice-this have they gained.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञेभिर्यज्ञवाहसं सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् । होत्राभिरिन्द्रं वावृधुर्व्यानशुः ॥
translation: With worship, him whom men adore, with Soma, him who drinks it most, Indra with lauds have they increasedthis have they gained.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः । विश्वा वसूनि दाशुषे व्यानशुः ॥
translation: His leadings are with power and might and his instructions manifold: He gives the worshipper all wealth: this have they gained.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे देवासो दधिरे पुरः । इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषता समोजसे ॥
translation: For slaying Vr̥itra have the Gods set Indra in the foremost place. Indra the choral bands have sung, for vigorous strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महान्तं महिना वयं स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुतम् । अर्कैरभि प्र णोनुमः समोजसे ॥
translation: We to the Mighty with our might, with lauds to him who hears our call, With holy hymns have sung aloud, for vigorous strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न यं विविक्तो रोदसी नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् । अमादिदस्य तित्विषे समोजसः ॥
translation: Not earth, nor heaven, nor firmaments contain the Thunder-wielding God: They shake before his violent rush and vigorous strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र पृतनाज्ये देवास्त्वा दधिरे पुरः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
translation: What time the Gods, O Indra, get thee foremost in the furious fight, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदा वृत्रं नदीवृतं शवसा वज्रिन्नवधीः । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
translation: When Vr̥itra, stayer of the floods, thou slewest, Thunderer with might, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदा ते विष्णुरोजसा त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे । आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
translation: When Vishṇu, through thine energy, strode wide those three great steps of his, Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदा ते हर्यता हरी वावृधाते दिवेदिवे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
translation: When thy two beautiful Bay Steeds grew great and greater day by day, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदा ते मारुतीर्विशस्तुभ्यमिन्द्र नियेमिरे । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
translation: When, Indra, all the Marut folk humbly submitted them to thee, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदा सूर्यममुं दिवि शुक्रं ज्योतिरधारयः । आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
translation: When yonder Sun, that brilliant light, thou settest in the heaven above, Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमां त इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं विप्र इयर्ति धीतिभिः । जामिं पदेव पिप्रतीं प्राध्वरे ॥
translation: To thee, O Indra, with this thought the sage lifts up this eulogy, Akin and leading as on foot to sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदस्य धामनि प्रिये समीचीनासो अस्वरन् । नाभा यज्ञस्य दोहना प्राध्वरे ॥
translation: When in thine own dear dwelling all gathered have lifted up the voice Milk-streams at worship's central spot, for sacrifice,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं सुगव्यमिन्द्र दद्धि नः । होतेव पूर्वचित्तये प्राध्वरे ॥
translation: As Priest, O Indra, give us wealth in brave men and good steeds ana kine That we may first remember thee for sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रः सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीत उक्थ्यम् । विदे वृधस्य दक्षसो महान्हि षः ॥
translation: INDRA, when Soma juices flow, makes his mind pure and meet for lauds. He gains the power that brings success, for great is he.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानां सदने वृधः । सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित् ॥
translation: In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success, Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the water-floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमह्वे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम् । भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
translation: Him, to win strength, have I invoked, even Indra mighty for the fray. Be thou most near to us for bliss, a Friend to aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इयं त इन्द्र गिर्वणो रातिः क्षरति सुन्वतः । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
translation: Indra, Song -lover, here for thee the worshipper's libation flows. Rejoicing in this sacred grass thou shinest forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नूनं तदिन्द्र दद्धि नो यत्त्वा सुन्वन्त ईमहे । रयिं नश्चित्रमा भरा स्वर्विदम् ॥
translation: Even now, O Indra, give us that which, pressing juice, we crave of thee. Bring us wealth manifold which finds the light of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तोता यत्ते विचर्षणिरतिप्रशर्धयद्गिरः । वया इवानु रोहते जुषन्त यत् ॥
translation: What time the zealous worshipper hath boldly sung his songs to thee, Like branches of a tree up-grows what they desire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्नवज्जनया गिरः शृणुधी जरितुर्हवम् । मदेमदे ववक्षिथा सुकृत्वने ॥
translation: Generate songs even as of old, give car unto the singer's call. Thou for the pious hast grown great at each carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रीळन्त्यस्य सूनृता आपो न प्रवता यतीः । अया धिया य उच्यते पतिर्दिवः ॥
translation: Sweet strains that glorify him play like waters speeding down a slope, Yea, him who in this song is called the Lord of Heaven;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतो पतिर्य उच्यते कृष्टीनामेक इद्वशी । नमोवृधैरवस्युभिः सुते रण ॥
translation: Yea, who alone is called the Lord, the single Ruler of the folk, By worshippers seeking aid: may he joy in the draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तुहि श्रुतं विपश्चितं हरी यस्य प्रसक्षिणा । गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहं नमस्विनः ॥
translation: Praise him, the Glorious, skilled in song, Lord of the two victorious Bays: They seek the worshipper's abode who bows in prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तूतुजानो महेमतेऽश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । आ याहि यज्ञमाशुभिः शमिद्धि ते ॥
translation: Put forth thy strength: with dappled Steeds come, thou of mighty intellect, With swift Steeds to the sacrifice, for 'tis thy joy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते रयिं गृणत्सु धारय । श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनम् ॥
translation: Grant wealth to those who praise thee, Lord of Heroes, Mightiest Indra: give Our princes everlasting fame and opulence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हवे त्वा सूर उदिते हवे मध्यंदिने दिवः । जुषाण इन्द्र सप्तिभिर्न आ गहि ॥
translation: I call thee when the Sun is risen, I call thee at the noon of day: With thy car-horses, Indra, come wellpleased to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तू गहि प्र तु द्रव मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः । तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं यथा विदे ॥
translation: Speed forward hither, come to us, rejoice thee in the milky draught: Spin out the thread of ancient time, as well is known.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसोऽवितेदसि ॥
translation: If, Ṣakra, Vr̥itra-slayer, thou be far away or near to us. Or in the sea, thou art the guard of Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तु नो गिर इन्द्रं सुतास इन्दवः । इन्द्रे हविष्मतीर्विशो अराणिषुः ॥
translation: Let songs we sing and Soma-drops expressed by us make Indra strong: The tribes who bring oblations find delight in him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिद्विप्रा अवस्यवः प्रवत्वतीभिरूतिभिः । इन्द्रं क्षोणीरवर्धयन्वया इव ॥
translation: Him sages longing for his aid, with offerings brought in eager haste, Him. even as branches, all mankind have made to grow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः सदावृधम् ॥
translation: At the Trkadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirred the mind: May our songs strengthen him who still hath strengthened us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तोता यत्ते अनुव्रत उक्थान्यृतुथा दधे । शुचिः पावक उच्यते सो अद्भुतः ॥
translation: When, true to duty, at due times the worshipper offers lauds to thee, They call him Purifier, Pure, and Wonderful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदिद्रुद्रस्य चेतति यह्वं प्रत्नेषु धामसु । मनो यत्रा वि तद्दधुर्विचेतसः ॥
translation: That mind of Rudra, fresh and strong, moves conscious in the ancient ways, With reference whereto the wise have ordered this.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदि मे सख्यमावर इमस्य पाह्यन्धसः । येन विश्वा अति द्विषो अतारिम ॥
translation: If thou elect to be my Friend drink of this sacrificial juice, By help whereof we may subdue all enemies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः स्तोता भवाति शंतमः । कदा नो गव्ये अश्व्ये वसौ दधः ॥
translation: O Indra, Lover of the song, when shall thy praiser be most blest? When wilt thou grant us wealth in herds of kine and steeds?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत ते सुष्टुता हरी वृषणा वहतो रथम् । अजुर्यस्य मदिन्तमं यमीमहे ॥
translation: And thy two highIy-lauded Bays, strong stallions, draw thy car who art Untouched by age, most gladdening car for which we pray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमीमहे पुरुष्टुतं यह्वं प्रत्नाभिरूतिभिः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सददध द्विता ॥
translation: With ancient offerings we implore the Young and Strong whom many praise. He from of old hath sat upon dear sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वर्धस्वा सु पुरुष्टुत ऋषिष्टुताभिरूतिभिः । धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषमवा च नः ॥
translation: Wax miglity, thou whom many laud for aids which R̥ishis have extolled. Pour down for us abundant food and guard us well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र त्वमवितेदसीत्था स्तुवतो अद्रिवः । ऋतादियर्मि ते धियं मनोयुजम् ॥
translation: O Indra, Caster of the Stone, thou helpest him who praises thee: From sacrifice I send to thee a mindyoked hymn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या युजानः सोमपीतये । हरी इन्द्र प्रतद्वसू अभि स्वर ॥
translation: Here, yoking for the Soma-draught these Horses, sharers of thy feast, Thy Bay Steeds, Indra, fraught with wealth, consent to come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि स्वरन्तु ये तव रुद्रासः सक्षत श्रियम् । उतो मरुत्वतीर्विशो अभि प्रयः ॥
translation: Attendants on thy glory, let the Rudras roar assent to thee, And all the Marut companies come tothe feast.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा अस्य प्रतूर्तयः पदं जुषन्त यद्दिवि । नाभा यज्ञस्य सं दधुर्यथा विदे ॥
translation: These his victorious followers bold in the heavens the place they love, Leagued in the heart of sacrifice, as well we know.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं दीर्घाय चक्षसे प्राचि प्रयत्यध्वरे । मिमीते यज्ञमानुषग्विचक्ष्य ॥
translation: That we may long behold the light, what time the ordered rite proceeds, He duly measures, as he views, the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषायमिन्द्र ते रथ उतो ते वृषणा हरी । वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो वृषा हवः ॥
translation: O Indra, strong is this thy car, and strong are these Bay Steeds of thine: O Ṣatakratu, thou art strong, strong is our call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः । वृषा यज्ञो यमिन्वसि वृषा हवः ॥
translation: Strong is the press-stone, strong thy joy, strong is the flowing Soma juice: Strong is the rite thou furtherest, strong is our call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः । वावन्थ हि प्रतिष्टुतिं वृषा हवः ॥
translation: As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunderer with thy thousand aids: For thou hast won the hymn of praise. Strong is our call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् । स्तोता मे गोषखा स्यात् ॥
translation: IF I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single Sovran of all wealth, My worshipper should be rich in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे । यदहं गोपतिः स्याम् ॥
translation: I should be fain, O Lord of Power, to strengthen and enrich the sage, Were I the Lord of herds of kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते । गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ॥
translation: To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम् ॥
translation: None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence, The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् । चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥
translation: The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वावृधानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । ऊतिमिन्द्रा वृणीमहे ॥
translation: Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great Hast won all treasures for thine own.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: व्य१न्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना । इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम् ॥
translation: In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light, When he cleft Vala limb from limb.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः । अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम् ॥
translation: Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Angirases, And Vala he cast headlong down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दृळ्हानि दृंहितानि च । स्थिराणि न पराणुदे ॥
translation: By Indra were the lumirious realms of heaven established and secured, Firm and immovable from their place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इन्द्राजिरायते । वि ते मदा अराजिषुः ॥
translation: Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods: Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः । स्तोतॄणामुत भद्रकृत् ॥
translation: For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify: Thou blessest those who worship thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रमित्केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः । उप यज्ञं सुराधसम् ॥
translation: Let the two long-maned Bay Steeds bring Indra to drink the Soma juice, The Bountiful to our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः । विश्वा यदजयः स्पृधः ॥
translation: With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuci, Subduing all contending hosts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मायाभिरुत्सिसृप्सत इन्द्र द्यामारुरुक्षतः । अव दस्यूँरधूनुथाः ॥
translation: The Dasyus, when they fain would climb by magic arts and mount to heaven, Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असुन्वामिन्द्र संसदं विषूचीं व्यनाशयः । सोमपा उत्तरो भवन् ॥
translation: As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side Their settlement who poured no gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ॥
translation: SING forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud. Invite the powerful Indra with your songs of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत्सहो दाधार रोदसी । गिरीँरज्राँ अपः स्वर्वृषत्वना ॥
translation: Whose lofty might-for doubly strong is he-supports the heavens and earth, And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स राजसि पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे । इन्द्र जैत्रा श्रवस्या च यन्तवे ॥
translation: Such, Praised by many! thou art King alone thou smitest Vr̥itras dead, To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृत्सु सासहिम् । उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम् ॥
translation: We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ । मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
translation: Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Âyu and for Manu's sake: Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा । वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे ॥
