translation: This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine: Win thou the waters day by day, thralls of the strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव शुष्ममुत क्रतुम् । वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम् ॥
translation: That lofty Indra-power of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence, Thy thunderbolt for which we long, the wish makes keen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौंस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः । त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ॥
translation: O Indra, Heaven and Earth augment thy manly power and thy renown; The waters and thy mountains stir and urge thee on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः । त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम् ॥
translation: Vishṇu the lofty ruling Power, Varuṇa, Mitra sing thy praise: In thee the Marut3' company have great delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं वृषा जनानां मंहिष्ठ इन्द्र जज्ञिषे । सत्रा विश्वा स्वपत्यानि दधिषे ॥
translation: O Indra, thou wast born the Lord of men, most liberal of thy gifts: Excellent deeds for evermore are all thine own.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सत्रा त्वं पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि तोशसे । नान्य इन्द्रात्करणं भूय इन्वति ॥
translation: Ever, alone, O highly-praised, thou sendest Vr̥itras to their rest: None else than Indra executes the mighty deed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्र मन्मशस्त्वा नाना हवन्त ऊतये । अस्माकेभिर्नृभिरत्रा स्वर्जय ॥
translation: Though here and there, in varied hymns, Indra, men call on thee for aid, Still with our heroes fight and win the light of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरं क्षयाय नो महे विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् । इन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षया शचीपतिम् ॥
translation: Already have all forms of him entered our spacious dwelling-place: For victory stir thou Indra, up, the Lord of Might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः । नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठम् ॥
translation: PRAISE Indra whom our songs must laud, sole Sovran of mankind, the Chief Most liberal who controlleth men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यन्ति विश्वानि च श्रवस्या । अपामवो न समुद्रे ॥
translation: In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs. Like the floods' longing for the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे ज्येष्ठराजं भरे कृत्नुम् । महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः ॥
translation: Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight, Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्यानूना गभीरा मदा उरवस्तरुत्राः । हर्षुमन्तः शूरसातौ ॥
translation: Whose perfect ecstasies are wide, profound, victorious, and give joy in the field where heroes win.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिद्धनेषु हितेष्वधिवाकाय हवन्ते । येषामिन्द्रस्ते जयन्ति ॥
translation: Him, when the spoils of war are staked, men call to be their advocate: They who have Indra win the day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिच्च्यौत्नैरार्यन्ति तं कृतेभिश्चर्षणयः । एष इन्द्रो वरिवस्कृत् ॥
translation: Men honour him with stirring songs and magnify with solemn rites: Indra is he who giveth case.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो ब्रह्मेन्द्र ऋषिरिन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः । महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
translation: Indra is priest and R̥ishi, he is much invoked by many men, And mighty by his mighty powers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स स्तोम्यः स हव्यः सत्यः सत्वा तुविकूर्मिः । एकश्चित्सन्नभिभूतिः ॥
translation: Meet to be lauded and invoked, true Hero with his deeds of might, Victorious even when alone.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमर्केभिस्तं सामभिस्तं गायत्रैश्चर्षणयः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति क्षितयः ॥
translation: The men, the people magnify that Indra with their Slina. songs, With hymns and sacred eulogies
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा कर्तारं ज्योतिः समत्सु । सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान् ॥
translation: Him who advances them to wealth, sends light to lead them in the war, And quells their foemen in the fray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पप्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः । इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ॥
translation: May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship Safely beyond all enemies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वं न इन्द्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च । अच्छा च नः सुम्नं नेषि ॥
translation: As such, O Indra, honour us with gifts of booty, further us, And lead us to felicity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् । एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
translation: COME, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here Sit thou on this my sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना । उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु ॥
translation: O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward Give car and listen to our prayers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः । सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
translation: We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend, We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो याहि सुतावतोऽस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप । पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नन्धसः ॥
translation: Come unto us who bring the juice, come unto this our eulogy, Fair-visored! drink thou of the juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु । गृभाय जिह्वया मधु ॥
translation: I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it spread: Take with. thy tongue the pleasant drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वादुष्टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमान्तन्वे३ तव । सोमः शमस्तु ते हृदे ॥
translation: Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice: Sweet be the Soma to thine heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमु त्वा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संवृतः । प्र सोम इन्द्र सर्पतु ॥
translation: Like women, let this Soma-draught, invested with its robe, approach, O active Indra, close to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरन्धसो मदे । इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
translation: Indra, transported with the juice, vast in his bulk, strong in his neck And stout arms, smites the Vr̥itras down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र प्रेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा । वृत्राणि वृत्रहञ्जहि ॥
translation: O Indra, go thou forward, thou who rulest over all by might: Thou Vr̥itra-slayer slay the fiends,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वङ्कुशो येना वसु प्रयच्छसि । यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
translation: Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest ample wealth to him Who sheds the juice and worships thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि । एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥
translation: Here, Indra, is thy Soma-draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः । आखण्डल प्र हूयसे ॥
translation: Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well this juice is shed for thy delight Thou art invoked, Âkhaṇḍala!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो नपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः । न्यस्मिन्दध्र आ मनः ॥
translation: To Kuṇḍapâyya, grandson's son, grandson of Ṣringavr̥ish! to thee, To him have I addressed my thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणांसत्रं सोम्यानाम् । द्रप्सो भेत्ता पुरां शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनां सखा ॥
translation: Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home armour of Soma-offerers: The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the R̥ishis' Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पृदाकुसानुर्यजतो गवेषण एकः सन्नभि भूयसः । भूर्णिमश्वं नयत्तुजा पुरो गृभेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Holy Pr̥idâkusânu, winner of the spoil, one eminent o'er many men, Lead on the wild horse Indra with his vigorous grasp forward to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं ह नूनमेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः । आदित्यानामपूर्व्यं सवीमनि ॥
translation: Now let the mortal offer prayer to win the unexampled grace Of these Âdityas and their aid to cherish life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनर्वाणो ह्येषां पन्था आदित्यानाम् । अदब्धाः सन्ति पायवः सुगेवृधः ॥
translation: For not an enemy molests the paths which these Âdityas tread: Infallible guards, they strengthen us in happiness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथो यदीमहे ॥
translation: Now soon may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman Give us the shelter widely spread which we implore.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवेभिर्देव्यदितेऽरिष्टभर्मन्ना गहि । स्मत्सूरिभिः पुरुप्रिये सुशर्मभिः ॥
translation: With Gods come thou whose fostering care none checks, O Goddesss Aditi: Come, dear to many, with the Lords who guard us well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेर्विदुर्द्वेषांसि योतवे । अंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयोऽनेहसः ॥
translation: For well these Sons of Aditi know to keep enmities aloof, Unrivalled, giving ample room, they save from woe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदितिर्नो दिवा पशुमदितिर्नक्तमद्वयाः । अदितिः पात्वंहसः सदावृधा ॥
translation: Aditi guard our herd by day, Aditi, free from guile, by night, Aditi, ever strengthening, save us from grief!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्या गमत् । सा शंताति मयस्करदप स्रिधः ॥
translation: And in the day our hymn is this: May Aditi come nigh to help, With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्या दैव्या भिषजा शं नः करतो अश्विना । युयुयातामितो रपो अप स्रिधः ॥
translation: And may the Aṣvins, the divine Pair of Physicians, send us health: May they remove iniquity and chase our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शमग्निरग्निभिः करच्छं नस्तपतु सूर्यः । शं वातो वात्वरपा अप स्रिधः ॥
translation: May Agni bless us with his fires, and Sûrya warm us pleasantly: May the pure Wind breathe sweet on us, and chase our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपामीवामप स्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम् । आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः ॥
translation: Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity: Âdityas, keep us ever far from sore distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युयोता शरुमस्मदाँ आदित्यास उतामतिम् । ऋधग्द्वेषः कृणुत विश्ववेदसः ॥
translation: Remove from us the arrow, keep famine, Âdityas! far away: Keep enmities afar from us, Lords of all wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्सु नः शर्म यच्छतादित्या यन्मुमोचति । एनस्वन्तं चिदेनसः सुदानवः ॥
translation: Now, O Âdityas, grant to us the shelter that lets man go free, Yea, even the sinner from his sin, ye Bounteous Gods!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो नः कश्चिद्रिरिक्षति रक्षस्त्वेन मर्त्यः । स्वैः ष एवै रिरिषीष्ट युर्जनः ॥
translation: Whatever mortal with the powe r of demons fain would injure us, May he, impetuous, suffer harm by his own deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समित्तमघमश्नवद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं रिपुम् । यो अस्मत्रा दुर्हणावाँ उप द्वयुः ॥
translation: May sin o'ertake our human foe, the man who speaketh evil thing, Him who would cause our misery, whose heart is false.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पाकत्रा स्थन देवा हृत्सु जानीथ मर्त्यम् । उप द्वयुं चाद्वयुं च वसवः ॥
translation: Gods, ye are with the simple ones, ye know each mortal in your hearts; Ye, Vasus, well discriminate the false and true.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ शर्म पर्वतानामोतापां वृणीमहे । द्यावाक्षामारे अस्मद्रपस्कृतम् ॥
translation: Fain would we have the sheltering aid of mountains and of water-floods: Keep far from us iniquity, O Heaven and Earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नो भद्रेण शर्मणा युष्माकं नावा वसवः । अति विश्वानि दुरिता पिपर्तन ॥
translation: So with auspicious sheltering aid do ye, O Vasus, carry us Beyond all trouble and distress, borne in your ship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुचे तनाय तत्सु नो द्राघीय आयुर्जीवसे । आदित्यासः सुमहसः कृणोतन ॥
translation: Âdityas, ye Most Mighty Ones, grant to our children and their seed Extended term of life that they may live long days.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञो हीळो वो अन्तर आदित्या अस्ति मृळत । युष्मे इद्वो अपि ष्मसि सजात्ये ॥
translation: Sacrifice, O Âdityas, is your inward monitor: be kind, For in the bond of kindred we are bound to you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहद्वरूथं मरुतां देवं त्रातारमश्विना । मित्रमीमहे वरुणं स्वस्तये ॥
translation: The Maruts' high protecting aid, the Aṣvins, and the God who saves, Mitra and Varuṇa for weal we supplicate.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनेहो मित्रार्यमन्नृवद्वरुण शंस्यम् । त्रिवरूथं मरुतो यन्त नश्छर्दिः ॥
translation: Grant us a home with triple guard, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa! Unthreatened, Maruts! meet for praise, and filled with men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये चिद्धि मृत्युबन्धव आदित्या मनवः स्मसि । प्र सू न आयुर्जीवसे तिरेतन ॥
translation: And as we human beings, O Âdityas, are akin to death, Graciously lengthen ye our lives that we may live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे । देवत्रा हव्यमोहिरे ॥
translation: SING praise to hiin, the Lord of Light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, And sent oblation to Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीळिष्व यन्तुरम् । अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम् ॥
translation: Agni, the Bounteous Giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari- Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् । अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥
translation: Thee have we chosen skilftillest in sacrifice, Immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निं श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् । स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ॥
translation: The Son of Strength, the blessed, brightly shining One, Agni whose light is excellent. May be by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuṇa, and the Floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः समिधा य आहुती यो वेदेन ददाश मर्तो अग्नये । यो नमसा स्वध्वरः ॥
translation: The mortal who hath ministered to Agni with oblation, fuel, ritual lore, And reverence, skilled in sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्येदर्वन्तो रंहयन्त आशवस्तस्य द्युम्नितमं यशः । न तमंहो देवकृतं कुतश्चन न मर्त्यकृतं नशत् ॥
translation: Verily swift to run are his fleet-footed steeds, and most resplendent fame is his. No trouble caused by Gods or wrought by mortal man from any side o'ertaketh him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वग्नयो वो अग्निभिः स्याम सूनो सहस ऊर्जां पते । सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
translation: May we by thine own fires be well supplied with fire, O Son of Strength, O Lord of Might: Thou as our Friend hast worthy men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रशंसमानो अतिथिर्न मित्रियोऽग्नी रथो न वेद्यः । त्वे क्षेमासो अपि सन्ति साधवस्त्वं राजा रयीणाम् ॥
translation: Agni, who praises like a guest of friendly mind, is as a car that brings us gear. Also in thee is found perfect security thou art the Sovran Lord of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सो अद्धा दाश्वध्वरोऽग्ने मर्तः सुभग स प्रशंस्यः । स धीभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
translation: That man, moreover, merits praise who brings, auspicious Agni, sacrificial gifts May he win riches by his thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य त्वमूर्ध्वो अध्वराय तिष्ठसि क्षयद्वीरः स साधते । सो अर्वद्भिः सनिता स विपन्युभिः स शूरैः सनिता कृतम् ॥
translation: He for whose sacrifice thou standest up erect is prosperous and rules o'er men. He wins with coursers and with singers killed in song: with heroes he obtains the prize.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्याग्निर्वपुर्गृहे स्तोमं चनो दधीत विश्ववार्यः । हव्या वा वेविषद्विषः ॥
translation: He in whose dwelling Agni is chief ornament, and, all-desired, loves his laud well, And zealously tends his offerings-
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विप्रस्य वा स्तुवतः सहसो यहो मक्षूतमस्य रातिषु । अवोदेवमुपरिमर्त्यं कृधि वसो विविदुषो वचः ॥
translation: His, or the lauding sage's word, his, Son of Strength! who Is most prompt with sacred gifts, Set thou beneath the Gods, Vasu, above mankind, the speech of the intelligent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अग्निं हव्यदातिभिर्नमोभिर्वा सुदक्षमाविवासति । गिरा वाजिरशोचिषम् ॥
translation: He who with sacrificial gifts or homage bringeth very skilful Agni nigh, Or him who flashes fast with song,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिधा यो निशिती दाशददितिं धामभिरस्य मर्त्यः । विश्वेत्स धीभिः सुभगो जनाँ अति द्युम्नैरुद्न इव तारिषत् ॥
translation: The mortal who with blazing fuel, as his laws command, adores the Perfect God, Blest with his thoughts in splendour shall exceed all men, as though he overpassed the floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासहत्सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् । मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यः ॥
translation: Give us the splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, The wrath of evil-hearted folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येन चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा येन नासत्या भगः । वयं तत्ते शवसा गातुवित्तमा इन्द्रत्वोता विधेमहि ॥
translation: That, wherewith Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, the Aṣvins, Bhaga give us light, That may we, by thy power finding best furtherance, worship, O Indra, helped by thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्यो३ ये त्वा विप्र निदधिरे नृचक्षसम् । विप्रासो देव सुक्रतुम् ॥
translation: O Agni, most devout are they, the sages who have set thee Sage exceeding wise, O God, for men to look upon:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त इद्वेदिं सुभग त आहुतिं ते सोतुं चक्रिरे दिवि । त इद्वाजेभिर्जिग्युर्महद्धनं ये त्वे कामं न्येरिरे ॥
translation: Who have arranged thine altar Blessed God, at morn brought thine oblation, pressed the juice. They by their deeds of strength have won diem, mighty wealth, who have set all their hope in thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः । भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥
translation: -May Agni worshipped bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One, and sacrifice bring bliss; Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहः । अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः ॥
translation: Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight. Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईळे गिरा मनुर्हितं यं देवा दूतमरतिं न्येरिरे । यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहनम् ॥
translation: I praise with song the Friend of man, whom Gods sent down to be herald and messenger, Best worshipper, bearer of our gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिग्मजम्भाय तरुणाय राजते प्रयो गायस्यग्नये । यः पिंशते सूनृताभिः सुवीर्यमग्निर्घृतेभिराहुतः ॥
translation: Thou unto sharp-toothed Agni, Young and Radiant God, proclaimest with thy song the feast- Agni, who for our sweet strains moulds heroic strength when sacred oil is offered him,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदी घृतेभिराहुतो वाशीमग्निर्भरत उच्चाव च । असुर इव निर्णिजम् ॥
translation: While, served with sacrificial oil, now upward and now downward Agni moves his sword, As doth the Asura his robe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो हव्यान्यैरयता मनुर्हितो देव आसा सुगन्धिना । विवासते वार्याणि स्वध्वरो होता देवो अमर्त्यः ॥
translation: The God, the Friend of man, who bears our gifts to heaven, the God with his sweet-smelling mouth, Distributes, skilled in sacrifice, his precious things, Invoking Priest, Immortal God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदग्ने मर्त्यस्त्वं स्यामहं मित्रमहो अमर्त्यः । सहसः सूनवाहुत ॥
translation: Son of Strength, Agni, if thou wert the mortal, bright as Mitra, I worshipped with our gifts! And I were the Immortal God
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न त्वा रासीयाभिशस्तये वसो न पापत्वाय सन्त्य । न मे स्तोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः स्यादग्ने न पापया ॥
translation: I would not give thee up, Vasu, to calumny, or misery, O Bounteous One. My worshipper should feel no hunger or distress, nor, Agni, should he live in sin.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पितुर्न पुत्रः सुभृतो दुरोण आ देवाँ एतु प्र णो हविः ॥
translation: Like a son cherished in his father's houi§e, let our oblation rise unto the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्नेदिष्ठाभिः सचेय जोषमा वसो । सदा देवस्य मर्त्यः ॥
translation: With thine immediate aid may I, excellent Agni, ever gain my wish A mortal with a God to help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा सनेयं तव रातिभिरग्ने तव प्रशस्तिभिः । त्वामिदाहुः प्रमतिं वसो ममाग्ने हर्षस्व दातवे ॥
translation: O Agni, by thy wisdom, by thy bounties, by thy leading may I gather wealth. Excellent Agni, thou art called my Providence: delight thou to be liberal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तिरते वाजभर्मभिः । यस्य त्वं सख्यमावरः ॥
translation: Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of noble heroes and great strength, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे । त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि ॥
translation: Thy spark is black and crackling, kindled in due time, O Bounteous, it is taken up. Thou art the dear Friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमागन्म सोभरयः सहस्रमुष्कं स्वभिष्टिमवसे । सम्राजं त्रासदस्यवम् ॥
translation: We Sobharis have come to him, for succour, who is good to help with thousand powers, The Sovran, Trasadasyu's Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते अग्ने अन्ये अग्नय उपक्षितो वया इव । विपो न द्युम्ना नि युवे जनानां तव क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
translation: O Agni, thou on whom all other fires depend, as branches on the parent stem, I make the treasures of the folk, like songs, mine own, while I exalt thy sovran might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमादित्यासो अद्रुहः पारं नयथ मर्त्यम् । मघोनां विश्वेषां सुदानवः ॥
translation: The mortal whom, Âdityas, ye, Guilelew, lead to the farther bank Of all the princes, Bounteous Ones
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यूयं राजानः कं चिच्चर्षणीसहः क्षयन्तं मानुषाँ अनु । वयं ते वो वरुण मित्रार्यमन्त्स्यामेदृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
translation: Whoe'er he be, Man-ruling Kings! the Regent of the race of men- May we, O Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman, like him be furtherers of your law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदान्मे पौरुकुत्स्यः पञ्चाशतं त्रसदस्युर्वधूनाम् । मंहिष्ठो अर्यः सत्पतिः ॥
translation: A gift of fifty female slaves hath Trasadasyu given me, Purukutsa's son, Most liberal, kind, lord of the brave.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत मे प्रयियोर्वयियोः सुवास्त्वा अधि तुग्वनि । तिसॄणां सप्ततीनां श्यावः प्रणेता भुवद्वसुर्दियानां पतिः ॥
translation: And Ṣyâva too for me led forth a strong steed at Suvâstu's ford: A herd of three times seventy kine, good lord of gifts, he gave to me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थाता समन्यवः । स्थिरा चिन्नमयिष्णवः ॥
translation: LET none, Swift Travellers! check you: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away, Ye benders even of what is firm.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वीळुपविभिर्मरुत ऋभुक्षण आ रुद्रासः सुदीतिभिः । इषा नो अद्या गता पुरुस्पृहो यज्ञमा सोभरीयवः ॥
translation: Maruts, R̥ibhukshans, Rudras come ye with your cars strong-fellied and exceeding bright. Come, ye for whom we long, with food, to sacrifice, come ye with love to Sobbari.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा हि रुद्रियाणां शुष्ममुग्रं मरुतां शिमीवताम् । विष्णोरेषस्य मीळ्हुषाम् ॥
translation: For well we know the vigorous might of Rudra's Sons, the Martits, who are passing strong, Swift Vishṇu's band, who send the rain.,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि द्वीपानि पापतन्तिष्ठद्दुच्छुनोभे युजन्त रोदसी । प्र धन्वान्यैरत शुभ्रखादयो यदेजथ स्वभानवः ॥
translation: Islands are bursting forth and misery is stayed: the heaven and earth are joined in one. Decked with bright rings, ye spread the broad expanses out, when ye, Self. luminous, stirred yourselves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्युता चिद्वो अज्मन्ना नानदति पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः । भूमिर्यामेषु रेजते ॥
translation: Even things immovable shake and reel, the mountains and the forest trees at your approach, And the earth trembles as ye come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमाय वो मरुतो यातवे द्यौर्जिहीत उत्तरा बृहत् । यत्रा नरो देदिशते तनूष्वा त्वक्षांसि बाह्वोजसः ॥
translation: To lend free course, O Maruts, to your furious rush, heaven high and higher still gives way, Where they, the Heroes mighty with their arms, display their gleaming omaments on their forms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वधामनु श्रियं नरो महि त्वेषा अमवन्तो वृषप्सवः । वहन्ते अह्रुतप्सवः ॥
translation: After their Godlike nature they, the bull. like Heroes, dazzling and impetuous, wear Great splendour as they show erect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोभिर्वाणो अज्यते सोभरीणां रथे कोशे हिरण्यये । गोबन्धवः सुजातास इषे भुजे महान्तो नः स्परसे नु ॥
translation: The pivot of the Sobharis' chariot within the golden box is balmed with milk. May they the Well-born, Mighty, kindred of the Cow, aid us to food and to delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति वो वृषदञ्जयो वृष्णे शर्धाय मारुताय भरध्वम् । हव्या वृषप्रयाव्णे ॥
translation: Bring, ye who sprinkle balmy drops. oblations to your vigorous Marut company, To those whose leader is the Bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषणश्वेन मरुतो वृषप्सुना रथेन वृषनाभिना । आ श्येनासो न पक्षिणो वृथा नरो हव्या नो वीतये गत ॥
translation: Come hither, O ye Mares, on your stronghorsed car, solid in look, with solid naves. Lightly like winged falcons, O ye Heroes, come, come to enjoy our ofrerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समानमञ्ज्येषां वि भ्राजन्ते रुक्मासो अधि बाहुषु । दविद्युतत्यृष्टयः ॥
translation: Their decoration is the same: their omaments of gold are bright upon their arms; Their lances glitter splendidly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त उग्रासो वृषण उग्रबाहवो नकिष्टनूषु येतिरे । स्थिरा धन्वान्यायुधा रथेषु वोऽनीकेष्वधि श्रियः ॥
translation: They toil not to defend their bodies from attack, strong Heroes with their mighty arms. Strong are your bows and strong the weapons in your cars, and glory sits on every face.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येषामर्णो न सप्रथो नाम त्वेषं शश्वतामेकमिद्भुजे । वयो न पित्र्यं सहः ॥
translation: Whose name extendeth like a sea, alone, resplendent, so that all have joy in it, And life-power like ancestral might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तान्वन्दस्व मरुतस्ताँ उप स्तुहि तेषां हि धुनीनाम् । अराणां न चरमस्तदेषां दाना मह्ना तदेषाम् ॥
translation: Pay honour to these Maruts and sing praise to them, for of the wheel-spokes of the car Of these loud roarers none is last: this is their power, this moves them to give mighty gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुभगः स व ऊतिष्वास पूर्वासु मरुतो व्युष्टिषु । यो वा नूनमुतासति ॥
translation: Blest by your favouring help was he, O Maruts, at the earlier flushings of the morn, And even now shall he be blest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य वा यूयं प्रति वाजिनो नर आ हव्या वीतये गथ । अभि ष द्युम्नैरुत वाजसातिभिः सुम्ना वो धूतयो नशत् ॥
translation: The strong man to whose sacrifice, O Heroes, ye approach that ye may taste thereof, With glories and with war that winneth spoil shall gain great bliss, ye Shakers of the world.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा रुद्रस्य सूनवो दिवो वशन्त्यसुरस्य वेधसः । युवानस्तथेदसत् ॥
translation: Even as Rudra's Sons, the brood of the Creator Dyaus, the Asura, desire, O Youthful Ones, so shall it be:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये चार्हन्ति मरुतः सुदानवः स्मन्मीळ्हुषश्चरन्ति ये । अतश्चिदा न उप वस्यसा हृदा युवान आ ववृध्वम् ॥
translation: And these the bounteous, worthy of the Maruts who move onward pouring down the rain- Even for their sake, O Youthful Ones, with kindest heart take us to you to be your own.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यून ऊ षु नविष्ठया वृष्णः पावकाँ अभि सोभरे गिरा । गाय गा इव चर्कृषत् ॥
translation: O Sobhari, with newest song sing out unto the youthful purifying Bulls, Even as a plougher to his steers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: साहा ये सन्ति मुष्टिहेव हव्यो विश्वासु पृत्सु होतृषु । वृष्णश्चन्द्रान्न सुश्रवस्तमान्गिरा वन्दस्व मरुतो अह ॥
translation: Who, like a celebrated boxer, overcome the challengers in every fight: They who, like shining bulls, are most illustrious-honour those Maruts with thy song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गावश्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः । रिहते ककुभो मिथः ॥
translation: Allied by common ancestry, ye Maruts, even the Cows, alike in energy, Lick, all by turns, each other's head.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मर्तश्चिद्वो नृतवो रुक्मवक्षस उप भ्रातृत्वमायति । अधि नो गात मरुतः सदा हि व आपित्वमस्ति निध्रुवि ॥
translation: Even mortal man, ye Dancers breast adorned with gold, attains to brotherhood with you. Mark ye and notice us, O Maruts; evermore your friendship is secured to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मरुतो मारुतस्य न आ भेषजस्य वहता सुदानवः । यूयं सखायः सप्तयः ॥
translation: O Maruts, rich in noble gifts, bring us a portion of the Maruts' medicine, Ye Coursers who are Friends to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याभिः सिन्धुमवथ याभिस्तूर्वथ याभिर्दशस्यथा क्रिविम् । मयो नो भूतोतिभिर्मयोभुवः शिवाभिरसचद्विषः ॥
translation: Haters of those who serve you not, bliss-bringers, bring us bliss with those auspicious aids Wherewith ye are victorious and guard Sindhu well, and succour Krvi in his need.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सिन्धौ यदसिक्न्यां यत्समुद्रेषु मरुतः सुबर्हिषः । यत्पर्वतेषु भेषजम् ॥
translation: Maruts, who rest on fair trimmed grass, what balm soever Sindhu or Asikni hath, Or mountains or the seas contain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वं पश्यन्तो बिभृथा तनूष्वा तेना नो अधि वोचत । क्षमा रपो मरुत आतुरस्य न इष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
translation: Ye carry on your bodies, ye who see it all: so bless us graciously therewith. Cast, Maruts, to the ground our sick man's malady: replace the dislocated limb.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः । वाजे चित्रं हवामहे ॥
translation: WE call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee wonderful in fight
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् । त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम् ॥
translation: On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth. We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, havie chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याहीम इन्दवोऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते । सोमं सोमपते पिब ॥
translation: Come hither, for the drops are here, O Lord of corn-lands. Lord of horses, Lord of kine: Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं हि त्वा बन्धुमन्तमबन्धवो विप्रास इन्द्र येमिम । या ते धामानि वृषभ तेभिरा गहि विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ॥
translation: For we the kinless singers have drawn hither thee, O Indra, who hast numerous kin. With all the forms thou hast, comic thou of bull-like strength, come near to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे । अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः ॥
translation: Sitting like birds beside thy meath., mingled with milk, that gladdeneth and exalteth thee, Indra, to thee we sing aloud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा च त्वैना नमसा वदामसि किं मुहुश्चिद्वि दीधयः । सन्ति कामासो हरिवो ददिष्ट्वं स्मो वयं सन्ति नो धियः ॥
translation: We speak to thee with this our reverential prayer. Why art thou pondering yet awhile? Here are our wishes; thou art liberal, Lord of Bays: we and our hymns are present here.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नूत्ना इदिन्द्र ते वयमूती अभूम नहि नू ते अद्रिवः । विद्मा पुरा परीणसः ॥
translation: For not in recent times alone, O Indra, Thunder-armed, have we obtained thine aid. Of old we knew thy plenteous wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा सखित्वमुत शूर भोज्य१मा ते ता वज्रिन्नीमहे । उतो समस्मिन्ना शिशीहि नो वसो वाजे सुशिप्र गोमति ॥
translation: Hero, we knew thy friendship and thy rich rewards: these, Thunderer, now we crave of thee. O Vasu, for all wealth that cometh of the kine, sharpen our powers, fair-visored God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु वः स्तुषे । सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
translation: Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमन्दत । आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतम् ॥
translation: Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight. May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि । संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ॥
translation: Hero, may we, with thee for Friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath, In fight with people rich in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जयेम कारे पुरुहूत कारिणोऽभि तिष्ठेम दूढ्यः । नृभिर्वृत्रं हन्याम शूशुयाम चावेरिन्द्र प्र णो धियः ॥
translation: May we be victors in the singer's battlesong, and meet the wicked, Much invoked! With heroes smite the foeman and show forth our strength. O Indra, further thou our thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि । युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥
translation: O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest comradeship in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकी रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः । यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे ॥
translation: Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine. What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a Father, art invoked.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा ते अमाजुरो यथा मूरास इन्द्र सख्ये त्वावतः । नि षदाम सचा सुते ॥
translation: O Indra, let us not, like fools who waste their lives at home, with friendship such as thine Sit idly by the poured-out juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा ते गोदत्र निरराम राधस इन्द्र मा ते गृहामहि । दृळ्हा चिदर्यः प्र मृशाभ्या भर न ते दामान आदभे ॥
translation: Giver of kine, may we not miss thy gracious gifts: let us not rob thee of thine own. Strip even the strong places of the foe, and bring: thy gifts can never be made vain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रो वा घेदियन्मघं सरस्वती वा सुभगा ददिर्वसु । त्वं वा चित्र दाशुषे ॥
translation: Indra or blest Sarasvatî alone bestows such wealth, treasure so great, or thou, O Chitra, on the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चित्र इद्राजा राजका इदन्यके यके सरस्वतीमनु । पर्जन्य इव ततनद्धि वृष्ट्या सहस्रमयुता ददत् ॥
translation: Chitra is King, and only kinglings are the rest who dwell beside Sarasvatî. He, like Parjanya with his rain, hath spread himself with thousand, yea, with myriad gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ओ त्यमह्व आ रथमद्या दंसिष्ठमूतये । यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी आ सूर्यायै तस्थथुः ॥
translation: HITHERWARD have I called to-day, for succour, that most wondrous car Which ye ascended, Aṣvins, ye whose paths are red, swift to give Car, for Sûryâ's sake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पूर्वायुषं सुहवं पुरुस्पृहं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् । सचनावन्तं सुमतिभिः सोभरे विद्वेषसमनेहसम् ॥
translation: Car ever young, much longed-for, easily invoked, soon guided, first in deeds of might, Which waits and serves, O Sobhari, with benevolence, without a rival or a foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इह त्या पुरुभूतमा देवा नमोभिरश्विना । अर्वाचीना स्ववसे करामहे गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
translation: These Aṣvins with our homage, these Two Omnipresent Deities Hitherward will we bring for kind help, these who seek the dwelling of the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवो रथस्य परि चक्रमीयत ईर्मान्यद्वामिषण्यति । अस्माँ अच्छा सुमतिर्वां शुभस्पती आ धेनुरिव धावतु ॥
translation: One of your chariot wheels is moving swiftly round, one speeds for you its onward course. Like a milch-cow, O Lords of splendour, and with haste let your benevolence come to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रथो यो वां त्रिवन्धुरो हिरण्याभीशुरश्विना । परि द्यावापृथिवी भूषति श्रुतस्तेन नासत्या गतम् ॥
translation: That chariot of yours which hath a triple seat and reins of gold, The famous car that traverseth the heaven and earth, thereon Nâsatyas, Aṣvins, come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दशस्यन्ता मनवे पूर्व्यं दिवि यवं वृकेण कर्षथः । ता वामद्य सुमतिभिः शुभस्पती अश्विना प्र स्तुवीमहि ॥
translation: Ye with your plough, when favouring Manu with your help, ploughed the first harvest in the sky. As such will we exalt you, Lords of splendour, now, O Aṣvins, with our prayer and praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नो वाजिनीवसू यातमृतस्य पथिभिः । येभिस्तृक्षिं वृषणा त्रासदस्यवं महे क्षत्राय जिन्वथः ॥
translation: Come to us, Lords of ample wealth, by paths of everlasting Law, Whereby to high dominion ye with mighty strength raised Tr̥ikshi, Trasadasyu's son.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं वामद्रिभिः सुतः सोमो नरा वृषण्वसू । आ यातं सोमपीतये पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ॥
translation: This Soma pressed with stones is yours, ye Heroes, Lords of plenteous wealth. Approach to drink the Soma, come, drink in the worshipper's abode.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ हि रुहतमश्विना रथे कोशे हिरण्यये वृषण्वसू । युञ्जाथां पीवरीरिषः ॥
translation: O Aṣvins, mount the chariot, mount the golden seat, ye who are Lords of plenteous wealth, And bring to us abundant food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: याभिः पक्थमवथो याभिरध्रिगुं याभिर्बभ्रुं विजोषसम् । ताभिर्नो मक्षू तूयमश्विना गतं भिषज्यतं यदातुरम् ॥
translation: The aids wherewith ye helped Paktha and Adhrigt;, and Babhru severed from his friends,– With those, O Aṣvins, come hither with speed and soon, and heal whatever is diseased.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदध्रिगावो अध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना हवामहे । वयं गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः ॥
translation: When we continually invoke the Aṣvins, the resistless, at this time of day, We lovers of the song, with songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताभिरा यातं वृषणोप मे हवं विश्वप्सुं विश्ववार्यम् । इषा मंहिष्ठा पुरुभूतमा नरा याभिः क्रिविं वावृधुस्ताभिरा गतम् ॥
translation: Through these, ye Mighty Ones, come hither to my call which brings all blessings, wears all forms,– Tlirough which, All-present Heroes, lavishest of food ye strengthened Krvi, come through these.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताविदा चिदहानां तावश्विना वन्दमान उप ब्रुवे । ता उ नमोभिरीमहे ॥
translation: I speak to both of these as such, these Aṣvins whom I reverence at this time of day: With homage we entreat them both.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताविद्दोषा ता उषसि शुभस्पती ता यामन्रुद्रवर्तनी । मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे वाजिनीवसू परो रुद्रावति ख्यतम् ॥
translation: Ye who are Lords of splendour, ye whose paths are red, at eve, at mom, at sacrifice, Give us not utterly as prey to mortal foe, ye Rudras, Lords of ample wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ सुग्म्याय सुग्म्यं प्राता रथेनाश्विना वा सक्षणी । हुवे पितेव सोभरी ॥
translation: For bliss I call. the blissful car, at morn the inseparable Aṣvins with their car I call, like Sobhari our sire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मनोजवसा वृषणा मदच्युता मक्षुंगमाभिरूतिभिः । आरात्ताच्चिद्भूतमस्मे अवसे पूर्वीभिः पुरुभोजसा ॥
translation: Rapid as thought, and strong, and speeding to thejoy, bringing.your swiftly-coming help, Be to us a protection even from far away Lords of great wealth, with many aids.'
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो अश्वावदश्विना वर्तिर्यासिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा । गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
translation: Come, Wonder-Workers, to our home, our home, O Aṣvins, rich in cattle, steeds, and gold, Chief drinkers of the Soma's juice
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुप्रावर्गं सुवीर्यं सुष्ठु वार्यमनाधृष्टं रक्षस्विना । अस्मिन्ना वामायाने वाजिनीवसू विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
translation: Choice-worthy strength, heroic, firm and excellent, uninjured by the Raksas foe, At this your coming nigh, ye Lords of ample wealth and all good things, may we obtain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईळिष्वा हि प्रतीव्यं१ यजस्व जातवेदसम् । चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम् ॥
translation: WORSHIP thou Jâtavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दामानं विश्वचर्षणेऽग्निं विश्वमनो गिरा । उत स्तुषे विष्पर्धसो रथानाम् ॥
translation: Thou, all men's friend, Viṣvamanas, exaltest Agni with thy song, The Giver, and his flames with which no cars contend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: येषामाबाध ऋग्मिय इषः पृक्षश्च निग्रभे । उपविदा वह्निर्विन्दते वसु ॥
translation: Whose resolute assault, to win vigour and food, deserves our praise,– Through whose discovering power the priest obtaineth wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदस्य शोचिरस्थाद्दीदियुषो व्य१जरम् । तपुर्जम्भस्य सुद्युतो गणश्रियः ॥
translation: Up springs the imperishable flame, the flame of the Refulgent One Most bright, with glowing jaws and glory in his train.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वर स्तवानो देव्या कृपा । अभिख्या भासा बृहता शुशुक्वनिः ॥
translation: Skilled in fair sacrifice, extolled, arise in Godlike loveliness, Shining with lofty splendour, with effulgent light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिर्हव्या जुह्वान आनुषक् । यथा दूतो बभूथ हव्यवाहनः ॥
translation: Called straight to our oblations, come, O Agni, through our eulogies, As thou hast been our envoy bearing up our gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं हुवे होतारं चर्षणीनाम् । तमया वाचा गृणे तमु वः स्तुषे ॥
translation: I call your Agni, from of old Invoking Priest of living men: Him with this song I laud and magnify for you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञेभिरद्भुतक्रतुं यं कृपा सूदयन्त इत् । मित्रं न जने सुधितमृतावनि ॥
translation: Whom, wondrous wise, they animate with solemn rites and his fair form, Kind as a friend to men who keep the holy Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतावानमृतायवो यज्ञस्य साधनं गिरा । उपो एनं जुजुषुर्नमसस्पदे ॥
translation: Him, true to Law, who perfecteth the sacrifice,. Law-loving ones! Ye with your song have gratified in the place of prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा नो अङ्गिरस्तमं यज्ञासो यन्तु संयतः । होता यो अस्ति विक्ष्वा यशस्तमः ॥
translation: May all our sacrifices go to him the truest Angiras, Who is among mankind the most illustrious Priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने तव त्ये अजरेन्धानासो बृहद्भाः । अश्वा इव वृषणस्तविषीयवः ॥
translation: Imperishable Agni, thine are all these high enkindled lights, Like horses and like stallions showing forth their strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वं न ऊर्जां पते रयिं रास्व सुवीर्यम् । प्राव नस्तोके तनये समत्स्वा ॥
translation: So give us, Lord of Power and Might, riches combined with hero strength, And guard us with our sons and grand. sons in our frays.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशि । विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षांसि सेधति ॥
translation: Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manti's race, Agni averteth from us all the demon host.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते । नि मायिनस्तपुषा रक्षसो दह ॥
translation: O Hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine, Burn down the Raksasas, enchanters, with thy flame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न तस्य मायया चन रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः । यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातिभिः ॥
translation: No mortal foe can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him Who serveth Agni well with sacrificial gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: व्यश्वस्त्वा वसुविदमुक्षण्युरप्रीणादृषिः । महो राये तमु त्वा समिधीमहि ॥
translation: Vyaṣva the sage, who sought the Bull, hath won thee, finder of good things: As such may we enkindle thee for ample wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उशना काव्यस्त्वा नि होतारमसादयत् । आयजिं त्वा मनवे जातवेदसम् ॥
translation: Uṣanâ Kâvya stablished thee, O Agni, as Invoking Priest: Thee, Jâtavedas, Sacrificing Priest for man.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत । श्रुष्टी देव प्रथमो यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
translation: All Deities of one accord appointed thee their messenger: Thou, God, through hearing, hadst first claim to sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं घा वीरो अमृतं दूतं कृण्वीत मर्त्यः । पावकं कृष्णवर्तनिं विहायसम् ॥
translation: Him may the mortal hero make his own immortal messenger. Far-spreading, Purifier, him whose path is black.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं हुवेम यतस्रुचः सुभासं शुक्रशोचिषम् । विशामग्निमजरं प्रत्नमीड्यम् ॥
translation: With lifted ladles let us call him splendid with his brilliant flame, Men's ancient Agni, wasting not, adorable.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अस्मै हव्यदातिभिराहुतिं मर्तोऽविधत् । भूरि पोषं स धत्ते वीरवद्यशः ॥
translation: The man who pays the worship due to him with sacrificial gifts Obtains both plenteous nourishment and hero fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रथमं जातवेदसमग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् । प्रति स्रुगेति नमसा हविष्मती ॥
translation: To Jâtavedas Agni, chief in sacrifices, first of all With homage goes the ladle rich with sacred gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आभिर्विधेमाग्नये ज्येष्ठाभिर्व्यश्ववत् । मंहिष्ठाभिर्मतिभिः शुक्रशोचिषे ॥
translation: Even as Vyatya did, may we with these most high and liberal hymns Pay worship unto Agni of the splendid flame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नूनमर्च विहायसे स्तोमेभिः स्थूरयूपवत् । ऋषे वैयश्व दम्यायाग्नये ॥
translation: Now sing, as Sthurayupa sang, with lands to him who spreadeth far, To Agni of the home, O R̥ishi, Vyaṣva's son.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतिथिं मानुषाणां सूनुं वनस्पतीनाम् । विप्रा अग्निमवसे प्रत्नमीळते ॥
translation: As welcome guest of human kind, as offspring of the forest kings, The sages worship ancient Agni for his aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महो विश्वाँ अभि षतो३ऽभि हव्यानि मानुषा । अग्ने नि षत्सि नमसाधि बर्हिषि ॥
translation: For men's oblations brought to him who is the mighty Lord of all, Sit, Agni, mid our homage, on the sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु वंस्व रायः पुरुस्पृहः । सुवीर्यस्य प्रजावतो यशस्वतः ॥
translation: Grant us abundant. treasures, grant the opulence which many crave, With store of heroes, progeny, and high renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं वरो सुषाम्णेऽग्ने जनाय चोदय । सदा वसो रातिं यविष्ठ शश्वते ॥
translation: Agni, Most Youthful of the Gods, send evermore the gift of wealth Unto Varosushâman and to all his folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं हि सुप्रतूरसि त्वं नो गोमतीरिषः । महो रायः सातिमग्ने अपा वृधि ॥
translation: A mighty Conqueror art thou, O Agni, so disclose to us Food in our herds of kine and gain of ample wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने त्वं यशा अस्या मित्रावरुणा वह । ऋतावाना सम्राजा पूतदक्षसा ॥
translation: Thou, Agni, art a glorious God: bring hither Mitra, Varuṇa, Imperial Sovrans, holy-minded, true to Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सखाय आ शिषामहि ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे । स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥
translation: COMPANIONS, let us learn a prayer to Indra. whom the thunder arms, To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा । मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि ॥
translation: For thou by slaying Vr̥itra art the Vr̥itra-slayer, famed for might. Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः स्तवान आ भर रयिं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् । निरेके चिद्यो हरिवो वसुर्ददिः ॥
translation: As such, when glorified, bring us riches of very wondrous fame, Set in the highest rank, Wealth-giver, Lord of Bays!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ निरेकमुत प्रियमिन्द्र दर्षि जनानाम् । धृषता धृष्णो स्तवमान आ भर ॥
translation: Yea, Indra, thou disclosest that preeminent dear wealth of men: Boldly, O Bold One, glorified, bring it to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न ते सव्यं न दक्षिणं हस्तं वरन्त आमुरः । न परिबाधो हरिवो गविष्टिषु ॥
translation: The workers of destruction stay neither thy right hand nor thy left: Nor hosts that press about thee, Lord of Bays, in fight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा गोभिरिव व्रजं गीर्भिॠणोम्यद्रिवः । आ स्मा कामं जरितुरा मनः पृण ॥
translation: O Thunder-armed, I come with songs to thee as to a stall with kine: Fulfil the wish and thought of him who sings thy praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वानि विश्वमनसो धिया नो वृत्रहन्तम । उग्र प्रणेतरधि षू वसो गहि ॥
translation: Chief Vr̥itra-slayer, through the hymn of Viṣvamanas think of all, All that concerneth us, Excellent, Mighty Guide.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्विद्याम शूर नव्यसः । वसोः स्पार्हस्य पुरुहूत राधसः ॥
translation: May we, O Vr̥itra-slayer, O Hero, find this thy newest boon, Longed-for, and excellent, thou who art much invoked!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र यथा ह्यस्ति तेऽपरीतं नृतो शवः । अमृक्ता रातिः पुरुहूत दाशुषे ॥
translation: O Indra, Dancer, Much-invoked! as thy great power is unsurpassed, So be thy bounty to the worshipper unchecked.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वृषस्व महामह महे नृतम राधसे । दृळ्हश्चिद्दृह्य मघवन्मघत्तये ॥
translation: Most Mighty, most heroic One, for mighty bounty fill thee full. Though strong, strengthen thyself to win wealth, Maghavan!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नू अन्यत्रा चिदद्रिवस्त्वन्नो जग्मुराशसः । मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः ॥
translation: O Thunderer, never have our prayers gone forth to any God but thee: So help us, Maghavan, with thine assistance now.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नह्य१ङ्ग नृतो त्वदन्यं विन्दामि राधसे । राये द्युम्नाय शवसे च गिर्वणः ॥
translation: For, Dancer, verily I find none else for bounty, saving thee, For splendid wealth and power, thou Lover of the Song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु । प्र राधसा चोदयाते महित्वना ॥
translation: For Indra pour ye out the drops meath blent with Soma let him drink With bounty and with majesty will he further us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो हरीणां पतिं दक्षं पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् । नूनं श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य ॥
translation: I spake to the Bay Coursers' Lord, to him who gives ability: Now hear the son of Aṣva as he praises thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नह्य१ङ्ग पुरा चन जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् । नकी राया नैवथा न भन्दना ॥
translation: Never was any Hero born before thee mightier than thou: None certairdy like thee in goodness and in wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एदु मध्वो मदिन्तरं सिञ्च वाध्वर्यो अन्धसः । एवा हि वीरः स्तवते सदावृधः ॥
translation: O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most: So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां नकिष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् । उदानंश शवसा न भन्दना ॥
translation: Indra, whom Tawny Coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent, None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः । अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम् ॥
translation: We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and might Who must be glorified by constant sacri fice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम सखायः स्तोम्यं नरम् । कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत् ॥
translation: Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends, the Hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अगोरुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः । घृतात्स्वादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत ॥
translation: To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, Celestial God, Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्यामितानि वीर्या३ न राधः पर्येतवे । ज्योतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा ॥
translation: Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne'er may be surpassed, Whose liberality, like light, is over all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तुहीन्द्रं व्यश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमम् । अर्यो गयं मंहमानं वि दाशुषे ॥
translation: As Vyaṣva did, praise Indra, praise the Strong unfluctuating Guide, Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा नूनमुप स्तुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवम् । सुविद्वांसं चर्कृत्यं चरणीनाम् ॥
translation: Now, son of Vyaṣva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new, The very Wise, whom living men must glorify
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेत्था हि निॠतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम् । अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव ॥
translation: Thou knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive powers, As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तदिन्द्राव आ भर येना दंसिष्ठ कृत्वने । द्विता कुत्साय शिश्नथो नि चोदय ॥
translation: O Indra, bring that aid wherewith of old, Most Wondrous! thou didst slay His foes for active Kutsa: send it down to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमीमहे नव्यं दंसिष्ठ सन्यसे । स त्वं नो विश्वा अभिमातीः सक्षणिः ॥
translation: So now we seek thee fresh in might, Most Wonderful in act! for gain: For thou art he who conquers all our foes for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य ऋक्षादंहसो मुचद्यो वार्यात्सप्त सिन्धुषु । वधर्दासस्य तुविनृम्ण नीनमः ॥
translation: Who will set free from ruinous woe, or Ârya on the Seven Streams: O valiant Hero, bend the Dâsa's weapon down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा वरो सुषाम्णे सनिभ्य आवहो रयिम् । व्यश्वेभ्यः सुभगे वाजिनीवति ॥
translation: As to Varosushâman thou broughtest great riches, for their gain, To Vyaṣva's sons, Blest Lady, rich in ample wealth!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नार्यस्य दक्षिणा व्यश्वाँ एतु सोमिनः । स्थूरं च राधः शतवत्सहस्रवत् ॥
translation: Let Nârya's sacrificial meed reach Vyaṣva's Soma-bearing sons: In hundreds and in thousands be the great reward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्त्वा पृच्छादीजानः कुहया कुहयाकृते । एषो अपश्रितो वलो गोमतीमव तिष्ठति ॥
translation: If one should ask thee, Where is he who sacrificed? Whither lookest thou? Like Vala he hath passed away and dwelleth now on Gomatî.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता वां विश्वस्य गोपा देवा देवेषु यज्ञिया । ऋतावाना यजसे पूतदक्षसा ॥
translation: I WORSHIP you who guard this All, Gods, holiest among the Gods, You, faithful to the Law, whose power is sanctified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रा तना न रथ्या३ वरुणो यश्च सुक्रतुः । सनात्सुजाता तनया धृतव्रता ॥
translation: So, too, like charioteers are they, Mitra and sapient Varuṇa, Sons high-born from of old, whose holy laws stand fast.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता माता विश्ववेदसासुर्याय प्रमहसा । मही जजानादितिॠतावरी ॥
translation: These Twain, possessors of all wealth, most glorious, for supremest sway Aditi, Mighty Mother, true to Law, brought forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महान्ता मित्रावरुणा सम्राजा देवावसुरा । ऋतावानावृतमा घोषतो बृहत् ॥
translation: Great Varuṇa and Mitra, Gods, Asuras and imperial Lords, True to Eternal Law proclaim the high decree.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नपाता शवसो महः सूनू दक्षस्य सुक्रतू । सृप्रदानू इषो वास्त्वधि क्षितः ॥
translation: The offspring of a lofty Power, Daksha's Two Sons exceeding strong, Who, Lords of flowing rain, dwell in the place of food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं या दानूनि येमथुर्दिव्याः पार्थिवीरिषः । नभस्वतीरा वां चरन्तु वृष्टयः ॥
translation: Ye who have gathered up your gifts, celestial and terrestrial food, Let your rain come to us fraught with the mist of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधि या बृहतो दिवो३ऽभि यूथेव पश्यतः । ऋतावाना सम्राजा नमसे हिता ॥
translation: The Twain, who from the lofty sky seem to look down on herds below, Holy, imperial Lords, are set to be revered.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतावाना नि षेदतुः साम्राज्याय सुक्रतू । धृतव्रता क्षत्रिया क्षत्रमाशतुः ॥
translation: They, true to Law, exceeding strong, have sat them down for savran rule: Princes whose laws stand fast, they have obtained their sway.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अक्ष्णश्चिद्गातुवित्तरानुल्बणेन चक्षसा । नि चिन्मिषन्ता निचिरा नि चिक्यतुः ॥
translation: Pathfinders even better than the eye, with unobstructed sight, Even when they close their lids, observant, they perceive.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो देव्यदितिरुरुष्यतां नासत्या । उरुष्यन्तु मरुतो वृद्धशवसः ॥
translation: So may the Goddess Aditi, may the Nâsatyas guard us well, The Martits guard us well,.endowed with mighty strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नो नावमुरुष्यत दिवा नक्तं सुदानवः । अरिष्यन्तो नि पायुभिः सचेमहि ॥
translation: Do ye, O Bounteous Gods, protect our dwelling lace by day and night: With you for our defenders may we go unharmed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अघ्नते विष्णवे वयमरिष्यन्तः सुदानवे । श्रुधि स्वयावन्त्सिन्धो पूर्वचित्तये ॥
translation: May we, unharmed, serve bountiful Vishṇu, the God who slayeth none: Self-moving Sindhu hear and be the first to mark.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्वार्यं वृणीमहे वरिष्ठं गोपयत्यम् । मित्रो यत्पान्ति वरुणो यदर्यमा ॥
translation: This sure protection we elect, desirable and reaching far, Which Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman afford.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नः सिन्धुरपां तन्मरुतस्तदश्विना । इन्द्रो विष्णुर्मीढ्वांसः सजोषसः ॥
translation: And may the Sindhu of the floods, the Maruts, and the ASvin Pair, Boon Indra, and boon Vishṇu have one mind with us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते हि ष्मा वनुषो नरोऽभिमातिं कयस्य चित् । तिग्मं न क्षोदः प्रतिघ्नन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
translation: Because these warring Heroes stay the enmity of every foe, As the fierce water-flood repels the furious ones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमेक इत्था पुरूरु चष्टे वि विश्पतिः । तस्य व्रतान्यनु वश्चरामसि ॥
translation: Here this one God, the Lord of men, looks forth exceeding far and wide: And we, for your advantage, keep his holy laws.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु पूर्वाण्योक्या साम्राज्यस्य सश्चिम । मित्रस्य व्रता वरुणस्य दीर्घश्रुत् ॥
translation: We keep the old accustomed laws, the statutes of supremacy, The Iong-known laws of Mitra and of Varuṇa.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि यो रश्मिना दिवोऽन्तान्ममे पृथिव्याः । उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ॥
translation: He who hath measured with his ray the boundaries of heaven and earth, And with his majesty hath filled the two worlds full,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु ष्य शरणे दिवो ज्योतिरयंस्त सूर्यः । अग्निर्न शुक्रः समिधान आहुतः ॥
translation: Sûrya hath spread his light aloft up to the region of the sky, Like Agni all aflame when gifts are offered him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वचो दीर्घप्रसद्मनीशे वाजस्य गोमतः । ईशे हि पित्वोऽविषस्य दावने ॥
translation: With him who sits afar the word is lord of food that comes from kine, Controller of the gift of unempoisoned food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्सूर्यं रोदसी उभे दोषा वस्तोरुप ब्रुवे । भोजेष्वस्माँ अभ्युच्चरा सदा ॥
translation: So unto Sûrya, Heaven, and Earth at morning and at eve I speak. Bringing enjoyments ever rise thou up for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋज्रमुक्षण्यायने रजतं हरयाणे । रथं युक्तमसनाम सुषामणि ॥
translation: From Ukshaṇyâyana a bay, from Harayâṇa a white steed, And from Sushâman we obtained a hamessed car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता मे अश्व्यानां हरीणां नितोशना । उतो नु कृत्व्यानां नृवाहसा ॥
translation: These two shall bring me further gain of troops of tawny-coloured steeds, The carriers shall they be of active men of war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्मदभीशू कशावन्ता विप्रा नविष्ठया मती । महो वाजिनावर्वन्ता सचासनम् ॥
translation: And the two sages have I gained who hold the reins and bear the whip, And the two great strong coursers, with my newest song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवोरु षू रथं हुवे सधस्तुत्याय सूरिषु । अतूर्तदक्षा वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
translation: I CALL your chariot to receive united praise mid princely men, Strong Gods who pour down wealth, of never vanquished might!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवं वरो सुषाम्णे महे तने नासत्या । अवोभिर्याथो वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
translation: Ye to Varosushâman come, Nâsatyas, for this glorious rite. With your protecting aid. Strong Gods, who pour down wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता वामद्य हवामहे हव्येभिर्वाजिनीवसू । पूर्वीरिष इषयन्तावति क्षपः ॥
translation: So with oblations we invoke you, rich in ample wealth, to-day, When night hath passed, O ye who send us plenteous food. O Aṣvins, Heroes, let your car, famed, best to travel, come to us, And, for his glory, mark your zealous servant's lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वां वाहिष्ठो अश्विना रथो यातु श्रुतो नरा । उप स्तोमान्तुरस्य दर्शथः श्रिये ॥
translation: O Aṣvins, Heroes, let your car, famed, best to travel, come to us, And, for his glory, mark your zealous servant's lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुहुराणा चिदश्विना मन्येथां वृषण्वसू । युवं हि रुद्रा पर्षथो अति द्विषः ॥
translation: Aṣvins, who send us precious gifts, even when offended, think of him: For ye, O Rudras, lead us safe beyond our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दस्रा हि विश्वमानुषङ्मक्षूभिः परिदीयथः । धियंजिन्वा मधुवर्णा शुभस्पती ॥
translation: For, Wonder-Workers, with fleet steeds ye fly completely round this All, Stirring our thoughts, ye Lords of splendour, honey-hued.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नो यातमश्विना राया विश्वपुषा सह । मघवाना सुवीरावनपच्युता ॥
translation: With all-sustaining opulence, Aṣvins, come hitherward to us, Ye rich and noble Heroes, ne'er to be o'erthrown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मे अस्य प्रतीव्य१मिन्द्रनासत्या गतम् । देवा देवेभिरद्य सचनस्तमा ॥
translation: To welcome this mine offering, O ye Indra-like Nâsatyas, come As Gods of best accord this day with other Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं हि वां हवामह उक्षण्यन्तो व्यश्ववत् । सुमतिभिरुप विप्राविहा गतम् ॥
translation: For we, like Vyaṣva, lifting up our voice like oxen, call on you: With all your loving kindness, Sages, come to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना स्वृषे स्तुहि कुवित्ते श्रवतो हवम् । नेदीयसः कूळयातः पणीँरुत ॥
translation: O R̥ishi, laud the Aṣvins well. Will they not listen to thy call? Will they not bum the Paṇis who are nearer them?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वैयश्वस्य श्रुतं नरोतो मे अस्य वेदथः । सजोषसा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ॥
translation: O Heroes, listen to the son of Vyaṣva, and regard me here, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, of one accord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवादत्तस्य धिष्ण्या युवानीतस्य सूरिभिः । अहरहर्वृषण मह्यं शिक्षतम् ॥
translation: Gods whom we yearn for, of your gifts, of what ye bring to us, bestow By princes' hands on me, ye Mighty, day by day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो वां यज्ञेभिरावृतोऽधिवस्त्रा वधूरिव । सपर्यन्ता शुभे चक्राते अश्विना ॥
translation: Him whom your sacrifices clothe, even as a woman with her robe, The Aṣvins help to glory honouring him well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो वामुरुव्यचस्तमं चिकेतति नृपाय्यम् । वर्तिरश्विना परि यातमस्मयू ॥
translation: Whoso regards your care of men as succour widest in its reach, About his dwelling go, ye Aṣvins, loving us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं सु वृषण्वसू यातं वर्तिर्नृपाय्यम् । विषुद्रुहेव यज्ञमूहथुर्गिरा ॥
translation: Come to us ye who pour down wealth, come to the home which men must guard: Like shafts, ye are made meet for sacrifice by song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाहिष्ठो वां हवानां स्तोमो दूतो हुवन्नरा । युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ॥
translation: Most fetching of all calls, the laud, as envoy, Heroes, called to you Be it your own, O Aṣvin Pair.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यददो दिवो अर्णव इषो वा मदथो गृहे । श्रुतमिन्मे अमर्त्या ॥
translation: Be ye in yonder sea of heaven, or joying in the home of food, Listen to me, Immortal Ones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत स्या श्वेतयावरी वाहिष्ठा वां नदीनाम् । सिन्धुर्हिरण्यवर्तनिः ॥
translation: This river with his lucid flow attracts you, more than all the streams,– Even Sindhu with his path of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्मदेतया सुकीर्त्याश्विना श्वेतया धिया । वहेथे शुभ्रयावाना ॥
translation: O Aṣvins, with that glorious fame come hither, through our brilliant song, Come ye whose ways are marked with light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि त्वं रथासहा युवस्व पोष्या वसो । आन्नो वायो मधु पिबास्माकं सवना गहि ॥
translation: Harness the steeds who draw the car, O Vasu, bring the well-fed pair. O Vâyu, drink thou of our meath: come unto our drink-offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव वायवृतस्पते त्वष्टुर्जामातरद्भुत । अवांस्या वृणीमहे ॥
translation: Wonderful Vâyu, Lord of Right, thou who art Tvashṭar's son-in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वष्टुर्जामातरं वयमीशानं राय ईमहे । सुतावन्तो वायुं द्युम्ना जनासः ॥
translation: To Tvashṭar's son-in-law we pray for wealth whereof he hath control: For glory we seek Vâyu, men with juice effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वायो याहि शिवा दिवो वहस्वा सु स्वश्व्यम् । वहस्व महः पृथुपक्षसा रथे ॥
translation: From heaven, auspicious Vâyu, come drive hither with thy noble steeds: Come on thy mighty car with wide-extending seat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां हि सुप्सरस्तमं नृषदनेषु हूमहे । ग्रावाणं नाश्वपृष्ठं मंहना ॥
translation: We call thee to the homes of men, thee wealthiest in noble food, And liberal as a press-stone with a horse's back.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वं नो देव मनसा वायो मन्दानो अग्रियः । कृधि वाजाँ अपो धियः ॥
translation: So, glad and joyful in thine heart, do thou, God, Vâyu, first of all Vouchsafe us water, strength, and thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे । ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पतिं देवाँ अवो वरेण्यम् ॥
translation: CHEIF Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice: With song I seek the Maruts, Brahmaṇaspati, Gods for help much to be desired.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पशुं गासि पृथिवीं वनस्पतीनुषासा नक्तमोषधीः । विश्वे च नो वसवो विश्ववेदसो धीनां भूत प्रावितारः ॥
translation: I sing to cattle and to Earth, to trees, to Dawns, to Night, to plants. O all ye Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, be ye the furtherers of our thoughts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सू न एत्वध्वरो३ऽग्ना देवेषु पूर्व्यः । आदित्येषु प्र वरुणे धृतव्रते मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ॥
translation: Forth go, with Agni, to the Gods our sacrifice of ancient use, To the Âdityas, Varuṇa whose Law stands fast, and the all-lightening Marut troop.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वे हि ष्मा मनवे विश्ववेदसो भुवन्वृधे रिशादसः । अरिष्टेभिः पायुभिर्विश्ववेदसो यन्ता नोऽवृकं छर्दिः ॥
translation: Lords of all wealth, may they be strengtheners of man, destroyers of his enemies. Lords of all wealth, do ye, with guards which none may harm, preserve our dwelling free from foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो अद्य समनसो गन्ता विश्वे सजोषसः । ऋचा गिरा मरुतो देव्यदिते सदने पस्त्ये महि ॥
translation: Come to us with one mind to-day, come to us all with one accord, Maruts with holy song, and, Goddess Aditi, Mighty One, to our house and home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रिया मरुतो या वो अश्व्या हव्या मित्र प्रयाथन । आ बर्हिरिन्द्रो वरुणस्तुरा नर आदित्यासः सदन्तु नः ॥
translation: Send us delightful things, ye Maruts, on your steeds: come ye, O Mitra, to our gifts. Let Indra, Varuṇa, and the Âdityas sit, swift Heroes, on our sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं वो वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आनुषक् । सुतसोमासो वरुण हवामहे मनुष्वदिद्धाग्नयः ॥
translation: We who have trimmed the grass for you, and set the banquet in array, And pressed the Soma, call you, Varuina, like men, with sacrificial fires aflame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ प्र यात मरुतो विष्णो अश्विना पूषन्माकीनया धिया । इन्द्र आ यातु प्रथमः सनिष्युभिर्वृषा यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
translation: O Maruts, Visinu, Aṣvins, Pûshan, haste away with minds turned hitherward to Me. Let the Strong Indra, famed as Vr̥itra's slayer, come first with the winners of the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि नो देवासो अद्रुहोऽच्छिद्रं शर्म यच्छत । न यद्दूराद्वसवो नू चिदन्तितो वरूथमादधर्षति ॥
translation: Ye Guileless Gods, bestow on us a refuge strong on every side, A sure protection, Vasus, unassailable from near at hand or from afar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्ति हि वः सजात्यं रिशादसो देवासो अस्त्याप्यम् । प्र णः पूर्वस्मै सुविताय वोचत मक्षू सुम्नाय नव्यसे ॥
translation: Kinship have I with you, and close alliance O ye Gods, destroyers of our foes. Call us to our prosperity of former days, and soon to new klicity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदा हि व उपस्तुतिमिदा वामस्य भक्तये । उप वो विश्ववेदसो नमस्युराँ असृक्ष्यन्यामिव ॥
translation: For now have I sent forth to you, that I may win a fair reward, Lords of all wealth, with homage, this my song of praise. like a milch-cow that faileth not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदु ष्य वः सविता सुप्रणीतयोऽस्थादूर्ध्वो वरेण्यः । नि द्विपादश्चतुष्पादो अर्थिनोऽविश्रन्पतयिष्णवः ॥
translation: Excellent Savitar hath mounted up on high for you, ye sure and careful Guides. Bipeds and quadrupeds, with several hopes and aims, and birds have settled to their tasks.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवंदेवं वोऽवसे देवंदेवमभिष्टये । देवंदेवं हुवेम वाजसातये गृणन्तो देव्या धिया ॥
translation: Singing their praise with God-like thought let us invoke each God for grace, Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवासो हि ष्मा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकं सरातयः । ते नो अद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवन्तु वरिवोविदः ॥
translation: For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts. May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing case and ample room.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वः शंसाम्यद्रुहः संस्थ उपस्तुतीनाम् । न तं धूर्तिर्वरुण मित्र मर्त्यं यो वो धामभ्योऽविधत् ॥
translation: I laud you, O ye Guileless Gods, here where we meet to render praise. None, Varuṇa and Mitra, harins the mortal, man who honours and obeys your laws.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति । प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्पर्यरिष्टः सर्व एधते ॥
translation: He makes his house endure, he gathers plenteous food who pays obedience to your will. Born in his sons anew he spreads as Law commands, and prospers every way unharmed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋते स विन्दते युधः सुगेभिर्यात्यध्वनः । अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः सरातयो यं त्रायन्ते सजोषसः ॥
translation: E'en without war he gathers wealth, and goes hisway on pleasant paths, Whom Mitra, Varuṇa and Aryaman protect, sharing the gift,of one accord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अज्रे चिदस्मै कृणुथा न्यञ्चनं दुर्गे चिदा सुसरणम् । एषा चिदस्मादशनिः परो नु सास्रेधन्ती वि नश्यतु ॥
translation: E'en on the plain for him ye make a sloping path, an easy way where road is none: And far away from him the ineffectual shaft must vanish, shot at him in vain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्य सूर्य उद्यति प्रियक्षत्रा ऋतं दध । यन्निम्रुचि प्रबुधि विश्ववेदसो यद्वा मध्यंदिने दिवः ॥
translation: If ye appoint the rite to-day, kind Rulers, when the Sun ascends, Lords of all wealth, at sunset or at wakingtime, or be it at the noon of day,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वाभिपित्वे असुरा ऋतं यते छर्दिर्येम वि दाशुषे । वयं तद्वो वसवो विश्ववेदस उप स्थेयाम मध्य आ ॥
translation: Or, Asuras, when ye have sheltered the worshipper who goes to sacrifice, at eve may we, O Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, come then into the midst of You.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्य सूर उदिते यन्मध्यंदिन आतुचि । वामं धत्थ मनवे विश्ववेदसो जुह्वानाय प्रचेतसे ॥
translation: If ye to-day at sunrise, or at noon, or in the gloom of eve, Lords of all riches, give fair treasure to the man, the wise man who hath sacrificed,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं तद्वः सम्राज आ वृणीमहे पुत्रो न बहुपाय्यम् । अश्याम तदादित्या जुह्वतो हविर्येन वस्योऽनशामहै ॥
translation: Then we, imperial Rulers, claim of you this boon, your wide protection, as a son. May we, Âdityas, offering holy gifts, obtain that which shall bring us greater bliss.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये त्रिंशति त्रयस्परो देवासो बर्हिरासदन् । विदन्नह द्वितासनन् ॥
translation: THE Thirty Gods and Three besides, whose seat hath been the sacred grass, From time of old have found and gained.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा स्मद्रातिषाचो अग्नयः । पत्नीवन्तो वषट्कृताः ॥
translation: Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Agnis, with Consorts, sending boons, To whom our Vashaṭ! is addressed:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नो गोपा अपाच्यास्त उदक्त इत्था न्यक् । पुरस्तात्सर्वया विशा ॥
translation: These are our guardians in the west, and northward here, and in the south, And on the cast, with all the tribe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसत्तदेषां नकिरा मिनत् । अरावा चन मर्त्यः ॥
translation: Even as the Gods desire so verily shall it be. None minisheth this power of theirs, No demon, and no mortal
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सप्तानां सप्त ऋष्टयः सप्त द्युम्नान्येषाम् । सप्तो अधि श्रियो धिरे ॥
translation: The Seven carry seven spears; seven are the splendours they possess, And seven the glories they assume.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बभ्रुरेको विषुणः सूनरो युवाञ्ज्यङ्क्ते हिरण्ययम् ॥
translation: ONE is a youth brown, active, manifold he decks the golden one with ornament.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योनिमेक आ ससाद द्योतनोऽन्तर्देवेषु मेधिरः ॥
translation: Another, luminous, occupies the place of sacritice, Sage, among the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाशीमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयसीमन्तर्देवेषु निध्रुविः ॥
translation: One brandishes in his hand an iron knife, firm, in his seat amid the Deities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वज्रमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आहितं तेन वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
translation: Another holds the thunderbolt, wherewith he slays the Vr̥itras, resting in his hand.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिग्ममेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयुधं शुचिरुग्रो जलाषभेषजः ॥
translation: Another bears a pointed weapon: bright is he, and strong, with healing medicines.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पथ एकः पीपाय तस्करो यथाँ एष वेद निधीनाम् ॥
translation: Another, thief-like, watches well the ways, and knows the places where the treasures lie.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रीण्येक उरुगायो वि चक्रमे यत्र देवासो मदन्ति ॥
translation: Another with his mighty stride hath made his three steps thither where the Gods rejoice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभिर्द्वा चरत एकया सह प्र प्रवासेव वसतः ॥
translation: Two with one Dame ride on with winged steeds, and journey forth like travellers on their way.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सदो द्वा चक्राते उपमा दिवि सम्राजा सर्पिरासुती ॥
translation: Two, highest, in the heavens have set their seat, worshipped with holy oil, imperial Kings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्चन्त एके महि साम मन्वत तेन सूर्यमरोचयन् ॥
translation: Some, singing lauds, conceived the Sâma-hymn, great hymn whereby they caused the Sun to shine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि वो अस्त्यर्भको देवासो न कुमारकः । विश्वे सतोमहान्त इत् ॥
translation: NOT one of you, ye Gods, is small, none of you is a feeble child: All of you, verily, are great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इति स्तुतासो असथा रिशादसो ये स्थ त्रयश्च त्रिंशच्च । मनोर्देवा यज्ञियासः ॥
translation: Thus be ye lauded, ye destroyers of the foe, ye Three-and-Thirty Deities, The Gods of man, the Holy Ones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नस्त्राध्वं तेऽवत त उ नो अधि वोचत । मा नः पथः पित्र्यान्मानवादधि दूरं नैष्ट परावतः ॥
translation: As such defend and succour us, with benedictions speak to us: Lead us not from our fathers' and from Manu's path into the distance far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये देवास इह स्थन विश्वे वैश्वानरा उत । अस्मभ्यं शर्म सप्रथो गवेऽश्वाय यच्छत ॥
translation: Ye Deities who stay with us, and all ye Gods of all mankind, Give us your wide protection, give shelter for cattle and for steed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो यजाति यजात इत्सुनवच्च पचाति च । ब्रह्मेदिन्द्रस्य चाकनत् ॥
translation: THAT Brahman pleases Indra well, who worships, sacrifices, pours Libation, and prepares the meal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरोळाशं यो अस्मै सोमं ररत आशिरम् । पादित्तं शक्रो अंहसः ॥
translation: Ṣakra protects from woe the man who gives him sacrificial cake. And offers Soma blent with milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्य द्युमाँ असद्रथो देवजूतः स शूशुवत् । विश्वा वन्वन्नमित्रिया ॥
translation: His chariot shall be glorious, sped by Gods, and mighty shall he be, Subduing all hostilities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य प्रजावती गृहेऽसश्चन्ती दिवेदिवे । इळा धेनुमती दुहे ॥
translation: Each day that passes, in his house flows his libation, rich in milk, Exhaustless, bringing progeny.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या दम्पती समनसा सुनुत आ च धावतः । देवासो नित्ययाशिरा ॥
translation: O Gods, with constant draught of milk, husband and wife with one accord Press out and wash the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति प्राशव्याँ इतः सम्यञ्चा बर्हिराशाते । न ता वाजेषु वायतः ॥
translation: They gain sufficient food: they come united to the sacred grass, And never do they fail in strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न देवानामपि ह्नुतः सुमतिं न जुगुक्षतः । श्रवो बृहद्विवासतः ॥
translation: Never do they deny or seek to hide the favour of the Gods: They win high glory for themselves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुत्रिणा ता कुमारिणा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतः । उभा हिरण्यपेशसा ॥
translation: With sons and daughters by their side they reach their full extent of life, Both decked with ornaments of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वीतिहोत्रा कृतद्वसू दशस्यन्तामृताय कम् । समूधो रोमशं हतो देवेषु कृणुतो दुवः ॥
translation: Serving the Immortal One with gifts of sacrificial meal and wealth, They satisfy the claims of love and pay due honour to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ शर्म पर्वतानां वृणीमहे नदीनाम् । आ विष्णोः सचाभुवः ॥
translation: We claim protection from the Hills, we claim protection of the Floods, Of him who stands by Vishṇu's side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऐतु पूषा रयिर्भगः स्वस्ति सर्वधातमः । उरुरध्वा स्वस्तये ॥
translation: May Pûshan come, and Bhaga, Lord of wealth, All-bounteous, for our weal Broad be the path that leads to bliss:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरमतिरनर्वणो विश्वो देवस्य मनसा । आदित्यानामनेह इत् ॥
