translation: Aramati, and, free from foes, Viṣva with spirit of a God, And the Âdityas' peerless might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा नो मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सन्ति गोपाः । सुगा ऋतस्य पन्थाः ॥
translation: Seeing that Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuṇa are guarding us, The paths of Law are fair to tread.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं गिरा देवमीळे वसूनाम् । सपर्यन्तः पुरुप्रियं मित्रं न क्षेत्रसाधसम् ॥
translation: I glorify with song, for wealth, Agni the God, the first of you. We honour as a well-loved Friend the God who prospereth our fields.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मक्षू देववतो रथः शूरो वा पृत्सु कासु चित् । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
translation: As in all frays the hero, so swift moves his car whom Gods attend. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न यजमान रिष्यसि न सुन्वान न देवयो । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
translation: Ne'er are ye injured, worshipper, presser of juice, or pious man. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशन्न प्र योषन्न योषति । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
translation: None in his action equals him, none holds him far or keeps him off. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असदत्र सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यम् । देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
translation: Such strength of heroes shall be his, such mastery of fleet-foot steeds. The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र कृतान्यृजीषिणः कण्वा इन्द्रस्य गाथया । मदे सोमस्य वोचत ॥
translation: Kaṇvas, tell forth with song the deeds of Indra, the Impetuous, Wrought in the Soma's wild delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः सृबिन्दमनर्शनिं पिप्रुं दासमहीशुवम् । वधीदुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥
translation: Strong God, he slew Anarṣani, Sr̥ibinda, Pipru, and the fiend, Ahîṣuva, and loosed the floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न्यर्बुदस्य विष्टपं वर्ष्माणं बृहतस्तिर । कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम् ॥
translation: Thou broughtest down the dwelling-place, the height of lofty Arbuda. That exploit, Indra, must be famed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति श्रुताय वो धृषत्तूर्णाशं न गिरेरधि । हुवे सुशिप्रमूतये ॥
translation: Bold, to your famous Soma I call the fair-visored God for aid, Down like a torrent from the hill.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स गोरश्वस्य वि व्रजं मन्दानः सोम्येभ्यः । पुरं न शूर दर्षसि ॥
translation: Rejoicing in the Soma-draughts, Hero, burst open, like a fort, The stall of horses and of kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदि मे रारणः सुत उक्थे वा दधसे चनः । आरादुप स्वधा गहि ॥
translation: If my libation gladdens, if thou takest pleasure in my laud, Come with thy Godhead from afar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं घा ते अपि ष्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः ॥
translation: O Indra, Lover of the Song, the singers of thy praise are we: O Soma-drinker, quicken us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नः पितुमा भर संरराणो अविक्षितम् । मघवन्भूरि ते वसु ॥
translation: And, taking thy delight with us bring us still undiminished food: Great is thy wealth, O Maghavan.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो गोमतस्कृधि हिरण्यवतो अश्विनः । इळाभिः सं रभेमहि ॥
translation: Make thou us rich in herds of kine, in steeds, in gold: let us exert Our strength in sacrificial gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृबदुक्थं हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये । साधु कृण्वन्तमवसे ॥
translation: Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, to whom high laud is due. Who worketh well to succour us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः संस्थे चिच्छतक्रतुरादीं कृणोति वृत्रहा । जरितृभ्यः पुरूवसुः ॥
translation: He, Ṣatakratu, even in fight acts as a Vr̥itra-slayer s,till: He gives his worshippers much wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः शक्रश्चिदा शकद्दानवाँ अन्तराभरः । इन्द्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ॥
translation: May he, this A;akra, strengthen us, Boon God who satisfies our needs, Indra, with all lhis saving helps.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो रायो३ऽवनिर्महान्त्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा । तमिन्द्रमभि गायत ॥
translation: To him, the mighty stream of wealth, the Soma-presser's rescuing Friend, To Indra sing your song of praise;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयन्तारं महि स्थिरं पृतनासु श्रवोजितम् । भूरेरीशानमोजसा ॥
translation: Who bringeth what is great and firm, who winneth glory in his wars, Lord of vast wealth through power and might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकिरस्य शचीनां नियन्ता सूनृतानाम् । नकिर्वक्ता न दादिति ॥
translation: There liveth none to cheek or stay his energies and gracious deeds: None who can say, He giveth not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न नूनं ब्रह्मणामृणं प्राशूनामस्ति सुन्वताम् । न सोमो अप्रता पपे ॥
translation: No debt is due by Brahmans now, by active men who press the juice: Well hath each Soma-draught been paid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पन्य इदुप गायत पन्य उक्थानि शंसत । ब्रह्मा कृणोत पन्य इत् ॥
translation: Sing ye to him who must be praised, say lauds to him who must be praised, Bring prayer to him who must be praised.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पन्य आ दर्दिरच्छता सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः । इन्द्रो यो यज्वनो वृधः ॥
translation: May be, unchecked, strong, meet for praise, bring hundreds, thousands forth to light, Indra who aids the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि षू चर स्वधा अनु कृष्टीनामन्वाहुवः । इन्द्र पिब सुतानाम् ॥
translation: Go with thy God-like nature forth, go where the folk are calling thee: Drink, Indra, of the drops we pour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिब स्वधैनवानामुत यस्तुग्र्ये सचा । उतायमिन्द्र यस्तव ॥
translation: Drink milky draughts which are thine own, this too which was with Tugrya once, This is it, Indra, that is thine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतीहि मन्युषाविणं सुषुवांसमुपारणे । इमं रातं सुतं पिब ॥
translation: Pass him who psours libations out in angry mood or after sin: Here drink the juice we offer thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इहि तिस्रः परावत इहि पञ्च जनाँ अति । धेना इन्द्रावचाकशत् ॥
translation: Over the three great distances, past the Five Peoples go thy way, O Indra, noticing our voice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सूर्यो रश्मिं यथा सृजा त्वा यच्छन्तु मे गिरः । निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥
translation: Send forth thy ray like Sûrya: let my songs attract thee hitherward, Like waters gathering to the vale.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध्वर्यवा तु हि षिञ्च सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे । भरा सुतस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Now to the Hero fair of cheek, Adhvaryu, pour the Soma forth: Bring of the juice that he may drink
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य उद्नः फलिगं भिनन्न्य१क्सिन्धूँरवासृजत् । यो गोषु पक्वं धारयत् ॥
translation: Who cleft the water-cloud in twain, loosed rivers for their downward flow, And set the ripe milk in the kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहन्वृत्रमृचीषम और्णवाभमहीशुवम् । हिमेनाविध्यदर्बुदम् ॥
translation: He, meet for praise, slew Vr̥itra, slew Ahîṣuva, Ûrṇavâbha's son, And pierced through Arbuda with frost.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र व उग्राय निष्टुरेऽषाळ्हाय प्रसक्षिणे । देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत ॥
translation: To him your matchless Mighty One, unconquerable Conqueror, Sing forth the prayer which Gods have given:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो विश्वान्यभि व्रता सोमस्य मदे अन्धसः । इन्द्रो देवेषु चेतति ॥
translation: Indra, who in the wild delight of Soma juice considers here All holy Laws among the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या । वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम् ॥
translation: Hither let these thy Bays who share thy banquet, Steeds with golden manes, Convey thee to the feast prepared.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी । सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ॥
translation: Hither, O thou whom many laud, the Bays whom Priyamedha praised, Shall bring thee to the Soma-draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः । पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥
translation: WE compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vr̥itra-slayer, sit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः । कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः ॥
translation: Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place: When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम् । पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
translation: Boldly, Bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kaṇvas' sake. O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store ol kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पाहि गायान्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे । यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यः सुते सचा वज्री रथो हिरण्ययः ॥
translation: Medhyâtithi, to Indra sing, drink of the juice to make thee glad. Close-knit to his Bay Steeds, bolt-armed, beside the juice is he: his chariot is of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः सुषव्यः सुदक्षिण इनो यः सुक्रतुर्गृणे । य आकरः सहस्रा यः शतामघ इन्द्रो यः पूर्भिदारितः ॥
translation: He Who is praised as strong of hand both right and left, most wise and hold: Indra who, rich in hundreds, gathers thousands up, honoured as breaker-down of forts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो धृषितो योऽवृतो यो अस्ति श्मश्रुषु श्रितः । विभूतद्युम्नश्च्यवनः पुरुष्टुतः क्रत्वा गौरिव शाकिनः ॥
translation: The bold of heart whom none provokes, who stands in bearded confidence; Much-lauded, very glorious, overthrowing foes, strong Helper, like a bull with might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे । अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः ॥
translation: Who knows what vital ower he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-checked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे । नकिष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाँश्चरस्योजसा ॥
translation: As a wild elephant rushes on this way and that way, mad with heat,' None may compel thee, yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृतः स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः । यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत् ॥
translation: When he, the Mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, steadfast, made ready for the fight, When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽवृतः । वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः ॥
translation: Yea, verily, thou art a Bull, with a bull's rush. whom none may stay: Thou Mighty One, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषणस्ते अभीशवो वृषा कशा हिरण्ययी । वृषा रथो मघवन्वृषणा हरी वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो ॥
translation: Thy reins are very bulls in strength, bulls' strength is in thy golden whip. Thy car, O Maghavan, thy Bays are strong as bulls: thou, Ṣatakratu, art a Bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा सोता सुनोतु ते वृषन्नृजीपिन्ना भर । वृषा दधन्वे वृषणं नदीष्वा तुभ्यं स्थातर्हरीणाम् ॥
translation: Let the strong presser press for thee. Bring hither, thou straight-rushing Bull. The mighty makes the mighty run in flowing streams for thee whom thy Bay Horses bear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि पीतये मधु शविष्ठ सोम्यम् । नायमच्छा मघवा शृणवद्गिरो ब्रह्मोक्था च सुक्रतुः ॥
translation: Come, thou most potent Indra, come to drink the savoury Soma juice. Maghavan, very wise, will quickly come to hear the songs, the prayer, the hymns of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वहन्तु त्वा रथेष्ठामा हरयो रथयुजः । तिरश्चिदर्यं सवनानि वृत्रहन्नन्येषां या शतक्रतो ॥
translation: When thou hast mounted on thy car let thy yoked Bay Steeds carry thee, Past other men's libations, Lord of Hundred Powers, thee, Vr̥itra-slayer, thee our Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्माकमद्यान्तमं स्तोमं धिष्व महामह । अस्माकं ते सवना सन्तु शंतमा मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः ॥
translation: O thou Most Lofty One, accept our laud as nearest to thine heart. May our libations be most sweet to make thee glad, O Soma-drinker, Heavenly Lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि षस्तव नो मम शास्त्रे अन्यस्य रण्यति । यो अस्मान्वीर आनयत् ॥
translation: Neither in thy decree nor mine, but in another's he delights,– The man who brought us unto this.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रश्चिद्घा तदब्रवीत्स्त्रिया अशास्यं मनः । उतो अह क्रतुं रघुम् ॥
translation: Indra himself hath said, The mind of woman brooks not discipline, Her intellect hath little weight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सप्ती चिद्घा मदच्युता मिथुना वहतो रथम् । एवेद्धूर्वृष्ण उत्तरा ॥
translation: His pair of horses, rushing on in their wild transport, draw his car: High-lifted is the stallion's yoke.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधः पश्यस्व मोपरि संतरां पादकौ हर । मा ते कशप्लकौ दृशन्त्स्त्री हि ब्रह्मा बभूविथ ॥
translation: Cast down thine eyes and look not up. More closely set thy feet. Let none See what thy garment veils, for thou, a Brahman, hast become a dame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Come hither, Indra, with thy Bays, come thou to Kaṇva's eulogy. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा ग्रावा वदन्निह सोमी घोषेण यच्छतु । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: May the stone draw thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा कण्वा इहावसे हवन्ते वाजसातये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: The Kaṇvas call thee hitherward for succour and to win the spoil. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दधामि ते सुतानां वृष्णे न पूर्वपाय्यम् । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: I set for thee, as for the Strong, the first draught of the juices shed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्मत्पुरंधिर्न आ गहि विश्वतोधीर्न ऊतये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Come with abundant blessings, come with perfect care to succour us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो याहि महेमते सहस्रोते शतामघ । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Come, Lord of lofty thought, who hast infinite wealth and countless aids.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा होता मनुर्हितो देवत्रा वक्षदीड्यः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Adorable mid Gods, the Priest good to mankind shall bring thee near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा मदच्युता हरी श्येनं पक्षेव वक्षतः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: As wings the falcon, so thy Bays rushing in joy shall carry thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याह्यर्य आ परि स्वाहा सोमस्य पीतये । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Come from the enemy to us, to Svâhâ and the Soma-draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो याह्युपश्रुत्युक्थेषु रणया इह । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Come hither with thine car inclined to hear, take pleasure in our lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सरूपैरा सु नो गहि सम्भृतैः सम्भृताश्वः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Lord of well-nourished Horses, come with well-fed Steeds alike in hue.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ याहि पर्वतेभ्यः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपः । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Come hither from the mountains, come from regions of the sea of air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो गव्यान्यश्व्या सहस्रा शूर दर्दृहि । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Disclose to us O Hero, wealth in thousands both of kine and steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः सहस्रशो भरायुतानि शतानि च । दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
translation: Bring riches hitherward to us in hundreds, thousands, myriads. Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यदिन्द्रश्च दद्वहे सहस्रं वसुरोचिषः । ओजिष्ठमश्व्यं पशुम् ॥
translation: The thousand steeds, the mightiest troop, which we and Indra have received From Vasurocis as a gift,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य ऋज्रा वातरंहसोऽरुषासो रघुष्यदः । भ्राजन्ते सूर्या इव ॥
translation: The brown that match the wind in speed, and bright bay coursers fleet of foot, Like Suns, resplendent are they all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पारावतस्य रातिषु द्रवच्चक्रेष्वाशुषु । तिष्ठं वनस्य मध्य आ ॥
translation: Mid the Pârâvata's rich gifts, swift steeds whose wheels run rapidly, I seemed to stand amid a wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निनेन्द्रेण वरुणेन विष्णुनादित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
translation: WITH Agni and with Indra, Vishṇu. Varuṇa, with the Âdityas, Rudras, Vasus, closely leagued; Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वाभिर्धीभिर्भुवनेन वाजिना दिवा पृथिव्याद्रिभिः सचाभुवा । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
translation: With all the Holy Thoughts, all being Mighty Ones! in close alliance wil the Mountains, Heaven, and Earth; Accordant. of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वैर्देवैस्त्रिभिरेकादशैरिहाद्भिर्मरुद्भिर्भृगुभिः सचाभुवा । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
translation: With all the Deities, three times eleven, here, in close alliance with the Maruts, Bhr̥igus, Floods; Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुषेथां यज्ञं बोधतं हवस्य मे विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
translation: Accept the sacrifice, attend to this my call: come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, bring us strengthening food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तोमं जुषेथां युवशेव कन्यनां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
translation: Accept our praise-song as a youth accepts a maid. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Sarya and with Dawn O Aṣvins, bring us strengthening food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरो जुषेथामध्वरं जुषेथां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
translation: Accept the songs we sing, accept the solemn rite. Conie nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, bring us strengthening food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हारिद्रवेव पतथो वनेदुप सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
translation: Ye fly as starlings fly unto the forest trees; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aṣvins, to our home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हंसाविव पतथो अध्वगाविव सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
translation: Ye fly like swans, like those who travel on their way; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aṣvins, to our home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्येनाविव पतथो हव्यदातये सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
translation: Ye fly to our oblation like a pair of hawks; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Aṣvins, to our home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबतं च तृप्णुतं चा च गच्छतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
translation: Come hitherward and drink and satisfy yourselves, bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, grant us vigorous strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जयतं च प्र स्तुतं च प्र चावतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
translation: Conquer your foes, protect us, praise your worshippers; bestow upon us progeny and affluence. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, grant us vigolms strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हतं च शत्रून्यततं च मित्रिणः प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
translation: Slay enemies, animate men whom ye befriend; bestow upon us progeny and aff luence. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, O Aṣvins, grant us vigorous strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मित्रावरुणवन्ता उत धर्मवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
translation: With Mitra, Varuṇa, Dharma, and the Maruts in your company approach unto your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, and with the Âdityas, Aṣvins! come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अङ्गिरस्वन्ता उत विष्णुवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
translation: With Vishṇu and the Angirases attending you, and with the Maruts come unto your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, and with the Âdityas, Aṣvins! come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋभुमन्ता वृषणा वाजवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
translation: With R̥ibhus and With Vâjas. O ye Mighty Ones, leagued with the Maruts come ye to your praiser's call. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, and with the Âdityas, Aṣvins! come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्म जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं धियो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
translation: Give spirit to our prayer and animate our thoughts; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of One mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, -the presser's Soma, Aṣvins drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षत्रं जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं नॄन्हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
translation: Strengthen the Ruling Power, strengthen the men of war; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Aṣvins drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धेनूर्जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं विशो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
translation: Give strength unto the milch-kine, give the people strength, slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Aṣvins drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्रेरिव शृणुतं पूर्व्यस्तुतिं श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
translation: As ye heard Atri's earliest eulogy, so hear Ṣyâvâṣva, Soma-presser, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aṣvins, three days old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सर्गाँ इव सृजतं सुष्टुतीरुप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
translation: Further like running streams Ṣyâvâṣva's eulogies who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aṣvins, three days old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रश्मीँरिव यच्छतमध्वराँ उप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता । सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
translation: Seize, as ye grasp the reins, Ṣyâvâṣva's solemn rites who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy. Accordant, of one mind with Sûrya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Aṣvins, three days old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्वाग्रथं नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु । आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
translation: Drive down your chariot hitherward drink ye the Soma's savoury juice. Approach, ye Aṣvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमोवाके प्रस्थिते अध्वरे नरा विवक्षणस्य पीतये । आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
translation: When sacrifice which tells our reverence hath begun. Heroes! to drink the gushing juice, Approach, ye Aṣvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वाहाकृतस्य तृम्पतं सुतस्य देवावन्धसः । आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
translation: Sate you with consecrated drink, with juice effused, ye Deities. Approach, ye Aṣvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवितासि सुन्वतो वृक्तबर्हिषः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
translation: THOU helpest him whose grass is trimmed, who sheds the juice, O Ṣatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. The share which they have fixed for thee, thou, Indra, Victor o'er all hosts and space, begirt with Maruts, Lord of Heroes, winner of the floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राव स्तोतारं मघवन्नव त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
translation: Maghavan, help thy worshipper: let him help thee. O Ṣatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad. The share which they have fixed for thee, etc.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्जा देवाँ अवस्योजसा त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
translation: Thou aidest Gods with food, and that with might aidg thee, O Ṣatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
translation: Creator of the heaven, creator of the earth, O Ṣatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जनिताश्वानां जनिता गवामसि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
translation: Father of cattle, father of all steeds art thou. O Ṣatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्रीणां स्तोममद्रिवो महस्कृधि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो । यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
translation: Stone-hurler, glorify the Atris' hymn of praise. O Ṣatakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः । प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धयन् ॥
translation: Hear thou Ṣyâvâṣva while he pours to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites. Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his prayers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेदं ब्रह्म वृत्रतूर्येष्वाविथ प्र सुन्वतः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
translation: THIS prayer, and those who shed the juice, in wars with Vr̥itra thou holpest, Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy succours. O Vr̥itra-slayer, from libation poured at noon, drink of the Soma juice, thou blameless Thunderer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सेहान उग्र पृतना अभि द्रुहः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
translation: Thou mighty Conqueror of hostile armaments, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एकराळस्य भुवनस्य राजसि शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
translation: Sole Ruler, thou art Sovran of this world of life, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सस्थावाना यवयसि त्वमेक इच्छचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
translation: Thou only sunderest these two consistent worlds, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षेमस्य च प्रयुजश्च त्वमीशिषे शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
translation: Thou art the Lord supreme o'er rest and energy, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षत्राय त्वमवसि न त्वमाविथ शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः । माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
translation: Thou helpest one to power, and one thou hast not helped, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य रेभतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः । प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
translation: Hear thou Ṣyâvâṣva while he sings to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites. Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his powers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
translation: YE Twain are Priests of sacrifice, wmners in war and holy works: Indra and Agni, mark this well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
translation: Ye bounteous riders on the car, ye Vr̥itra-slayers unsubdued: Indra and Agni, mark this well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः । इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
translation: The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight: Indra, and Agni, mark this well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये सुतं सोमं सधस्तुती । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
translation: Accept our sacrifice for weal, sharers of praise! the Soma shed: Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमा जुषेथां सवना येभिर्हव्यान्यूहथुः । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
translation: Be pleased with these libations which attract you to our sacred gifts Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमां गायत्रवर्तनिं जुषेथां सुष्टुतिं मम । इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
translation: Accept this eulogy of mine whose model is the Gâyatrî: Indra and Agni, Heroes, Come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रातर्यावभिरा गतं देवेभिर्जेन्यावसू । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
translation: Come with the early-faring Gods, ye who are Lords of genuine wealth: Indra-Agni, to the Soma-draught
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतोऽत्रीणां शृणुतं हवम् । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
translation: Hear ye the call of Atris, hear Ṣyâvâṣva as he sheds the juice: Indra-Agni to the Soma-draught
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः । इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
translation: Thus have I called you to our aid as sages called on you of old: Indra-Agni to the Soma draught!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आहं सरस्वतीवतोरिन्द्राग्न्योरवो वृणे । याभ्यां गायत्रमृच्यते ॥
translation: Indra's and Agni's grace I claim, Sarasvatî's associates To whom this psalm of praise is sung.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमस्तोष्यृग्मियमग्निमीळा यजध्यै । अग्निर्देवाँ अनक्तु न उभे हि विदथे कविरन्तश्चरति दूत्यं१ नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: THE glorious Agni have I praised, and worshipped with. the sacred food. May Agni deck the Gods for us. Between both gathering-places he goes on his embassy, the Sage. May all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न्यग्ने नव्यसा वचस्तनूषु शंसमेषाम् । न्यराती रराव्णां विश्वा अर्यो अरातीरितो युच्छन्त्वामुरो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni, burn down the word within their bodies through our newest speech, All hatreds of the godless, all the wicked man's malignities. Away let the destroyers go. May all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने मन्मानि तुभ्यं कं घृतं न जुह्व आसनि । स देवेषु प्र चिकिद्धि त्वं ह्यसि पूर्व्यः शिवो दूतो विवस्वतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni, I offer hymns to thee, like holy oil within thy moutlh. Acknowledge them. among the Gods, for thou art the rmost excellent, the worshipper's blissful messenger. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्तदग्निर्वयो दधे यथायथा कृपण्यति । ऊर्जाहुतिर्वसूनां शं च योश्च मयो दधे विश्वस्यै देवहूत्यै नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni bestows all vital power even as each man supplicates. He brings the Vasus strengthening gifts, and grants deliglht, in rest and stir, for every calling on the Gods. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स चिकेत सहीयसाग्निश्चित्रेण कर्मणा । स होता शश्वतीनां दक्षिणाभिरभीवृत इनोति च प्रतीव्यं१ नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni hath made himself renowned by wonderful victorious act. He is the Priest of all the tribes, chosen with sacrificial meeds. He urges Deities to receive. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्जाता देवानामग्निर्वेद मर्तानामपीच्यम् । अग्निः स द्रविणोदा अग्निर्द्वारा व्यूर्णुते स्वाहुतो नवीयसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni knows all that springs from Gods, he knows the mystery of men. Giver of wealth is Agni, he uncloses both the doors to us when worshipped with our newest gift. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्देवेषु संवसुः स विक्षु यज्ञियास्वा । स मुदा काव्या पुरु विश्वं भूमेव पुष्यति देवो देवेषु यज्ञियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni inhabiteth with Gods and men who offer sacrifice. He cherisheth with great delight much wisdom, as all things that be, God among Gods adorable. May all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अग्निः सप्तमानुषः श्रितो विश्वेषु सिन्धुषु । तमागन्म त्रिपस्त्यं मन्धातुर्दस्युहन्तममग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni who liveth in all streams, Lord of the Sevenfold Race of men, Him dweller in three homes we seek, best slayer of the Dasytis for Mandhâtar, first in sacrifice. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निस्त्रीणि त्रिधातून्या क्षेति विदथा कविः । स त्रीँरेकादशाँ इह यक्षच्च पिप्रयच्च नो विप्रो दूतः परिष्कृतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Agni the Wise inhabiteth three gathering-places, triply formed. Decked as our envoy let the Sage bring hither and conciliate the Thrice Eleven Deities. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं नो अग्न आयुषु त्वं देवेषु पूर्व्य वस्व एक इरज्यसि । त्वामापः परिस्रुतः परि यन्ति स्वसेतवो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Our Agni, thou art first among the Gods, and first mid living men. Thou only rulest over wealth. Round about thee, as natural dams, circumfluous the waters run. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राग्नी युवं सु नः सहन्ता दासथो रयिम् । येन दृळ्हा समत्स्वा वीळु चित्साहिषीमह्यग्निर्वनेव वात इन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: INDRA and Agni, surely ye as Conquerors will give us wealth, Whereby in fight we may o'ercome that which is strong and firmly fixed, as Agni burns the woods with wind. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि वां वव्रयामहेऽथेन्द्रमिद्यजामहे शविष्ठं नृणां नरम् । स नः कदा चिदर्वता गमदा वाजसातये गमदा मेधसातये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: We set no snares to tangle you; Indra we worship and adore, Hero of heroes mightiest. Once may he come unto us with his Steed, come unto us to win us strength, and to complete the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता हि मध्यं भराणामिन्द्राग्नी अधिक्षितः । ता उ कवित्वना कवी पृच्छ्यमाना सखीयते सं धीतमश्नुतं नरा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: For, famous Indra-Agni, ye are dwellers in the midst of frays. Sages in wisdom, ye are knit to him who seeketh you as friends. Heroes, bestow on him his wish.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्च नभाकवदिन्द्राग्नी यजसा गिरा । ययोर्विश्वमिदं जगदियं द्यौः पृथिवी मह्यु१पस्थे बिभृतो वसु नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Nabhâka-like, with sacred song Indra's and Agni's praise I sing, Theirs to whom all this world belongs, this heaven and this mighty earth which bear rich treasure in their lap.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ब्रह्माणि नभाकवदिन्द्राग्निभ्यामिरज्यत । या सप्तबुध्नमर्णवं जिह्मबारमपोर्णुत इन्द्र ईशान ओजसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: To Indra and to Agni send your prayers, as was Nabhâka's wont,– Who oped with sideway opening the sea with its foundations seven-Indra all powerful in his might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपि वृश्च पुराणवद्व्रततेरिव गुष्पितमोजो दासस्य दम्भय । वयं तदस्य सम्भृतं वस्विन्द्रेण वि भजेमहि नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant, Demolish thou the Dâsa's might. May we with Indra's help divide the treasure he hath gathered up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदिन्द्राग्नी जना इमे विह्वयन्ते तना गिरा । अस्माकेभिर्नृभिर्वयं सासह्याम पृतन्यतो वनुयाम वनुष्यतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: What time with this same song these men call Indra-Agni sundry ways, May we with our own heroes quell those who provoke us to the fight, and conquer those who strive with us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या नु श्वेताववो दिव उच्चरात उप द्युभिः । इन्द्राग्न्योरनु व्रतमुहाना यन्ति सिन्धवो यान्त्सीं बन्धादमुञ्चतां नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: The Two refulgent with their beams rise and come downward from the sky. By Indra's and by Agni's hest, flowing away, the rivers, run which they released from their restraint.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पूर्वीष्ट इन्द्रोपमातयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः सूनो हिन्वस्य हरिवः । वस्वो वीरस्यापृचो या नु साधन्त नो धियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: O Indra, many are thine aids, many thy ways of guiding us, Lord of the Bay Steeds, Hinva's Son. To a Good Hero come our prayers, which soon shall have accomplishment.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं शिशीता सुवृक्तिभिस्त्वेषं सत्वानमृग्मियम् । उतो नु चिद्य ओजसा शुष्णस्याण्डानि भेदति जेषत्स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Inspire him with your holy hymns, the Hero bright and glorious, Him who with might demolisbeth even the brood of Ṣushṇa, and winneth for us the heavenly streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं शिशीता स्वध्वरं सत्यं सत्वानमृत्वियम् । उतो नु चिद्य ओहत आण्डा शुष्णस्य भेदत्यजैः स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Inspire him worshipped with fair rites, the glorious Hero truly brave. He brake in pieces Ṣushṇa's brood who still expected not the stroke, and won for us the heavenly streams. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यां पितृवन्नवीयो मन्धातृवदङ्गिरस्वदवाचि । त्रिधातुना शर्मणा पातमस्मान्वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
translation: Thus have we sung anew to Indra-Agni, as sang our sires, Angirases, and Mandhâtar. Guard us with triple shelter and preserve us: may we be masters of a store of riches.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मा ऊ षु प्रभूतये वरुणाय मरुद्भ्योऽर्चा विदुष्टरेभ्यः । यो धीता मानुषाणां पश्वो गा इव रक्षति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: To make this Varuṇa come forth sing thou a song unto the band of Maruts wiser than thyself,– This Varuṇa who guardeth well the thoughts of men like herds of kine. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमू षु समना गिरा पितॄणां च मन्मभिः । नाभाकस्य प्रशस्तिभिर्यः सिन्धूनामुपोदये सप्तस्वसा स मध्यमो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Him altogether praise I with the song and hymns our fathers sang, and with Nâbhâka's eulogies,– Him dwelling at the rivers' source, surrounded by his Sisters Seven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स क्षपः परि षस्वजे न्यु१स्रो मायया दधे स विश्वं परि दर्शतः । तस्य वेनीरनु व्रतमुषस्तिस्रो अवर्धयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: The nights he hath encompassed, and stablished the morns with magic art visible over all is he. His dear Ones, following his Law, have prospered the Three Dawns for him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः ककुभो निधारयः पृथिव्यामधि दर्शतः । स माता पूर्व्यं पदं तद्वरुणस्य सप्त्यं स हि गोपा इवेर्यो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: He, visible o'er all the earth, stablished the quarters of the sky: He measured out the eastern place, that is the fold of Varuṇa: like a strong herdsman is the God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो धर्ता भुवनानां य उस्राणामपीच्या३ वेद नामानि गुह्या । स कविः काव्या पुरु रूपं द्यौरिव पुष्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: He who supports the worlds of life, he who well knows the hidden names mysterious of the morning beams, He cherishes much wisdom, Sage, as heaven brings forth each varied form.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वानि काव्या चक्रे नाभिरिव श्रिता । त्रितं जूती सपर्यत व्रजे गावो न संयुजे युजे अश्वाँ अयुक्षत नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: In whom all wisdom centres, as the nave is set within the wheel. Haste ye to honour Trita, as kine haste to gather in the fold, even as they muster steeds to yoke.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य आस्वत्क आशये विश्वा जातान्येषाम् । परि धामानि मर्मृशद्वरुणस्य पुरो गये विश्वे देवा अनु व्रतं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: He wraps these regions as a robe; he contemplates the tribes of Gods and all the works of mortal men. Before the home of Varuṇa all the Gods follow his decree.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स समुद्रो अपीच्यस्तुरो द्यामिव रोहति नि यदासु यजुर्दधे । स माया अर्चिना पदास्तृणान्नाकमारुहन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: He is an Ocean far-removed, yet through the heaven to him ascends the worship which these realms possess. With his bright foot he overthrew their magic, and went up to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य श्वेता विचक्षणा तिस्रो भूमीरधिक्षितः । त्रिरुत्तराणि पप्रतुर्वरुणस्य ध्रुवं सदः स सप्तानामिरज्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Ruler, whose bright far-seeing rays, pervading all three earths, have filled the three superior realms of heaven. Firm is the seat of Varuṇa: over the Seven he rules as King.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः श्वेताँ अधिनिर्णिजश्चक्रे कृष्णाँ अनु व्रता । स धाम पूर्व्यं ममे यः स्कम्भेन वि रोदसी अजो न द्यामधारयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Who, after his decree, o'erspread the Dark Ones with a robe of light; Who measured out the ancient seat, who pillared both the worlds apart as the Unborn supported heaven. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्तभ्नाद्द्यामसुरो विश्ववेदा अमिमीत वरिमाणं पृथिव्याः । आसीदद्विश्वा भुवनानि सम्राड्विश्वेत्तानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि ॥
translation: LORD of all wealth, the Asura propped the heavens, and measured out the broad earth's wide expanses. He, King supreme, approached all living creatures. All these are Varuṇa's holy operations.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा वन्दस्व वरुणं बृहन्तं नमस्या धीरममृतस्य गोपाम् । स नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसत्पातं नो द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थे ॥
translation: So humbly worship Varuṇa the Mighty revere the wise Guard of World Immortal. May he vouchsafe us triply-barred protection. O Earth and Heaven, within your lap preserve us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमां धियं शिक्षमाणस्य देव क्रतुं दक्षं वरुण सं शिशाधि । ययाति विश्वा दुरिता तरेम सुतर्माणमधि नावं रुहेम ॥
translation: Sharpen this song of him who strives his utmost, sharpen, God Varuṇa, his strength and insight; May we ascend the ship that bears us safely, whereby we may pass over all misfortune.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वां ग्रावाणो अश्विना धीभिर्विप्रा अचुच्यवुः । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: Aṣvins, with songs the singer stones have made you hasten hitherward, Nâsatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यथा वामत्रिरश्विना गीर्भिर्विप्रो अजोहवीत् । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: As the sage Atri with his hymns, O Aṣvins, called you eagerly, Nâsatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः । नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
translation: So have I called you to our aid, even as the wise have called of old, Nâsatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमे विप्रस्य वेधसोऽग्नेरस्तृतयज्वनः । गिरः स्तोमास ईरते ॥
translation: THESE songs of mine go forth as lauds of Agni, the disposing Sage, Whose worshipper is ne'er o'erthrawn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मै ते प्रतिहर्यते जातवेदो विचर्षणे । अग्ने जनामि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
translation: Wise Agni Jâtavedas, I beget a song of praise for thee. Who willingly receivest it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आरोका इव घेदह तिग्मा अग्ने तव त्विषः । दद्भिर्वनानि बप्सति ॥
translation: Thy sharpened flames, O Agni, like the gleams of light that glitter through, Devour the forests with their teeth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हरयो धूमकेतवो वातजूता उप द्यवि । यतन्ते वृथगग्नयः ॥
translation: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते त्ये वृथगग्नय इद्धासः समदृक्षत । उषसामिव केतवः ॥
translation: These lightly kindled fiery flames are all around made visible, Even as the glearaings of the Dawns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कृष्णा रजांसि पत्सुतः प्रयाणे जातवेदसः । अग्निर्यद्रोधति क्षमि ॥
translation: As Jâtavedas speeds along, the dust is black beneath his feet, When Agni spreads upon the earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धासिं कृण्वान ओषधीर्बप्सदग्निर्न वायति । पुनर्यन्तरुणीरपि ॥
translation: Making the plants his nourishment, Agni devours and wearies not, Seeking the tender shrubs again.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जिह्वाभिरह नन्नमदर्चिषा जञ्जणाभवन् । अग्निर्वनेषु रोचते ॥
translation: Bending him down with all his tongues, he flickers with his fiery glow Splendid is Agni in the woods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्स्वग्ने सधिष्टव सौषधीरनु रुध्यसे । गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुनः ॥
translation: Agni, thine home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest way, And as their Child art born anew.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदग्ने तव तद्घृतादर्ची रोचत आहुतम् । निंसानं जुह्वो३ मुखे ॥
translation: Worshipped with offerings shines thy flame, O Agni, from the sacred oil, With kisses on the ladle's mouth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे । स्तोमैर्विधेमाग्नये ॥
translation: Let us serve Agni with our hymns, Disposer, fed on ox and cow, Who bears the Soma on his back.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्वा नमसा वयं होतर्वरेण्यक्रतो । अग्ने समिद्भिरीमहे ॥
translation: Yea, thee, O Agni, do we seek with homage and with fuel, Priest Whose wisdom is most excellent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्वा भृगुवच्छुचे मनुष्वदग्न आहुत । अङ्गिरस्वद्धवामहे ॥
translation: O worshipped with oblations, pure Agni, we call on thee as erst, Did Bhr̥igu, Manus, Angiras.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं ह्यग्ने अग्निना विप्रो विप्रेण सन्त्सता । सखा सख्या समिध्यसे ॥
translation: For thou, O Agni, by the fire, Sage by the Sage, Good by the Good, Friend by the Friend, art lighted up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वं विप्राय दाशुषे रयिं देहि सहस्रिणम् । अग्ने वीरवतीमिषम् ॥
translation: So wealth in thousands, food with store of heroes give thou to the sage, O Agni, to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने भ्रातः सहस्कृत रोहिदश्व शुचिव्रत । इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व मे ॥
translation: O Agni, Brother, made by strength, Lord of red steeds and brilliant sway, Take pleasure in this laud of mine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्वाग्ने मम स्तुतो वाश्राय प्रतिहर्यते । गोष्ठं गाव इवाशत ॥
translation: My praises, Agni, go to thee, as the cows seek the stall to meet, The lowing calf that longs for milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् । अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥
translation: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes, Apart, have turned as to their wish.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं धीभिर्मनीषिणो मेधिरासो विपश्चितः । अद्मसद्याय हिन्विरे ॥
translation: The sages skilled in holy song and thin. kers with their thoughts have urged Agni to share the sacred feast.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वामज्मेषु वाजिनं तन्वाना अग्ने अध्वरम् । वह्निं होतारमीळते ॥
translation: So, Agni, unto thee the Priest, Invoker, strong in forays, pray 'nose who spin out the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः । समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
translation: In many a place, the same in look art thou, a Prince o'er all the tribes In battles we invoke thine aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमीळिष्व य आहुतोऽग्निर्विभ्राजते घृतैः । इमं नः शृणवद्धवम् ॥
translation: Pray thou to Agni, pray to him who blazes served with sacred oil: Let him give ear to this our call.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा वयं हवामहे शृण्वन्तं जातवेदसम् । अग्ने घ्नन्तमप द्विषः ॥
translation: We call on thee as such, as one who hears, as Jâtavedas, one, Agni! who beats away our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विशां राजानमद्भुतमध्यक्षं धर्मणामिमम् । अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत् ॥
translation: I pray to Agni, King of men, the Wonderful, the President Of holy Laws: may he give ear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं विश्वायुवेपसं मर्यं न वाजिनं हितम् । सप्तिं न वाजयामसि ॥
translation: Him like a bridegroom, him who stirs all people, like a noble horse, Like a fleet steed, we instigate.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घ्नन्मृध्राण्यप द्विषो दहन्रक्षांसि विश्वहा । अग्ने तिग्मेन दीदिहि ॥
translation: Slaying things deadly, burning up foes, Riksasas, on every side, Shine, Agni, with thy sharpened flame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं त्वा जनास इन्धते मनुष्वदङ्गिरस्तम । अग्ने स बोधि मे वचः ॥
translation: Thou whom the people kindle even as Manus did, best Angiras! O Agni, mark thou this my speech.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदग्ने दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्कृत । तं त्वा गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
translation: O Agni, made by strength! be thou born in the heavens or born in floods, As such we call on thee with songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यं घेत्ते जना इमे विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् । धासिं हिन्वन्त्यत्तवे ॥
translation: Yea, all the people, all the folk who have good dwellings, each apart, Send food for thee to eat thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्योऽहा विश्वा नृचक्षसः । तरन्तः स्याम दुर्गहा ॥
translation: O Agni, so may we, devout, gazed at by men, throughout our days, Pass lightly over all distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं मन्द्रं पुरुप्रियं शीरं पावकशोचिषम् । हृद्भिर्मन्द्रेभिरीमहे ॥
translation: We venerate with cheerful hearts the cheerful Agni, dear to all, Burning, with purifying flame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्वमग्ने विभावसुः सृजन्त्सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः । शर्धन्तमांसि जिघ्नसे ॥
translation: So thou, O Agni rich in light, beaming like Sûrya with thy rays Boldly demolishest the gloom,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्ते सहस्व ईमहे दात्रं यन्नोपदस्यति । त्वदग्ने वार्यं वसु ॥
translation: We pray to thee for this thy gift, Victor the gift that faileth not, O Agni, choicest wealth from thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम् । आस्मिन्हव्या जुहोतन ॥
translation: PAY service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil: In him present your offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने स्तोमं जुषस्व मे वर्धस्वानेन मन्मना । प्रति सूक्तानि हर्य नः ॥
translation: Agni, do thou accept my laud, be magnified by this my song: Welcome my sweedy-spoken words.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं दूतं पुरो दधे हव्यवाहमुप ब्रुवे । देवाँ आ सादयादिह ॥
translation: Agni, envoy, I place in front; the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः । अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते ॥
translation: Agni, the lofty flames of' thee enkindled have gone up on high, Thy bright flames, thou Refulgent One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा जुह्वो३ मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत । अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः ॥
translation: Beloved! let my ladles full of sacred oil come near to thee: Agni, accept our offerings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्द्रं होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम् । अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत् ॥
translation: I worship Agni-may he hear!-the cheerful, the Invoker, Priest, Of varied splendour, rich in light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रत्नं होतारमीड्यं जुष्टमग्निं कविक्रतुम् । अध्वराणामभिश्रियम् ॥
translation: Ancient Invoker, meet for praise, beloved Agni, wise and strong, The visitant of solemn rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुषाणो अङ्गिरस्तमेमा हव्यान्यानुषक् । अग्ने यज्ञं नय ऋतुथा ॥
translation: Agni, best Angiras, accept straightway these offerings, and guide The seasonable sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिधान उ सन्त्य शुक्रशोच इहा वह । चिकित्वान्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
translation: Excellent God, with brilliant flames, enkindled bring thou hitherward, Knowing the way, the Heavenly Host.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विप्रं होतारमद्रुहं धूमकेतुं विभावसुम् । यज्ञानां केतुमीमहे ॥
translation: Him, Sage and Herald, void of guile, ensign of sacrifices, him Smoke-bannered, rich in light, we seek.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने नि पाहि नस्त्वं प्रति ष्म देव रीषतः । भिन्धि द्वेषः सहस्कृत ॥
translation: O Agni, be our Guardian thou, God, against those who injure us: Destroy our foes, thou Son of Strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निः प्रत्नेन मन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वं१ स्वाम् । कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे ॥
translation: Making his body beautiful, Agni the Sage hath waxen by The singer and his ancient hymn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्जो नपातमा हुवेऽग्निं पावकशोचिषम् । अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे ॥
translation: I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni with purifying flame, At this well-ordered sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा । देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
translation: So Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour, seat thyself With Gods upon our sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अग्निं तन्वो३ दमे देवं मर्तः सपर्यति । तस्मा इद्दीदयद्वसु ॥
translation: The mortal man who serves the God Agni within his own abode, For him he causes wealth to shine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् । अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति ॥
translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the watere seed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते । तव ज्योतींष्यर्चयः ॥
translation: Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high, Thy lustres, fair effulgences.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वर्पतिः । स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि ॥
translation: For, Agni, thou as Lord of Light rulest o'er choicest gifts: may I, Thy singer, find defence in thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामग्ने मनीषिणस्त्वां हिन्वन्ति चित्तिभिः । त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
translation: O Agni, they who understand stir thee to action with their thoughts: So let our songs enhance thy might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदब्धस्य स्वधावतो दूतस्य रेभतः सदा । अग्नेः सख्यं वृणीमहे ॥
translation: We ever claim the friendship of Agni, the singing messenger, Of God-like nature, void of guile.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निः शुचिव्रततमः शुचिर्विप्रः शुचिः कविः । शुची रोचत आहुतः ॥
translation: Agni who bears most holy sway, the holy Singer, holy Sage, Shines holy when we worship him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्वा धीतयो मम गिरो वर्धन्तु विश्वहा । अग्ने सख्यस्य बोधि नः ॥
translation: Yea, let my meditations, let my songs exalt thee evermore. Think, Agni, of our friendly bond,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदग्ने स्यामहं त्वं त्वं वा घा स्या अहम् । स्युष्टे सत्या इहाशिषः ॥
translation: If I were thou and thou wert I, O Agni, every prayer of thine Should have its due fulfilment here.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वसुर्वसुपतिर्हि कमस्यग्ने विभावसुः । स्याम ते सुमतावपि ॥
translation: For Excellent and Lord of wealth. art thou O Agni, rich in light: May we enjoy thy favouring grace.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने धृतव्रताय ते समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः । गिरो वाश्रास ईरते ॥
translation: Agni, to thee whose laws stand fast our resonant songs of praise speed forth, As rivers hasten to the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवानं विश्पतिं कविं विश्वादं पुरुवेपसम् । अग्निं शुम्भामि मन्मभिः ॥
translation: Agni, the Youthful Lord of men, who stirreth much and eateth all, The Sage, I glorify with hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्ञानां रथ्ये वयं तिग्मजम्भाय वीळवे । स्तोमैरिषेमाग्नये ॥
translation: To Agni let us haste with lauds, the Guide of sacrificial rites, Armed with sharp teeth, the Mighty One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमग्ने त्वे अपि जरिता भूतु सन्त्य । तस्मस पावक मृळय ॥
translation: And let this man, good Agni, be with thee the singer of thy praise: Be gracious, Holy One, to him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: धीरो ह्यस्यद्मसद्विप्रो न जागृविः सदा । अग्ने दीदयसि द्यवि ॥
translation: For thou art sharer of our feast, wise, ever watchful as a Sage: Agni, thou shinest in the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुराग्ने दुरितेभ्यः पुरा मृध्रेभ्यः कवे । प्र ण आयुर्वसो तिर ॥
translation: O Agni, Sage, before our foes, before misfortunes fall on us, Excellent Lord, prolong our lives.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
translation: HITHERWARD! they who light flame and straightway trim the sacred grass. Whose Friend is Indra ever young.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्तं पृथुः स्वरुः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
translation: High is their fuel, great their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake, Whose Friend is Indra ever young.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतं शूर आजति सत्वभिः । येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
translation: Unequelled in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs. Whose Friend is Indra ever young.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छद्वि मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
translation: The new-born Vr̥itra-slayer asked his Mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the fierce? Who are renowned?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रति त्वा शवसी वदद्गिरावप्सो न योधिषत् । यस्ते शत्रुत्वमाचके ॥
translation: Ṣavasî answered, He who seeks thine enmity will battle like A stately elephant on a hill.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्वं मघवञ्छृणु यस्ते वष्टि ववक्षि तत् । यद्वीळयासि वीळु तत् ॥
translation: And hear, O Maghavan; to him who craves of thee thou grantest all Whate'er thou makest firm is firm.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदाजिं यात्याजिकृदिन्द्रः स्वश्वयुरुप । रथीतमो रथीनाम् ॥
translation: What time the Warrior Indra goes to battle, borne by noble steeds, Best of all charioteers is he.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि षु विश्वा अभियुजो वज्रिन्विष्वग्यथा वृह । भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः ॥
translation: Repel, O Thunder-armed, in all directions all attacks on us: And be our own most glorious God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्माकं सु रथं पुर इन्द्रः कृणोतु सातये । न यं धूर्वन्ति धूर्तयः ॥
translation: May Indra set our car in front, in foremost Place to win the spoil, He whom the wicked injure not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृज्याम ते परि द्विषोऽरं ते शक्र दावने । गमेमेदिन्द्र गोमतः ॥
translation: Thine enmity may we escape, and, gakra, for thy bounty, rich In kine, may we come near to thee
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शनैश्चिद्यन्तो अद्रिवोऽश्वावन्तः शतग्विनः । विवक्षणा अनेहसः ॥
translation: Softly approaching, Thunder-armed wealthy by hundreds, rich in steeds, Unrivalled, readywith our gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वा हि ते दिवेदिवे सहस्रा सूनृता शता । जरितृभ्यो विमंहते ॥
translation: For thine exalted excellence gives to thy worshippers each day Hundreds and thousands of thy boons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा धनंजयमिन्द्र दृळ्हा चिदारुजम् । आदारिणं यथा गयम् ॥
translation: Indra, we know thee breaker-down even of trong forts, winner of spoil, A:one who conquers wealth for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ककुहं चित्त्वा कवे मन्दन्तु धृष्णविन्दवः । आ त्वा पणिं यदीमहे ॥
translation: Though thou art highest, Sage and Bold let the drops cheer thee when we come To thee as to a trafficker.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते रेवाँ अदाशुरिः प्रममर्ष मघत्तये । तस्य नो वेद आ भर ॥
translation: Bring unto us the treasure of the opulent man who, loth to give, Hath slighted thee for gain of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः । पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम् ॥
translation: Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee, As men with fodder to the herd.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्वाबधिरं वयं श्रुत्कर्णं सन्तमूतये । दूरादिह हवामहे ॥
translation: And thee who art not deaf, whose cars are quick to listen, for our aid, We call to us from far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्छुश्रूया इमं हवं दुर्मर्षं चक्रिया उत । भवेरापिर्नो अन्तमः ॥
translation: When thou hast listened, make our call one which thou never wilt forget, And be our very nearest Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्चिद्धि ते अपि व्यथिर्जगन्वांसो अमन्महि । गोदा इदिन्द्र बोधि नः ॥
translation: When even now, when we have been in trouble, we have thought of thee, O Indra, give us gifts of kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा रम्भं न जिव्रयो ररभ्मा शवसस्पते । उश्मसि त्वा सधस्थ आ ॥
translation: O Lord of Strength, we rest on thee, as old men rest upon a staff: We long to have. thee dwell with us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्तोत्रमिन्द्राय गायत पुरुनृम्णाय सत्वने । नकिर्यं वृण्वते युधि ॥
translation: To Indra sing a song of praise, Hero of mighty valour, him Whom no one challenges to war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतं सृजामि पीतये । तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम् ॥
translation: Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink: Sate thee and finish thy carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन् । माकीं ब्रह्मद्विषो वनः ॥
translation: Let not the fools, or those who mock beguile thee when they seek thine aid Love not the enemies of prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इह त्वा गोपरीणसा महे मन्दन्तु राधसे । सरो गौरो यथा पिब ॥
translation: Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to great munificence: Drink as the wild-bull drinks the lake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या वृत्रहा परावति सना नवा च चुच्युवे । ता संसत्सु प्र वोचत ॥
translation: Proclaim in our assemblies what deeds, new and ancient, far away, The Vr̥itra-slayer hath achieved.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे । अत्रादेदिष्ट पौंस्यम् ॥
translation: In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadrû's Soma juice: There he displayed his manly might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सत्यं तत्तुर्वशे यदौ विदानो अह्नवाय्यम् । व्यानट् तुर्वणे शमि ॥
translation: True undeniabIc strength he found in Yadu and in Turvaṣa, And conquered through the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः । समानमु प्र शंसिषम् ॥
translation: Him have I magnified, our Lord in, common, Guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋभुक्षणं न वर्तव उक्थेषु तुग्र्यावृधम् । इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
translation: R̥ibhukshan, not to be restrained, who strengthened Tugra's son in lauds, Indra beside the flowingjuice;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः कृन्तदिद्वि योन्यं त्रिशोकाय गिरिं पृथुम् । गोभ्यो गातुं निरेतवे ॥
translation: Who for Triṣoka clave the hill that formed a wide receptacle, So that the cows might issue forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्दधिषे मनस्यसि मन्दानः प्रेदियक्षसि । मा तत्करिन्द्र मृळय ॥
translation: Whate'er thy plan or purpose be, whate'er, in transport, thou wouldst do, Do it not, Indra, but be kind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दभ्रं चिद्धि त्वावतः कृतं शृण्वे अधि क्षमि । जिगात्विन्द्र ते मनः ॥
translation: But little hath been heard of done upon the earth by one like thee i Let thine heart, Indra, turn to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवेदु ताः सुकीर्तयोऽसन्नुत प्रशस्तयः । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
translation: Thine then shall be this high renown, thine shall these lofty praises be, When, Indra, thou art kind to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा न एकस्मिन्नागसि मा द्वयोरुत त्रिषु । वधीर्मा शूर भूरिषु ॥
translation: Not for one trespass, not for two, O Hero, slay us, nor for three, Nor yet for many trespasses.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बिभया हि त्वावत उग्रादभिप्रभङ्गिणः । दस्मादहमृतीषहः ॥
translation: I fear one powerful like thee, the crusherdown of enemies, Mighty, repelling all attacks.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा सख्युः शूनमा विदे मा पुत्रस्य प्रभूवसो । आवृत्वद्भूतु ते मनः ॥
translation: O wealthy God, ne'er may I live to see my friend or son in need: Hitherward let thy heart be turned.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: को नु मर्या अमिथितः सखा सखायमब्रवीत् । जहा को अस्मदीषते ॥
translation: What friend, O people, unprovoked, hath ever said unto a friend, He turns and leaves us in distress?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवारे वृषभा सुतेऽसिन्वन्भूर्यावयः । श्वघ्नीव निवता चरन् ॥
translation: Hero, insatiate enjoy this Soma juice so near to thee, Even as a hunter rushing down.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त एता वचोयुजा हरी गृभ्णे सुमद्रथा । यदीन ब्रह्मभ्य इद्ददः ॥
translation: Hither I draw those Bays of thine yoked by our hymn, with splendid car, That thou mayst give unto the priests.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
translation: Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वीळाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
translation: O Tndra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipitous: Bring us the wealth for which we long
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते विश्वमानुषो भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति । वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
translation: Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thbe: Bring us the wealth for which we long.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः । स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणाम् ॥
translation: WE, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our Guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the Tawny Steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां हि सत्यमद्रिवो विद्म दातारमिषाम् । विद्म दातारं रयीणाम् ॥
translation: For, Hurler of the Bolt, we know thee true, the giver of our food, We know the giver of our wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यस्य ते महिमानं शतमूते शतक्रतो । गीर्भिर्गृणन्ति कारवः ॥
translation: O thou whose majesty the bards celebrate with their songs, thou Lord, Of hundred powers and hundred aids.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा । मित्रः पान्त्यद्रुहः ॥
translation: Fair guidance hath the mortal man whom Aryaman, the Marut host, And Mitra, void of guile, protect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दधानो गोमदश्ववत्सुवीर्यमादित्यजूत एधते । सदा राया पुरुस्पृहा ॥
translation: Kine, steeds, and hero strength he gains, and prospers, by the Âdityas sped, Ever in wealth which all desire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं दानमीमहे शवसानमभीर्वम् । ईशानं राय ईमहे ॥
translation: We pray to Indra for his gift, to him the Fearless and the Strong, We pray to him the Lord of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्मिन्हि सन्त्यूतयो विश्वा अभीरवः सचा । तमा वहन्तु सप्तयः पुरूवसुं मदाय हरयः सुतम् ॥
translation: For verily combined in him are all the fearless powers of aid. Him, rich in wealth, let swift Steeds bring to us, his Bays, to Soma juice for his carouse:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः । य आददिः स्व१र्नृभिर्यः पृतनासु दुष्टरः ॥
translation: Yea, that most excellent carouse, Indra, which slays most enemies, With Heroes wins the light of heaven, and is invincible in war:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो दुष्टरो विश्ववार श्रवाय्यो वाजेष्वस्ति तरुता । स नः शविष्ठ सवना वसो गहि गमेम गोमति व्रजे ॥
translation: Which merits fame, all-bountiful! and, unsubdued, hath victory in deeds of might. So come to our libations, Strongest! Excellent! May we obtain a stall of kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया । वरिवस्य महामह ॥
translation: Responding to our wish for cows, for steeds, and chariots, as of old, Be gracious, Greatest of the Great
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि ते शूर राधसोऽन्तं विन्दामि सत्रा । दशस्या नो मघवन्नू चिदद्रिवो धियो वाजेभिराविथ ॥
translation: For, Hero, nowhere can I find the bounds of thy munificence. Still do thou favour us, O Bolt-armed Maghavan: with strength hast thou rewarded hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य ऋष्वः श्रावयत्सखा विश्वेत्स वेद जनिमा पुरुष्टुतः । तं विश्वे मानुषा युगेन्द्रं हवन्ते तविषं यतस्रुचः ॥
translation: High, glorifier of his friend, he knows all generations, he whom many praise. All races of mankind with ladies lifted up invoke that Mighty Indra's aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो वाजेष्वविता पुरूवसुः पुरस्थाता मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् ॥
translation: Be he our Champion and Protector in great deeds, rich in all wealth, the Vr̥itra-slayer, Maghavan.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम् । इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यं शाकिनं वचो यथा ॥
translation: In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your Hero with high laud, to him the Wise, To Indra, glorious in his name, the Mighty One, even as the hymn alloweth it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ददी रेक्णस्तन्वे ददिर्वसु ददिर्वाजेषु पुरुहूत वाजिनम् । नूनमथ ॥
translation: Thou givest wealth to me myself, thou givest treasure, Excellent! and the strong steed, O Much-invoked, in deeds of might, yea, even now.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेषामिरज्यन्तं वसूनां सासह्वांसं चिदस्य वर्पसः । कृपयतो नूनमत्यथ ॥
translation: Him, Sovran Ruler of all precious things, who even hath power o'er this fair form of his, As now it taketh shape, and afterward,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महः सु वो अरमिषे स्तवामहे मीळ्हुषे अरंगमाय जग्मये । यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिर्विश्वमनुषां मरुतामियक्षसि गाये त्वा नमसा गिरा ॥
translation: We praise, so that the Mighty One may speed to you, Pourer of boun ies, Traveller, prepared to go. Thou favourest the Maruts known to all, by song and sacrifice. With song and praise I sing to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये पातयन्ते अज्मभिर्गिरीणां स्नुभिरेषाम् । यज्ञं महिष्वणीनां सुम्नं तुविष्वणीनां प्राध्वरे ॥
translation: We in the sacrifice perform their will whose voice is lifted high, The worship of those Thundering Ories who o'er the ridges of these mountains fly in troops.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रभङ्गं दुर्मतीनामिन्द्र शविष्ठा भर । रयिमस्मभ्यं युज्यं चोदयन्मते ज्येष्ठं चोदयन्मते ॥
translation: O Indra, Mightiest, bring us that which crushes men of evil minds, Wealth suited to our needs, O Stirrer of the thought, best wealth, O thou who stirrest thought.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सनितः सुसनितरुग्र चित्र चेतिष्ठ सूनृत । प्रासहा सम्राट् सहुरिं सहन्तं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
translation: O Winner, noble winner, strong, wondrous, most splendid, excellent, Sole Lord of victory, bring all-ovcrpowering wealth, joy-giving, chief in deeds of might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ स एतु य ईवदाँ अदेवः पूर्तमाददे । यथा चिद्वशो अश्व्यः पृथुश्रवसि कानीते३ऽस्या व्युष्याददे ॥
translation: Now let the godless man approach who hath received reward so great As Vaṣa Aṣvya, when this light of morning dawned, received from Pr̥ithuṣravas, from Kanîta's son.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: षष्टिं सहस्राश्व्यस्यायुतासनमुष्ट्रानां विंशतिं शता । दश श्यावीनां शता दश त्र्यरुषीणां दश गवां सहस्रा ॥
translation: Steeds sixty thousand and ten thousand kine, and twenty hundred camels I obtained; Ten hundred brown in hue, and other ten red in three spots: in all, ten thousand kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दश श्यावा ऋधद्रयो वीतवारास आशवः । मथ्रा नेमिं नि वावृतुः ॥
translation: Ten browns that make my wealth increase, fleet steeds whose tails are long and fair, Turn with swift whirl my chariot wheel;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दानासः पृथुश्रवसः कानीतस्य सुराधसः । रथं हिरण्ययं ददन्मंहिष्ठः सूरिरभूद्वर्षिष्ठमकृत श्रवः ॥
translation: The gifts which Pr̥ithuṣravas gave, Kanîta's son munificent. He gave a chariot wrought of gold: the prince was passing bountiful, and won himself most lofty fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो वायो महे तने याहि मखाय पाजसे । वयं हि ते चकृमा भूरि दावने सद्यश्चिन्महि दावने ॥
translation: Come thou to this great rite of ours, Vâyu! to give us vigorous light. We have served thee that thou mightest give much to us, yea, mightest quickly give great wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अश्वेभिर्वहते वस्त उस्रास्त्रिः सप्त सप्ततीनाम् । एभिः सोमेभिः सोमसुद्भिः सोमपा दानाय शुक्रपूतपाः ॥
translation: Who with thrice seven times seventy horses comes to us, invested with the rays of morn, Through these our Soma-draughts and those who press, to give, drinker of pure bright Soma Juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो म इमं चिदु त्मनामन्दच्चित्रं दावने । अरट्वे अक्षे नहुषे सुकृत्वनि सुकृत्तराय सुक्रतुः ॥
translation: Who hath inclined this glorious one, buunteous himself, to give me gifts. Borne on firm chariot with the prosperous Nahup, wise, to a man yet more devout.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उचथ्ये३ वपुषि यः स्वराळुत वायो घृतस्नाः । अश्वेषितं रजेषितं शुनेषितं प्राज्म तदिदं नु तत् ॥
translation: Sole Lord in beauty meet for praise, O Vâyu, dropping fatness down, Hurried along by steeds, by camels, and by hounds, spreads forth thy train: even this it is.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध प्रियमिषिराय षष्टिं सहस्रासनम् । अश्वानामिन्न वृष्णाम् ॥
translation: So, as a prize dear to the strong, the sixty thousand have I gained, Bulls that resemble vigorous steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गावो न यूथमुप यन्ति वध्रय उप मा यन्ति वध्रयः ॥
translation: To me come oxen like a herd, yea, unto me the oxen come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध यच्चारथे गणे शतमुष्ट्राँ अचिक्रदत् । अध श्वित्नेषु विंशतिं शता ॥
translation: And in the grazing herd he made a hundred camels bleat for me, And twenty hundred mid the white.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतं दासे बल्बूथे विप्रस्तरुक्ष आ ददे । ते ते वायविमे जना मदन्तीन्द्रगोपा मदन्ति देवगोपाः ॥
translation: A hundred has the sage received, Dâsa Balbûtha's and Taruksha's gifts. These are thy people, Vâyu, who rejoice with Indra for their guard, rejoice with Gods for guards.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध स्या योषणा मही प्रतीची वशमश्व्यम् । अधिरुक्मा वि नीयते ॥
translation: And now to Vaṣa Aṣvya here this stately woman is led forth, Adorned with ornaments of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्र दाशुषे । यमादित्या अभि द्रुहो रक्षथा नेमघं नशदनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: GREAT help ye give the worshipper, Varuṇa, Mitra, Mighty Ones! No sorrow ever reaches him whom ye, Âdityas, keep from harm. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विदा देवा अघानामादित्यासो अपाकृतिम् । पक्षा वयो यथोपरि व्य१स्मे शर्म यच्छतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: O Gods, Âdityas, well ye know the way to keep all woes afar. As the birds spread their sheltering wings, spread your protection over us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: व्य१स्मे अधि शर्म तत्पक्षा वयो न यन्तन । विश्वानि विश्ववेदसो वरूथ्या मनामहेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: As the birds spread their sheltering wings let your protection cover us. We mean all shelter and defence, ye who have all things for your own.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मा अरासत क्षयं जीवातुं च प्रचेतसः । मनोर्विश्वस्य घेदिम आदित्या राय ईशतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: To whomsoever they, Most Wise, have given a home and means of life, O'er the whole riches of this man they, the Âdityas, have control.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि णो वृणजन्नघा दुर्गाणि रथ्यो यथा । स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मण्यादित्यानामुतावस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: As drivers of the car avoid ill roads, let sorrows pass us by. May we be under Indra's guard, in the Âdityas' favouring grace.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परिह्वृतेदना जनो युष्मादत्तस्य वायति । देवा अदभ्रमाश वो यमादित्या अहेतनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: For verily men sink and faint through loss of wealth which ye have given. Much hath he gained from you, O Gods, whom ye, Âdityas, have approached.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न तं तिग्मं चन त्यजो न द्रासदभि तं गुरु । यस्मा उ शर्म सप्रथ आदित्यासो अराध्वमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: On him shall no fierce anger fall, no sore distress shall visit him, To whom, Âdityas, ye have lent your shelter that extendeth far.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युष्मे देवा अपि ष्मसि युध्यन्त इव वर्मसु । यूयं महो न एनसो यूयमर्भादुरुष्यतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: Resting in you, O Gods, we are like men who fight in coats of mail. Ye guard us from each great offence, ye guard us from each lighter fault.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदितिर्न उरुष्यत्वदितिः शर्म यच्छतु । माता मित्रस्य रेवतोऽर्यम्णो वरुणस्य चानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: May Aditi defend us, may Aditi guard and shelter us, Mother of wealthy Mitra and of Aryaman and Varuṇa.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्देवाः शर्म शरणं यद्भद्रं यदनातुरम् । त्रिधातु यद्वरूथ्यं१ तदस्मासु वि यन्तनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: The shelter, Gods, that is secure, auspicious, free from malady, A sure protection, triply strong, even that do ye extend to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदित्या अव हि ख्यताधि कूलादिव स्पशः । सुतीर्थमर्वतो यथानु नो नेषथा सुगमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुतयो व ऊतयः ॥
translation: Look down on us, Âdityas, as a guide exploring from the bank. Lead us to pleasant ways as men lead horses to an easy ford.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith
