sanskrit: अग्निं वो देवयज्ययाग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे । अग्निं धीषु प्रथममग्निमर्वत्यग्निं क्षैत्राय साधसे ॥
translation: Agni, made yours by sacrifice, Agni, while holy rites advance; Agni, the first in songs, first with the warrior steed; Agril to win the land for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निरिषां सख्ये ददातु न ईशे यो वार्याणाम् । अग्निं तोके तनये शश्वदीमहे वसुं सन्तं तनूपाम् ॥
translation: May Agni who is Lord of wealth vouchsafe us food for friendship sake. Agni we ever seek for seed and progeny, the Vasu who protects our lives.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमीळिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् । अग्निं राये पुरुमीळ्ह श्रुतं नरोऽग्निं सुदीतये छर्दिः ॥
translation: Solicit with your chants, for help, Agni the God with piercing flame, For riches famous Agni, Purumîḷha and ye men! Agni to light our dwelling well.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं द्वेषो योतवै नो गृणीमस्यग्निं शं योश्च दातवे । विश्वासु विक्ष्ववितेव हव्यो भुवद्वस्तुॠषूणाम् ॥
translation: Agni we laud that he may keep our foes afar, Agni to give us health and strength. Let him as Guardian be invoked in all the tribes, the lighter-up of glowing brands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हविष्कृणुध्वमा गमदध्वर्युर्वनते पुनः । विद्वाँ अस्य प्रशासनम् ॥
translation: PREPARE oblation: let him come; and let the minister serve again Who knows the ordering thereof,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि तिग्ममभ्यं१शुं सीदद्धोता मनावधि । जुषाणो अस्य सख्यम् ॥
translation: Rejoicing in his friendship, let the priest be seated over man, Beside the shoot of active power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्तरिच्छन्ति तं जने रुद्रं परो मनीषया । गृभ्णन्ति जिह्वया ससम् ॥
translation: Him, glowing bright beyond all thought, they seek among the race of man; With him for tougue they seize the food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जाम्यतीतपे धनुर्वयोधा अरुहद्वनम् । दृषदं जिह्वयावधीत् ॥
translation: He hath inflamed the twofold plain: lifegiving, he hath climbed the wood, And with his tongue hath struck the rock.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चरन्वत्सो रुशन्निह निदातारं न विन्दते । वेति स्तोतव अम्ब्यम् ॥
translation: Wandering here the radiant Calf finds none to fetter him, and seeks The Mother to declare his praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य यन्महदश्वावद्योजनं बृहद् । दामा रथस्य ददृशे ॥
translation: And now that great and mighty team, the team of horses that are his, And traces of his car, are seen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दुहन्ति सप्तैकामुप द्वा पञ्च सृजतः । तीर्थे सिन्धोरधि स्वरे ॥
translation: The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work, On the stream's loud-resounding bank.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ दशभिर्विवस्वत इन्द्रः कोशमचुच्यवीत् । खेदया त्रिवृता दिवः ॥
translation: Entreated by Vivasvan's ten, Indra cast down the water-jar With threefold hammer from the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि त्रिधातुरध्वरं जूर्णिरेति नवीयसी । मध्वा होतारो अञ्जते ॥
translation: Three times the newly-kindled flame proceeds around the sacrifice: The priests anoint it with the meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिञ्चन्ति नमसावतमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानम् । नीचीनबारमक्षितम् ॥
translation: With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above, Exhaustless, with the mouth below.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु । अवतस्य विसर्जने ॥
translation: The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank, At the out-shedding of the fount.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा । उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥
translation: Ye cows, protect the fount: the two Mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् । रसा दधीत वृषभम् ॥
translation: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth Supply the liquid to the Bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते जानत स्वमोक्यं१ सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः । मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः ॥
translation: These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside the mother cows They meet together with their kin.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि । इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः ॥
translation: Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food in heaven, To Indra, Agni light and prayer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधुक्षत्पिप्युषीमिषमूर्जं सप्तपदीमरिः । सूर्यस्य सप्त रश्मिभिः ॥
translation: The Pious One milked out rich food, sustenance dealt in portions seven, Together with the Sun's seven rays.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमस्य मित्रावरुणोदिता सूर आ ददे । तदातुरस्य भेषजम् ॥
translation: I took some Soma when the Sun rose up, O Mitra, Varuṇa. That is the sick man's medicine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य यत्पदं हर्यतस्य निधान्यम् । परि द्यां जिह्वयातनत् ॥
translation: From where oblations must be laid, which is the Well-beloved's home, He with his tongue hath compassed heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदीराथामृतायते युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: ROUSE ye for him who keeps the Law, yoke your steeds, Aṣvins, to your car Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निमिषश्चिज्जवीयसा रथेना यातमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Come, Aṣvins, with your car more swift than is the twinkling of an eye Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप स्तृणीतमत्रये हिमेन घर्ममश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Aṣvins, ye overlaid with cold the fiery pit for Atri's sake: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुह स्थः कुह जग्मथुः कुह श्येनेव पेतथुः । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Where are ye? whither are ye gone? whither, like falcons, have ye flown? Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्य कर्हि कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: If ye at any time this day are listening to this my call, Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना यामहूतमा नेदिष्ठं याम्याप्यम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: The Aṣvins, fust to hear our prayer, for closest kinship I approach: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवन्तमत्रये गृहं कृणुतं युवमश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: For Atri ye, O Aṣvins, made a dwellingplace to shield him well, Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वरेथे अग्निमातपो वदते वल्ग्वत्रये । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Ye warded off the fervent heat for Atri when he sweetly spake: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सप्तवध्रिराशसा धारामग्नेरशायत । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Erst Saptavadbri by his prayer obtained the trenchant edge of fire: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इहा गतं वृषण्वसू शृणुतं म इमं हवम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Come hither, O ye Lords of wealth, and listen to this call of mine: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: किमिदं वां पुराणवज्जरतोरिव शस्यते । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: What is this praise told forth of you as Elders in the ancient way? Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समानं वां सजात्यं समानो बन्धुरश्विना । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: One common brotherhood is yours, Aṣvins your kindred is the same: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो वां रजांस्यश्विना रथो वियाति रोदसी । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: This is your chariot, Aṣvins, which speeds through the regions, earth and heaven: Let your protecting aid be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रैरुप गच्छतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Approach ye hitherward to us with thousands both of steeds and kine : Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रेभिरति ख्यतम् । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: Pass us not by, remember us with thousands both of kine and steeds; Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरुणप्सुरुषा अभूदकर्ज्योतिॠतावरी । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: The purple tinted Dawn hath risen, and true to Law hath made the light: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्विना सु विचाकशद्वृक्षं परशुमाँ इव । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: He looked upon the Aṣvins, as an axe-armed man upon a tree: Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरं न धृष्णवा रुज कृष्णया बाधितो विशा । अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
translation: By the black band encompassed round, break it down, bold one, like a fort. Let your protecting help be near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् । अग्निं वो दुर्यं वचः स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥
translation: EXERTING all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar Friend, the darling Guest in every home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् । प्रशंसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः ॥
translation: Whom, served with sacrificial oil like Mitra, men presenting gifts Eulogize with their songs of praise
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पन्यांसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता । हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि ॥
translation: Much-lauded Jâtavedas, him who bears oblations up to heaven Prepared in service of the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् । यस्य श्रुतर्वा बृहन्नार्क्षो अनीक एधते ॥
translation: To noblest Agni, Friend of man, best Vr̥itra-slayer, are we come, Him in whose presenceR̥iksha's son, mighty Ṣrutarvan, waxes great;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमृतं जातवेदसं तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतम् । घृताहवनमीड्यम् ॥
translation: To deathless Jâtavedas, meet for praise, adored, with sacred oil, Visible through the gloom of night
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सबाधो यं जना इमे३ऽग्निं हव्येभिरीळते । जुह्वानासो यतस्रुचः ॥
translation: Even Agni whom these priestly men worship with sacrificial gifts, With lifted ladles offering them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इयं ते नव्यसी मतिरग्ने अधाय्यस्मदा । मन्द्र सुजात सुक्रतोऽमूर दस्मातिथे ॥
translation: O Agni, this our newest hymn hath been addressed from us to thee, O cheerful Guest, well-born, most wise, worker of wonders, ne'er deceived.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सा ते अग्ने शंतमा चनिष्ठा भवतु प्रिया । तया वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
translation: Agni, may it be dear to thee, most grateful, and exceeding sweet: Grow mightier, eulogized therewith.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सा द्युम्नैर्द्युम्निनी बृहदुपोप श्रवसि श्रवः । दधीत वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
translation: Splendid with splendours may it be, and in the battle with the foe Add loftier glory to thy fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वमिद्गां रथप्रां त्वेषमिन्द्रं न सत्पतिम् । यस्य श्रवांसि तूर्वथ पन्यम्पन्यं च कृष्टयः ॥
translation: Steed, cow, a lord of heroes, bright like Indra, who shall fill the car. Whose high renown ye celebrate, and people praise each glorious deed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा चनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गिरः । स पावक श्रुधी हवम् ॥
translation: Thou whom Gopavana made glad with song, O Agni Angiras, Hear this my call, thou Holy One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं त्वा जनास ईळते सबाधो वाजसातये । स बोधि वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
translation: Thou whom the priestly folk implore to aid the gathering of the spoil, Such be thou in the fight with foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहं हुवान आर्क्षे श्रुतर्वणि मदच्युति । शर्धांसीव स्तुकाविनां मृक्षा शीर्षा चतुर्णाम् ॥
translation: I, called to him who reels with joy, Ṣrutarvan, Riksha’s son, shall stroke The heads of four presented steeds, like the long wool of fleecy rams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मां चत्वार आशवः शविष्ठस्य द्रवित्नवः । सुरथासो अभि प्रयो वक्षन्वयो न तुग्र्यम् ॥
translation: Four coursers with a splendid car, Savistha’s horses, fleet of foot, Shall bring me to the sacred feast, as flying steeds brought Tugra’s son.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सत्यमित्त्वा महेनदि परुष्ण्यव देदिशम् । नेमापो अश्वदातरः शविष्ठादस्ति मर्त्यः ॥
translation: The very truth do I declare to thee, Parushṇî, mighty flood. Waters! no man is there who gives more horses than Savishtha gives.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ अश्वाँ अग्ने रथीरिव । नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः ॥
translation: YOKE, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invite the Gods: As ancient Herald seat thyself.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो देव देवाँ अच्छा वोचो विदुष्टरः । श्रद्विश्वा वार्या कृधि ॥
translation: And, God, as skilfullest of all, call for us hitherward the Gods: Give all our wishes sure effect.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं ह यद्यविष्ठ्य सहसः सूनवाहुत । ऋतावा यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
translation: For thou, Most Youthful, Son of Strength, thou to whom sacrifice is paid, Art holy, faithful to the Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः । मूर्धा कवी रयीणाम् ॥
translation: This Agni, Lord of wealth and spoil hundredfold, thousandfold, is head And chief of riches and a Sage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं नेमिमृभवो यथा नमस्व सहूतिभिः । नेदीयो यज्ञमङ्गिरः ॥
translation: As craftsmen bend the felly, so bend at our general call: come nigh, Angiras, to the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्मै नूनमभिद्यवे वाचा विरूप नित्यया । वृष्णे चोदस्व सुष्टुतिम् ॥
translation: Now, O Virûpa, rouse for him, Strong God who shines at early morn, Fair praise with voice that ceases not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कमु ष्विदस्य सेनयाग्नेरपाकचक्षसः । पणिं गोषु स्तरामहे ॥
translation: With missile of this Agni, his who looks afar, will we lay low The thief in combat for the kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो देवानां विशः प्रस्नातीरिवोस्राः । कृशं न हासुरघ्न्याः ॥
translation: Let not the Companies of Gods fail us, like Dawns that float away, Like cows who leave the niggardly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नः समस्य दूढ्य१ः परिद्वेषसो अंहतिः । ऊर्मिर्न नावमा वधीत् ॥
translation: Let not the sinful tyranny of any fiercely hating foe Smite us, as billows smite a ship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः । अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥
translation: O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् । उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि ॥
translation: Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid in winning cattle, winning wealth? Maker of room, make room for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा । संवर्गं सं रयिं जय ॥
translation: In this great battle cast us not aside as one who bears a load: Snatch up the wealih and win it all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्यमस्मद्भिया इयमग्ने सिषक्तु दुच्छुना । वर्धा नो अमवच्छवः ॥
translation: O Agni, let this plague pursue and fright another and not us: Make our impetuous strength more strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्याजुषन्नमस्विनः शमीमदुर्मखस्य वा । तं घेदग्निर्वृधावति ॥
translation: The reverent or unwearied man whose holy labour he accepts, Him Agni favours with success.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परस्या अधि संवतोऽवराँ अभ्या तर । यत्राहमस्मि ताँ अव ॥
translation: Abandoning the foeman’s host pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा हि ते पुरा वयमग्ने पितुर्यथावसः । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
translation: As we have known thy gracious help, as of a Father, long agi, So now we pray to thee for bliss.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं नु मायिनं हुव इन्द्रमीशानमोजसा । मरुत्वन्तं न वृञ्जसे ॥
translation: NOT to forsake me, I invoke this Indra girt by Maruts, Lord Of magic power who rules with might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमिन्द्रो मरुत्सखा वि वृत्रस्याभिनच्छिरः । वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
translation: This Indra with his Marut Friends clave into pieces Vritra's head With hundred-knotted thunderbolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वावृधानो मरुत्सखेन्द्रो वि वृत्रमैरयत् । सृजन्त्समुद्रिया अपः ॥
translation: Indra, with Marut Friends grown strong, hath rent asunder Vritra, and Released the waters of the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं ह येन वा इदं स्वर्मरुत्वता जितम् । इन्द्रेण सोमपीतये ॥
translation: This is that Indra who, begirt by Maruts, won the light of heaven That he might drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मरुत्वन्तमृजीषिणमोजस्वन्तं विरप्शिनम् । इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
translation: Mighty, impetuous, begirt by Maruts, him who loudly roars, Indra we invocate with songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं प्रत्नेन मन्मना मरुत्वन्तं हवामहे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Indra begirt by Maruts we invoke after the ancient plan, That he may drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र मीढ्वः पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो । अस्मिन्यज्ञे पुरुष्टुत ॥
translation: O liberal Indra, Marut-girt, much-lauded Ṣatakratu, drink The Soma at this sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्येदिन्द्र मरुत्वते सुताः सोमासो अद्रिवः । हृदा हूयन्त उक्थिनः ॥
translation: To thee, O Indra, Marut-girt, these Soma juices, Thunderer! Are offered from the heart with lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबेदिन्द्र मरुत्सखा सुतं सोमं दिविष्टिषु । वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
translation: Drink, Indra, with thy Marut Friends, pressed Soma at the morning rites, Whetting thy thunderbolt with strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः । सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम् ॥
translation: Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed The Soma which the mortar pressed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे क्रक्षमाणमकृपेताम् । इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः ॥
translation: Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar, What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतस्पृशम् । इन्द्रात्परि तन्वं ममे ॥
translation: From Indra have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts, Delicate, faithful to the Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जज्ञानो नु शतक्रतुर्वि पृच्छदिति मातरम् । क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
translation: SCARCELY was Ṣatakratu, born when of his Mother he inquired, Who are the mighty? Who are famed?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीं शवस्यब्रवीदौर्णवाभमहीशुवम् । ते पुत्र सन्तु निष्टुरः ॥
translation: Then Ṣavasî declared to him Aurṇavâbha, Ahîṣuva: Son, these be they thou must o'erthrow
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समित्तान्वृत्रहाखिदत्खे अराँ इव खेदया । प्रवृद्धो दस्युहाभवत् ॥
translation: The Vritra-slayer smote them all as spokes are hammered into naves: The Dasyu-killer waxed in might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एकया प्रतिधापिबत्साकं सरांसि त्रिंशतम् । इन्द्रः सोमस्य काणुका ॥
translation: Then Indra at a single draught drank the contents of thirty pails, Pails that were filled with Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि गन्धर्वमतृणदबुध्नेषु रजस्स्वा । इन्द्रो ब्रह्मभ्य इद्वृधे ॥
translation: Indra in groundless realms of space pierced the Gandharva through, that he Might make Brahmans' strength increase.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निराविध्यद्गिरिभ्य आ धारयत्पक्वमोदनम् । इन्द्रो बुन्दं स्वाततम् ॥
translation: Down from the mountains Indra shot hither his well-directed shaft: He gained the ready brew of rice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतब्रध्न इषुस्तव सहस्रपर्ण एक इत् । यमिन्द्र चकृषे युजम् ॥
translation: One only is that shaft of thine, with thousand feathers, hundred barbs, Which, Indra, thou hast made thy friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेन स्तोतृभ्य आ भर नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो अत्तवे । सद्यो जात ऋभुष्ठिर ॥
translation: Strong as the Ribhus at thy birth, therewith to those who praise thee, men, And women, bring thou food to eat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एता च्यौत्नानि ते कृता वर्षिष्ठानि परीणसा । हृदा वीड्वधारयः ॥
translation: By thee these exploits were achieved, the mightiest deeds, abundantly: Firm in thy heart thou settest them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेत्ता विष्णुराभरदुरुक्रमस्त्वेषितः । शतं महिषान्क्षीरपाकमोदनं वराहमिन्द्र एमुषम् ॥
translation: All these things Vishṇu brought, the Lord of ample stride whom thou hadst sent- A hundred buffaloes, a brew of rice and milk: and Indra, slew the ravening boar
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुविक्षं ते सुकृतं सूमयं धनुः साधुर्बुन्दो हिरण्ययः । उभा ते बाहू रण्या सुसंस्कृत ऋदूपे चिदृदूवृधा ॥
translation: Most deadly is thy bow, successful, fashioned well: good is thine arrow, decked with gold. Warlike and well equipped thine arms are, which increase sweetness for him who drinks the sweet.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरोळाशं नो अन्धस इन्द्र सहस्रमा भर । शता च शूर गोनाम् ॥
translation: BRING us a thousand, Indra, as our guerdon for the Soma juice: Hundreds of kine, O Hero, bring.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो भर व्यञ्जनं गामश्वमभ्यञ्जनम् । सचा मना हिरण्यया ॥
translation: Bring cattle, bring us ornament, bring us embellishment and steeds, Give us, besides, two rings of gold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नः कर्णशोभना पुरूणि धृष्णवा भर । त्वं हि शृण्विषे वसो ॥
translation: And, Bold One, bring in ample store rich jewels to adorn the ear, For thou, Good Lord, art far renowned.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकीं वृधीक इन्द्र ते न सुषा न सुदा उत । नान्यस्त्वच्छूर वाघतः ॥
translation: None other is there for the priest, Hero! but thou, to give him gifts, To win much spoil and prosper him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकीमिन्द्रो निकर्तवे न शक्रः परिशक्तवे । विश्वं शृणोति पश्यति ॥
translation: Indra can never be brought low, Ṣakra can never be subdued: He heareth and beholdeth all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स मन्युं मर्त्यानामदब्धो नि चिकीषते । पुरा निदश्चिकीषते ॥
translation: He spieth out the wrath of man, he who can never be deceived: Ere blame can come he marketh it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रत्व इत्पूर्णमुदरं तुरस्यास्ति विधतः । वृत्रघ्नः सोमपाव्नः ॥
translation: He hath his stomach full of might, the Vritra-slayer, Conqueror, The Soma-drinker, ordering all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वे वसूनि संगता विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । सुदात्वपरिह्वृता ॥
translation: In thee all treasures are combined, Soma all blessed things in thee, Uninjured, easy to bestow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिद्यवयुर्मम कामो गव्युर्हिरण्ययुः । त्वामश्वयुरेषते ॥
translation: To thee speeds forth my hope that craves the gift of corn, and kine and gold, Yea, craving horses, speeds to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवेदिन्द्राहमाशसा हस्ते दात्रं चना ददे । दिनस्य वा मघवन्त्सम्भृतस्य वा पूर्धि यवस्य काशिना ॥
translation: Indra, through hope in thee alone even this sickle do I grasp. Fill my hand, Maghavan, with all that it can hold of barley cut or gathered up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं कृत्नुरगृभीतो विश्वजिदुद्भिदित्सोमः । ऋषिर्विप्रः काव्येन ॥
translation: THIS here is Soma, ne'er restrained, active, all-conquering bursting forth, Rishi and Sage by sapience,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यूर्णोति यन्नग्नं भिषक्ति विश्वं यत्तुरम् । प्रेमन्धः ख्यन्निः श्रोणो भूत् ॥
translation: All that is bare he covers o'er, all that is sick he medicines; The blind man sees, the cripple walks.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्योऽन्यकृतेभ्यः । उरु यन्तासि वरूथम् ॥
translation: Thou, Soma, givest wide defence against the hate of alien men, Hatreds that waste and weaken us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं चित्ती तव दक्षैर्दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन् । यावीरघस्य चिद्द्वेषः ॥
translation: Thou by thine insight and thy skill, Impetuous One, from heaven and earth Drivest the sinner's enmity.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्थिनो यन्ति चेदर्थं गच्छानिद्ददुषो रातिम् । ववृज्युस्तृष्यतः कामम् ॥
translation: When to their task they come with zeal, may they obtain the Giver's grace, And satisfy his wish who thirsts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विदद्यत्पूर्व्यं नष्टमुदीमृतायुमीरयत् । प्रेमायुस्तारीदतीर्णम् ॥
translation: So may he find what erst was lost, so may be speed the pious man, And lengthen his remaining life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुशेवो नो मृळयाकुरदृप्तक्रतुरवातः । भवा नः सोम शं हृदे ॥
translation: Gracious, displaying tender love, unconquered, gentle in thy thoughts, Be sweet, O Soma, to our heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नः सोम सं वीविजो मा वि बीभिषथा राजन् । मा नो हार्दि त्विषा वधीः ॥
translation: O Soma, terrify us not; strike us not with alarm, O King: Wound not our heart with dazzling flame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव यत्स्वे सधस्थे देवानां दुर्मतीरीक्षे । राजन्नप द्विषः सेध मीढ्वो अप स्रिधः सेध ॥
translation: When in my dwelling-place I see the wicked enemies of Gods, King, chase their hatred far away, thou Bounteous One, dispel our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नह्य१न्यं बळाकरं मर्डितारं शतक्रतो । त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
translation: O Ṣatakratu! truly I have made none else my Comforter. Indra; be gracious unto us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो नः शश्वत्पुराविथामृध्रो वाजसातये । स त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
translation: Thou who hast ever aided us kindly of old to win the spoil, As such, O Indra, favour us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: किमङ्ग रध्रचोदनः सुन्वानस्यावितेदसि । कुवित्स्विन्द्र णः शकः ॥
translation: What now? As prompter of the poor thou helpest him who sheds the juice. Wilt thou not, Indra, strengthen us?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र प्र णो रथमव पश्चाच्चित्सन्तमद्रिवः । पुरस्तादेनं मे कृधि ॥
translation: O Indra, help our chariot on, yea, Thunderer, though it lag behind: Give this my car the foremost place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हन्तो नु किमाससे प्रथमं नो रथं कृधि । उपमं वाजयु श्रवः ॥
translation: Ho there! why sittest thou at case? Make thou my chariot to be first And bring the fame of victory near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवा नो वाजयुं रथं सुकरं ते किमित्परि । अस्मान्त्सु जिग्युषस्कृधि ॥
translation: Assist our car that seeks the prize. What can be easier for thee? So make thou us victorious.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र दृह्यस्व पूरसि भद्रा त एति निष्कृतम् । इयं धीॠत्वियावती ॥
translation: Indra, be firm: a fort art thou. To thine appointed place proceeds The auspicious hymn in season due.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा सीमवद्य आ भागुर्वी काष्ठा हितं धनम् । अपावृक्ता अरत्नयः ॥
translation: Let not our portion be disgrace. Broad is the course, the prize is set, The barriers are opened wide.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुरीयं नाम यज्ञियं यदा करस्तदुश्मसि । आदित्पतिर्न ओहसे ॥
translation: This thing we wish. that thou mayst take thy fourth, thy sacrificial name. So art thou held to be our Lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवीवृधद्वो अमृता अमन्दीदेकद्यूर्देवा उत याश्च देवीः । तस्मा उ राधः कृणुत प्रशस्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
translation: Ekadyû hath exalted you, Immortals: both Goddesses and Gods hath he delighted. Bestow upon him bounty meet for praises. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय । महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥
translation: INDRA, God of the mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम् । तुविमात्रमवोभिः ॥
translation: We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth, Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम् । भीमं न गां वारयन्ते ॥
translation: Hero, when thou art fain to give, neither may Gods nor mortal men Restrain thee like a fearful Bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवामेशानं वस्वः स्वराजम् । न राधसा मर्धिषन्नः ॥
translation: Come, let us glorify Indra, Lord supreme of wealth, Self-ruling King: In bounty may he harm us not.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र स्तोषदुप गासिषच्छ्रवत्साम गीयमानम् । अभि राधसा जुगुरत् ॥
translation: Let prelude sound and following chant so let him hear the Sâman sung, And with his bounty answer us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो भर दक्षिणेनाभि सव्येन प्र मृश । इन्द्र मा नो वसोर्निर्भाक् ॥
translation: O Indra, with thy right hand bring, and with thy left remember us. Let us not lose our share of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप क्रमस्वा भर धृषता धृष्णो जनानाम् । अदाशूष्टरस्य वेदः ॥
translation: Come nigh, O Bold One, boldly bring hither the riches of the churl Who giveth least of all the folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र य उ नु ते अस्ति वाजो विप्रेभिः सनित्वः । अस्माभिः सु तं सनुहि ॥
translation: Indra, the booty which thou hast with holy singers to receive, Even that booty win with us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सद्योजुवस्ते वाजा अस्मभ्यं विश्वश्चन्द्राः । वशैश्च मक्षू जरन्ते ॥
translation: Indra, thy swiftly-coming spoil, the booty which rejoices all, Sounds quick in concert with our hopes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ प्र द्रव परावतोऽर्वावतश्च वृत्रहन् । मध्वः प्रति प्रभर्मणि ॥
translation: HASTE forward to us from afar, or, Vritra-slayer, from anear, To meet the offering to the meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तीव्राः सोमास आ गहि सुतासो मादयिष्णवः । पिबा दधृग्यथोचिषे ॥
translation: Strong are the Soma-draughts; come nigh: the juices fill thee with delight: Drink boldly even as thou art wont'.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषा मन्दस्वादु तेऽरं वराय मन्यवे । भुवत्त इन्द्र शं हृदे ॥
translation: Joy, Indra, in the strengthening food: let it content thy wish and thought, And be delightful to thine heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वशत्रवा गहि न्यु१क्थानि च हूयसे । उपमे रोचने दिवः ॥
translation: Come to us thou who hast no foe: we call thee down to hymns of praise, In heaven's sublimest realm of light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यायमद्रिभिः सुतो गोभिः श्रीतो मदाय कम् । प्र सोम इन्द्र हूयते ॥
translation: This Soma here expressed with stones and dressed with milk for thy carouse, Indra, is offered up to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र श्रुधि सु मे हवमस्मे सुतस्य गोमतः । वि पीतिं तृप्तिमश्नुहि ॥
translation: Graciously, Indra, hear my call. Come and obtain the draught, and sate Thyself with juices blent with milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
translation: The Soma, Indra, which is shed in chalices and vats for thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अप्सु चन्द्रमा इव सोमश्चमूषु ददृशे । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
translation: The Soma seen within the vats, as in the flood the Moon is seen, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यं ते श्येनः पदाभरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतम् । पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
translation: That which the Hawk brought in his claw, inviolate, through the air to thee, Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवानामिदवो महत्तदा वृणीमहे वयम् । वृष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये ॥
translation: WE choose unto ourselves that high protection of the Mighty Gods That it may help and succour us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नः सन्तु युजः सदा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा । वृधासश्च प्रचेतसः ॥
translation: May they be ever our allies, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Far-seeing Gods who prosper us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अति नो विष्पिता पुरु नौभिरपो न पर्षथ । यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
translation: Ye furtherers of holy Law, transport us safe o'er many woes, As over water-floods in ships.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वामं नो अस्त्वर्यमन्वामं वरुण शंस्यम् । वामं ह्यावृणीमहे ॥
translation: Dear wealth be Aryaman to us, Varuṇa dear wealth meet for praise: Dear wealth we choose unto ourselves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वामस्य हि प्रचेतस ईशानाशो रिशादसः । नेमादित्या अघस्य यत् ॥
translation: For Sovrans of dear wealth are ye, Âdityas, not of sinner's wealth, Ye sapient Gods who slay the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमिद्वः सुदानवः क्षियन्तो यान्तो अध्वन्ना । देवा वृधाय हूमहे ॥
translation: We in our homes, ye Bounteous Ones, and while we journey on the road, Invoke you, Gods, to prosper us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधि न इन्द्रैषां विष्णो सजात्यानाम् । इता मरुतो अश्विना ॥
translation: Regard us, Indra, Vishṇu, here, ye Aṣvins and the Marut host, Us who are kith and kin to you.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र भ्रातृत्वं सुदानवोऽध द्विता समान्या । मातुर्गर्भे भरामहे ॥
translation: Ye Bounteous Ones, from time of old we here set forth our brotherhood, Our kinship in the Mother's womb.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः । अधा चिद्व उत ब्रुवे ॥
translation: Then come with Indra for your chief, as early day, ye Bounteous Gods Yea, I address you now for this.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् । अग्निं रथं न वेद्यम् ॥
translation: AGNI, your dearest Guest, I laud, him who is loving as a friend, Who brings us riches like a car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कविमिव प्रचेतसं यं देवासो अध द्विता । नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ॥
translation: Whom as a far-foreseeing Sage the Gods have, from the olden time, Established among mortal men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँः पाहि शृणुधी गिरः । रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥
translation: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, And of thyself preserve their seed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् । वराय देव मन्यवे ॥
translation: What is the praise wherewith, O God, Afigiras, Agni, Son of Strength, We, after thine own wish and thought,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो । कदु वोच इदं नमः ॥
translation: May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan? What prayer shall I now speak to thee?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः । वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ॥
translation: Our God, make all of us to dwell in happy habitations, and Reward our songs with spoil and wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्य नूनं परीणसो धियो जिन्वसि दम्पते । गोषाता यस्य ते गिरः ॥
translation: Lord of the house, what plenty fills the songs which thou inspirest now, Thou whose hymn helps to win the kine?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं मर्जयन्त सुक्रतुं पुरोयावानमाजिषु । स्वेषु क्षयेषु वाजिनम् ॥
translation: Him Wise and Strong they glorify, the foremost Champion in the fray, And mighty in his dwelling-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्षेति क्षेमेभिः साधुभिर्नकिर्यं घ्नन्ति हन्ति यः । अग्ने सुवीर एधते ॥
translation: Agni, he dwells in rest and peace who smites and no one smites again: With hero sons he prospers well
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मे हवं नासत्याश्विना गच्छतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: To this mine invocation, O ye Aṣvins, ye Nâsatyas, come, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमं मे स्तोममश्विनेमं मे शृणुतं हवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: This laud of mine, ye Aṣvins Twain, and this mine invitation hear, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं वां कृष्णो अश्विना हवते वाजिनीवसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Here Kr̥ishṇa is invoking you, O Aṣvins, Lords of ample wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवं कृष्णस्य स्तुवतो नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: List, Heroes, to the singer's call, the call of Kr̥ishṇa lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यं विप्राय स्तुवते नरा । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Chiefs, to the sage who sings your praise grant an inviolable home, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गच्छतं दाशुषो गृहमित्था स्तुवतो अश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Come to the worshipper's abode, Aṣvins, who here is lauding you, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जाथां रासभं रथे वीड्वङ्गे वृषण्वसू । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Yoke to the firmly jointed car the ass which draws you, Lords of wealth. To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेना यातमश्विना । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: Come hither, Aṣvins, on your car of triple form with triple seat, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नू मे गिरो नासत्याश्विना प्रावतं युवम् । मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: O Aṣvins, O Nâsatyas, now accept with favouring grace my songs, To drink the savoury Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभा हि दस्रा भिषजा मयोभुवोभा दक्षस्य वचसो बभूवथुः । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
translation: YE Twain are wondrous strong, well-skilled in arts that heal, both bringers of delight, ye both won Daksha's praise. Viṣvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कथा नूनं वां विमना उप स्तवद्युवं धियं ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
translation: How shall he praise you now who is distraught in mind? Ye Twain give wisdom for the gain of what is good. Viṣvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवं हि ष्मा पुरुभुजेममेधतुं विष्णाप्वे ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये । ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
translation: Already have ye Twain, possessors of great wealth, prospered Vishṇâpû thus for gain of what is good. Viṣvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्यं वीरं धनसामृजीषिणं दूरे चित्सन्तमवसे हवामहे । यस्य स्वादिष्ठा सुमतिः पितुर्यथा मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
translation: And that Impetuous Hero, winner of the spoil, though he is far away, we call to succour us, Whose gracious favour, like a father's, is most sweet. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतेन देवः सविता शमायत ऋतस्य शृङ्गमुर्विया वि पप्रथे । ऋतं सासाह महि चित्पृतन्यतो मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
translation: About the holy Law toils Savitar the God the horn of holy Law hath he spread far and wide. The holy Law hath quelled even mighty men of war. Break ye not off our ftiendship, come and set me free.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्युम्नी वां स्तोमो अश्विना क्रिविर्न सेक आ गतम् । मध्वः सुतस्य स दिवि प्रियो नरा पातं गौराविवेरिणे ॥
translation: SPLENDID, O Aṣvins, is your praise. Come fountain-like, to pour the stream. Of the sweet juice effused-dear is it, Chiefs, in heaven-drink like two wild bulls at a pool.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबतं घर्मं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं नरा । ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ नि पातं वेदसा वयः ॥
translation: Drink the libation rich in sweets, O Aṣvins Twain: sit. Heroes, on the sacred grass. Do ye with joyful heart in the abode of man preserve his life by means of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत । ता वर्तिर्यातमुप वृक्तबर्हिषो जुष्टं यज्ञं दिविष्टिषु ॥
translation: The Priyamedhas bid you come with all the succours that are yours. Come to his house whose holy grass is trimmed, to dear sacrifice at the morning rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं सुमत् । ता वावृधाना उप सुष्टुतिं दिवो गन्तं गौराविवेरिणम् ॥
translation: Drink ye the Soma rich in meath, ye Aṣvins Twain: sit gladly on the sacred grass. So, waxen mighty, to our eulogy from heaven come ye as wild-bulls to the pool.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नूनं यातमश्विनाश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः । दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
translation: Come to us, O ye Aṣvins, now with steeds of many a varied hue, Ye Lords of splendour, wondrous, borne on paths of gold, drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयं हि वां हवामहे विपन्यवो विप्रासो वाजसातये । ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुदंससा धियाश्विना श्रुष्ट्या गतम् ॥
translation: For we the priestly singers, fain tohymn your praise, invoke you for the gain of strength. So, wondrous, fair, and famed for great deeds come to us, through our hymn, Aṣvins, when ye hear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः । अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥
translation: As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your Wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम् । क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
translation: Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things, Him swift we seek. for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीळवः । यद्दित्ससि स्तुवते मावते वसु नकिष्टदा मिनाति ते ॥
translation: Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way. None stay that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: योद्धासि क्रत्वा शवसोत दंसना विश्वा जाताभि मज्मना । आ त्वायमर्क ऊतये ववर्तति यं गोतमा अजीजनन् ॥
translation: A Warrior thou by strength, wisdom, and wondrous deed, in might excellest all that is. Hither may this our hymn attract thee to our help, the hymn which Gotamas have made.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र हि रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि । न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमनु स्वधां ववक्षिथ ॥
translation: For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the boundaries of heaven. The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. After thy Godhead hast thou waxed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नकिः परिष्टिर्मघवन्मघस्य ते यद्दाशुषे दशस्यसि । अस्माकं बोध्युचथस्य चोदिता मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
translation: When, Maghavan, thou honourest the worshipper, no one is there to stay thy wealth. Most liberal Giver thou, do thou inspire our song of praise, that we may win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम् । येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥
translation: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts that slays the Vr̥itras best. Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेन्द्रो द्युम्न्याभवत् । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण ॥
translation: Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us. Indra, refulgent with thy Marut host! the Gods strove eagerly to win thy love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत । वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
translation: Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise. Let Ṣatakratu, Vr̥itra-slayer, kill the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्र भर धृषता धृषन्मनः श्रवश्चित्ते असद्बृहत् । अर्षन्त्वापो जवसा वि मातरो हनो वृत्रं जया स्वः ॥
translation: Aim and fetch boldly forth, O thou whose heart is bold: great glory will be thine thereby. In rapid torrent let the mother waters spread. Slay Vr̥itra, win the light of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय । तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उत द्याम् ॥
translation: When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vr̥itras dead, Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः । तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम् ॥
translation: There was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy, Thou in thy might surpassest all, all that now is and yet shall be.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि । घर्मं न सामन्तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत् ॥
translation: Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Sûrya rise to heaven. Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sâma hymns, great joy to him who loves the song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः समत्सु भूषतु । उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहा परमज्या ऋचीषमः ॥
translation: MAY Indra, who in every fight must be invoked, be near to us. May the most mighty Vr̥itra-slayer, meet for praise, come to libations and to hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् । तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ॥
translation: Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gifts, true art thou, lordly in thine act. We claim alliance with the very Glorious One, yea, with the Mighty Son of Strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ब्रह्मा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः क्रियन्ते अनतिद्भुता । इमा जुषस्व हर्यश्व योजनेन्द्र या ते अमन्महि ॥
translation: Prayers unsurpassed are offered up to thee the Lover of the Song. Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, accept these fitting hymns, hymns which we have thought out for thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं हि सत्यो मघवन्ननानतो वृत्रा भूरि न्यृञ्जसे । स त्वं शविष्ठ वज्रहस्त दाशुषेऽर्वाञ्चं रयिमा कृधि ॥
translation: For thou, O Maghavan, art truthful, ne'er subdued and bringest many a Vr̥itra low. As such, O Mightiest Lord, Wielder of Thunder, send wealth hither to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पते । त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इदनुत्ता चर्षणीधृता ॥
translation: O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous, O Lord of Strength. Alone thou slayest with the guardian of mankind resistless never-conquered foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे । महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन् ॥
translation: As such we seek thee now, O Asura, thee most wise, craving thy bounty as our share. Thy sheltering defence is like a mighty cloak. So may thy glories reach to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कन्या३ वारवायती सोममपि स्रुताविदत् । अस्तं भरन्त्यब्रवीदिन्द्राय सुनवै त्वा शक्राय सुनवै त्वा ॥
translation: DOWN to the stream a maiden came, and found the Soma by the way. Bearing it to her home she said, For Indra will I press thee out, for Ṣakra will I press thee out.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असौ य एषि वीरको गृहंगृहं विचाकशद् । इमं जम्भसुतं पिब धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् ॥
translation: Thou roaming yonder, little man, beholding every house in turn, Drink thou this Soma pressed with teeth, accompanied with grain and curds, with cake of meal and song of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ चन त्वा चिकित्सामोऽधि चन त्वा नेमसि । शनैरिव शनकैरिवेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
translation: Fain would we learn to know thee well, nor yet can we attain to thee. Still slowly and in gradual drops, O Indu, unto Indra flow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुविच्छकत्कुवित्करत्कुविन्नो वस्यसस्करत् । कुवित्पतिद्विषो यतीरिन्द्रेण संगमामहै ॥
translation: Will he not help and work for us? Will he not make us wealthier? Shall we not, hostile to our lord, unite ourselves to Indra now?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इमानि त्रीणि विष्टपा तानीन्द्र वि रोहय । शिरस्ततस्योर्वरामादिदं म उपोदरे ॥
translation: O Indra, cause to sprout again three places, these which I declare,– My father's head, his cultured field, and this the part below my waist.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असौ च या न उर्वरादिमां तन्वं१ मम । अथो ततस्य यच्छिरः सर्वा ता रोमशा कृधि ॥
translation: Make all of these grow crops of hair, you cultivated field of ours, My body, and my father's head.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो । अपालामिन्द्र त्रिष्पूत्व्यकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम् ॥
translation: Cleansing Apâlâ, Indra! thrice, thou gavest sunlike skin to her, Drawn, Ṣatakratu! through the hole of car, of wagon, and of yoke.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत । विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
translation: INVITE ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice, All-conquering Ṣatakratu, most munificent of all who live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्यं१ सनश्रुतम् । इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन ॥
translation: Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song, renowned of old: His name is Indra, tell it forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र इन्नो महानां दाता वाजानां नृतुः । महाँ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत् ॥
translation: Indra the Dancer be to us the giver of abundant strength: May he, the mighty, bring it near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपादु शिप्र्यन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः । इन्दोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः ॥
translation: Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksha's draught, The Soma juice with barley mixt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तम्वभि प्रार्चतेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । तदिद्ध्यस्य वर्धनम् ॥
translation: Call Indra loudly with your songs of praise to drink the Soma juice. For this is what augments his stiength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा मदानां देवो देवस्यौजसा । विश्वाभि भुवना भुवत् ॥
translation: When he hath drank its gladdening drops, the God with vigour of a God Hath far surpassed all things that are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् । आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥
translation: Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours, Him who is drawn to all our songs
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युध्मं सन्तमनर्वाणं सोमपामनपच्युतम् । नरमवार्यक्रतुम् ॥
translation: The Warrior not to be restrained, the Soma-drinker ne'er o'erthrown, The Chieftain of resistless might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाँ ऋचीषम । अवा नः पार्ये धने ॥
translation: O Indra, send us riches, thou Omniscient, worthy of our praise: Help us in the decisive fray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतश्चिदिन्द्र ण उपा याहि शतवाजया । इषा सहस्रवाजया ॥
translation: Even thence, O Indra, come to us with food that gives a hundred powers, With food that gives a thousand powers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयाम धीवतो धियोऽर्वद्भिः शक्र गोदरे । जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
translation: We sought the wisdom of the wise. Ṣakra, Kine-giver, Thunder-armed! May we with steeds o’ercome in fight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वयमु त्वा शतक्रतो गावो न यवसेष्वा । उक्थेषु रणयामसि ॥
translation: We make thee, Ṣatakratu, find enjoyment in the songs we sing, Like cattle in the pasture lands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वा हि मर्त्यत्वनानुकामा शतक्रतो । अगन्म वज्रिन्नाशसः ॥
translation: For, Ṣatakratu, Thunder-armed, all that we craved, as men are wont, All that we hoped, have we attained.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वे सु पुत्र शवसोऽवृत्रन्कामकातयः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
translation: Those, Son of Strength, are come to thee who cherish wishes in their hearts: O Indra, none excelleth thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो वृषन्त्सनिष्ठया सं घोरया द्रवित्न्वा । धियाविड्ढि पुरंध्या ॥
translation: So, Hero, guard us with thy care, with thy most liberal providence, Speedy, and terrible to foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते नूनं शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः । तेन नूनं मदे मदेः ॥
translation: O Ṣatakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most splendid of them all;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते चित्रश्रवस्तमो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः । य ओजोदातमो मदः ॥
translation: Even, Indra, that carouse which slays the Vritras best, most widely famed, Best giver of thy power and might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विद्मा हि यस्ते अद्रिवस्त्वादत्तः सत्य सोमपाः । विश्वासु दस्म कृष्टिषु ॥
translation: For that which is thy gift we know, true Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Mighty One, amid all the folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः । अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः ॥
translation: For Indra, Lover of Carouse, loud be our songs about the juice: Let poets sing the song of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त संसदः । इन्द्रं सुते हवामहे ॥
translation: We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom The seven communities rejoice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत । तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
translation: At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind: Let our songs aid and prosper it.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः । न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
translation: Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea: O Indra, naught excelleth thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षं सोमस्य जागृवे । य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते ॥
translation: Thou, wakeful Hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice, Which, Indra, is within thee now.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् । अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः ॥
translation: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw, The drops be ready for thy forms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरमश्वाय गायति श्रुतकक्षो अरं गवे । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
translation: Now Ṣrutakaksha sings his song that cattle and the steed may come, That Indra’s very self may come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरं हि ष्म सुतेषु णः सोमेष्विन्द्र भूषसि । अरं ते शक्र दावने ॥
translation: Here, Indra, thou art ready by our Soma juices shed for thee, Ṣakra, at hand that thou mayst give.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पराकात्ताच्चिदद्रिवस्त्वां नक्षन्त नो गिरः । अरं गमाम ते वयम् ॥
translation: Even from far away our songs reach thee, O Caster of the Stone: May we come very close to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः । एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥
translation: For so thou art the hero’s Friend, a Hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः । अधा चिदिन्द्र मे सचा ॥
translation: So hath the offering, wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers: So dwell thou, Indra, even with me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मो षु ब्रह्मेव तन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते । मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ॥
translation: He not thou like a slothful priest, O Lord of spoil and wealth: rejoice In the pressed Soma blent with milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा न इन्द्राभ्या३दिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमन् । त्वा युजा वनेम तत् ॥
translation: O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light: This may we gain with thee for Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वयेदिन्द्र युजा वयं प्रति ब्रुवीमहि स्पृधः । त्वमस्माकं तव स्मसि ॥
translation: With thee to help us, Indra, let us answer all our enemies: For thou art ours and we are thine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिद्धि त्वायवोऽनुनोनुवतश्चरान् । सखाय इन्द्र कारवः ॥
translation: Indra, the poets and thy friends, faithful to thee, shall loudly sing Thy praises as they follow thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् । अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥
translation: Sûrya, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा । अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत् ॥
translation: Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down, Slew Vr̥itra and smote Ahi dead.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् । उरुधारेव दोहते ॥
translation: This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream Riches in horses, kine, and corn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य । सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे ॥
translation: Whatever, Vr̥itra-slayer! thou, Sûrya, hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वा प्रवृद्ध सत्पते न मरा इति मन्यसे । उतो तत्सत्यमित्तव ॥
translation: When, Mighty One, Lord of the brave, thou thinkest thus, I shall not die, That thought of thine is true indeed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । सर्वाँस्ताँ इन्द्र गच्छसि ॥
translation: Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee, Both far away and near at hand.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे । स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥
translation: We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vr̥itra dead: A vigorous Hero shall he be.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः । द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः ॥
translation: Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty, o'er the joyous draught. Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः । ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः ॥
translation: By song as 'twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was prepared Lofty, invincible he grew.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दुर्गे चिन्नः सुगं कृधि गृणान इन्द्र गिर्वणः । त्वं च मघवन्वशः ॥
translation: Indra, Song-lover, lauded, make even in the wilds fair ways for us, Whenever, Maghavan, thou wilt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते नू चिदादिशं न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम् । न देवो नाध्रिगुर्जनः ॥
translation: Thou whose commandment and behest of sovran sway none disregards, Neither audacious man nor God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा ते अप्रतिष्कुतं देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः । उभे सुशिप्र रोदसी ॥
translation: And both these Goddesses, Earth, Heaven, Lord of the beauteous helm! revere Thy might which no one may resist.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमेतदधारयः कृष्णासु रोहिणीषु च । परुष्णीषु रुशत्पयः ॥
translation: Thou in the black cows and the red and in the cows with spotted skin This white milk hast deposited.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि यदहेरध त्विषो विश्वे देवासो अक्रमुः । विदन्मृगस्य ताँ अमः ॥
translation: When in their terror all the Gods shrank from the Dragon’s furious might, Fear of the monster fell on them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदु मे निवरो भुवद्वृत्रहादिष्ट पौंस्यम् । अजातशत्रुरस्तृतः ॥
translation: Then he was my Defender, then, Invincible, whose foe is not, The Vritra-slayer showed his might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् । आ शुषे राधसे महे ॥
translation: Him your best Vritra-slayer, him the famous Champion of mankind I urge to great munificence,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत । यत्सोमेसोम आभवः ॥
translation: To come, Much-lauded! Many-named! with this same thought that longs for milk, Whene’er the Soma juice is shed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बोधिन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः । शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम् ॥
translation: Much-honoured by libations, may the Vritra-slayer wake for us: May Ṣakra listen to our prayers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् । कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
translation: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring Riches to those who worship thee?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कस्य वृषा सुते सचा नियुत्वान्वृषभो रणत् । वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
translation: With whose libation joys the Strong, the Hero with his team who quells The foe, to drink the Soma juice?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी षु णस्त्वं रयिं मन्दसानः सहस्रिणम् । प्रयन्ता बोधि दाशुषे ॥
translation: Rejoicing in thy spirit bring thousandfold opulence to us: Enrich thy votary with gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पत्नीवन्तः सुता इम उशन्तो यन्ति वीतये । अपां जग्मिर्निचुम्पुणः ॥
translation: These juices with their wedded wives flow to enjoyment lovingly: To waters speeds the restless one.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधासो अध्वरे । अच्छावभृथमोजसा ॥
translation: Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With might, unto the cleansing bath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या । वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम् ॥
translation: These two who share his feast, Bay Steeds with golden manes, shall bring him to The banquet that is laid for him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यं सोमाः सुता इमे स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमा वह ॥
translation: For thee, O Lord of Light, are shed these Soma-drops, and grass is strewn: Bring Indra to his worshippers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं वि रोचना दधद्रत्ना वि दाशुषे । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमर्चत ॥
translation: May Indra give thee skill and lights of heaven, wealth to his votary And priests who praise him: laud ye him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते दधामीन्द्रियमुक्था विश्वा शतक्रतो । स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृळय ॥
translation: O Ṣatakratu, wondrous strength and all our lauds I bring to thee: Be gracious to thy worshippers.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भद्रम्भद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जं शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
translation: Bring to us all things excellent, O Ṣatakratu, food and strength; For, Indra, thou art kind to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो विश्वान्या भर सुवितानि शतक्रतो । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
translation: O Ṣatakratu, bring to us all blessings, all felicity: For, Indra, thou art kind to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम सुतावन्तो हवामहे । यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
translation: Bearing the Soma juice we call, best Vritra-slayer, unto thee: For, Indra, thou art kind to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
translation: Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy Bay Steeds, come To our libation with thy Steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
translation: Known as best Vritra-slayer erst, as Indra Ṣatakratu, come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि । उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
translation: O Vritra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma: come With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुं रयिम् । वाजी ददातु वाजिनम् ॥
translation: May Indra give, to aid us, wealth handy that rules the Skilful Ones: Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गौर्धयति मरुतां श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् । युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम् ॥
translation: THE Cow, the famous Mother of the wealthy Maruts, pours her milk: Both horses of the cars are yoked,–
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्या देवा उपस्थे व्रता विश्वे धारयन्ते । सूर्यामासा दृशे कम् ॥
translation: She in whose bosom all the Gods, and Sun and Moon for men to see, Maintain their everlasting Laws.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणन्ति कारवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
translation: This all the pious sing to us, and sacred poets evermore: The Maruts to the Soma-draught
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः । उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥
translation: Here is the Soma ready pressed of this the Maruts drink, of this Self-luminous the Aṣvins drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः । त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः ॥
translation: Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant, Drink Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतो न्वस्य जोषमाँ इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः । प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति ॥
translation: And Indra, like the Herald Priest, desirous of the milky juice, At early morn will quaff thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कदत्विषन्त सूरयस्तिर आप इव स्रिधः । अर्षन्ति पूतदक्षसः ॥
translation: When have the Princes gleamed and shone through waters as through troops of foes? When hasten they whose might is pure?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कद्वो अद्य महानां देवानामवो वृणे । त्मना च दस्मवर्चसाम् ॥
translation: What favour do I claim this day of you great Deities, you who are Wondrously splendid in yourselves?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ये विश्वा पार्थिवानि पप्रथन्रोचना दिवः । मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
translation: I call, to drink the Soma, those Maruts who spread all realms of earth And luminous regions of the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यान्नु पूतदक्षसो दिवो वो मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: You, even such, pure in your might, you, O ye Maruts, I invoke From heaven to drink this Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यान्नु ये वि रोदसी तस्तभुर्मरुतो हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: The Maruts, those who have sustained and propped the heavens and earth apart, I call to drink this Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्यं नु मारुतं गणं गिरिष्ठां वृषणं हुवे । अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: That vigorous baud of Maruts that abideth in the mountains, I Invoke to drink this Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः । अभि त्वा समनूषतेन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः ॥
translation: SONG-LOVER! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows. O Indra, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त्वा शुक्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतास इन्द्र गिर्वणः । पिबा त्व१स्यान्धस इन्द्र विश्वासु ते हितम् ॥
translation: Bright juices hitherward have sped thee, Indra, Lover of the Song. Drink, Indra, of this flowing sap: in every house 'tis set for thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पिबा सोमं मदाय कमिन्द्र श्येनाभृतं सुतम् । त्वं हि शश्वतीनां पती राजा विशामसि ॥
translation: Drink Soma to inspirit thee, juice, Indra, which the Falcon brought: For thou art King and Sovran Lord of all the families of men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति । सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि ॥
translation: O Indra, hear Tiraṣchî's call, the call of him who serveth thee. Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring: Great art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र यस्ते नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् । चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम् ॥
translation: For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song, A hymn that springs from careful thought, ancient, and full of sacred truth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः । पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
translation: That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified. Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना । शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्ध आशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥
translation: Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sâma hymns. Let the pure milky draught delight him strengthened by pure songs of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः । शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्यः ॥
translation: O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance, pure thyself. Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma, pure, be glad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे । शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
translation: O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure, enrich the worshipper. Pure, thou dost strike the Vr̥itras dead, and strivest, pure, to win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मा उषास आतिरन्त याममिन्द्राय नक्तमूर्म्याः सुवाचः । अस्मा आपो मातरः सप्त तस्थुर्नृभ्यस्तराय सिन्धवः सुपाराः ॥
translation: FOR him the Mornings made their courses longer, and Nights with pleasant voices spake to Indra. For him the Floods stood still, the Seven Mothers, Streams easy for the heroes to pass over.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतिविद्धा विथुरेणा चिदस्त्रा त्रिः सप्त सानु संहिता गिरीणाम् । न तद्देवो न मर्त्यस्तुतुर्याद्यानि प्रवृद्धो वृषभश्चकार ॥
translation: The Darter penetrated, though in trouble, thrice-seven close-pressed ridges of the mountains. Neither might God nor mortal man accomplish what the Strong Hero wrought in full-grown vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य वज्र आयसो निमिश्ल इन्द्रस्य बाह्वोर्भूयिष्ठमोजः । शीर्षन्निन्द्रस्य क्रतवो निरेक आसन्नेषन्त श्रुत्या उपाके ॥
translation: The mightiest force is Indra's bolt of iron when firmly grasped in both the arms of Indra. His head and mouth have powers that pass all others, and all his people hasten near to listen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्ये त्वा यज्ञियं यज्ञियानां मन्ये त्वा च्यवनमच्युतानाम् । मन्ये त्वा सत्वनामिन्द्र केतुं मन्ये त्वा वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
translation: I count thee as the Holiest of the Holy, the caster-down of what hath ne'er been shaken. I count thee as the Banner of the heroes, I count thee as the Chief of all men living.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिन्द्र धत्से मदच्युतमहये हन्तवा उ । प्र पर्वता अनवन्त प्र गावः प्र ब्रह्माणो अभिनक्षन्त इन्द्रम् ॥
translation: What time, O Indra, in thine arms thou tookest thy wildly rushing bolt to Slay the Dragon, The mountains roared, the cattle loudly bellowed, the Brahmans with their hymns drew nigh to Indra.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु ष्टवाम य इमा जजान विश्वा जातान्यवराण्यस्मात् । इन्द्रेण मित्रं दिधिषेम गीर्भिरुपो नमोभिर्वृषभं विशेम ॥
translation: Let us praise him who made these worlds and creatures, all things that after him sprang into being. May we win Mitra with our songs, and Indra, and. wait upon our Lord with adoration.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः । मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि ॥
translation: Flying in terror from the snort of Vr̥itra, all Deities who were thy friends forsook thee. So, Indra, be thy friendship with the Maruts: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिः षष्टिस्त्वा मरुतो वावृधाना उस्रा इव राशयो यज्ञियासः । उप त्वेमः कृधि नो भागधेयं शुष्मं त एना हविषा विधेम ॥
translation: Thrice-sixty Maruts, waxing strong, were with thee, like piles of beaming light, worthy of worship. We come to thee: grant us a happy portion. Let us adore thy might with this oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिग्ममायुधं मरुतामनीकं कस्त इन्द्र प्रति वज्रं दधर्ष । अनायुधासो असुरा अदेवाश्चक्रेण ताँ अप वप ऋजीषिन् ॥
translation: A sharpened weapon is the host of Maruts. Who, Indra, dares withstand thy bolt of thunder? Weaponless are the Asuras, the godless: scatter them with thy wheel, Impetuous Hero.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मह उग्राय तवसे सुवृक्तिं प्रेरय शिवतमाय पश्वः । गिर्वाहसे गिर इन्द्राय पूर्वीर्धेहि तन्वे कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
translation: To him the Strong and Mighty, most auspicious, send up the beauteous hymn for sake of cattle. Lay on his body many songs for Indra invoked with song, for will not he regard them
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्थवाहसे विभ्वे मनीषां द्रुणा न पारमीरया नदीनाम् । नि स्पृश धिया तन्वि श्रुतस्य जुष्टतरस्य कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
translation: To him, the Mighty, who accepts laudation, send forth thy thought as by a boat o’er rivers, Stir with thy hymn the body of the Famous and Dearest One, for will not he regard it?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तद्विविड्ढि यत्त इन्द्रो जुजोषत्स्तुहि सुष्टुतिं नमसा विवास । उप भूष जरितर्मा रुवण्यः श्रावया वाचं कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
translation: Serve him with gifts of thine which Indra welcomes: praise with fair praise, invite him with thine homage. Draw near, O singer, and refrain from outcry. Make thy voice heard, for will not he regard it?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदियानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः । आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नेहितीर्नृमणा अधत्त ॥
translation: The Black Drop sank in Anṣumatîs bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it. Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted laid aside his weapons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: द्रप्समपश्यं विषुणे चरन्तमुपह्वरे नद्यो अंशुमत्याः । नभो न कृष्णमवतस्थिवांसमिष्यामि वो वृषणो युध्यताजौ ॥
translation: I saw the Drop in the far distance moving, on the slope bank of Anṣumatîs river, Like a black cloud that sank into the water. Heroes, I send you forth. Go, fight in battle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध द्रप्सो अंशुमत्या उपस्थेऽधारयत्तन्वं तित्विषाणः । विशो अदेवीरभ्या३चरन्तीर्बृहस्पतिना युजेन्द्रः ससाहे ॥
translation: And then the Drop in Anṣumatîs bosom, splendid with light, assumed its proper body; And Indra, with Br̥ihaspati to aid him, conquered the godless tribes that came against him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र । गूळ्हे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः ॥
translation: Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival. The hidden Pair, the Heaven and Earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यदप्रतिमानमोजो वज्रेण वज्रिन्धृषितो जघन्थ । त्वं शुष्णस्यावातिरो वधत्रैस्त्वं गा इन्द्र शच्येदविन्दः ॥
translation: So, Thunder-armed! thou with thy bolt of thunder didst boldly smite that power which none might equal; With weapons broughtest low the phght of Sushna, and, Indra, foundest by thy strength the cattle.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं ह त्यद्वृषभ चर्षणीनां घनो वृत्राणां तविषो बभूथ । त्वं सिन्धूँरसृजस्तस्तभानान्त्वमपो अजयो दासपत्नीः ॥
translation: Then wast thou, Chieftain of all living mortals, the very mighty slayer of the Vritras. Then didst thou set the obstructed rivers flowing, and win the floods that were enthralled by Dâsas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स सुक्रतू रणिता यः सुतेष्वनुत्तमन्युर्यो अहेव रेवान् । य एक इन्नर्यपांसि कर्ता स वृत्रहा प्रतीदन्यमाहुः ॥
translation: Most wise is he, rejoicing in libations, splendid as day, resistless in his anger. He only doth great deeds, the only Hero, sole Vritra-slayer he, with none beside him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणीधृत्तं सुष्टुत्या हव्यं हुवेम । स प्राविता मघवा नोऽधिवक्ता स वाजस्य श्रवस्यस्य दाता ॥
translation: Indra is Vritra’s slayer, man’s sustainer: he must be called; with fair praise let us call him. Maghavan is our Helper, our Protector, giver of spoil and wealth to make us famous.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वृत्रहेन्द्र ऋभुक्षाः सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूव । कृण्वन्नपांसि नर्या पुरूणि सोमो न पीतो हव्यः सखिभ्यः ॥
translation: This Indra, Vritra-slayer, this Ribhukshan, even at his birth, was meet for invocation. Doer of many deeds for man’s advantage, like Soma quaffed, for friends we must invoke him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाँ असुरेभ्यः । स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
translation: O INDRA, Lord of Light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमिन्द्र दधिषे त्वमश्वं गां भागमव्ययम् । यजमाने सुन्वति दक्षिणावति तस्मिन्तं धेहि मा पणौ ॥
translation: The unwasting share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured, Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इन्द्र सस्त्यव्रतोऽनुष्वापमदेवयुः । स्वैः ष एवैर्मुमुरत्पोष्यं रयिं सनुतर्धेहि तं ततः ॥
translation: The riteless, godless man who sleeps, O Indra, his unbroken sleep, – May he by following his own devices die. Hide from him wealth that nourishes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् । अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाँ आ विवासति ॥
translation: Whether, O Ṣakra, thou be far, or, Vritra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who hath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned Steeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वासि रोचने दिवः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । यत्पार्थिवे सदने वृत्रहन्तम यदन्तरिक्ष आ गहि ॥
translation: Whether thou art in heaven's bright sphere, or in the basin of the sea; Whether, chief Vr̥itra-slayer, in some place on earth, or in the firmament, approach.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः सोमेषु सोमपाः सुतेषु शवसस्पते । मादयस्व राधसा सूनृतावतेन्द्र राया परीणसा ॥
translation: Thou Soma-drinker, Lord of Strength, beside our flowing Soma juice Delight us with thy bounty rich in pleasantness, O Indra, with abundant wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्यः । त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक् ॥
translation: O Indra, turn us not away: be the companion of our feast. For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते नि षदा पीतये मधु । कृधी जरित्रे मघवन्नवो महदस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते ॥
translation: Sit down with us, O Indra, sit beside the juice to drink the meath. Show forth great favour to the singer, Maghavan; Indra, with us, beside the juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न त्वा देवास आशत न मर्त्यासो अद्रिवः । विश्वा जातानि शवसाभिभूरसि न त्वा देवास आशत ॥
translation: O Caster of the Stone, nor Gods nor mortals have attained to thee. Thou in thy might surpassest all that hath been made: the Gods have not attained to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरं सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे । क्रत्वा वरिष्ठं वर आमुरिमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तवसं तरस्विनम् ॥
translation: Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh, Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समीं रेभासो अस्वरन्निन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये । स्वर्पतिं यदीं वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः ॥
translation: Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice, The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरा । सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः ॥
translation: The holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram. Inciters, full of vigour, not to be deceived, are with the chanters, nigh to hear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं शवांसि । मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्तद्राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री ॥
translation: Loudly I call that Indra, Maghavan the Mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, Thunder-armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं पुर इन्द्र चिकिदेना व्योजसा शविष्ठ शक्र नाशयध्यै । त्वद्विश्वानि भुवनानि वज्रिन्द्यावा रेजेते पृथिवी च भीषा ॥
translation: Thou knowest well, O Ṣakra, thou Most Potent, with thy strength, Indra, to destroy these castles. Before thee, Thunder-armed! all beings tremble: the heavens and earth before thee shake with terror.
