author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तन्म ऋतमिन्द्र शूर चित्र पात्वपो न वज्रिन्दुरिताति पर्षि भूरि । कदा न इन्द्र राय आ दशस्येर्विश्वप्स्न्यस्य स्पृहयाय्यस्य राजन् ॥
translation: May thy truth, Indra, Wondrous Hero! be my guard: bear me o’er much woe, Thunderer! as over floods. When, Indra, wilt thou honour us with opulence, all-nourishing and much-to-be-desired, O King ?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् । धर्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥
translation: To Indra sing a Sâma hymn, a lofty song to Lofty Sage, To him who guards the Law, inspired, and fain for praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः । विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाँ असि ॥
translation: Thou, Indra, art the Conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun. Maker of all things, thou art Mighty and All-God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्व१रगच्छो रोचनं दिवः । देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे ॥
translation: Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of heaven. ne Deities, Indra strove to win thee for their Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्द्र नो गधि प्रियः सत्राजिदगोह्यः । गिरिर्न विश्वतस्पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥
translation: Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable, Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of Heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी । इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
translation: O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds. Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of Heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र दर्ता पुरामसि । हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
translation: For thou art he, O Indra, who stormeth all castles of the foe, Slayer of Dasyus, man's Supporter, Lord of Heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा कामान्महः ससृज्महे । उदेव यन्त उदभिः ॥
translation: Now have we, Indra, Friend of Song, sent our great wishes forth to thee, Coming like floods that follow floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि । वावृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे ॥
translation: As rivers swell the ocean, so, Hero, our prayers increase thy might. Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे । इन्द्रवाहा वचोयुजा ॥
translation: With holy song they bind to the broad wide-yoked car the Bay Steeds of the rapid God, Bearers of Indra, yoked by word.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं न इन्द्रा भरँ ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे । आ वीरं पृतनाषहम् ॥
translation: O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Ṣatakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ । अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
translation: For, gracious Ṣatakratu, thou hast ever been a Mother and a Sire to us, So now for bliss we pray to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे शतक्रतो । स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: To thee, Strong, Much-invoked, who showest forth thy strength, O Ṣatakratu, do I speak: So grant thou us heroic strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः । स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहसामिह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥
translation: O THUNDERER, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday. So, Indra, listen here to those who bring the laud: come near unto our dwellingplace.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मत्स्वा सुशिप्र हरिवस्तदीमहे त्वे आ भूषन्ति वेधसः । तव श्रवांस्युपमान्युक्थ्या सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
translation: Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: this we crave. Here the disposers wait on thee. Thy loftiest glories claim our lauds beside the juice, O Indra, Lover of the Song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत । वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम ॥
translation: Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनर्शरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः । सो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन् ॥
translation: Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none: good are the gifts which Indra grants. He is not worth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to giving boons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः । अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥
translation: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा । विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि ॥
translation: The Earth and Heaven clung close to thy victorious might as to their calf two mother-cows. When thou attackest Vritra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितम् । आशुं जेतारं हेतारं रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्र्यावृधम् ॥
translation: Bring to your aid the Eternal One, who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of Charioteers, Tugrya’s unvanquished Strengthener;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इष्कर्तारमनिष्कृतं सहस्कृतं शतमूतिं शतक्रतुम् । समानमिन्द्रमवसे हवामहे वसवानं वसूजुवम् ॥
translation: Arranger of things unarranged, e’en Ṣatakratu, source of might, Indra, the Friend of all, for succour we invoke, Guardian of treasure, sending wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं त एमि तन्वा पुरस्ताद्विश्वे देवा अभि मा यन्ति पश्चात् । यदा मह्यं दीधरो भागमिन्द्रादिन्मया कृणवो वीर्याणि ॥
translation: I MOVE before thee here present in person, and all the Deities follow behind me.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दधामि ते मधुनो भक्षमग्रे हितस्ते भागः सुतो अस्तु सोमः । असश्च त्वं दक्षिणतः सखा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ॥
translation: The food of meath in foremost place I give thee, thy Soma shall be pressed, thy share appointed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सु स्तोमं भरत वाजयन्त इन्द्राय सत्यं यदि सत्यमस्ति । नेन्द्रो अस्तीति नेम उ त्व आह क ईं ददर्श कमभि ष्टवाम ॥
translation: Striving for strength bring forth a laud to Indra, a truthful hymn if he in truth existeth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयमस्मि जरितः पश्य मेह विश्वा जातान्यभ्यस्मि मह्ना । ऋतस्य मा प्रदिशो वर्धयन्त्यादर्दिरो भुवना दर्दरीमि ॥
translation: Here am I, look upon me here, O singer. All that existeth I surpass in greatness.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यन्मा वेना अरुहन्नृतस्यँ एकमासीनं हर्यतस्य पृष्ठे । मनश्चिन्मे हृद आ प्रत्यवोचदचिक्रदञ्छिशुमन्तः सखायः ॥
translation: When the Law's lovers mounted and approached me as I sate lone upon the dear sky's summit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या या चकर्थ मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वते । पारावतं यत्पुरुसम्भृतं वस्वपावृणोः शरभाय ऋषिबन्धवे ॥
translation: All these thy deeds must be declared at Soma-feasts, wrought, Indra, Bounteous Lord, for him who sheds the juice,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र नूनं धावता पृथङ्नेह यो वो अवावरीत् । नि षीं वृत्रस्य मर्मणि वज्रमिन्द्रो अपीपतत् ॥
translation: Now run ye forth your several ways: he is not here who kept you back.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मनोजवा अयमान आयसीमतरत्पुरम् । दिवं सुपर्णो गत्वाय सोमं वज्रिण आभरत् ॥
translation: On-rushing with the speed of thought within the iron fort he pressed :
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रे अन्तः शयत उद्ना वज्रो अभीवृतः । भरन्त्यस्मै संयतः पुरःप्रस्रवणा बलिम् ॥
translation: Deep in the ocean lies the bolt with waters compassed round about,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यद्वाग्वदन्त्यविचेतनानि राष्ट्री देवानां निषसाद मन्द्रा । चतस्र ऊर्जं दुदुहे पयांसि क्व स्विदस्याः परमं जगाम ॥
translation: When, uttering words which no one comprehended, Vâk, Queen of Gods, the Gladdener, was seated,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवीं वाचमजनयन्त देवास्तां विश्वरूपाः पशवो वदन्ति । सा नो मन्द्रेषमूर्जं दुहाना धेनुर्वागस्मानुप सुष्टुतैतु ॥
translation: The Deities generated Vâk the Goddess, and animals of every figure speak her.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व द्यौर्देहि लोकं वज्राय विष्कभे । हनाव वृत्रं रिणचाव सिन्धूनिन्द्रस्य यन्तु प्रसवे विसृष्टाः ॥
translation: Step forth with wider stride, my comrade Vishṇu; make room, Dyaus, for the leaping of the lightning.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये । यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टय आचक्रे हव्यदातये ॥
translation: YEA, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods, Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuṇa. to share his sacrificial gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वर्षिष्ठक्षत्रा उरुचक्षसा नरा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा । ता बाहुता न दंसना रथर्यतः साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
translation: Supreme in sovran power, far-sighted, Chiefs and Kings, most swift to hear from far away, Both, wondrously, set them in motion as with arms, in company with Sûrya's beams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र यो वां मित्रावरुणाजिरो दूतो अद्रवत् । अयःशीर्षा मदेरघुः ॥
translation: The rapid messenger who runs before you, Mitra-Varuṇa, with iron head, swift to the draught,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न यः सम्पृच्छे न पुनर्हवीतवे न संवादाय रमते । तस्मान्नो अद्य समृतेरुरुष्यतं बाहुभ्यां न उरुष्यतम् ॥
translation: He whom no man may question, none may summon back, who stands not still for colloquy,– From hostile clash with him keep ye us safe this day: keep us in safety with your arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो । वरूथ्यं१ वरुणे छन्द्यं वचः स्तोत्रं राजसु गायत ॥
translation: To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn that shall protect to Varuṇa: sing forth a laud unto the Kings.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते हिन्विरे अरुणं जेन्यं वस्वेकं पुत्रं तिसॄणाम् । ते धामान्यमृता मर्त्यानामदब्धा अभि चक्षते ॥
translation: The true, Red Treasure they have sent, one only Son born of the Three. They, the Immortal Ones, never deceived, survey the families of mortal men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मे वचांस्युद्यता द्युमत्तमानि कर्त्वा । उभा यातं नासत्या सजोषसा प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ॥
translation: My songs are lifted up, and acts most splendid are to be performed. Come hither, ye Nâsatyas, with accordant mind, to meet and to enjoy my gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रातिं यद्वामरक्षसं हवामहे युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू । प्राचीं होत्रां प्रतिरन्तावितं नरा गृणाना जमदग्निना ॥
translation: Lords of great wealth, when we invoke your bounty which no demon checks, Both of you, furthering our eastward-offered praise, come, Chiefs whom Jamadagni lauds!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः । अन्तः पवित्र उपरि श्रीणानो३ऽयं शुक्रो अयामि ते ॥
translation: Come, Vâyu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven. Poured on the middle of the straining-cloth, and cooked, this bright drink hath been offered thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वेत्यध्वर्युः पथिभी रजिष्ठैः प्रति हव्यानि वीतये । अधा नियुत्व उभयस्य नः पिब शुचिं सोमं गवाशिरम् ॥
translation: He comes by straightest paths, as ministering Priest, to taste the sacrificial gifts. Then, Lord of harnessed teams! drink of the twofold draught, bright Soma mingled with the milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बळादित्य महाँ असि । महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ असि ॥
translation: Verily, Sûrya, thou art great; truly, Âditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed, thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, thou, God, art great.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि । मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम् ॥
translation: Yea, Sûrya, thou art great in fame: thou evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' High Priest, divine, far-spread unconquerable light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इयं या नीच्यर्किणी रूपा रोहिण्या कृता । चित्रेव प्रत्यदर्श्यायत्य१न्तर्दशसु बाहुषु ॥
translation: She yonder, bending lowly down, clothed in red hues and rich in rays, Is seen, advancing as it were with various tints, amid the ten surrounding arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रजा ह तिस्रो अत्यायमीयुर्न्य१न्या अर्कमभितो विविश्रे । बृहद्ध तस्थौ भुवनेष्वन्तः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश ॥
translation: Past and gone are three mortal generations: the fourth and last into the Sun hath entered. He mid the worlds his lofty place hath taken. Into green plants is gone the Purifying.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः । प्र नु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट ॥
translation: The Rudras' Mother, Daughter of the Vasus, centre of nectar, the Âdityas' Sister — To folk who understand will I proclaim it — injure not Aditi, the Cow, the sinless.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वचोविदं वाचमुदीरयन्तीं विश्वाभिर्धीभिरुपतिष्ठमानाम् । देवीं देवेभ्यः पर्येयुषीं गामा मावृक्त मर्त्यो दभ्रचेताः ॥
translation: Weak-minded men have as a cow adopted me who came hither from the Gods, a Goddess, Who, skilled in eloquence, her voice uplifteth, who standeth near at hand with all devotions.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमग्ने बृहद्वयो दधासि देव दाशुषे । कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
translation: LORD of the house, Sage, ever young, high power of life, O Agni, God, Thou givest to thy worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स न ईळानया सह देवाँ अग्ने दुवस्युवा । चिकिद्विभानवा वह ॥
translation: So with our song that prays and serves, attentive, Lord of spreading light, Agni, bring hitherward the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं चोदिष्ठेन यविष्ठ्य । अभि ष्मो वाजसातये ॥
translation: For, Ever-Youthful One, with thee, best Furtherer, as our ally, We overcome, to win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
translation: As Aurva Bhrigu used, as Apnavâna used, I call the pure Agni who clothes him with the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हुवे वातस्वनं कविं पर्जन्यक्रन्द्यं सहः । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
translation: I call the Sage who sounds like wind, the Might that like Parjanya roars, Agni who clothes him with the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ सवं सवितुर्यथा भगस्येव भुजिं हुवे । अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
translation: As Savitar's productive Power, as him who sends down bliss, I call Agni who clothes him with the sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् । अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
translation: Hither, for powerful kirship, I call Agni, him Who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या । अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः ॥
translation: That through this famed One's power, he may stand by us even as Tvashṭar comes Unto the forms that must be shaped.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते । आ वाजैरुप नो गमत् ॥
translation: This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories mid the Gods: May he come nigh to us with strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वेषामिह स्तुहि होतॄणां यशस्तमम् । अग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
translation: Here praise ye him the most renowned of all the ministering Priests, Agni, the Chief at sacrifice;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शीरं पावकशोचिषं ज्येष्ठो यो दमेष्वा । दीदाय दीर्घश्रुत्तमः ॥
translation: Piercing, with purifying flame, enkindled in our homes, most high, Swiftest to hear from far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमर्वन्तं न सानसिं गृणीहि विप्र शुष्मिणम् । मित्रं न यातयज्जनम् ॥
translation: Sage, laud the Mighty One who wins the spoil of victory like a steed, And, Mitra-like, unites the folk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः । वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥
translation: Still turning to their aim in thee, the oblation-bearer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसंदिनम् । आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम् ॥
translation: The waters find their place in him, for whom the threefold sacred grass Is spread unbound, unlimited.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पदं देवस्य मीळ्हुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः । भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक् ॥
translation: The station of the Bounteous God hath, through his aid which none impair, A pleasant aspect like the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने घृतस्य धीतिभिस्तेपानो देव शोचिषा । आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
translation: Blazing with splendour, Agni, God, through pious gifts of sacred oil, Bring thou the Gods and worship them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वाजनन्त मातरः कविं देवासो अङ्गिरः । हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् ॥
translation: The Gods as mothers brought thee forth, the Immortal Sage, O Angiras, The bearer of our gifts to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रचेतसं त्वा कवेऽग्ने दूतं वरेण्यम् । हव्यवाहं नि षेदिरे ॥
translation: Wise Agni, Gods established thee, the Seer, noblest messenger, As bearer of our sacred gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि मे अस्त्यघ्न्या न स्वधितिर्वनन्वति । अथैतादृग्भरामि ते ॥
translation: No cow have I to call mine own, no axe at hand wherewith to work, Yet what is here I bring to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि । ता जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
translation: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay for thee, Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रो अतिसर्पति । सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतम् ॥
translation: That which the white-ant eats away, that over which the emmet crawls — May all of this be oil to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियं सचेत मर्त्यः । अग्निमीधे विवस्वभिः ॥
translation: When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I with the priests have kindled him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः । उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्त नो गिरः ॥
translation: THAT noblest Furtherer hath appeared, to whom men bring their holy works. Our songs of praise have risen aloft to Agni who was barn to give the Ârya strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देवाँ अच्छा न मज्मना । अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य सानवि ॥
translation: Agni of Divodâsa turned, as 'twere in majesty, to the Gods. Onward he sped along the mother earth, and took his station in the height of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः । सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत ॥
translation: Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds, Him who wins thousands at the worship of the Gods, himself, that Agni, serve with son s.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र यं राये निनीषसि मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् । स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशंसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम् ॥
translation: The mortal man whom thou wouldst lead to opulence, O Vasu, he who brings thee gifts. He, Agni, wins himself a hero singing lauds, yea, one who feeds a thousand men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स दृळ्हे चिदभि तृणत्ति वाजमर्वता स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः । त्वे देवत्रा सदा पुरूवसो विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
translation: He with the steed wins spoil even in the fenced fort, and gains imperishable fame. In thee, O Lord of wealth, continually we lay all precious offerings to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् । मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्यग्नये ॥
translation: To him who dealeth out all wealth, who is the cheerful Priest of men, To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni go the songs of praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वं न गीर्भी रथ्यं सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः । उभे तोके तनये दस्म विश्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
translation: Votaries, richly-gifted, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car. On both, Strong Lord of men! on child and grandson pour the bounties which our nobles give.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे । उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥
translation: Sing forth to him, the Holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वंसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः । कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्नवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत् ॥
translation: Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame. And will not his most newly shown benevolence come to us with abundant strength?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रेष्ठमु प्रियाणां स्तुह्यासावातिथिम् । अग्निं रथानां यमम् ॥
translation: Priest, presser of the juice! praise now the dearest Guest of all our friends, Agni, the driver of the cars.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदिता यो निदिता वेदिता वस्वा यज्ञियो ववर्तति । दुष्टरा यस्य प्रवणे नोर्मयो धिया वाज सिषासतः ॥
translation: Who, finder-out of treasures open and concealed, bringeth them hither, Holy One; Whose waves, as in a cataract, are hard to pass, when he, through song, would win him strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मा नो हृणीतामतिथिर्वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एषः । यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः ॥
translation: Let not the noble Guest, Agni, be wroth with us: by many a man his praise is sung, Good Herald, skilled in sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मो ते रिषन्ये अच्छोक्तिभिर्वसोऽग्ने केभिश्चिदेवैः । कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामीट्टे दूत्याय रातहव्यः स्वध्वरः ॥
translation: O Vasu, Agni, let not them be harmed who come in any way with lauds to thee. Even the lowly, skilled in rites, with offered gifts, seeketh thee for the envoy's task.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आग्ने याहि मरुत्सखा रुद्रेभिः सोमपीतये । सोभर्या उप सुष्टुतिं मादयस्व स्वर्णरे ॥
translation: Friend of the Maruts, Agni, come with Rudras to the Soma-draught, To Sobharî's fair song of praise, and be thou joyful in the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः ॥
translation: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहतम् । द्रुणा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
translation: Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath with the wood attained unto His place, his iron-fashioned home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वरिवोधातमो भव मंहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः । पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
translation: Be thou best Vr̥itra-slayer, best granter of bliss, most liberal: Promote our wealthy princes' gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष महानां देवानां वीतिमन्धसा । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
translation: Flow onward with thy juice unto the banquet of the Mighty Gods: Flow bither for our strength and fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वामच्छा चरामसि तदिदर्थं दिवेदिवे । इन्दो त्वे न आशसः ॥
translation: O Indu, we draw nigh to thee, with this one object day by day: To thee alone our prayers are said
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता । वारेण शश्वता तना ॥
translation: By means of this eternal fleece may Sûrya's Daughter purify Thy Soma that is foaming forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमीमण्वीः समर्य आ गृभ्णन्ति योषणो दश । स्वसारः पार्ये दिवि ॥
translation: Ten sister maids of slender form seize him within the press and hold Him firmly on the final day.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमीं हिन्वन्त्यग्रुवो धमन्ति बाकुरं दृतिम् । त्रिधातु वारणं मधु ॥
translation: The virgins send him forth: they blow the the skin musician-like and fuse The triple foe-repelling meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभी३ममघ्न्या उत श्रीणन्ति धेनवः शिशुम् । सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ॥
translation: Inviolable milch-kine round about him blend for Indra's drink, The fresh young Soma with their milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा विश्वा वृत्राणि जिघ्नते । शूरो मघा च मंहते ॥
translation: In the wild raptures of this draught, Indra slays all the Vr̥itras: he, The Hero, pours his wealth on us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या । इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश ॥
translation: Soma, flow on, inviting Gods, speed to the purifying cloth: Pass into Indra, as a Bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः । आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः ॥
translation: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid Steer: Sit in thy place as one with strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः ॥
translation: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice ne Sage drew waters to himself.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
translation: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee Mighty One, When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः । सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः ॥
translation: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our Friend, heaven's prop and stay, Falls on the purifying cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः । सं सूर्येण रोचते ॥
translation: The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold: He shines together with the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे ॥
translation: Songs, Indu, active in their might are beautified for thee, wherewith Thou deckest thee for our delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे । तव प्रशस्तयो महीः ॥
translation: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the joyous draught: Great are the praises due to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रयुर्मध्वः पवस्व धारया । पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव ॥
translation: Indu as, Indra's Friend, on us pour with a stream of sweetness, like Parjanya sender of the rain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत । आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ॥
translation: Winner of kine, Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and strength Primeval Soul of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयति । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
translation: HERE present this Immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings, To settle in the vats of wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वरांसि धावति । पवमानो अदाभ्यः ॥
translation: This God, made ready with the hymn, runs swiftly through the winding ways, Inviolable as he flows.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः । हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते ॥
translation: This God while flowing is adorned, like a bay steed for war, by men Devout and skilled in holy songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः । पवमानः सिषासति ॥
translation: He, like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along Is fain to win all precious boons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दशस्यति । आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम् ॥
translation: This God, as he is flowing on, speeds like a car and gives his gifts: He lets his voice be heard of all
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
translation: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows Rich gifts upon the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया । पवमानः कनिक्रदत् ॥
translation: Away he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven, And roars as he is flowing on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतः । पवमानः स्वध्वरः ॥
translation: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven across The regions, irresistible.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
translation: After the 'way of ancient time, this God, pressed out for Deities, Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः । धारया पवते सुतः ॥
translation: This Lord of many Holy Laws, even at his birth engendering strength, Effused, flows onward in a stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: O Soma flowing on thy way, win thou and conquer high renown; And make us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सना ज्योतिः सना स्व१र्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities; And make us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: Win skilful strength and mental power. O Soma, drive away our foes; And make us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink: Make thou us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids; And make us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: Through thine own mental power and aid long may we look upon the Sun; Make thou us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to usa stream of riches doubly great; And make us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्य१र्षानपच्युतो रयिं समत्सु सासहिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: As one victorious unsubdued in battle pour forth wealth to us; And make us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: By worship, Pavamâna! men have strengthened thee to prop the Law: Make thou us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि ॥
translation: O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds, manifold. quickening all life; And mate us better than we are.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिद्धो विश्वतस्पतिः पवमानो वि राजति । प्रीणन्वृषा कनिक्रदत् ॥
translation: ENKINDLED, Pavamâna, Lord, sends forth his light on, every side In friendly show, the bellowing Bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तनूनपात्पवमानः शृङ्गे शिशानो अर्षति । अन्तरिक्षेण रारजत् ॥
translation: He, Pavamâna, Self-produced, speeds onward sharpening his horns: He glitters through the firmament.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ईळेन्यः पवमानो रयिर्वि राजति द्युमान् । मधोर्धाराभिरोजसा ॥
translation: Brilliant like wealth, adorable, with splendour Pavamâna shines, Mightily with the streams of meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बर्हिः प्राचीनमोजसा पवमानः स्तृणन्हरिः । देवेषु देव ईयते ॥
translation: The tawny Pavamâna, who strews from of old the grass with might, Is worshipped, God amid the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उदातैर्जिहते बृहद्द्वारो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः । पवमानेन सुष्टुताः ॥
translation: The golden, the Celestial Doors are lifted with their frames on high, By Pavamâna glorified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुशिल्पे बृहती मही पवमानो वृषण्यति । नक्तोषासा न दर्शते ॥
translation: With passion Pavamâna longs for the great lofty pair, well-formed Like beauteous maidens, Night and Dawn
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभा देवा नृचक्षसा होतारा दैव्या हुवे । पवमान इन्द्रो वृषा ॥
translation: Both Gods who look on men I call, Celestial Heralds: Indra's Self Is Pavamâna, yea, the Bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भारती पवमानस्य सरस्वतीळा मही । इमं नो यज्ञमा गमन्तिस्रो देवीः सुपेशसः ॥
translation: This, Pavamâna's sacrifice, shall the three beauteous Goddesses, Sarasvatî and Bhâratî and Iḷâ, Mighty One, attend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वष्टारमग्रजां गोपां पुरोयावानमा हुवे । इन्दुरिन्द्रो वृषा हरिः पवमानः प्रजापतिः ॥
translation: I summon Tvashṭar hither, our protector, champion, earliest-born, Indu is Indra, tawny Steer; Pavamâna is Prajâpati.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वनस्पतिं पवमान मध्वा समङ्ग्धि धारया । सहस्रवल्शं हरितं भ्राजमानं हिरण्ययम् ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, with the meath in streams anoint Vanaspati, The ever-green. the golden-hued, refulgent, with a thousand boughs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वे देवाः स्वाहाकृतिं पवमानस्या गत । वायुर्बृहस्पतिः सूर्योऽग्निरिन्द्रः सजोषसः ॥
translation: Come to the consecrating rite of Pavamâna, all ye Gods,– Vâyu, Sûrya, Br̥ihaspati, Indra, and Agni, in accord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्द्रया सोम धारया वृषा पवस्व देवयुः । अव्यो वारेष्वस्मयुः ॥
translation: SOMA, flow on with pleasant stream, a Bull devoted to the Gods, Our Friend, unto the woollen sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्यं मद्यं मदमिन्दविन्द्र इति क्षर । अभि वाजिनो अर्वतः ॥
translation: Pour hitherward, as Indra's Self, Indu, that gladdening stream of thine, And send us coursers full of strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्यं पूर्व्यं मदं सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
translation: Flow to the filter hitherward, pouring that ancient gladdening juice, Streaming forth power and high renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु द्रप्सास इन्दव आपो न प्रवतासरन् । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
translation: Hither the sparkling drops have flowed, like waters down a steep descent They have reached Indra purified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यमत्यमिव वाजिनं मृजन्ति योषणो दश । वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् ॥
translation: Whom, having passed the filter, ten dames cleanse, as 'twere a vigorous steed, While he disports him in the wood,–
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं गोभिर्वृषणं रसं मदाय देववीतये । सुतं भराय सं सृज ॥
translation: The steer-strong juice with milk pour forth, for feast and service of the Gods, To him who bears away the draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवो देवाय धारयेन्द्राय पवते सुतः । पयो यदस्य पीपयत् ॥
translation: Effused, the God flows onward with his stream to Indra, to the God, So that his milk may strengthen him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आत्मा यज्ञस्य रंह्या सुष्वाणः पवते सुतः । प्रत्नं नि पाति काव्यम् ॥
translation: Soul of the sacrifice, the juice effused flows quickly on: he keeps His ancient wisdom of a Sage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा पुनान इन्द्रयुर्मदं मदिष्ठ वीतये । गुहा चिद्दधिषे गिरः ॥
translation: So pouring forth, as Indra's Friend, strong drink, best Gladdener! for the feast, Thou, even in secret, storest hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः । विदाना अस्य योजनम् ॥
translation: FORTH on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law, Knowing this sacrifice's course.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र धारा मध्वो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते । हविर्हविष्षु वन्द्यः ॥
translation: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of meath, most excellent, Oblation best of all in worth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र युजो वाचो अग्रियो वृषाव चक्रदद्वने । सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः ॥
translation: About the holy place, the Steer true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth Continuous voices in the wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा वसानो अर्षति । स्वर्वाजी सिषासति ॥
translation: When, clothed in manly strength, the Sage flows in celestial wisdom round, The Strong would win the light of heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति । यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः ॥
translation: When purified, he sits as King above the hosts, among his folk, What time the sages bring him nigh.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति । रेभो वनुष्यते मती ॥
translation: Dear, golden-coloured, in the fleece he sinks and settles in the wood: The Singer shows his zeal in hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति । रणा यो अस्य धर्मभिः ॥
translation: He goes to Indra, Vâyu, to the Aṣvins, as his custom is, With gladdening juice which gives them joy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मित्रावरुणा भगं मध्वः पवन्त ऊर्मयः । विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः ॥
translation: Tle streams of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra-Varuṇa,– Well-knowing through his mighty powers. Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth: Gain for us treasures and renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये । श्रवो वसूनि सं जितम् ॥
translation: Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth: Gain for us treasures and renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् । वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम् ॥
translation: OBEYING Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth, Increasing his heroic might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना । ते नो धान्तु सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Laid in the bowl, pure-flowing on to Vâyu and the Aṣvins, may These give us great heroic strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
translation: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart, To sit in place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मृजन्ति त्वा दश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः । अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः ॥
translation: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth, seven ministers impel thee on: The sages have rejoiced in thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कं सृजानमति मेष्यः । सं गोभिर्वासयामसि ॥
translation: When through the filter thou art poured, we clothe thee with a robe of milk To be a gladdening draught for Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः । परि गव्यान्यव्यत ॥
translation: When purified within the jars, Soma, brightred and golden-hued, Hath clothed him with a robe of milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः । इन्दो सखायमा विश ॥
translation: Flow on to us and make us rich. Drive all our enemies away. O Indu, flow into thy Friend. Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us, O Soma, victory in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि । सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः ॥
translation: Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us, O Soma, victory in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतं स्वर्विदम् । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम् ॥
translation: May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light, Gain thee, and progeny and food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयांसि नप्त्योर्हितः । सुवानो याति कविक्रतुः ॥
translation: THE Sage of Heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands and pressed, Sends us delightful powers of life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहे । वीत्यर्ष चनिष्ठया ॥
translation: On, onward to a glorious home; dear to the people void of guile, With excellent enjoyment, flow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् । महान्मही ऋतावृधा ॥
translation: He, the bright Son, when born illumed his Parents who had sprung to life, Great Son great Strengtheners of Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स सप्त धीतिभिर्हितो नद्यो अजिन्वदद्रुहः । या एकमक्षि वावृधुः ॥
translation: Urged by the seven devotions he hath stirred the guileless rivers which Have magnified the Single Eye.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ता अभि सन्तमस्तृतं महे युवानमा दधुः । इन्दुमिन्द्र तव व्रते ॥
translation: These helped to might theYouthful One, high over all, invincible, Even Indu, Indra! in thy law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वह्निरमर्त्यः सप्त पश्यति वावहिः । क्रिविर्देवीरतर्पयत् ॥
translation: The immortal Courser, good to draw, looks down upon the Seven: the fount Hath satisfied the Goddesses
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवा कल्पेषु नः पुमस्तमांसि सोम योध्या । तानि पुनान जङ्घनः ॥
translation: Aid us in holy rites, O Man: O Pavamâna, drive away Dark shades that must be met in fight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नू नव्यसे नवीयसे सूक्ताय साधया पथः । प्रत्नवद्रोचया रुचः ॥
translation: Make the paths ready for a hymn newer and newer evermore: Make the lights shine as erst they shone.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान महि श्रवो गामश्वं रासि वीरवत् । सना मेधां सना स्वः ॥
translation: Give, Pavamâna, high renown, give kine and steeds and hero sons: Win for us wisdom, win the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र स्वानासो रथा इवार्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः । सोमासो राये अक्रमुः ॥
translation: LIKE cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown, Have Soma-drops flowed forth for wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः । भरासः कारिणामिव ॥
translation: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed, Like joyful songs of singing-men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते । यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः ॥
translation: The Somas deck themselves with milk, as Kings are graced with eulogies, And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि सुवानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा । सुता अर्षन्ति धारया ॥
translation: Pressed for the gladdening draught, the drops flow forth abundantly with song, The Soma juices in a stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आपानासो विवस्वतो जनन्त उषसो भगम् । सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते ॥
translation: Winning Vivasvan's glory and producing Morning's light, the Suns Pass through the openings of the cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः । वृष्णो हरस आयवः ॥
translation: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs,– Men, for the mighty to accept.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समीचीनास आसते होतारः सप्तजामयः । पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः ॥
translation: Combined in close society sit the seven priests, the brother-hood, Filling the station of the One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुश्चित्सूर्ये सचा । कवेरपत्यमा दुहे ॥
translation: He gives us kinship with the Gods, and with the Sun unites our eye: The Sage's ofrspring hath appeared.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितम् । सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा ॥
translation: The Sun with his dear eye beholds that quarter of the heavens which priests Have placed within the sacred cell.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाँ इयक्षते ॥
translation: SING forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः । देवं देवाय देवयु ॥
translation: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled milk, Divine, devoted to the God.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते । शं राजन्नोषधीभ्यः ॥
translation: Bring, by thy flowing, weal to kine, weal to the people, weal to steeds. Weal, O thou King, to growing plants
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे । सोमाय गाथमर्चत ॥
translation: Sing a praise-song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might. The Red, who reaches up to heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पुनीतन । मधावा धावता मधु ॥
translation: Purify Soma when effused with stones which bands move rapidly, And pour the sweet milk in the meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन । इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन ॥
translation: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds: To Indra offer Indu up.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे । देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत् ॥
translation: Soma, foe-que chief o'er men, doing the will of pour forth Prosperity upon our kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे । मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः ॥
translation: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, that Indra may drink thee and rejoice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः । इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा ॥
translation: O Soma Pavamâna, give us riches and heroic strength,– Indu! with. Indra for ally.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य सादने । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः ॥
translation: To Indra have the Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, been poured, Shed in the seat of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न मातरः । इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
translation: As mother kine low to their calves, to Indra have the sages called, Called him to drink the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् । सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः ॥
translation: In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his seat, Resting upon a wiId-cow's hide.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते । सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः ॥
translation: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and Seer, is worshipped in the central point Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः सोमः कलशेष्वाँ अन्तः पवित्र आहितः । तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे ॥
translation: In close embraces Indu holds Soma when poured within the jars. And on the. purifying sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
translation: Indu sends forth a voice on high to regions of the sea of air, Shaking the vase that drops with meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धीनामन्तः सबर्दुघः । हिन्वानो मानुषा युगा ॥
translation: The Tree whose praises never fail yields heavenly milk among our hymns, Urging men's generations on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदा सोमो हिन्वानो अर्षति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
translation: The Wise One, with the Sage's stream, the Soma urged to speed, flows on To the dear places of the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसम् । अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम् ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours. Yea. O Indu, give us ready help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः । वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
translation: PASSED through, the fleece in thousand streams the Soma, purified, flows on To Indra's, Viyu's special place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत । सुष्वाणं देववीतये ॥
translation: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamâna, to the Sage, Effused to entertain the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः । गृणाना देववीतये ॥
translation: The Soma-drops with thousand powers are purified for victory, Hymned to become the feast of Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः । द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win the spoil Indu, bring splendid manly might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
translation: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,– These Godlike Soma-drops effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये । वि वारमव्यमाशवः ॥
translation: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, for victory, Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न धेनवः । दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः ॥
translation: Noisily flow the Soma-drops, like milch-kine lowing to their calves: They have run forth from both the hands.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
translation: As Gladdener whom Indra loves, O Pavamâna, with a roar Drive all our enemies away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः । योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
translation: O Pavamamas, driving off the godless, looking on the light, Sit in the place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि श्रितः । कारं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
translation: REPOSING on the river's wave the Sage hath widely flowed around, Bearing the hymn which many love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरा यदी सबन्धवः पञ्च व्राता अपस्यवः । परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम् ॥
translation: When the Five kindred Companies, active in duty, with the song Establish him, the Powerful,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदस्य शुष्मिणो रसे विश्वे देवा अमत्सत । यदी गोभिर्वसायते ॥
translation: Then in his juice whose strength is great, have all the Gods rejoiced themselves, When he hath clothed him in the milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: निरिणानो वि धावति जहच्छर्याणि तान्वा । अत्रा सं जिघ्नते युजा ॥
translation: Freeing himself he flows away, leaving his body's severed limbs, And meets his own Companion here.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नप्तीभिर्यो विवस्वतः शुभ्रो न मामृजे युवा । गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम् ॥
translation: He by the daughters of the priest, like a fair youth, hath been adorned, Making the milk, as 'twere, his robe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अति श्रिती तिरश्चता गव्या जिगात्यण्व्या । वग्नुमियर्ति यं विदे ॥
translation: O'er the fine fingers, through desire of milk, in winding course he goes, And utters voice which he hath found.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि क्षिपः समग्मत मर्जयन्तीरिषस्पतिम् । पृष्ठा गृभ्णत वाजिनः ॥
translation: The nimble fingers have approached, adorning him the Lord of Strength: They grasp the vigorous Courser's back.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि दिव्यानि मर्मृशद्विश्वानि सोम पार्थिवा । वसूनि याह्यस्मयुः ॥
translation: Comprising all the treasures that are in the heavens and on the earth, Come, Soma, as our faithful Friend.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष धिया यात्यण्व्या शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
translation: THROUGH the fine fingers, with the song, this Hero comes with rapid ears, Going to Indra's special place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये । यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
translation: In holy thought he ponders much for the great worship of the Gods. Where the Immortals have their seat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुभ्रावता पथा । यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
translation: Like a good horse is he led out, when on the path that shines with light The mettled steeds exert their strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो३ वृषा । नृम्णा दधान ओजसा ॥
translation: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them Bull who leads the herd, Doing with might heroic deeds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजी शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः । पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन् ॥
translation: He moves, a vigorous Steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold, Becoming Sovran of the streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष वसूनि पिब्दना परुषा ययिवाँ अति । अव शादेषु गच्छति ॥
translation: He, over places rough to pass, bringing rich treasures closely packed. Descends into the reservoirs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः । प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः ॥
translation: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified, Him who brings forth abundant food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सप्त धीतयः । स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम् ॥
translation: Him, even him, the fingers ten and the seven songs make beautiful, Well-weaponed, best of gladdeners.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ते सोतार ओण्यो३ रसं मदाय घृष्वये । सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः ॥
translation: THE pressers from the Soma-press send forth thy juice for rapturous joy The speckled sap runs like a flood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रत्वा दक्षस्य रथ्यमपो वसानमन्धसा । गोषामण्वेषु सश्चिम ॥
translation: With strength we follow through the sieve him who brings might and wins the kine, Enrobed in water with his juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनप्तमप्सु दुष्टरं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
translation: Pour on the sieve the Soma, ne'er subdued in waters, waterless, And make it pure for Indra's drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र पुनानस्य चेतसा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । क्रत्वा सधस्थमासदत् ॥
translation: Moved by the purifier's thought, the Soma flows into the sieve: By wisdom it hath gained its home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र त्वा नमोभिरिन्दव इन्द्र सोमा असृक्षत । महे भराय कारिणः ॥
translation: With humble homage, Indra, have the Soma-drops flowed forth to thee, Contending for the glorious prize.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो रूपे अव्यये विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
translation: Purified in his fleecy garb, attaining every beauty, he Stands, hero-like, amid the kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवो न सानु पिप्युषी धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । वृथा पवित्रे अर्षति ॥
translation: Swelling, as 'twere, to heights of heaven, the stream of the creative juice Falls lightly on the cleansing sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं तना पुनान आयुषु । अव्यो वारं वि धावसि ॥
translation: Thus, Soma, purifying himwho knoweth song mid living men, Thou wanderest through the cloth of wool.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र निम्नेनेव सिन्धवो घ्नन्तो वृत्राणि भूर्णयः । सोमा असृग्रमाशवः ॥
translation: LIKE rivers down a steep descent, slaying the Vr̥itras, full of zeal, The rapid Soma-streams have flowed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि सुवानास इन्दवो वृष्टयः पृथिवीमिव । इन्द्रं सोमासो अक्षरन् ॥
translation: The drops of Soma juice effused fall like the rain upon the earth: To Indra flow the Soma-streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्यूर्मिर्मत्सरो मदः सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
translation: With swelling wave the gladdening drink, the Soma, flows into.the sieve, Loving the Gods and slaying fiends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । उक्थैर्यज्ञेषु वर्धते ॥
translation: It hastens to the pitchers, poured upon the sieve it waxes strong At sacrifices through the lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अति त्री सोम रोचना रोहन्न भ्राजसे दिवम् । इष्णन्त्सूर्यं न चोदयः ॥
translation: Soma, thou shinest mounting heaven as 'twere above light's triple realm, And moving secm'st to speed the Sun.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि विप्रा अनूषत मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य कारवः । दधानाश्चक्षसि प्रियम् ॥
translation: To him, the head of sacnfice, singers and bards have sung their songs, Offering what he loves to see.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमु त्वा वाजिनं नरो धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः । मृजन्ति देवतातये ॥
translation: The men, the sages with their hymns, eager for help, deck thee strong steed, Deck thee for service of the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मधोर्धारामनु क्षर तीव्रः सधस्थमासदः । चारुॠताय पीतये ॥
translation: Flow onward to the stream of meath rest efficacious in thy home, Fair, to be drunk at sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि सुवानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षाः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
translation: THOU, Soma, dweller on the hills, effused, hast flowed into the sieve,: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
translation: Thou art a sacred Bard, a Sage; the meath is offspring of thy sap: All-bountcous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
translation: All Deities of one accord have come that they may drink of thee: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यो विश्वानि वार्या वसूनि हस्तयोर्दधे । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
translation: He who containeth in his hands all treasures much to be desired: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य इमे रोदसी मही सं मातरेव दोहते । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
translation: Who milketh out this mighty Pair, the Earth and Heaven, like mother kine All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि यो रोदसी उभे सद्यो वाजेभिरर्षति । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
translation: Who in a moment mightily floweth around these two world-halvcs: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स शुष्मी कलशेष्वा पुनानो अचिक्रदत् । मदेषु सर्वधा असि ॥
translation: The Strong One, being purified, hath in the pitchers cried aloud: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु । तन्नः पुनान आ भर ॥
translation: O SOMA, being purified bring us the wondrous treasure, meet For lauds, that is in earth and heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: युवं हि स्थः स्वर्पती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
translation: For ye Twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of the light, Lords of the kine: Great Rulers, prosper ye our songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा पुनान आयुषु स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि । हरिः सन्योनिमासदत् ॥
translation: The tawny Steer, while cleansed among the living, bellowing on the grass, Hath sunk and settled in his home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अवावशन्त धीतयो वृषभस्याधि रेतसि । सूनोर्वत्सस्य मातरः ॥
translation: Over the Steer's productive flow the sacred songs were resonant, The mothers of the darling Son.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कुविद्वृषण्यन्तीभ्यः पुनानो गर्भमादधत् । याः शुक्रं दुहते पयः ॥
translation: Hath he not, purified, impregned the kine whb long to meet their Lord, The kine who yield the shining milk?
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रुषु । पवमान विदा रयिम् ॥
translation: Bring near us those who stand aloof strike fear into our enemies: O Pavamâna, find us wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि शत्रोः सोम वृष्ण्यं नि शुष्मं नि वयस्तिर । दूरे वा सतो अन्ति वा ॥
translation: Soma, bring down the foeman's might, his vigorous strength and vital powe'r, Whether he be afar or near.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः ॥
translation: FORTH through the straining-cloth the Sage flows to the banquet of the Gods, Subduing all our enemies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति । पवमानः सहस्रिणम् ॥
translation: For he, as Pavamâna, sends thousandfold treasure in the shape Of cattle to the singing-men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृशसे पवसे मती । स नः सोम श्रवो विदः ॥
translation: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts As such, O Soma, find us fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं रयिम् । इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
translation: Pour lofty glory on us, send sure riches to our liberal lords, Bring food to those who sing thy praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमा विवेशिथ । पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत ॥
translation: As thou art cleansed, O Wondrous Steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like A pious King, into the songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । सोमश्चमूषु सीदति ॥
translation: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made clean With hands, is resting in the jars.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: क्रीळुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest, Soma, to the sieve, Lending the laud a Hero's strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते धावन्तीन्दवः सोमा इन्द्राय घृष्वयः । मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः ॥
translation: To Indra flow these running drops, these Somas frolicsome in mood. Exhilarating, finding light;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रवृण्वन्तो अभियुजः सुष्वये वरिवोविदः । स्वयं स्तोत्रे वयस्कृतः ॥
translation: Driving off foes, bestowing room upon the presser, willingly Bringing their praiser vitalforce.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृथा क्रीळन्त इन्दवः सधस्थमभ्येकमित् । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरन् ॥
translation: Lightly disporting them, the drops flow to one common reservoir, And fall into the river's wave.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते विश्वानि वार्या पवमानास आशत । हिता न सप्तयो रथे ॥
translation: These Pavamânas have obtained all blessings much to be desired, Like coursers harnessed to a car.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आस्मिन्पिशङ्गमिन्दवो दधाता वेनमादिशे । यो अस्मभ्यमरावा ॥
translation: With view to us, O Soma-drops, bestow his manifold desire On him who yet hath given us naught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋभुर्न रथ्यं नवं दधाता केतमादिशे । शुक्राः पवध्वमर्णसा ॥
translation: Bring us our wish with this design, as a wright brings his new-wrought wheel: Flow pure and shining with the stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एत उ त्ये अवीवशन्काष्ठां वाजिनो अक्रत । सतः प्रासाविषुर्मतिम् ॥
translation: These drops have cried with resonant voice: like swift steeds they have run the course, And roused the good man's hymn to life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते सोमास आशवो रथा इव प्र वाजिनः । सर्गाः सृष्टा अहेषत ॥
translation: THESE rapid Soma-streams have stirred themselves to motion like strong steeds, Like cars, like armies hurried forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते वाता इवोरवः पर्जन्यस्येव वृष्टयः । अग्नेरिव भ्रमा वृथा ॥
translation: Swift as wide winds they lightly move, like rain-storms of Parjanya, like The flickering flames of burning fire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः । विपा व्यानशुर्धियः ॥
translation: These Soma juices, blent with curds, purified, skilled in sacred hymns, Have gained by song their hearts'desire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते मृष्टा अमर्त्याः ससृवांसो न शश्रमुः । इयक्षन्तः पथो रजः ॥
translation: Immortal, cleansed, these drops, since first they flowed, have never wearied, fain To reach the regions and their paths.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते पृष्ठानि रोदसोर्विप्रयन्तो व्यानशुः । उतेदमुत्तमं रजः ॥
translation: Advancing they have travelled o'er the ridges of the earth and heaven, And this the highest realm of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तन्तुं तन्वानमुत्तममनु प्रवत आशत । उतेदमुत्तमाय्यम् ॥
translation: Over the heights have they attained the highest thread that is spun out, And this which must be deemed most high.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोम पणिभ्य आ वसु गव्यानि धारयः । ततं तन्तुमचिक्रदः ॥
translation: Thou, Soma, boldest wealth in kine which thou hast seized from niggard churls: Thou calledst forth the outspun thread.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमा असृग्रमाशवो मधोर्मदस्य धारया । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
translation: SWIFT Soma drops have been effused in streams of meath, the gladdening drink, For sacred lore of every kind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अनु प्रत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः । रुचे जनन्त सूर्यम् ॥
translation: Hither to newer. resting-place the ancient Living Ones are come. They made the Sun that he might shine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवमान नो भरार्यो अदाशुषो गयम् । कृधि प्रजावतीरिषः ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, bring to us the unsacrificing foeman's wealth, And give us food with progeny.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
translation: The living Somas being cleansed diffuse exhilarating drink, Turned to the vat which drips with meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमो अर्षति धर्णसिर्दधान इन्द्रियं रसम् । सुवीरो अभिशस्तिपाः ॥
translation: Soma gows on intelligent, possessing sap and mighty strength, Brave Hero who repels the curse.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्राय सोम पवसे देवेभ्यः सधमाद्यः । इन्दो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
translation: For Indra, Soma! thou art cleansed, a feast-companion for the Gods:
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य पीत्वा मदानामिन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रति । जघान जघनच्च नु ॥
translation: When he had drunken draughts of this, Indra smote down resistless foes: Yea, smote them, and shall smite them still.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः । श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत ॥
translation: HITHERWARD have the Soma streamed, the drops while they are purified: When bIent, in waters they are rinsed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत ॥
translation: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice: They come to Indra, being cleansed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय पातवे । नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे ॥
translation: O Soma Pavamâna, thou art flowing to be Indra's drink: The men have seized and lead thee forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीसहे । सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः ॥
translation: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow, delighting men, To him who ruleth o'er mankind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिधावसि । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
translation: Thou, Indu, when, effused by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art, Ready for Indra's high decree.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वृत्रहन्तमोक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः । शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः ॥
translation: Flow on, best Vr̥itra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds. Pure, purifying, wonderful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतस्य मध्वः । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
translation: Pure, purifying is he called the Soma of the meath eflused, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे । मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः ॥
translation: GREEN-HUED! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught For Vâyu and the Marut host.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान धिया हितो३ऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् । धर्मणा वायुमा विश ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, sent by song, roaring about thy dwelling-place, Pass into Vâyu as Law bids.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
translation: The Steer shines with the Deities, dear Sage in his appointed home, Foe-Slayer, most beloved by Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन्पुनानो याति हर्यतः । यत्रामृतास आसते ॥
translation: Taking each beauteous form, he goes, desirable, while purified, Thither where- the Immortals sit.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अरुषो जनयन्गिरः सोमः पवत आयुषक् । इन्द्रं गच्छन्कविक्रतुः ॥
translation: To Indra Soma flows, the Red, engendering song, exceeding wise, The visitor of living men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
translation: Flow, best exhilarator, Sage, flow to the filter in a stream To seat thee in the place of song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तममृक्षन्त वाजिनमुपस्थे अदितेरधि । विप्रासो अण्व्या धिया ॥
translation: THE sages with the fingers' art have dressed and decked that vigorous Steed Upon the lap of Aditi,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं गावो अभ्यनूषत सहस्रधारमक्षितम् । इन्दुं धर्तारमा दिवः ॥
translation: The kine have called aloud to him exhaustless with a thousand streams, To Indu who supporteth heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं वेधां मेधयाह्यन्पवमानमधि द्यवि । धर्णसिं भूरिधायसम् ॥
translation: Him, nourisher of many, Sage, creative Pavamâna, they Have sent, by wisdom, to the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमह्यन्भुरिजोर्धिया संवसानं विवस्वतः । पतिं वाचो अदाभ्यम् ॥
translation: Him, dweller with Vivasvan, they with use of both arms have sent forth, The Lord of Speech infallible.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं सानावधि जामयो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । हर्यतं भूरिचक्षसम् ॥
translation: Him, green, beloved, many eyed, the Sisters with prosing stones Send down to ridges of the sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा हिन्वन्ति वेधसः पवमान गिरावृधम् । इन्दविन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, Indu, priests hurry thee on to Indra, thee Who aidest song and cheerest him.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते । पुनानो घ्नन्नप स्रिधः ॥
translation: THIS Sage, exalted by our lauds, flows to the purifying cloth, Scattering foes as he is cleansed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते । पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः ॥
translation: As giving power and winning light, for Indra and for Vâyu he Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः । सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित् ॥
translation: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, Omniscient, and the Head of Heaven, Effused into the vats of wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः । इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः ॥
translation: Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamâna lowed, Still Conqueror, never overcome.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष सूर्येण हासते पवमानो अधि द्यवि । पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः ॥
translation: This Pavamâna, gladdening draught, drops on the filtering cloth, and then Mounts up with Sûrya to the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
translation: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed, This Indu, being purified.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः । अव्यो वारं वि धावति ॥
translation: URGED by the men, this vigorous Steed, Lord of the mind, Omniscient, Runs to the woollen straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा धामान्याविशन् ॥
translation: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused, Entering all their essences.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः ॥
translation: He shines in beauty there, this God Immortal in his dwelling-place, Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः । अभि द्रोणानि धावति ॥
translation: Directed by the Sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer Runs onward to the wooden vats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो विचर्षणिः । विश्वा धामानि विश्ववित् ॥
translation: This Pavamâna, swiftand strong, Omniscient, gave spleudour to The Sun and all his forms of light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
translation: This Soma being purified, flows mighty and infallible, Slayer of sinners, dear toGods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा । देवाँ अनु प्रभूषतः ॥
translation: FORWARD with mighty force have flowed the currents of this Steer effused, Of him who sets him by the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा । ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम् ॥
translation: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the Steed, Brought forth as light that merits laud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
translation: These things thou winnest lightly while purified, Soma, Lord of wealth: Fill full the sea that claims our praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वा वसूनि संजयन्पवस्व सोम धारया । इनु द्वेषांसि सध्र्यक् ॥
translation: Winning all precious things at once, flow on, O Soma, with thy stream Drive to one place our enemies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रक्षा सु नो अररुषः स्वनात्समस्य कस्य चित् । निदो यत्र मुमुच्महे ॥
translation: Preserve us from the godless, from ill-omened voice of one and all, That so we may be freed from blame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एन्दो पार्थिवं रयिं दिव्यं पवस्व धारया । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भर ॥
translation: O Indu, as thou flowest on bring us the wealth of earth and heaven, And splendid vigour, in thy stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र धारा अस्य शुष्मिणो वृथा पवित्रे अक्षरन् । पुनानो वाचमिष्यति ॥
translation: STREAMS of this Potent One have flowed easily to the straining-cloth: While he is cleansed he lifts his voice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुर्हियानः सोतृभिर्मृज्यमानः कनिक्रदत् । इयर्ति वग्नुमिन्द्रियम् ॥
translation: Indu, by pressers urged to speed, bellowing out while beautified. Sends forth a very mighty sound.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः शुष्मं नृषाह्यं वीरवन्तं पुरुस्पृहम् । पवस्व सोम धारया ॥
translation: Pour on us, Soma, with thy stream manconquering might which many crave, Accompanied with hero sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमो अति धारया पवमानो असिष्यदत् । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम् ॥
translation: Hither hath Pavamâna flowed, Soma flowed hither in a stream, To settle in the vats of wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्सु त्वा मधुमत्तमं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: To waters with the stones they drive thee tawny-hued, most rich in sweets, O Indu, to be Indra's drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुनोता मधुमत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । चारुं शर्धाय मत्सरम् ॥
translation: For Indra, for the Thunderer press the Soma very rich in sweets, Lovely, inspiriting, for strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासः स्वाध्य१ः पवमानासो अक्रमुः । रयिं कृण्वन्ति चेतनम् ॥
translation: THE, Soma-drops, benevolent, come forth as they are purified, Bestowing wealth which all may see.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवस्पृथिव्या अधि भवेन्दो द्युम्नवर्धनः । भवा वाजानां पतिः ॥
translation: O Indu, high o'er heaven and earth be thou, increaser of our might: The Master of all strength be thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यं वाता अभिप्रियस्तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । सोम वर्धन्ति ते महः ॥
translation: The winds are gracious in their love to thee, the rivers flow to thee Soma, they multiply thy power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् । भवा वाजस्य संगथे ॥
translation: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee: Be in the gathering-Place of strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्यं गावो घृतं पयो बभ्रो दुदुह्रे अक्षितम् । वर्षिष्ठे अधि सानवि ॥
translation: For thee, brown-hued! the kine have poured imperishable oil and milk. Aloft on the sublimest height.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वायुधस्य ते सतो भुवनस्य पते वयम् । इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
translation: Friendship, O Indu, we desire with thee who bearest noble arms, With thee, O Lord of all that is.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनः । सुता विदथे अक्रमुः ॥
translation: THE rapture-shedding Soma-drops, effused in our assembly, have Flowed forth to glorify our prince.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: Then Trita's Maidens onward urge the Tawny-coloured with the stones, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् । अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते ॥
translation: Now like a swan he maketh all the company sing each his hymn: He, like a steed, is bathed in milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभे सोमावचाकशन्मृगो न तक्तो अर्षसि । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
translation: O Soma, viewing heaven and earth, thou runncst like a darting deer Set in the place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि गावो अनूषत योषा जारमिव प्रियम् । अगन्नाजिं यथा हितम् ॥
translation: The cows have sung with joy to him, even as a woman to her love He came as to a settled race.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मे धेहि द्युमद्यशो मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च । सनिं मेधामुत श्रवः ॥
translation: Bestow illustrious fame on us, both on our liberal lords and me, Glory, intelligence, and wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपां न यन्त्यूर्मयः । वनानि महिषा इव ॥
translation: LIKE waves of waters, skilled in song the juices of the Soma speed Onward, as buffaloes to woods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
translation: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store Of kine into the wooden vats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमा अर्षन्ति विष्णवे ॥
translation: To Indra, Vâyu, Varuṇa, to Vishṇu, and the Maruts, flow The drops of Soma juice effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः । हरिरेति कनिक्रदत् ॥
translation: Three several words are uttered: kine are lowing, cows who give their milk: The Tawny-hued goes bellowing on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीॠतस्य मातरः । मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवः शिशुम् ॥
translation: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise: They decorate the Child of Heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रायः समुद्राँश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः ॥
translation: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas Filled full of riches thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सुवानो धारया तनेन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति । रुजद्दृळ्हा व्योजसा ॥
translation: THE drop of Soma juice effused flows onward with this stream impelled. Rending strong places with its might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुत इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
translation: Poured forth to Indra, Varuṇa, to Vâyu and the Marut hosts, To Vishṇu, flows the Soma juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषाणं वृषभिर्यतं सुन्वन्ति सोममद्रिभिः । दुहन्ति शक्मना पयः ॥
translation: With stones they press the Soma forth, the Strong conducted by the strong: They milk the liquor out with skill.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: भुवत्त्रितस्य मर्ज्यो भुवदिन्द्राय मत्सरः । सं रूपैरज्यते हरिः ॥
translation: 'Tis he whom Trita must refine, 'tis he who shall make Indra glad: The Tawny One is decked with tints.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभीमृतस्य विष्टपं दुहते पृश्निमातरः । चारु प्रियतमं हविः ॥
translation: Him do the Sons of Pr̥iṣni milk, the dwelling-place of sacrifice, Oblation lovely and most dear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समेनमह्रुता इमा गिरो अर्षन्ति सस्रुतः । धेनूर्वाश्रो अवीवशत् ॥
translation: To him in one unitcd stream th-,se songs flow on straight forward. he, Loud voiced, hath made the milch-kine low.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः पवस्व धारया पवमान रयिं पृथुम् । यया ज्योतिर्विदासि नः ॥
translation: Pour forth on us abundant wealth, O Pavamâna, with thy stream. Wherewith thou mayest find us light
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दो समुद्रमीङ्खय पवस्व विश्वमेजय । रायो धर्ता न ओजसा ॥
translation: O Indu, swayer of the sea, shaker of all things, flow thou on, Bearer of wealth to us with might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वया वीरेण वीरवोऽभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः । क्षरा णो अभि वार्यम् ॥
translation: With thee for Hero, Valiant One! may we subdue our enemies: Let what is precious flow to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith
