sanskrit: प्र वाजमिन्दुरिष्यति सिषासन्वाजसा ऋषिः । व्रता विदान आयुधा ॥
translation: Indu arouses strength the Sage who strives for victory, winning power, Discovering holy works and means.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं गीर्भिर्वाचमीङ्खयं पुनानं वासयामसि । सोम जनस्य गोपतिम् ॥
translation: Mover of speech, we robe him with our songs as he is purified Soma, the Guardian of the folk;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वो यस्य व्रते जनो दाधार धर्मणस्पतेः । पुनानस्य प्रभूवसोः ॥
translation: On whose way, Lord of Holy Law, most richi as he is purified. The people all have set their hearts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः । कार्ष्मन्वाजी न्यक्रमीत् ॥
translation: FORTH from the mortar is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve: The Steed steps forward to the goal.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वह्निः सोम जागृविः पवस्व देववीरति । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
translation: Thus, Soma, watchful, bearing well, cheering the Gods, flow past the sieve, Turned to the vat that drops with meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो ज्योतींषि पूर्व्य पवमान वि रोचय । क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु ॥
translation: Excellent Pavamâna, make the lights shine brightly out for us. Speed us to mental power and skill.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुम्भमान ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । पवते वारे अव्यये ॥
translation: He, beautified by pious men, and coming from their hands adorned, Flows through the fleecy straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमो दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवतामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
translation: May Soma pour all treasures of the heavens, the earth, the firmament Upon the liberal worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ दिवस्पृष्ठमश्वयुर्गव्ययुः सोम रोहसि । वीरयुः शवसस्पते ॥
translation: Thou mountest to the height of heaven, O Soma, seeking steeds and kine, And seeking heroes, Lord of Strength!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
translation: SOMA, the Steer, effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् ॥
translation: Far-sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve, intelligent, Bellowing, to his place of rest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥
translation: This vigorous Pavamâna runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven, Fiend-slayer, through the fleecy sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् । जामिभिः सूर्यं सह ॥
translation: This Payamana up above Trita's high ridge hath made the Sun, Together with the Sisters, shine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः । सोमो वाजमिवासरत् ॥
translation: This Vr̥itra-slaying Steer, effused, Soma room-giver, ne'er deceived, Hath gone, as 'twere, to win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स देवः कविनेषितो३ऽभि द्रोणानि धावति । इन्दुरिन्द्राय मंहना ॥
translation: Urged onward by the sage, the God speeds forward to the casks of wood, Indu to Indra willingly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । गच्छन्वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
translation: THIS Steer, this Chariot, rushes through the woollen filter, as he goes To war that wins a thousand spoils.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: The Dames of Trita with the stones onward impel this Tawny One Indu to Indra for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं त्यं हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते ॥
translation: Ten active fingers carefully adorn him here; they make him bright And beauteous for the gladdening draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति । गच्छञ्जारो न योषितम् ॥
translation: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men. Speeding like lover to his love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः । य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत् ॥
translation: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven, This Soma-drop that pierced the sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम् ॥
translation: Poured for the draught, this tawny juice flows forth, intelligent, crying out, Unto the well-beloved place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना । यत्र देवा इति ब्रवन् ॥
translation: FLOW On, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form, Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः । वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव ॥
translation: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man, Make thou the rain descend from heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा । विचक्षाणो विरोचयन् ॥
translation: With might, bestowing power, thejuice enters the purifying sieve, Far-seeing, sending forth its light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत् ॥
translation: This is it which in rapid course hath with the river's wave flowed down From heaven upon the straining cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः । इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु ॥
translation: Inviting him frorh far away, and even from near at hand, the juice For Indra is poured forth as meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । योनावृतस्य सीदत ॥
translation: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the Tawny One. Sit in the place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः । शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः ॥
translation: THE Very Active hath assailed, while purified, all enemies: They deck the Sage with holy songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रं वृषा सुतः । ध्रुवे सदसि सीदति ॥
translation: The Red hath mounted to his place; to India, goes the mighty juice: He settles in his firm abode.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नू नो रयिं महामिन्दोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥
translation: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side, Pour on us treasures thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वा सोम पवमान द्युम्नानीन्दवा भर । विदाः सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
translation: O Soma Pavamâna, bring, Indu, all splcndours hitherward: Find for us food in boundless store.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् । जरितुर्वर्धया गिरः ॥
translation: As thou art cleansed, bring hero strength and riches to thy worshipper, And prosper thou the singer's hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । वृषन्निन्दो न उक्थ्यम् ॥
translation: O Indu, Soma, being cleansed, bring hither riches doublypiled, Wealth, mighty Indu, meet for lauds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ये गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः । घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम् ॥
translation: ACTIVE and bright have they come forth, impetuous in speed like bulls, Driving the black skin far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराव्यम् । साह्वांसो दस्युमव्रतम् ॥
translation: Quelling the riteless Dasyu, may we think upon the bridge of bliss, Leaving the bridge of woe behind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः । चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि ॥
translation: The mighty Pavamâna's roar is heard as 'twere the rush of rain Lightnings are flashing to the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । अश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः ॥
translation: Pour out on us abundant food, when thou art pressed, O Indu wealth In kine and gold and steeds and spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवस्व विचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण । उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ॥
translation: Flow on thy way, Most Active, thou. fill full the mighty heavens and earth, As Dawn, as Sûrya with his beams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि णः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः । सरा रसेव विष्टपम् ॥
translation: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream, As Rasâ flows around the world.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जनयन्रोचना दिवो जनयन्नप्सु सूर्यम् । वसानो गा अपो हरिः ॥
translation: ENGENDERING the Sun in floods, engendering heaven's lights, green-hued, Robed in the waters and the milk,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । धारया पवते सुतः ॥
translation: According to primeval plan this Soma, with his stream, effused Flows purely on, a God for Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वावृधानाय तूर्वये पवन्ते वाजसातये । सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः ॥
translation: For him victorious, waxen great, the juices with a thousand powers Are purified for winning spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । क्रन्दन्देवाँ अजीजनत् ॥
translation: Shedding the ancient fluid he is poured into the cleansing sieve: He, thundering, hath produced the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि विश्वानि वार्याभि देवाँ ऋतावृधः । सोमः पुनानो अर्षति ॥
translation: Soma, while purifying, sends hither all things to be desired, He sends the Gods who strengthen Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गोमन्नः सोम वीरवदश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः । पवस्व बृहतीरिषः ॥
translation: Soma, effused, pour on us wealth in kine, in heroes, steeds, and spoil, Send us abundant store of food.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अत्य इव मृज्यते गोभिर्मदाय हर्यतः । तं गीर्भिर्वासयामसि ॥
translation: WE will enrobe with sacred song the Lovely One who, as a Steed, Is decked with milk for rapturous joy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं नो विश्वा अवस्युवो गिरः शुम्भन्ति पूर्वथा । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: All songs of ours desiring grace adorn him in the ancient way, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो याति हर्यतः सोमो गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः । विप्रस्य मेध्यातिथेः ॥
translation: Soma flows on when purified, beloved and adorned with songs, Songs of the sage Medhyâtithi.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम सुश्रियम् । इन्दो सहस्रवर्चसम् ॥
translation: O Soma Pavamâna, find exceeding glorious wealth for us, Wealth, Indu, fraught with boundless might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुरत्यो न वाजसृत्कनिक्रन्ति पवित्र आ । यदक्षारति देवयुः ॥
translation: Like courser racing to the prize Indu, the lover of the Gods, Roars, as he passes, in the sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वाजसातये विप्रस्य गृणतो वृधे । सोम रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Flow on thy way to win us strength, to speed the sage who praises thee: Soma, bestow heroic power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ण इन्दो महे तन ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि । अभि देवाँ अयास्यः ॥
translation: INDU, to us for this great rite, bearing as 'twere thy wave to Gods, Unwearied, thou art flowing forQh.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मती जुष्टो धिया हितः सोमो हिन्वे परावति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः ॥
translation: Pleased with the hymn, impelled by prayer, Soma is hurried far away, The Wise One in the Singer's stream.,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं देवेषु जागृविः सुत एति पवित्र आ । सोमो याति विचर्षणिः ॥
translation: Watchful among the. gods, this juice advances to the cleansing sieve Soma, most active, travels on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पवस्व वाजयुश्चक्राणश्चारुमध्वरम् । बर्हिष्माँ आ विवासति ॥
translation: Flow onward, seeking strength for us, embellishing the sacrifice: The priest with trimmed grass calleth thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो भगाय वायवे विप्रवीरः सदावृधः । सोमो देवेष्वा यमत् ॥
translation: May Soma, ever bringing power to Bhaga and to Vâyu, Sage And Hero, lead us to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो अद्य वसुत्तये क्रतुविद्गातुवित्तमः । वाजं जेषि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
translation: So, to increase our wealth to-day, Inspirer, best of Furtherers, Win for us strength and high renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवस्व मदाय कं नृचक्षा देववीतये । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: FLOW, thou who viewest men, to give delight, to entertain the Gods, Indu, to Indra for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो अर्षाभि दूत्यं१ त्वमिन्द्राय तोशसे । देवान्त्सखिभ्य आ वरम् ॥
translation: Stream to thine embassy for us: thou hastenest, for Indra, to The Gods, O better than our friends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्वामरुणं वयं गोभिरञ्ज्मो मदाय कम् । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
translation: We balm thee, red of hue, with milk to fit thee for the rapturous joy: Unbar for us the doors of wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अत्यू पवित्रमक्रमीद्वाजी धुरं न यामनि । इन्दुर्देवेषु पत्यते ॥
translation: He through the sieve hath passed, as comes a courser to the pole, to run Indu belongs unto the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समी सखायो अस्वरन्वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् । इन्दुं नावा अनूषत ॥
translation: All friends have lauded him as he sports in the wood, beyond the fleece: Singers have chanted Indu's praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया पीतो विचक्षसे । इन्दो स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Flow, Indu, with that stream wherein steeped thou announcest to the man Who worships thee heroic strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृग्रन्देववीतयेऽत्यासः कृत्व्या इव । क्षरन्तः पर्वतावृधः ॥
translation: LIKE able coursers they have been sent forth to be the feast of Gods, joying in mountains, flowing on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परिष्कृतास इन्दवो योषेव पित्र्यावती । वायुं सोमा असृक्षत ॥
translation: To Vâyu flow the Soma-streams, the drops of juice made beautiful Like a bride dowered by her sire.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते सोमास इन्दवः प्रयस्वन्तश्चमू सुताः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति कर्मभिः ॥
translation: Pressed in the mortar, these, the drops of juice, the Somas rich in food, Give strength to Indra with their work.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ धावता सुहस्त्यः शुक्रा गृभ्णीत मन्थिना । गोभिः श्रीणीत मत्सरम् ॥
translation: Deft-handed men, run hither, seize the brilliant juices blent with meal, And cook with milk the gladdening draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवस्व धनंजय प्रयन्ता राधसो महः । अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
translation: Thus, Soma, Conqueror of wealth! flow, finding furtherance for us, Giver oF ample opulence.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं पवमानं दश क्षिपः । इन्द्राय मत्सरं मदम् ॥
translation: This Pavamâna, meet to be adorned, the fingers ten adorn, The draught that shall make Indra glad.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया सोमः सुकृत्यया महश्चिदभ्यवर्धत । मन्दान उद्वृषायते ॥
translation: GREAT as he was, Soma hath gained strength by this high solemnity: joyous he riseth like a bull.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कृतानीदस्य कर्त्वा चेतन्ते दस्युतर्हणा । ऋणा च धृष्णुश्चयते ॥
translation: His task is done: his crushings of the Dasyus are made manifest: He sternly reckoneth their debts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आत्सोम इन्द्रियो रसो वज्रः सहस्रसा भुवत् । उक्थं यदस्य जायते ॥
translation: Soon as his song of praise is born, the Soma, Indra's juice, becomes A thousand-winning thunderbolt.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स्वयं कविर्विधर्तरि विप्राय रत्नमिच्छति । यदी मर्मृज्यते धियः ॥
translation: Seer and Sustainer, he himself desireth riches for the sage When he embellisheth his songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिषासतू रयीणां वाजेष्वर्वतामिव । भरेषु जिग्युषामसि ॥
translation: Fain would they both win riches as in races of the steeds. In war Thou art upon the conquerors' side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः । चारुं सुकृत्ययेमहे ॥
translation: WITH sacrifice we seek to thee kind Cherisher of manly might In mansions of the lofty heavens;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् । शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम् ॥
translation: Gladdening crusher of the bold, ruling with very mighty sway, Destroyer of a hundred forts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अतस्त्वा रयिमभि राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः । सुपर्णो अव्यथिर्भरत् ॥
translation: Hence, Sapient One! the Falcon, strong of wing, unwearied, brought thee down, Lord over riches, from the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणं रजस्तुरम् । गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत् ॥
translation: That each may see the light, the Bird brought us the guard of Law, the Friend Of all, the speeder through the air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे । अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः ॥
translation: And now, sent forth, it hath attained to mighty power and majesty, Most active, ready to assist.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि । अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः ॥
translation: Poust down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky, And plenteous store of wholesome fbod.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् । जन्यास उप नो गृहम् ॥
translation: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us, The kine of strangers to our home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः । अस्मभ्यय वृष्टिमा पव ॥
translation: Chief Friend of Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream, Ppur down on us a flood of rain.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स न ऊर्जे व्य१व्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया । देवासः शृणवन्हि कम् ॥
translation: To give us vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth For verily the Gods will bear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षांस्यपजङ्घनत् । प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः ॥
translation: Onward hath Pavamâna flowed and beaten off the Raksasas, Flashing out splendour as of old.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः । वाणस्य चोदया पविम् ॥
translation: LOUD as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves: Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः । यदव्य एषि सानवि ॥
translation: At thine effusion upward rise three voices full of joy, when thou Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् ॥
translation: On to the fleece they urge with stone the tawny well-beloved One, Even Pavamâna, dropping meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
translation: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage most powerful to cheer, To seat thee in the place of song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: Flow, Most Exhilarating! flow anointed with the milk for balm, Indu, for Indra, for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे ॥
translation: ADHVARYU, on the filter pour the Soma juice expressed with stones, And make it pure for Indra's drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । सुनोता मधुमत्तमम् ॥
translation: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven,, the Soma's juice, Most excellent, most rich in sweets.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्यश्नते । पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
translation: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu enjoy this juice of thine, This Pavamâna's flowing meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं हि सोम वर्धयन्त्सुतो मदाय भूर्णये । वृषन्त्स्तोतारमूतये ॥
translation: For, Soma, thou hast been effused, strengthening for the wild carouse, O Steer, the singer, for our help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष विचक्षण पवित्रं धारया सुतः । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
translation: Flow with thy stream, Far-sighted One, effused, into the cleansing sieve: Flow on to give us strength and fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि द्युक्षः सनद्रयिर्भरद्वाजं नो अन्धसा । सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ ॥
translation: WEALTH-WINNER, dwelling in the sky, bringing us vigour with the juice, Flow to the filter when effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव प्रत्नेभिरध्वभिरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः । सहस्रधारो यात्तना ॥
translation: So, in thine ancient ways, may he, beloved, with a thousand streams Run o'er the fleecy straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: चरुर्न यस्तमीङ्खयेन्दो न दानमीङ्खय । वधैर्वधस्नवीङ्खय ॥
translation: Him who is like a caldron shake: O Indu, shake thy gift to us Shake it, armed Warrior! with thine arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नि शुष्ममिन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् । यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति ॥
translation: Indu, invoked with many a prayer, bring down the vigour of these men, Of him who threatens us with war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शतं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सहस्रं वा शुचीनाम् । पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
translation: Indu, Wealth-giver, with thine help pour out for us a hundred, yea, A thousand of thy pure bright streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः । नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः ॥
translation: O THOU with stones for arms, thy powers, crushing the fiends, have raised themselves: Chase thou the foes who compass us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसंगे धने हिते । स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा ॥
translation: Thou conquerest thus with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked: With fearless heart will I sing praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या । रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति ॥
translation: No one with evil thought assails this Pavamâna's holy laws: Crush him who fain would fight with thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
translation: For Indra to the streams they drive the tawny rapture-dropping Steed, Indu the bringer of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः । पयः सहस्रसामृषिम् ॥
translation: AFTER his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand gifts.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं सूर्य इवोपदृगयं सरांसि धावति । सप्त प्रवत आ दिवम् ॥
translation: In aspect he is like the Sun; he runneth forward to the lakes, Seven currents flowing through the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि । सोमो देवो न सूर्यः ॥
translation: He, shining in his splendour, stands high over all things that exist- Soma, a God as Sûrya is.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि णो देववीतये वाजाँ अर्षसि गोमतः । पुनान इन्दविन्द्रयुः ॥
translation: Thou, Indu, in thy brilliancy, pourest on us, as Indra's Friend, Wealth from the kine to feast the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टम्पुष्टं परि स्रव । सोम विश्वा च सौभगा ॥
translation: POUR on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment, And, Soma, all felicities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः ॥
translation: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from the juice, Seat thee on the dear sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमान्धसा । मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः ॥
translation: And, finding for us kine and steeds, O Soma, with thy juice flow on Through days that fly most rapidly.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य । स पवस्व सहस्रजित् ॥
translation: As one who conquers, ne'er subdued, attacks and stays the enemy, Thus, Vanquisher of thousands! flow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि सोम ऋतं बृहदाशुः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः ॥
translation: SWIFT to the purifying sieve flows Soma as exalted Law, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्सोमो वाजमर्षति शतं धारा अपस्युवः । इन्द्रस्य सख्यमाविशन् ॥
translation: When Soma pours the strengthening food a hundred ever-active streams To Indra's friendship win theirway.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि त्वा योषणो दश जारं न कन्यानूषत । मृज्यसे सोम सातये ॥
translation: Ten Dames have sung to welcome thee, even as a maiden greets her love: O Soma, thou art decked to win.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्द्राय विष्णवे स्वादुरिन्दो परि स्रव । नॄन्त्स्तोतॄन्पाह्यंहसः ॥
translation: Flow hitherward, O Indu, sweet to Indra and to Vishṇu: guard The men, the singers, from distress.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः । अच्छा वाजं सहस्रिणम् ॥
translation: THY streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven, To bring a thousand stores of strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति । हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा ॥
translation: He flows beholding on his way all wellbeloved sacred lore, Green-tinted, brandishing his, arms.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः । श्येनो न वंसु षीदति ॥
translation: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants. Sits as a falcon in the, wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि । पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
translation: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified, All treasures both of heaven and earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
translation: SWIFT runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
translation: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
translation: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Purushanti's hands: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति ॥
translation: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three times ten beside: Swift runs this giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व गोजिदश्वजिद्विश्वजित्सोम रण्यजित् । प्रजावद्रत्नमा भर ॥
translation: FLOW onward, Soma, winning kine, and steeds, and all that gives delight: Bring hither wealth with progeny.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्वाद्भ्यो अदाभ्यः पवस्वौषधीभ्यः । पवस्व धिषणाभ्यः ॥
translation: Flow onward from the waters, flow, inviolable, from the plants: Flow onward from the pressing-boards.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोम पवमानो विश्वानि दुरिता तर । कविः सीद नि बर्हिषि ॥
translation: Soma, as Pavamâna, pass over all trouble and distress: Sit on the sacred grass, a Sage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान स्वर्विदो जायमानोऽभवो महान् । इन्दो विश्वाँ अभीदसि ॥
translation: Thou, Pavamâna, foundest light; thou at thy birth becamest great: O Indu, thou art over all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र गायत्रेण गायत पवमानं विचर्षणिम् । इन्दुं सहस्रचक्षसम् ॥
translation: SING forth and laud with sacred song most active Pavamâna, laud Indu who sees with thousand eyes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा सहस्रचक्षसमथो सहस्रभर्णसम् । अति वारमपाविषुः ॥
translation: Thee who hast thousand eyes to see, bearer of thousand burthens, they Have filtered through the fleecy cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अति वारान्पवमानो असिष्यदत्कलशाँ अभि धावति । इन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन् ॥
translation: He, Pavamâna, hath streamed through the fleece then: he runs into the jars, Finding his way to Indra's heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे शं पवस्व विचर्षणे । प्रजावद्रेत आ भर ॥
translation: That Indra may be bounteous, flow, most active Soma, for our weal: Bring genial seed with progeny.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा । अवाहन्नवतीर्नव ॥
translation: FLOW onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delight Battered the nine-and-ninety down,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शम्बरम् । अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥
translation: Smote swiftly forts, and gambara, then Yadu and that Turvaga, For pious Divodâsa's sake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि णो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः ॥
translation: Finder of horses, pour on us horses and wealth in kine and gold, And, Indu, food in boundless store.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
translation: We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamâna's flowing o'er The limit of the cleansing sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया । तेभिर्नः सोम मृळय ॥
translation: With those same waves which in their stream oyerflow the purifying sieve, Soma; be gracious unto us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् । ईशानः सोम विश्वतः ॥
translation: O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides,– for thou canst,– Riches and food with hero sons.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरम् । समादित्येभिरख्यत ॥
translation: Him here, the Child whom streams have borne, the ten swift fingers beautify With the Âdityas is he seen.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ । सं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
translation: With Indra and with Vâyu he, effused, flows onward with,the beams Of Sûrya to the cleansing sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् । चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च ॥
translation: Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vâyu, Pûshan flow For Mitra and for Varuṇa.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि षद्भूम्या ददे । उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः ॥
translation: High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Strong sheltering power and great renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणाम् । सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
translation: Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth from the ungodly man, Yea, all the glories of mankind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । वरिवोवित्परि स्रव ॥
translation: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore, For Varuṇa and the Marut host.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः ॥
translation: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk, The active crusher of the foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव । य इन्द्रस्य हृदंसनिः ॥
translation: Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him, Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्षा णः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम् ॥
translation: Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk Increase the sea that merits laud.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् । ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत् ॥
translation: From heaven hath Pavamâna made, as 'twere, the marvellous thunder, and The lofty light of all mankind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते रसो मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः । वि वारमव्यमर्षति ॥
translation: The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, of Pavamâna, King! Flows o'er the woollen straining-cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान रसस्तव दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् । ज्योतिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
translation: Thy juice, O Pavamâna, sends its rays abroad like splendid skill, Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा । देवावीरघशंसहा ॥
translation: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियं सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे । गोषा उ अश्वसा असि ॥
translation: Killing the foeman and his hate, and winning booty every day, Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भव सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभिः । सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
translation: Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast, Falcon-like resting in thine home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स पवस्व य आविथेन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे । वव्रिवांसं महीरपः ॥
translation: Flow onward thou who strengthenedst Indra to slaughter Vr̥itra who Compassed and stayed the mighty floods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुवीरासो वयं धना जयेम सोम मीढ्वः । पुनानो वर्ध नो गिरः ॥
translation: Soma who rainest gifts, may we win riches with our hero sons: Strengthen, as thou art cleansed, our hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वोतासस्तवावसा स्याम वन्वन्त आमुरः । सोम व्रतेषु जागृहि ॥
translation: Aided by thee, and through thy grace, may we be slayers when we war: Watch, Soma, at our solemn rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् ॥
translation: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma flowcth on, Going to Indra's special place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः । रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes: O Indu, grant heroic fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: न त्वा शतं चन ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् । यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे ॥
translation: A hundred obstacles have ne'er checked thee when fain to give thy boons, When, being cleansed, thou combatest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि ॥
translation: Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: Drive all our enemies away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य ते सख्ये वयं तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे । सासह्याम पृतन्यतः ॥
translation: Indu, in this thy friendship most lofty and glorious may we Subdue all those who war with us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे । रक्षा समस्य नो निदः ॥
translation: Those awful weapons that thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down- Guard us therewith from every foe.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । विश्वान्यभि सौभगा ॥
translation: THESE rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieve To bring us all felicities.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः । तना कृण्वन्तो अर्वते ॥
translation: Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser's progeny, Yea, and the warrior steed, success.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम् । इळामस्मभ्यं संयतम् ॥
translation: Bringing prosperity to kine, they make perpetual Iḷâ flow To us for noble eulogy.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असाव्यंशुर्मदायाप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः । श्येनो न योनिमासदत् ॥
translation: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy: Hawk-like he settles in his home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धूतो नृभिः सुतः । स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः ॥
translation: Fair is the God-loved juice; the plant is washed in waters, pressed by men The milch-kine sweeten it with milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आदीमश्वं न हेतारोऽशूशुभन्नमृताय । मध्वो रसं सधमादे ॥
translation: As drivers deck a courser, so have they adorned the meath's juice for Ambrosia, for the festival.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतोऽसृग्रमिन्द ऊतये । ताभिः पवित्रमासदः ॥
translation: Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help, Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो रोमाण्यव्यया । सीदन्योना वनेष्वा ॥
translation: So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow, to be his drink, Finding thine home in vats of wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वमिन्दो परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः । वरिवोविद्घृतं पयः ॥
translation: As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk, O Indu, for the Angirases.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं विचर्षणिर्हितः पवमानः स चेतति । हिन्वान आप्यं बृहत् ॥
translation: Most active and benevolent, this Pavamâna, sent to us For lofty friendship, meditates.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष वृषा वृषव्रतः पवमानो अशस्तिहा । करद्वसूनि दाशुषे ॥
translation: Queller of curses, mighty, with strong sway, this Pavamâna shall Bring treasures to the worshipper.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । पुरुश्चन्द्रं पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
translation: Pour thou upon us thousandfold possessions, both of kine and steeds, Exceeding glorious, much-desired.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष स्य परि षिच्यते मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः । उरुगायः कविक्रतुः ॥
translation: Wandering far, with wise designs, the juice here present is effused, Made beautiful by living men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सहस्रोतिः शतामघो विमानो रजसः कविः । इन्द्राय पवते मदः ॥
translation: For Indra flows the gladdening drink, the measurer of the region, Sage, With countless wealth and endless help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गिरा जात इह स्तुत इन्दुरिन्द्राय धीयते । विर्योना वसताविव ॥
translation: Born on the inountain, lauded here, Indu for Indra is set down, As in her sheltering nest a bird.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानः सुतो नृभिः सोमो वाजमिवासरत् । चमूषु शक्मनासदम् ॥
translation: Pressed by the men, as 'twere to war hath Soma Pavamâna sped, To test with might within the vats.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्रिपृष्ठे त्रिवन्धुरे रथे युञ्जन्ति यातवे । ऋषीणां सप्त धीतिभिः ॥
translation: That he may move, they yoke him to the three-backed triple-seated car By the Seven R̥ishis' holy songs.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं सोतारो धनस्पृतमाशुं वाजाय यातवे । हरिं हिनोत वाजिनम् ॥
translation: Drive ye that Tawny Courser, O ye pressers, on his way to war, Swift Steed who carries off the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आविशन्कलशं सुतो विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति ॥
translation: Pouring all glories hither, he, effused and entering the jar, Stands like a hero mid the kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ त इन्दो मदाय कं पयो दुहन्त्यायवः । देवा देवेभ्यो मधु ॥
translation: Indu, the living men milk out the juice to make the rapturous draught: Gods for the Gods milk out the meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः सोमं पवित्र आ सृजता मधुमत्तमम् । देवेभ्यो देवश्रुत्तमम् ॥
translation: Pour for the Gods into the sieve our Soma very rich in sweets, Him whom the Gods most gladly hear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः श्रवसे महे । मदिन्तमस्य धारया ॥
translation: Into his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured, Lauded with songs for lofty fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि । सनद्वाजः परि स्रव ॥
translation: Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being cleansed: Winning the spoil flow hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः । गृणानो जमदग्निना ॥
translation: And, hymned by Jamadagnis, let all nourishment that kine supply, And general praises, flow to us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
translation: Soma, as leader of the song flow onward with thy wondrous aids, For holy lore of every kind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् । पवस्व विश्वमेजय ॥
translation: Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea, Flow onward, thou who movest all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे । तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः ॥
translation: O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to attest thy might: For thy behoof the rivers flow.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ते दिवो न वृष्टयो धारा यन्त्यसश्चतः । अभि शुक्रामुपस्तिरम् ॥
translation: Like showers of rain that fall from heaven thy streams perpetually flow To the bright fleece spread under them.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायेन्दुं पुनीतनोग्रं दक्षाय साधनम् । ईशानं वीतिराधसम् ॥
translation: For potent Indra purify Indu effectual and strong, Enjoyment-giver, Mighty Lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान ऋतः कविः सोमः पवित्रमासदत् । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Soma, true, Pavamâna, Sage, is seated in the cleansing sieve, Giving his praiser hero strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं सोम सुवीर्यम् । अस्मे श्रवांसि धारय ॥
translation: POUR hitherward, O Soma, wealth in thousands and heroic strength, And keep renown secure for us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषमूर्जं च पिन्वस इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमः । चमूष्वा नि षीदसि ॥
translation: Thou makest food and vigour swell for Indra, best of gladdeners! Within the cups thou seatest thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुत इन्द्राय विष्णवे सोमः कलशे अक्षरत् । मधुमाँ अस्तु वायवे ॥
translation: For Indra and for Vishṇu poured, Soma hath flowed into the jar: May Vâyu find it rich in sweets.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते असृग्रमाशवोऽति ह्वरांसि बभ्रवः । सोमा ऋतस्य धारया ॥
translation: These Somas swift and brown of hue, in stream of solemn sacrifice Have flowed through twisted obstacles,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तो अप्तुरः कृण्वन्तो विश्वमार्यम् । अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः ॥
translation: Performing every noble work, active, augmenting Indra's strength, Driving away the godless ones.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुता अनु स्वमा रजोऽभ्यर्षन्ति बभ्रवः । इन्द्रं गच्छन्त इन्दवः ॥
translation: Brown Soma-drops, effused that seek Indra, to their appropriate place Flow through the region hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः । हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः ॥
translation: Flow onward with that stream of thine wherewith thou gavest Sûrya light, Urging on waters good to men.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
translation: He, Pavamâna, high o'er man yoked the Sun's courser Etaṣa To travel through the realm of air.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत त्या हरितो दश सूरो अयुक्त यातवे । इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन् ॥
translation: And those ten Coursers, tawny-hued, he harnessed that the Sun might come Indu, he said, is Indra's self.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परीतो वायवे सुतं गिर इन्द्राय मत्सरम् । अव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत ॥
translation: Hence, singers, pour the gladdeningjuice to Vâyu and to Indra, pour The drops upon the fleecy cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम दुष्टरम् । यो दूणाशो वनुष्यता ॥
translation: O Soma Pavamâna, find wealth for us not to be assailed, Wealth which the foeman may not win.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभ्यर्ष सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः ॥
translation: Send riches hither with thy stream in thousands, both of steeds and kine, Send spoil of war and high renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सोमो देवो न सूर्योऽद्रिभिः पवते सुतः । दधानः कलशे रसम् ॥
translation: Soma the God, expressed with stones, like Sûrya, floweth on his way, Pouring the juice within the jar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एते धामान्यार्या शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन् ॥
translation: These brilliant drops have poured for us, in stream of solemn sacrifice, Worshipful laws and strength in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सुता इन्द्राय वज्रिणे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । पवित्रमत्यक्षरन् ॥
translation: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Somas, blent with curdled milk, Effused for Indra Thunder-armed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोम मधुमत्तमो राये अर्ष पवित्र आ । मदो यो देववीतमः ॥
translation: Soma, do thou most rich in sweets, a gladdening drink most dear to Gods, Flow to the sieve to bring us wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तमी मृजन्त्यायवो हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम् ॥
translation: For Indra, living men adorn the Tawny Courser in the streams, Indu, the giver of delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व हिरण्यवदश्वावत्सोम वीरवत् । वाजं गोमन्तमा भर ॥
translation: Pour for us, Soma, wealth in gold, in horses and heroic sons, Bring hither strength in herds of kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि वाजे न वाजयुमव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमम् ॥
translation: For Indra pour ye on the fleece him very sweet to taste, who longs. For battle as it were in war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: कविं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः । वृषा कनिक्रदर्षति ॥
translation: The singers, seeking help, adorn the Sage who must be decked with songs: Loud bellowing the Steer comes on,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषणं धीभिरप्तुरं सोममृतस्य धारया । मती विप्राः समस्वरन् ॥
translation: The singers with their thoughts and hymns have, in the stream of sacrifice, Caused Soma, active Steer, to roar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व देवायुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः । वायुमा रोह धर्मणा ॥
translation: God, working with mankind, flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice: To Vâyu mount as Law commands
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिं सोम श्रवाय्यम् । प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
translation: O Soma, Pavamâna, thou pourest out wealth that brings renown: Enter the lake, as one we love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः । नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम् ॥
translation: Soma thou flowest chasing foes and bringing wisdom and delight: Drive off the folk who love not Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या ॥
translation: The Pavamânas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice, For holy lore of every kind.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः । घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः ॥
translation: The Pavamânas have been shed, the beautiful swift Soma-drops, Driving all enemies afar.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत । पृथिव्या अधि सानवि ॥
translation: From, heaven, from out the firmament, hath Pavamâna been effused Upon the summit of the earth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानः सोम धारयेन्दो विश्वा अप स्रिधः । जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो ॥
translation: O Soma, Indu, very wise, drive, being purified, with thy stream All foes, all Raksasas away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपघ्नन्त्सोम रक्षसोऽभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम् ॥
translation: Driving the Raksasas afar, O Soma, bellowing, pour for us Most excellent and splendid strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्मे वसूनि धारय सोम दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । इन्दो विश्वानि वार्या ॥
translation: Soma, do thou secure for us the treasures of the earih and heaven, Indu, all boons to be desired.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा सोम द्युमाँ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः । वृषा धर्माणि दधिषे ॥
translation: Soma, thou art a splendid Steer, a Steer, O God, with steerlike sway: Thou as a Steer ordainest laws.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यं शवो वृषा वनं वृषा मदः । सत्यं वृषन्वृषेदसि ॥
translation: Steer-strong thy might is as a steer's, steerstrong thywood, steer-like thy drink A Steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि ॥
translation: Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine: Unbar for us the doors to wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया । शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः ॥
translation: Out of desire of cows and steeds and horses. potent Soma-drops, Brilliant and swift, have been effused.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: शुम्भमाना ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः । पवन्ते वारे अव्यये ॥
translation: They purified in both the hands, made beautiful by holy men, Flow onward to the fleecy cloth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या ॥
translation: These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper From heaven and earth and firmament.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत । सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः ॥
translation: The streams of Pavamâna, thine, Finder of all, have been effused, Even as Sûrya's rays of light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: केतुं कृण्वन्दिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि । समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे ॥
translation: Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form Soma, thou swellest like a sea.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि । अक्रान्देवो न सूर्यः ॥
translation: Urged on thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamâna; thou hast moved, Like the God Sûrya, to the sieve.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुः पविष्ट चेतनः प्रियः कवीनां मती । सृजदश्वं रथीरिव ॥
translation: Indu, Enlightener, Friend, hath been purified by the sages' hymns: So starts the charioteer his steed-
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऊर्मिर्यस्ते पवित्र आ देवावीः पर्यक्षरत् । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
translation: Thy God-delighting wave which hath flowed to purifying seive, Alighting in the home of Law.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स नो अर्ष पवित्र आ मदो यो देववीतमः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: Flow to our sieve, a gladdening draught that hath most intercourse with Gods, Indu, to Indra for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः । इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि ॥
translation: Flow onward with a stream for food, made beautiful by sapient men: Indu with sheen approach the milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः । हरे सृजान आशिरम् ॥
translation: While thou art cleansed, Song-Lover, bring comfort and vigour to the folk, Poured, Tawny One! on milk and curds.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतम् । द्युतानो वाजिभिर्यतः ॥
translation: Purified for the feast of Gods, go thou to Indra's special place, Resplendent, guided by the strong.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र हिन्वानास इन्दवोऽच्छा समुद्रमाशवः । धिया जूता असृक्षत ॥
translation: Accelerated by the hymn, the rapid drops of Soma juice Have flowed, urged onward, to the lake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मर्मृजानास आयवो वृथा समुद्रमिन्दवः । अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
translation: Easily have the living drops, made beautiful, approached the lake, Yea, to the place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि णो याह्यस्मयुर्विश्वा वसून्योजसा । पाहि नः शर्म वीरवत् ॥
translation: Compass about, our faithful Friend, all our possessions with thy might: Guard, hero like, our sheltering home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मिमाति वह्निरेतशः पदं युजान ऋक्वभिः । प्र यत्समुद्र आहितः ॥
translation: Loud neighs the Courser Etaṣa, with singers, harnessed for the place, Guided for travel to the lake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययमाशुॠतस्य सीदति । जहात्यप्रचेतसः ॥
translation: What time the Swift One resteth in the golden place of sacrifice, He leaves the foolish far away.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अभि वेना अनूषतेयक्षन्ति प्रचेतसः । मज्जन्त्यविचेतसः ॥
translation: The friends have sung in unison, the prudent wish to sacrifice: Down sink the unintelligent.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
translation: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in sweets, To sit in place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परि ष्कृण्वन्ति वेधसः । सं त्वा मृजन्त्यायवः ॥
translation: Controlling priests and sages skilled in holy song adorn thee well: The living make thee beautiful.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्ति वरुणः कवे । पवमानस्य मरुतः ॥
translation: Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa drink Pavamâna's juice, yea, thine: O Sage, the Maruts drink thereof.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं पुनानो वाचमिष्यसि । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसम् ॥
translation: O Soma, Indu, thou while thou art purified urgest onward speech. Thousandfold, with the lore of hymns.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उतो सहस्रभर्णसं वाचं सोम मखस्युवम् । पुनान इन्दवा भर ॥
translation: Yea, Soma, Indu, while thou art purified do thou bring to us Speech thousandfold that longs for war.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनान इन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् । प्रियः समुद्रमा विश ॥
translation: O Indu, Much-invoked, while thou art purifying, as the Friend. Of these men enter thou the lake.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा । सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः ॥
translation: Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly. And form that utters loud acclaim.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वानो हेतृभिर्यत आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत् । सीदन्तो वनुषो यथा ॥
translation: Led by his drivers, and sent forth, the Strong Steed hath come nigh for spoil, Like warriors when they stand arrayed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋधक्सोम स्वस्तये संजग्मानो दिवः कविः । पवस्व सूर्यो दृशे ॥
translation: Specially, Soma, coming as a Sage from heaven to prosper us, Flow like the Sun for us to see.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिम् । महामिन्दुं महीयुवः ॥
translation: THE, glittering maids send Sura forth, the glorious sisters, close-allied, Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । विश्वा वसून्या विश ॥
translation: Pervade, O Pavamâna, all our treasures with repeated light, God, coming hither from the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः । इषे पवस्व संयतम् ॥
translation: Pour on us, Pavamâna, rain, as service and rain praise for Gods: Pour all to be our nourishment.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे । पवमान स्वाध्यः ॥
translation: Thou art a Steer by lustre: we, O Pavamâna, faithfully Call upon thee the Splendid One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध । इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि ॥
translation: Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength: O Indu, come thou bitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदद्भिः परिषिच्यसे मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । द्रुणा सधस्थमश्नुषे ॥
translation: When thou art cleansed with both the hands and dipped in waters, with the wood. Thou comest to the gathering-place.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोमाय व्यश्ववत्पवमानाय गायत । महे सहस्रचक्षसे ॥
translation: Sing forth your songs, as Vyaṣva sang, to Soma Pavamâna, to, The Mighty One with thousand eyes;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य वर्णं मधुश्चुतं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये ॥
translation: Whose coloured sap they drive with stones, the yellow meath-distilling juice, Indu for Indra, for his drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तस्य ते वाजिनो वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे ॥
translation: We seek to gain the friendly love of thee that Strong and Mighty One, Of thee the winner of all wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः । विश्वा दधान ओजसा ॥
translation: Flow onward with thy stream, a Steer, inspiriting the Maruts' Lord, Winning all riches by thy might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा धर्तारमोण्यो३ः पवमान स्वर्दृशम् । हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम् ॥
translation: I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamâna, Strong, Sustainer, looker on the light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया । युजं वाजेषु चोदय ॥
translation: Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawny-coloured, with thy stream Incite to battle thine ally.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ न इन्दो महीमिषं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः । अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित् ॥
translation: O Indu, visible to all pour out for us abundant food: Soma, be thou our prosperer.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ कलशा अनूषतेन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । एन्द्रस्य पीतये विश ॥
translation: The pitchers, Indu, with thy streams have sung aloud in vigorous might Enter them, and let Indra drink.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते मद्यं रसं तीव्रं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः । स पवस्वाभिमातिहा ॥
translation: O thou whose potent gladdening juice they milk out with the stones, flow on, Destroyer of our enemies.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे ॥
translation: King Pavamâna is implored with holy songs, on man's behalf, To travel through the firmament.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यम् । वहा भगत्तिमूतये ॥
translation: Bring us, O Indu, hundredfold increase of kine, and noble steeds, The gift of fortune for our help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर । सुष्वाणो देववीतये ॥
translation: Pressed for the banquet of the Gods, O Soma, bring us might, and speed, Like beauty for a brilliant show.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् । सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा ॥
translation: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the wooden vats, Falcon-like resting in thine home.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे ॥
translation: Soma, the Water-winner flows to Indra, Vâyu, Varuṇa, To Vishṇu and the Marut host.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम् ॥
translation: Soma , bestowing food upon our progeny, from every sides, Pour on us riches thousandfold
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । ये वादः शर्यणावति ॥
translation: The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand, Or there on Saryanavan's bank,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम् । ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु ॥
translation: Those pressed among Ârjîkas, pressed among the active, in men's homes, Or pressed among the Races Five-
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः ॥
translation: May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow, Rain from the heavens apd hero strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवते हर्यतो हरिर्गृणानो जमदग्निना । हिन्वानो गोरधि त्वचि ॥
translation: Urged forward o'er the ox-hide flows the Lovely One of tawny hue, Lauded by Jamadagni's song.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र शुक्रासो वयोजुवो हिन्वानासो न सप्तयः । श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत ॥
translation: Like horses urged to speed, the drops, bright, stirring vital power, when blent With milk, are beautified in streams.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तं त्वा सुतेष्वाभुवो हिन्विरे देवतातये । स पवस्वानया रुचा ॥
translation: So they who toil with juices send thee forward for the Gods' repast: So with this splendour flow thou on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
translation: We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the Strong, that brings us bliss, The Guardian, the desire of all,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणम् । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
translation: The Excellent, the Gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands, The Guardian, the desire of all;
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम् ॥
translation: Who for ourselves, O thou Most Wise, is wealth and fair intelligence, The Guardian, the desire of all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व विश्वचर्षणेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या । सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः ॥
translation: FOR holy lore of every sort, flow onward thou whom all men love. A Friend to be besought by friends.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ताभ्यां विश्वस्य राजसि ये पवमान धामनी । प्रतीची सोम तस्थतुः ॥
translation: O'er all thou rulest with these Two which, Soma Pavamâna, stand, Turned, as thy stations, hitherward.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि धामानि यानि ते त्वं सोमासि विश्वतः । पवमान ऋतुभिः कवे ॥
translation: Wise Soma Pavamâna, thou encompassest on every side Thy stations as the seasons come.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व जनयन्निषोऽभि विश्वानि वार्या । सखा सखिभ्य ऊतये ॥
translation: Flow onward, generating food, for precious boons of every kind, A Friend for friends, to be our help.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तव शुक्रासो अर्चयो दिवस्पृष्ठे वि तन्वते । पवित्रं सोम धामभिः ॥
translation: Upon the lofty ridge of heaven thy bright rays with their essences, Soma, spread purifying power.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तवेमे सप्त सिन्धवः प्रशिषं सोम सिस्रते । तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः ॥
translation: O Soma, these Seven Rivers flow, as being thine, to give command: The Streams of milk run forth to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सोम याहि धारया सुत इन्द्राय मत्सरः । दधानो अक्षिति श्रवः ॥
translation: Flow onward, Soma in a stream, effused to gladden Indra's heart, Bringing imperishable fame.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समु त्वा धीभिरस्वरन्हिन्वतीः सप्त जामयः । विप्रमाजा विवस्वतः ॥
translation: Driving thee in Vivasvan's course, the Seven Sisters with their hymns Made melody round thee the Sage.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मृजन्ति त्वा समग्रुवोऽव्ये जीरावधि ष्वणि । रेभो यदज्यसे वने ॥
translation: The virgins deck thee o'er fresh streams to drive thee to the sieve when thou, A singer, bathest in the wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन्त्सर्गा असृक्षत । अर्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः ॥
translation: The streams of Pavamâna, thine, Sage, Mighty One, have pouredthem forth. Like coursers eager for renown.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतमसृग्रं वारे अव्यये । अवावशन्त धीतयः ॥
translation: They have been poured upon the fleece towards the meath-distilling vat: The holy songs have sounded forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अच्छा समुद्रमिन्दवोऽस्तं गावो न धेनवः । अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा ॥
translation: Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake, Have reached the place of sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र ण इन्दो महे रण आपो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे ॥
translation: O Indu, to our great delight the running waters flow to us, When thou wilt robe thyself in milk.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य ते सख्ये वयमियक्षन्तस्त्वोतयः । इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि ॥
translation: In this thy friendship, and with thee to help us, fain to sacrifice, Indu, we crave thy friendly love.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ पवस्व गविष्टये महे सोम नृचक्षसे । एन्द्रस्य जठरे विश ॥
translation: Flow on, O Soma, for the great Viewer of men, for gain of Idne Enter thou into Indra's throat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महाँ असि सोम ज्येष्ठ उग्राणामिन्द ओजिष्ठः । युध्वा सञ्छश्वज्जिगेथ ॥
translation: Best art thou, Soma, of the great, Strongest of strong ones, Indu: thou As Warrior ever hast prevailed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: य उग्रेभ्यश्चिदोजीयाञ्छूरेभ्यश्चिच्छूरतरः । भूरिदाभ्यश्चिन्मंहीयान् ॥
translation: Mightier even than the strong, more valiant even than the brave, More libpral than the bountiful,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोम सूर एषस्तोकस्य साता तनूनाम् । वृणीमहे सख्याय वृणीमहे युज्याय ॥
translation: Soma, as Sura, bring us food, win offspring of our bodies: we Elect thee for our friendship, we elect thee for companionship.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्न आयूंषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् ॥
translation: Agni, thou pourest life; send down upon us food and vigorous strength; Drive thou misfortune far away,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्निॠषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः । तमीमहे महागयम् ॥
translation: Agni is Pavamâna, Sage, Chief Priest of all the Races Five: To him whose wealth is great we pray.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम् । दधद्रयिं मयि पोषम् ॥
translation: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us, Granting me wealth that nourishes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो अति स्रिधोऽभ्यर्षति सुष्टुतिम् । सूरो न विश्वदर्शतः ॥
translation: Beyond his enemies away to sweet praise Pavamâna flows, Like Sûrya visible to all.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स मर्मृजान आयुभिः प्रयस्वान्प्रयसे हितः । इन्दुरत्यो विचक्षणः ॥
translation: Adorned by living men, set forth for entertainment, rich in food, Far-sighted Indu is a Steed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमान ऋतं बृहच्छुक्रं ज्योतिरजीजनत् । कृष्णा तमांसि जङ्घनत् ॥
translation: He, Pavamâna, hath produced the lofty Law, the brilliant light, Destroying darkness black of hue.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानस्य जङ्घ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत । जीरा अजिरशोचिषः ॥
translation: From tawny Pavamâna, the Destroyer, radiant streams have sprung, Quick streams from him whose gleams are swift.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः । हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः ॥
translation: Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise mid beauteous ones, Gold-gleaming with the Marut host,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानो व्यश्नवद्रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: May Pavamâna, best to win the booty, penetrate with rays, Giving the singer hero strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र सुवान इन्दुरक्षाः पवित्रमत्यव्ययम् । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा ॥
translation: Over the fleecy sieve hath flowed the drop effused: to Indra comes Indu while he is purified
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष सोमो अधि त्वचि गवां क्रीळत्यद्रिभिः । इन्द्रं मदाय जोहुवत् ॥
translation: This Soma, through the pressing-stones, is sporting on the oxhide, and Summoning Indra to the draught.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्य ते द्युम्नवत्पयः पवमानाभृतं दिवः । तेन नो मृळ जीवसे ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, bless us, so that we may live, with that bright milk Of thine which hath been brought from heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे । पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः ॥
translation: THOU, Soma, hast a running stream, joyous, most strong at sacrifice: Flow bounteously bestowing wealth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सुतो नृमादनो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः । इन्द्राय सूरिरन्धसा ॥
translation: Effused as cheerer of the men, flowing best gladdener, thou art A Prince to Indra with thy juice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वं सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम् ॥
translation: Poured forth by pressing-stones, do thou with loud roar send us in a stream Most excellent illustrious might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । हरिर्वाजमचिक्रदत् ॥
translation: Indu, urged forward, floweth through the fleecy cloth: the Tawny One With his loud roar hath brought as strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्दो व्यव्यमर्षसि वि श्रवांसि वि सौभगा । वि वाजान्त्सोम गोमतः ॥
translation: Indu, thou flowest through the fleece, bringing felicities and fame, And, Soma, spoil and wealth in kine.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । भरा सोम सहस्रिणम् ॥
translation: Hither, O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds and cattle hundredfold: Bring wealth, O Soma, thousandfold.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानास इन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । इन्द्रं यामेभिराशत ॥
translation: In purifying, through the sieve the rapid drops of'Soma juice Come nigh to Indra in their course.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ककुहः सोम्यो रस इन्दुरिन्द्राय पूर्व्यः । आयुः पवत आयवे ॥
translation: For Indra floweth excellent Indu, the noblest Soma juice The Living for the Living One.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् । अभि गिरा समस्वरन् ॥
translation: The glittering maids send Sura forth they with their song have sung aloud To Pavamâna dropping meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अविता नो अजाश्वः पूषा यामनियामनि । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
translation: May Pûshan, drawn by goats, be our protector, and on all his paths Bestow on us our share of maids.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं सोमः कपर्दिने घृतं न पवते मधु । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
translation: This Soma flows like gladdening oil for him who wears the braided locks: He shall give us our share of maids.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं त आघृणे सुतो घृतं न पवते शुचि । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः ॥
translation: This Soma juice, O glowing God, flows like pure oil, effused for thee: He shall give us our share of maids.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वाचो जन्तुः कवीनां पवस्व सोम धारया । देवेषु रत्नधा असि ॥
translation: Flow onward, Soma, in thy stream, begetter of the sages' speech: Wealth-giver among Gods art thou.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आ कलशेषु धावति श्येनो वर्म वि गाहते । अभि द्रोणा कनिक्रदत् ॥
translation: The Falcon dips within the jars: he wrap.him in his robe and goes Loud roaring to the vats of wood.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परि प्र सोम ते रसोऽसर्जि कलशे सुतः । श्येनो न तक्तो अर्षति ॥
translation: Soma, thy juice hath been effused and poured into the pitcher: like A rapid hawk it rushes on.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः ॥
translation: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: असृग्रन्देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
translation: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots that display their strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ते सुतासो मदिन्तमाः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत ॥
translation: Brilliant, best givers of delight, these juices have sent Vâyu forth.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ग्राव्णा तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् ॥
translation: Bruised by the press-stones and extolled, Soma, thou goest to the sieve, Giving the worshipper hero strength.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एष तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रमति गाहते । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम् ॥
translation: This juice bruised by the pressing-stones and lauded passes through the sieve, Slayer of demons, through the fleece.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यदन्ति यच्च दूरके भयं विन्दति मामिह । पवमान वि तज्जहि ॥
translation: O Pavamâna, drive away the danger, whether near at hand Or far remote, that finds me here.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पवमानः सो अद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः । यः पोता स पुनातु नः ॥
translation: This day may Pavamâna cleanse us with his purifying power, Most active purifying Priest.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमन्तरा । ब्रह्म तेन पुनीहि नः ॥
translation: O Agni, with the cleansing light diffused through all thy fiery glow, Purify thou this prayer of ours.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिवदग्ने तेन पुनीहि नः । ब्रह्मसवैः पुनीहि नः ॥
translation: Cleanse us with thine own cleansing power, O Agni, that is bright with flame, And by libations poured to thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च । मां पुनीहि विश्वतः ॥
translation: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिभिष्ट्वं देव सवितर्वर्षिष्ठैः सोम धामभिः । अग्ने दक्षैः पुनीहि नः ॥
translation: Cleanse us, God Savitar, with Three, O Soma, with sublimest forms, Agni, with forms of power and might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पुनन्तु मां देवजनाः पुनन्तु वसवो धिया । विश्वे देवाः पुनीत मा जातवेदः पुनीहि मा ॥
translation: May the Gods' company make me clean, and Vasus make rue pure by song. Purify me, ye General Gods; O Jâtavedas, make me pure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र प्यायस्व प्र स्यन्दस्व सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः । देवेभ्य उत्तमं हविः ॥
translation: Fill thyself full of juice, flow forth, O Soma, thou with all thy stalks, The best oblation to the Gods.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उप प्रियं पनिप्नतं युवानमाहुतीवृधम् । अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः ॥
translation: We with our homage have approached the Friend who seeks our wondering praise, Young, strengthener of the solemn rite.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अलाय्यस्य परशुर्ननाश तमा पवस्व देव सोम । आखुं चिदेव देव सोम ॥
translation: Lost is Alâyya's axe. O Soma, God do thou send it back hither in thy flow Even, Soma, God, if 'twere a mole.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् । सर्वं स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना ॥
translation: The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pâvamânî hymns, Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Mâtariṣvan's touch.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् । तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकम् ॥
translation: Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pâvamânî hymns, Sarasvatî draws forth for him water and butter, milk and meath.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र देवमच्छा मधुमन्त इन्दवोऽसिष्यदन्त गाव आ न धेनवः । बर्हिषदो वचनावन्त ऊधभिः परिस्रुतमुस्रिया निर्णिजं धिरे ॥
translation: THE drops of Soma juice like cows who yield their milk have flowed forth, rich in meath, unto the Shining One, And, seated on the grass, raising their voice, assumed the milk, the covering robe wherewith the udders stream.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स रोरुवदभि पूर्वा अचिक्रददुपारुहः श्रथयन्त्स्वादते हरिः । तिरः पवित्रं परियन्नुरु ज्रयो नि शर्याणि दधते देव आ वरम् ॥
translation: He bellows with a roar arourd the highest twigs: the Tawny One is sweetened as he breaks them up. Then passing through the sieve into the ample room, the God throws off the dregs according to his wish.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वि यो ममे यम्या संयती मदः साकंवृधा पयसा पिन्वदक्षिता । मही अपारे रजसी विवेविददभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाज आ ददे ॥
translation: The gladdening drink that measured out the meeting Twins fills full with milk the Eternal Everwaxing Pair. Bringing to light the Two great Regions limitless, moving above them he gained sheen that never fades.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: स मातरा विचरन्वाजयन्नपः प्र मेधिरः स्वधया पिन्वते पदम् । अंशुर्यवेन पिपिशे यतो नृभिः सं जामिभिर्नसते रक्षते शिरः ॥
translation: Wandering through, the Parents, strengthening the floods, the Sage makes his place swell with his own native might. The stalk is mixed with grain: he comes led by the men together with the sisters, and preserves the Head.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं दक्षेण मनसा जायते कविॠतस्य गर्भो निहितो यमा परः । यूना ह सन्ता प्रथमं वि जज्ञतुर्गुहा हितं जनिम नेममुद्यतम् ॥
translation: With energetic intellect the Sage is born, deposited as germ of Law, far from the Twins. They being young at first showed visibly distinct the Creature that is half-concealed and halfexposed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मन्द्रस्य रूपं विविदुर्मनीषिणः श्येनो यदन्धो अभरत्परावतः । तं मर्जयन्त सुवृधं नदीष्वाँ उशन्तमंशुं परियन्तमृग्मियम् ॥
translation: The sages knew the form of him the Gladdener, what time the Falcon brought the plant from far away. Him who assures success they beautified in streams, the stalk who yearned therefor, mighty and meet for praise.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्वां मृजन्ति दश योषणः सुतं सोम ऋषिभिर्मतिभिर्धीतिभिर्हितम् । अव्यो वारेभिरुत देवहूतिभिर्नृभिर्यतो वाजमा दर्षि सातये ॥
translation: Together with the R̥ishis, with their prayers and hymns ten women deck thee, Soma, friendly when effused. Led by the men, with invocations of the Gods, through the fleece, thou hast given us strength to win the spoil.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: परिप्रयन्तं वय्यं सुषंसदं सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभः । यो धारया मधुमाँ ऊर्मिणा दिव इयर्ति वाचं रयिषाळमर्त्यः ॥
translation: Songs resonant with praise have celebrated him. Soma, Friend, springing forth with his fair company. Even him who rich in meath, with undulating stream, Winnner of Wealth, Immortal, sends his voice from heaven,
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अयं दिव इयर्ति विश्वमा रजः सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति । अद्भिर्गोभिर्मृज्यते अद्रिभिः सुतः पुनान इन्दुर्वरिवो विदत्प्रियम् ॥
translation: He sends it into all the region forth from heaven. Soma, while he is filtcred, settles in the jars. With milk and waters is he decked when pressed with stones: Indu, when purified, shall find sweet rest and room.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमानो वयो दधच्चित्रतमं पवस्व । अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम् ॥
translation: Even thus poured forth How on thy way, O Soma, vouchsafing us most manifold lively vigour. We will invoke benevolent Earth and Heaven. Give us, ye Gods, riches with noble heroes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इषुर्न धन्वन्प्रति धीयते मतिर्वत्सो न मातुरुप सर्ज्यूधनि । उरुधारेव दुहे अग्र आयत्यस्य व्रतेष्वपि सोम इष्यते ॥
translation: LAID like an arrow on the bow the hymn hath been loosed like a young calf to the udder of its dam. As one who cometh first with full stream she is milked the Soma is impelled to this man's holy rites.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि । पवमानः संतनिः प्रघ्नतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति ॥
translation: The thought is deeply fixed; the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth; And Pavamâna, like the shout of combatants, the drop rising in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अव्ये वधूयुः पवते परि त्वचि श्रथ्नीते नप्तीरदितेॠतं यते । हरिरक्रान्यजतः संयतो मदो नृम्णा शिशानो महिषो न शोभते ॥
translation: He flows about the sheep-skin, longing for a bride: he looses Aditi's Daughters for the worshipper. The sacred drink hath come, gold-tinted, well-restrained: like a strong Bull he shines, whetting his manly might.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उक्षा मिमाति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतम् । अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत ॥
translation: The Bull is bellowing; the Cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God's own restingplace. Onward hath Soma passed through the sheep's fair bright fleece, and hath, as 'twere, endued a garment newly washed.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अमृक्तेन रुशता वाससा हरिरमर्त्यो निर्णिजानः परि व्यत । दिवस्पृष्ठं बर्हणा निर्णिजे कृतोपस्तरणं चम्वोर्नभस्मयम् ॥
translation: The golden-hued, Immortal, newly bathed, puts on a brightly shining vesture that is never harmed. He made the ridge of heaven to be his radiant robe, by sprinkling of the bowls from moisture of the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुपः साकमीरते । तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन ॥
translation: Even as the beams of Sûrya, urging men to speed, that cheer and send to sleep, together rush they forth, These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सिन्धोरिव प्रवणे निम्न आशवो वृषच्युता मदासो गातुमाशत । शं नो निवेशे द्विपदे चतुष्पदेऽस्मे वाजाः सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः ॥
