translation: O MUCH-INVOKED, thou hast subdued thy foemen: thy might is loftiest; here display thy bounty. In thy right hand, O Indra, bring us treasures: thou art the Lord of rivers filled with riches.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: मृगो न भीमः कुचरो गिरिष्ठाः परावत आ जगन्था परस्याः । सृकं संशाय पविमिन्द्र तिग्मं वि शत्रून्ताळ्हि वि मृधो नुदस्व ॥
translation: Like a dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bold and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foe and scatter those who hate us.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: इन्द्र क्षत्रमभि वाममोजोऽजायथा वृषभ चर्षणीनाम् । अपानुदो जनममित्रयन्तमुरुं देवेभ्यो अकृणोरु लोकम् ॥
translation: Thou, mighty Indra, sprangest into being as strength for lovely lordship o'er the people. Thou drovest off the folk who were unfriendly, and to the Gods thou gavest room and freedom.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्रथश्च यस्य सप्रथश्च नामानुष्टुभस्य हविषो हविर्यत् । धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णो रथंतरमा जभारा वसिष्ठः ॥
translation: Vasishṭha mastered the Rathantara, took it from radiant Dhatar, Savitar, and Vishṇu, Oblation, portion of fourfold oblation, known by the names of Saprathas and Prathas.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अविन्दन्ते अतिहितं यदासीद्यज्ञस्य धाम परमं गुहा यत् । धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोर्भरद्वाजो बृहदा चक्रे अग्नेः ॥
translation: These sages found what lay remote and hidden, the sacrifice's loftiest secret essence. From radiant Dhatar, Savitar, and Vishṇu, from Agni, Bharadvâja brought the Br̥ihat.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तेऽविन्दन्मनसा दीध्याना यजुः ष्कन्नं प्रथमं देवयानम् । धातुर्द्युतानात्सवितुश्च विष्णोरा सूर्यादभरन्घर्ममेते ॥
translation: They found with mental eyes the earliest Yajus, a pathway to the Gods, that had descended. From radiant Dhitar, Savitar, and Vishṇu, from Sûrya did these sages bring the Gharma.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: बृहस्पतिर्नयतु दुर्गहा तिरः पुनर्नेषदघशंसाय मन्म । क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
translation: Br̥ihaspati lead us safely over troubless and turn his evil thought against the sinner; Repel the curse, and drive away ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and cornfort!
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नराशंसो नोऽवतु प्रयाजे शं नो अस्त्वनुयाजो हवेषु । क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
translation: May Narâṣansa aid us at Prayâja: blest be our Anuyâja at invokings. May he repel the curse, and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: तपुर्मूर्धा तपतु रक्षसो ये ब्रह्मद्विषः शरवे हन्तवा उ । क्षिपदशस्तिमप दुर्मतिं हन्नथा करद्यजमानाय शं योः ॥
translation: May he whose head is flaming burn the demons, haters of prayer, so that the arrow slay them. May he repel the curse and chase ill-feeling, and give the sacrificer peace and comfort.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपश्यं त्वा मनसा चेकितानं तपसो जातं तपसो विभूतम् । इह प्रजामिह रयिं रराणः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकाम ॥
translation: I SAW thee meditating in thy spirit what sprang from Fervour and hath thence developed. Bestowing offspring here, bestowing riches, spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अपश्यं त्वा मनसा दीध्यानां स्वायां तनू ऋत्व्ये नाधमानाम् । उप मामुच्चा युवतिर्बभूयाः प्र जायस्व प्रजया पुत्रकामे ॥
translation: I saw thee pondering in thine heart, and praying that in due time thy body might be fruitful. Come as a youthful woman, rise to meet me: spread in thine offspring, thou who cravest children.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अहं गर्भमदधामोषधीष्वहं विश्वेषु भुवनेष्वन्तः । अहं प्रजा अजनयं पृथिव्यामहं जनिभ्यो अपरीषु पुत्रान् ॥
translation: In plants and herbs, in all existent beings I have deposited the germ of increase. All progeny on earth have I engendered, and sons in women who will be hereafter.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: विष्णुर्योनिं कल्पयतु त्वष्टा रूपाणि पिंशतु । आ सिञ्चतु प्रजापतिर्धाता गर्भं दधातु ते ॥
translation: MAY Vishṇu form and mould the womb, may Tvashṭar duly shape the forms, Prajâpati infuse the stream, and Dhatar lay the germ for thee.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: गर्भं धेहि सिनीवालि गर्भं धेहि सरस्वति । गर्भं ते अश्विनौ देवावा धत्तां पुष्करस्रजा ॥
translation: O Sinîvâlî, set the germ, set thou the germ, Sarasvatî: May the Twain Gods bestow the germ, the Aṣvins crowned with lotuses.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: हिरण्ययी अरणी यं निर्मन्थतो अश्विना । तं तत गर्भं हवामहे दशमे मासि सूतवे ॥
translation: That which the Aṣvins Twain rub forth with the attrition-sticks of gold,– That germ of thine we invocate, that in the tenth month thou mayst bear.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: महि त्रीणामवोऽस्तु द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य ॥
translation: GREAT, unassailable must he the heavenly favour of' Three Gods, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: नहि तेषाममा चन नाध्वसु वारणेषु । ईशे रिपुरघशंसः ॥
translation: O'er these, neither at home nor yet abroad or pathways that are Strange, The evil-minded foe hath power
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यस्मै पुत्रासो अदितेः प्र जीवसे मर्त्याय । ज्योतिर्यच्छन्त्यजस्रम् ॥
translation: Nor over him,. the man on whom the Sons of Aditi bestow Eternal light that he may live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: वात आ वातु भेषजं शम्भु मयोभु नो हृदे । प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥
translation: FILLING our hearts with health and joy, may Vâta breathe his balm on us May he prolong our days of life.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: उत वात पितासि न उत भ्रातोत नः सखा । स नो जीवातवे कृधि ॥
translation: Thou art our Father, Vâta, yea, thou art a Brother and a friend, So give us strength that we may live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यददो वात ते गृहे३ऽमृतस्य निधिर्हितः । ततो नो देहि जीवसे ॥
translation: The store of Amrit laid away yonder, O Vâta, in thine home,– Give us thereof that we may live.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्राग्नये वाचमीरय वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
translation: To Agni send I forth my song, to him the Bull of all the folk: So may he bear us past our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यः परस्याः परावतस्तिरो धन्वातिरोचते । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
translation: Who from the distance far away shines brilliantly across the wastes: So may he bear us past our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वति वृषा शुक्रेण शोचिषा । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
translation: The Bull with brightly-gleaming flame who utterly consumes the fiends So may he bear us past our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
translation: Who looks on all existing things and comprehends them with his view: So may he bear us past our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत । स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
translation: Resplendent Agni, who was born in farthest region of the air: So may he bear us past our foes.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: प्र नूनं जातवेदसमश्वं हिनोत वाजिनम् । इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
translation: Now send ye Jâtavedas forth, send hitherward the vigorous Steed To seat him on our sacred grass.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अस्य प्र जातवेदसो विप्रवीरस्य मीळ्हुषः । महीमियर्मि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
translation: I raise the lofty eulogy of Jâtavedas, raining boons, With sages for his hero band.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: या रुचो जातवेदसो देवत्रा हव्यवाहनीः । ताभिर्नो यज्ञमिन्वतु ॥
translation: With flames of Jâtavedas which carry oblation to the Gods, May he promote our sacrifice.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन्मातरं पुरः । पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः ॥
translation: THIS spotted Bull hath come, and sat before the Mother in the east, Advancing to his Father heaven.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: अन्तश्चरति रोचनास्य प्राणादपानती । व्यख्यन्महिषो दिवम् ॥
translation: Expiring when he draws his breath, she moves along the lucid spheres: The Bull shines out through all the sky.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: त्रिंशद्धाम वि राजति वाक्पतंगाय धीयते । प्रति वस्तोरह द्युभिः ॥
translation: Song is bestowed upon the Bird: it rules supreme through thirty realms Throughout the days at break of morn.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: ऋतं च सत्यं चाभीद्धात्तपसोऽध्यजायत । ततो रात्र्यजायत ततः समुद्रो अर्णवः ॥
translation: FROM Fervour kindled to its height Eternal Law and Truth were born: Thence was the Night produced, and thence the billowy flood of sea arose.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समुद्रादर्णवादधि संवत्सरो अजायत । अहोरात्राणि विदधद्विश्वस्य मिषतो वशी ॥
translation: From that same billowy flood of sea the Year was afterwards produced, Ordainer of the days nights, Lord over all who close the eye.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् । दिवं च पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षमथो स्वः ॥
translation: Dhatar, the great Creator, then formed in due order Sun and Moon. He formed in order Heaven and Earth, the regions of the air, and light.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: संसमिद्युवसे वृषन्नग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ । इळस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर ॥
translation: THOU, mighty Agni, gatherest up all that is precious for thy friend. Bring us all treasures as thou art enkindled in libation's place
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: सं गच्छध्वं सं वदध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् । देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ॥
translation: Assemble, speak together: let your minds be all of one accord, As ancient Gods unanimous sit down to their appointed share.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं मनः सह चित्तमेषाम् । समानं मन्त्रमभि मन्त्रये वः समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि ॥
translation: The place is common, common the assembly, common the mind, so be their thought united. A common purpose do I lay before you, and worship with your general oblation.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith

sanskrit: समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः । समानमस्तु वो मनो यथा वः सुसहासति ॥
translation: One and the same be your resolve, and be your minds of one accord. United be the thoughts of all that all may happily agree.
author: Ralph T.H. Griffith
